   Optional horizontal pixel ruler under the header — toggle “Ruler” (same row as DP #); minor ticks every 10px, labels every 100px (CSS px from viewport left).
   Min-wall analysis tabs (.m5-mw-panel): numbering restarts in each tab; first in-tab label is 2 because item 1 is the field above the tab strip (Internal: Damage mechanism; External: environment summary). Half remaining life row: M0 band readout then 1/2-life value. */

      <h3>1. Demonstration and Proof-of-Concept Website</h3>
      <p>OpenRBI is a free, user-operated demonstration and proof-of-concept website, including for training purposes. It has been developed to illustrate a transparent, traceable, and reviewable approach to Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) calculations and documentation.</p>
      <p>OpenRBI provides a calculation and record-management workspace for screening, training, education, calculation support, evaluation, discussion, and the preparation of user-controlled RBI calculation records.</p>
      <p>OpenRBI is not a production engineering system. It must not be used as the sole basis for engineering decisions, inspection planning, inspection interval extension, inspection deferral, fitness-for-service assessment, regulatory compliance decisions, maintenance deferral, risk acceptance, safety-critical decisions, plant operation, regulatory submissions, or authorisation for continued operation.</p>
      <p>A complete, deployable RBI system would require extensive customisation to national, local, and customer requirements — including codes, standards, data libraries, workflows, approvals, and record-keeping — before it could be considered fit for operational or decision-making use in any practical sense.</p>
      <h3>2. No Engineering Approval or Certification</h3>
      <p>OpenRBI exports user-generated RBI calculation records only. It does not issue approved, certified, or regulator-accepted RBI assessments.</p>
      <p>OpenRBI does not provide engineering certification, regulatory approval, statutory inspection approval, fitness-for-service approval, inspection interval approval, inspection deferral approval, plant safety assurance, or any other formal engineering approval.</p>
      <p>Engineering approval by OpenRBI is not provided. Regulatory approval is not provided. No certification status is conferred by OpenRBI.</p>
      <p>Access to or use of the website does not create a contract for professional engineering services, an engineer-client relationship, or any obligation to provide engineering advice, verification, certification, approval, maintenance, or ongoing support.</p>
      <p>Any professional engineering service provided separately by an RPEQ engineer is a separate engagement and must be governed by its own written scope of services and formally issued deliverables.</p>
      <h3>3. User Responsibility and Competent Review</h3>
      <p>OpenRBI is intended for use only by suitably qualified and experienced personnel.</p>
      <p>All calculations, inputs, assumptions, reference data, damage mechanisms, consequence assumptions, inspection history, inspection intervals, outputs, and conclusions must be independently checked by the user before use.</p>
      <p>Any output must be reviewed by a competent engineer, Registered Professional Engineer of Queensland (RPEQ), certified inspector, owner-user representative, statutory authority, or other appropriately qualified person where required by applicable law, site rules, codes, standards, and jurisdictional requirements.</p>
      <p>The user remains responsible for the final interpretation, acceptance, use, and implementation of any OpenRBI output.</p>
      <h3>4. Demonstration Data and Examples</h3>
      <p>Any pre-filled data, default values, sample records, demonstration examples, reference examples, and illustrative calculations are provided for demonstration purposes only.</p>
      <p>They must not be treated as recommended values, site-specific values, approved values, or suitable values for any actual plant, equipment, facility, or inspection programme.</p>
      <p>The user is responsible for replacing all example data with independently verified, site-specific information before any output is considered for further review.</p>
      <h3>5. Local Browser Processing and Data Control</h3>
      <p>OpenRBI operates within the user’s web browser. It does not require a login, user account, or registration.</p>
      <p>User-selected files, equipment data, inspection data, calculation records, and exported reports are processed locally within the browser. The OpenRBI application does not upload, transmit, receive, store, or retain the contents of user-selected files or user-generated RBI calculation records.</p>
      <p>OpenRBI does not use server-side storage, databases, external application programming interfaces, analytics scripts, third-party trackers, or data-upload services.</p>
      <p>The website is not an archival storage service. Users remain responsible for retaining their own master copies of all source files, exported files, PDF reports, calculation records, and supporting documents.</p>
      <h3>6. Website Updates, Version Control and Compatibility</h3>
      <p>OpenRBI may be updated periodically. Updates may change the website layout, features, calculation methods, assumptions, default values, examples, documentation, file formats, or outputs.</p>
      <p>Users are responsible for recording the OpenRBI version and date used for any retained calculation record. Users must independently verify outputs following any update.</p>
      <p>No representation is made that files or outputs created using one version of OpenRBI will remain identical to, or fully compatible with, a later version.</p>
      <h3>7. Website Availability and Downtime</h3>
      <p>The OpenRBI website may be unavailable from time to time due to maintenance, updates, technical issues, or other downtime.</p>
      <p>Continuous access is not guaranteed. The website, any feature, and the service itself may be changed, suspended, or discontinued at any time without notice.</p>
      <p>Users must not rely on the website as the sole repository for any file, calculation record, or supporting document.</p>
      <h3>8. Exported PDF Reports and Calculation Records</h3>
      <p>Any PDF report or calculation record exported from OpenRBI is a user-generated calculation record.</p>
      <p>It is not an engineering certificate, statutory inspection certificate, fitness-for-service approval, inspection deferral approval, regulatory compliance certificate, or plant safety assurance document.</p>
      <p>Review status: requires competent review before use.</p>
      <h3>9. Standards, Codes and Recommended Practices</h3>
      <p>OpenRBI supports API 580 and industry screening-style RBI workflows but does not claim to replace competent engineering review, statutory inspection, professional judgement, site procedures, owner-user responsibility, or regulatory approval.</p>
      <p>Any reference to standards, codes, or recommended practices is provided for calculation support and workflow alignment only. It is not a statement of compliance, certification, or approval.</p>

/* Read-only mode: ?readonly=1 or ?view=1 in URL */
var READONLY_MODE = (function(){
  try {
    var loc = typeof location !== "undefined" ? location : null;
    var p = loc && loc.search ? loc.search.slice(1).split("&") : [];
    for (var i = 0; i < p.length; i++) {
      var kv = p[i].split("=");
      if ((kv[0] === "readonly" || kv[0] === "view") && (kv[1] === "1" || kv[1] === "true" || !kv[1])) return true;
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return false;
})();

/* Apply one library's data (used by refLoad and refLoadAll) — client-side only */
function refApply(type, data, fname) {
  var arr = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.fluids||data.items||data.chemical||data.chemicals||data.materials||data.mechanisms||data.data||[data]);
  if (type === 'toxic' || type === 'other') {
    if (typeof data === 'string' && data.trim()) { try { data = JSON.parse(data); } catch(_) {} }
    arr = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data && data.fluid_properties_library) || (data && data.fluids) || (data && data.items) || (data && data.data) || (data ? [data] : []);
    if (!Array.isArray(arr) && data && typeof data === 'object') { if (data.fluid_properties_library && Array.isArray(data.fluid_properties_library)) { arr = data.fluid_properties_library; } else { var k=Object.keys(data); for (var i=0;i<k.length;i++){ var v=data[k[i]]; if(Array.isArray(v)&&v.length>0){ arr=v; break; }}}}
    if (arr.length === 1 && arr[0] && typeof arr[0] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(arr[0]) && arr[0].fluid_properties_library) { arr = arr[0].fluid_properties_library; }
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) arr = [];
  } else if (type === 'acid') {
    if (typeof data === 'string' && data.trim()) { try { data = JSON.parse(data); } catch(_) {} }
    arr = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data && data.acid_properties_library) || (data && data.fluids) || (data && data.items) || (data && data.data) || (data ? [data] : []);
    if (!Array.isArray(arr) && data && typeof data === 'object') { if (data.acid_properties_library && Array.isArray(data.acid_properties_library)) { arr = data.acid_properties_library; } else { var k=Object.keys(data); for (var i=0;i<k.length;i++){ var v=data[k[i]]; if(Array.isArray(v)&&v.length>0){ arr=v; break; }}}}
    if (arr.length === 1 && arr[0] && typeof arr[0] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(arr[0]) && arr[0].acid_properties_library) { arr = arr[0].acid_properties_library; }
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) arr = [];
  } else if (type === 'material') {
    if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) arr = data;
    else arr = data.rows || data.material_list || data.materials || data.Materials || data.items || data.data;
    if (!Array.isArray(arr) || arr.length === 0) {
      var dk = Object.keys(data || {});
      for (var di = 0; di < dk.length; di++) {
        var dv = data[dk[di]];
        if (Array.isArray(dv) && dv.length > 0) { arr = dv; break; }
      }
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) arr = [];
    if (arr.length === 1 && arr[0] && typeof arr[0] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(arr[0])) {
      var inner = arr[0].rows || arr[0].materials || arr[0].Materials || arr[0].items || arr[0].data;
      if (Array.isArray(inner) && inner.length > 0) arr = inner;
    }
    if (arr.length === 0 && data && typeof data === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data)) {
      var nested = data.result || data.data || data.response;
      if (nested && typeof nested === 'object') {
        var innerArr = nested.materials || nested.Materials || nested.rows || nested.items || nested.data;
        if (Array.isArray(innerArr) && innerArr.length > 0) arr = innerArr;
      }
    }
  } else if (type === 'tank_components') {
    if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) arr = data;
    else arr = data.tank_components || data.tankComponents || data.components || data.rows || data.items || data.data;
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) arr = [];
  }
  switch(type) {
    case 'location':
      REF.locationLib = (typeof m1_parseLocationLibObject === "function") ? m1_parseLocationLibObject(data) : data;
      REF.locationLibName = fname;
      if (typeof m1_popLocationSelects === "function") m1_popLocationSelects(!!activeAsset);
      break;
    case 'chem':
      REF.chemLib = arr; REF.chemLibName = fname;
      m2_popChemSelect(); m3_popFluidSelect(); m2_popRepDropdown();
      var m2src = m2_data || (activeAsset && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi ? activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry : null);
      var inhFluid = m2src && m2src.suggested_representative_fluid ? m2src.suggested_representative_fluid : null;
      if(inhFluid){ $("m3_fluidSel").value = inhFluid; m3_fluidChanged(); }
      if(m2_data) m2_updateRepHint();
      break;
    case 'toxic':
      REF.toxLib = arr; REF.toxLibName = fname;
      m2_popToxSelect();
      break;
    case 'acid':
      REF.acidLib = arr; REF.acidLibName = fname;
      m2_popAcidSelect();
      break;
    case 'other':
      REF.otherLib = arr; REF.otherLibName = fname;
      m2_popOtherSelect();
      if (m2_data) { m2_normalizeOtherItems(m2_data); m2_renderOtherTable(); }
      break;
    case 'material':
      REF.materialLib = arr; REF.materialLibName = fname;
      if(typeof m5_renderMinWallCalcs==="function"){ m5_renderMinWallCalcs("internal"); }
      if(typeof m1_renderComponentDesignTable==="function") m1_renderComponentDesignTable();
      break;
    case 'tank_components':
      var tcRows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.tank_components || data.tankComponents || data.components || arr || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(tcRows)) tcRows = [];
      REF.tankComponentLib = tcRows; REF.tankComponentLibName = fname;
      if(typeof m1_renderComponentDesignTable==="function") m1_renderComponentDesignTable();
      break;
    case 'damage':
      var dmArr = data.mechanisms||data.damage_mechanisms||data.data||data;
      if(!Array.isArray(dmArr)){var dk2=Object.keys(data);for(var di2=0;di2<dk2.length;di2++){var dv2=data[dk2[di2]];if(Array.isArray(dv2)&&dv2.length>0){dmArr=dv2;break;}}}
      if(!Array.isArray(dmArr)) dmArr=[data];
      REF.screenLib = {mechanisms:dmArr}; REF.screenLibName = fname;
      m5_defsMap = {}; m5_defsCount = 0;
      dmArr.forEach(function(d){
        var did=d.id||d.dm_id||d.mechanism_id||d.ID||"";
        if(did){ m5_defsMap[did]=d; m5_defsCount++; }
        var dname=d.name||d.mechanism_name||d.Name||"";
        if(dname) m5_defsMap["_name_"+dname.toLowerCase()]=d;
      });
      if (!m5_data) m5_data = m5_blank();
      m5_data.screening_source = fname;
      m5_populateFilters(); m5_applyFilter();
      break;
    case 'gff':
      var gffRows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.gff || data.generic_failure_frequency || data.generic_failure_gff || data.rows || data.items || data.data || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(gffRows)) gffRows = [];
      REF.gffLib = gffRows; REF.gffLibName = fname;
      if (typeof m5_populateGenericFailure === "function") m5_populateGenericFailure();
      break;
    case 'pof_mapping':
      var pofRows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.pof_mapping || data.pofMapping || data.bands || data.rows || data.items || data.data || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(pofRows)) pofRows = [];
      REF.pofMapping = pofRows; REF.pofMappingName = fname;
      if(typeof m6_calc==="function") m6_calc();
      break;
    case 'half_remaining_life':
      var halfRows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.half_remaining_life || data.halfRemainingLife || data.bands || data.rows || data.items || data.data || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(halfRows)) halfRows = [];
      REF.halfRemainingLife = halfRows; REF.halfRemainingLifeName = fname;
      if (typeof m5_renderMinWallCalcs === "function" && typeof m5_data !== "undefined" && m5_data) {
        m5_renderMinWallCalcs("internal");
      }
      if (typeof m6_calc === "function") m6_calc();
      break;
    case 'susceptibility':
    case 'cracking_susceptibility':
      var susRows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.susceptibility || data.susceptibility_bands || data.cracking_susceptibility || data.bands || data.rows || data.items || data.data || []);
      if (!Array.isArray(susRows)) susRows = [];
      REF.susceptibilityBands = susRows; REF.susceptibilityBandsName = fname;
      if(typeof m5_renderCrackingCalcs==="function") m5_renderCrackingCalcs();
      break;
    case 'management_questionnaire':
      var mq = (data && typeof data === "object" && !Array.isArray(data)) ? data : {};
      REF.managementQuestionnaire = mq; REF.managementQuestionnaireName = fname;
      if (!m5_data) m5_data = m5_blank();
      if (!m5_data.management_questionnaire || typeof m5_data.management_questionnaire !== "object") {
        m5_data.management_questionnaire = {answers:{},pscore:null,fms:null};

      if (typeof m5_recalcManagementScores === "function") m5_recalcManagementScores();

      if (data.dimensions && !data.consequence) { data = { consequence: { dimensions: data.dimensions }, probability: data.probability || {} }; }
      REF.riskConfig = data; REF.riskConfigName = fname;

      REF.consequenceDimensions = Array.isArray(dims) ? dims : [];

/* Load one library from file picker — .csv only (embedded payload_json row or rules-bundle CSV). */
function refLoad(type) {
  if (typeof OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED !== "undefined" && OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED) {
    alert(typeof osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage === "function" ? osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage() : "Reference libraries are fixed from the approved M0 RBI Data in this application.");
    return;
  }
  var inp = document.createElement("input");
  inp.type = "file";
  inp.accept = ".csv,text/csv";
  inp.onchange = function() {
    if (!inp.files.length) return;
    var fname = inp.files[0].name;
    var r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = function() {
      try {
        var text = String(r.result || "");
        var data = tryParseCsvEmbeddedJsonPayload(text);
        if (data == null) {
          var rules = parseRulesCsv(text);
          data = refPickLibraryFromRulesCsvObject(rules, type);
        }
        if (data == null) {
          alert("Could not load this CSV for the selected reference.\n\nUse either:\n• A rules bundle CSV that includes the matching library section (same as File → Load User Rules CSV), or\n• A 2-row CSV with header format,version,payload_json and the library data in the payload_json cell.");
          return;
        }
        refApply(type, data, fname);
      } catch (e) {
        alert("Invalid or unsupported reference CSV: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
      }
    };
    r.readAsText(inp.files[0], "UTF-8");
  };
  inp.click();
}

/* Apply rules from an object (used by refLoadRulesCSV and applyDemoRules). Returns number of libraries loaded. */
function refApplyRulesFromObject(data, fname) {
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object" || Array.isArray(data)) return 0;
  var loaded = 0;
  function findTopLevelValue(obj, key, fallbackKeys) {
    if (!obj || typeof obj !== "object") return undefined;
    if (obj[key] !== undefined) return obj[key];
    var keysToTry = Array.isArray(fallbackKeys) ? fallbackKeys.slice() : [];
    keysToTry.unshift(key);
    var lowerMap = {};
    Object.keys(obj).forEach(function(k) { lowerMap[String(k).toLowerCase()] = k; });
    for (var i = 0; i < keysToTry.length; i++) {
      var want = String(keysToTry[i] || "").toLowerCase();
      if (!want) continue;
      var hit = lowerMap[want];
      if (hit !== undefined) return obj[hit];
    }
    return undefined;
  }
  function normalizeMaybeJson(v) {
    if (typeof v !== "string") return v;
    var s = v.trim();
    if (!s) return v;
    if (s.charAt(0) === "{" || s.charAt(0) === "[") {
      try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (_) { return v; }
    }
    return v;
  }
  function applyIfPresent(type, key, fallbackKeys, displayName) {
    var containers = [
      data,
      data.rules,
      data.rule_set,
      data.ruleSet,
      data.libraries,
      data.library,
      data.refs,
      data.reference,
      data.references
    ].filter(function(x){ return x && typeof x === "object" && !Array.isArray(x); });
    var v;
    for (var ci = 0; ci < containers.length; ci++) {
      v = findTopLevelValue(containers[ci], key, fallbackKeys);
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null) break;
    }
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return;
    v = normalizeMaybeJson(v);
    refApply(type, v, fname + " -> " + (displayName || key));
    loaded++;
  }

  applyIfPresent("location", "location");
  applyIfPresent("chem", "chemical", ["chem", "chemicals"]);
  applyIfPresent("toxic", "toxic");
  applyIfPresent("acid", "acid");
  applyIfPresent("other", "other", ["other_inventory", "other_fluids", "other_chemistry"]);
  if ((!REF.toxLib || !REF.toxLib.length) && data && (data.toxic !== undefined && data.toxic !== null)) { refApply("toxic", data.toxic, fname + " -> toxic"); loaded++; }
  if ((!REF.acidLib || !REF.acidLib.length) && data && (data.acid !== undefined && data.acid !== null)) { refApply("acid", data.acid, fname + " -> acid"); loaded++; }
  if ((!REF.otherLib || !REF.otherLib.length) && data && (data.other !== undefined && data.other !== null)) { refApply("other", data.other, fname + " -> other"); loaded++; }
  applyIfPresent("material", "materials", ["material", "material_list"]);
  applyIfPresent("tank_components", "tankComponents", ["tank_components", "components", "tank_component_library"], "Tank components");
  applyIfPresent("damage", "damage");
  applyIfPresent("gff", "gff", ["GFF", "generic_failure_frequency", "generic_failure_gff", "genericFailureFrequency", "genericFailureGff"]);
  applyIfPresent("pof_mapping", "pofMapping", ["pof_mapping", "pof_numeric_bands", "pofMapping", "pofmapping", "pof mapping", "PoF Mapping"], "PoF Mapping");
  applyIfPresent("half_remaining_life", "halfRemainingLife", ["half_remaining_life", "halfRemainingLife", "half_remaning_life", "half remaning life", "Half remaning life", "Half remaining life"], "Half remaining life");
  applyIfPresent("susceptibility", "susceptibility", ["susceptibility", "susceptibility_bands", "cracking_susceptibility", "Susceptibility"], "Cracking susceptibility");
  applyIfPresent("management_questionnaire", "managementQuestionnaire", ["management_questionnaire", "management_system_questionnaire", "m3_management_questionnaire"], "Management systems questionnaire");
  applyIfPresent("risk", "risk", null, "CoF dimensions & PoF scale");
  if ((!Array.isArray(REF.pofMapping) || !REF.pofMapping.length) && REF.riskConfig && REF.riskConfig.probability) {
    var nb = REF.riskConfig.probability.numeric_bands || REF.riskConfig.probability.pof_numeric_bands || REF.riskConfig.probability.pof_mapping;
    if (Array.isArray(nb) && nb.length) {
      refApply("pof_mapping", nb, fname + " -> PoF Mapping (from CoF dimensions file)");
      loaded++;
    }
  }
  applyIfPresent("risk_matrix", "riskMatrix", ["risk_matrix"]);
  applyIfPresent("consequence_areas", "areaAffected", ["consequence_areas", "area_affected"]);
  applyIfPresent("planning", "planning");
  applyIfPresent("inspection_method", "inspectionMethod", ["inspection_method"]);

  refSyncPills();
  return loaded;
}

function applyDemoRules(silent) {
  try {
    if (typeof DEMO_RULES === "undefined" || !DEMO_RULES) {
      if (!silent) alert(osrUseOnlyEmbeddedDocumentData() ? "Embedded rules not available in this file." : "Demo rules not available. Open this file in a browser so the embedded rules can load.");
      return;
    }
    if (typeof REF === "undefined" || REF == null) {
      REF = { locationLib: null, locationLibName: null, chemLib: [], chemLibName: null, toxLib: [], toxLibName: null, acidLib: [], acidLibName: null, otherLib: [], otherLibName: null, materialLib: [], materialLibName: null, tankComponentLib: [], tankComponentLibName: null, screenLib: null, screenLibName: null, gffLib: [], gffLibName: null, pofMapping: [], pofMappingName: null, halfRemainingLife: [], halfRemainingLifeName: null, susceptibilityBands: [], susceptibilityBandsName: null, managementQuestionnaire: null, managementQuestionnaireName: null, riskConfig: null, riskConfigName: null, consequenceDimensions: null, consequenceDimensionsName: null, consequenceAreas: null, consequenceAreasName: null, riskMatrix: null, riskMatrixName: null, planningLib: null, planningLibName: null, inspectionMethods: null, inspectionMethodsName: null };
    }
    var rulesSourceName = osrUseOnlyEmbeddedDocumentData() ? "Rules in this file" : "Demo rules";
    var srcRules = osrDeepCloneJson(DEMO_RULES || {});
    srcRules.location = osrCloneDefaultDemoLocation();
    srcRules.materials = osrCloneDefaultDemoMaterials();
    srcRules.material = srcRules.materials;
    var n = refApplyRulesFromObject(srcRules, rulesSourceName);
    if (!silent) {
      if (n) alert("Loaded " + n + " libraries from " + rulesSourceName + ".");
      else alert("No known reference libraries found in " + rulesSourceName + ".");
    }
    if (typeof refSyncPills === "function") refSyncPills();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("applyDemoRules", e);
    if (!silent) alert("Could not apply demo rules: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
  }
}

/* Parse rules CSV (path, value; value may be multiline quoted JSON). */
function parseRulesCsv(csvText) {
  var out = {};
  var raw = String(csvText || "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").replace(/\r/g, "\n");
  var firstLineEnd = raw.indexOf("\n");
  if (firstLineEnd < 0) return out;
  var re = /^([a-zA-Z_]+),/gm;
  var positions = [];
  var m;
  while ((m = re.exec(raw)) !== null) {
    if (m[1] === "path") continue;
    positions.push({ key: m[1], keyStart: m.index, valueStart: m.index + m[0].length });
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
    var key = positions[i].key;
    var valueStart = positions[i].valueStart;
    var valueEnd = i + 1 < positions.length ? positions[i + 1].keyStart : raw.length;
    var value = raw.slice(valueStart, valueEnd).trim();
    if (value.charAt(0) === '"') {
      value = value.slice(1);
      var unescaped = "";
      for (var j = 0; j < value.length; j++) {
        if (value[j] === '"' && value[j + 1] === '"') { unescaped += '"'; j++; continue; }
        if (value[j] === '"') break;
        unescaped += value[j];
      }
      value = unescaped.replace(/""/g, '"');
    }
    value = value.trim();
    if (value && (value.charAt(0) === "{" || value.charAt(0) === "[")) {
      try { out[key] = JSON.parse(value); } catch (_) { out[key] = value; }
    } else {
      out[key] = value;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* Load a rules CSV (path, value columns; value may be JSON). */
function refLoadRulesCSV() {
  if (typeof OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED !== "undefined" && OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED) {
    alert(typeof osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage === "function" ? osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage() : "Rules CSV import is disabled; M0 RBI Data is fixed in this application.");
    return;
  }
  var inp = document.createElement("input");
  inp.type = "file";
  inp.accept = ".csv";
  inp.onchange = function() {
    if (!inp.files || !inp.files.length) return;
    var fname = inp.files[0].name;
    var r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = function() {
      try {
        var data = parseRulesCsv(r.result);
        var n = refApplyRulesFromObject(data, fname);
        if (n) alert("Loaded " + n + " libraries from " + fname + ".");
        else alert("No known reference libraries found in this CSV.");
      } catch (e) {
        alert("Could not load rules CSV: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
      }
    };
    r.readAsText(inp.files[0], "UTF-8");
  };
  inp.click();
}

/* Update all library status pills in reference bar */
function refSyncPills() {
  if (typeof REF === "undefined" || REF == null) return;
  var locCount = REF.locationLib ? (m1_getLocSites().length||0) : 0;
  var items = [
    {id:'rb_loc',     st:'rb_locSt',      name:REF.locationLibName, n:locCount||null,         unit:'sites'},
    {id:'rb_chem',    st:'rb_chemSt',     name:REF.chemLibName,     n:(REF.chemLib&&REF.chemLib.length)||0,     unit:'fluids'},
    {id:'rb_toxic',   st:'rb_toxicSt',    name:REF.toxLibName,      n:(REF.toxLib&&REF.toxLib.length)||0,      unit:'items'},
    {id:'rb_acid',    st:'rb_acidSt',     name:REF.acidLibName,     n:(REF.acidLib&&REF.acidLib.length)||0,     unit:'items'},
    {id:'rb_other',   st:'rb_otherSt',    name:REF.otherLibName,    n:(REF.otherLib&&REF.otherLib.length)||0,    unit:'items'},
    {id:'rb_material',st:'rb_materialSt', name:REF.materialLibName, n:(REF.materialLib&&REF.materialLib.length)||0, unit:'items'},
    {id:'rb_damage', st:'rb_damageSt',   name:REF.screenLibName,   n:m5_getMechs().length||null, unit:'mechs'},
    {id:'rb_gff',    st:'rb_gffSt',      name:REF.gffLibName,      n:(REF.gffLib&&REF.gffLib.length)||null,    unit:'rows'},
    {id:'rb_pofmap', st:'rb_pofmapSt',   name:REF.pofMappingName,  n:(REF.pofMapping&&REF.pofMapping.length)||null, unit:'bands'},
    {id:'rb_halfrem', st:'rb_halfremSt', name:REF.halfRemainingLifeName, n:(REF.halfRemainingLife&&REF.halfRemainingLife.length)||null, unit:'bands'},
    {id:'rb_susceptibility', st:'rb_susceptibilitySt', name:REF.susceptibilityBandsName, n:REF.susceptibilityBands&&REF.susceptibilityBands.length?REF.susceptibilityBands.length:null, unit:'bands'},
    {id:'rb_management', st:'rb_managementSt', name:REF.managementQuestionnaireName, n:(REF.managementQuestionnaire && REF.managementQuestionnaire.final_score != null) ? REF.managementQuestionnaire.final_score : null, unit:'score'},
    {id:'rb_risk',    st:'rb_riskSt',     name:REF.riskConfigName,  n:null,                   unit:null},
    {id:'rb_matrix',  st:'rb_matrixSt',   name:REF.riskMatrixName,  n:null,                   unit:null},
    {id:'rb_areas',   st:'rb_areasSt',    name:REF.consequenceAreasName, n:REF.consequenceAreas?REF.consequenceAreas.bands.length:null, unit:'bands'},
    {id:'rb_planning', st:'rb_planningSt', name:REF.planningLibName, n:REF.planningLib&&REF.planningLib.cells?Object.keys(REF.planningLib.cells).length:null, unit:'cells'},
    {id:'rb_inspection_method', st:'rb_inspection_methodSt', name:REF.inspectionMethodsName, n:REF.inspectionMethods&&REF.inspectionMethods.inspection_methods?REF.inspectionMethods.inspection_methods.length:null, unit:'methods'}
  ];
  items.forEach(function(it) {
    var el = $(it.id), st = $(it.st);
    if (!el || !st) return;
    if (it.name) {
      el.classList.add('loaded');
      st.textContent = it.n != null ? it.n+' '+it.unit : it.name;
      st.title = it.name;
    } else {
      el.classList.remove('loaded');
      st.textContent = 'not loaded';
      st.title = '';
    }
  });
  refUpdateSectionLabels();
}

/** Shared HTML body for M0 snapshot summary (used by read-only reference + publish Produce report). */
function osrM0TryParseJson(raw){
  if (raw == null) return null;
  var s = String(raw).trim();
  if (!s) return null;
  var c0 = s.charAt(0);
  if (c0 !== "{" && c0 !== "[") return null;
  try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (e) { return null; }
}
function osrM0ReportRenderValue(v, depth){
  depth = depth || 0;
  if (depth > 6) return '<pre class="osr-m0-ro-pre">' + escHtml(JSON.stringify(v, null, 2)) + "</pre>";
  if (v == null) return '<div class="hint">—</div>';
  var t = typeof v;
  if (t === "string" || t === "number" || t === "boolean") return '<div>' + escHtml(String(v)) + "</div>";
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    if (!v.length) return '<div class="hint">No rows.</div>';
    var allObj = v.every(function(x){ return x && typeof x === "object" && !Array.isArray(x); });
    if (allObj) {
      var cols = [];
      v.forEach(function(r){
        Object.keys(r).forEach(function(k){ if (cols.indexOf(k) < 0) cols.push(k); });
      });
      if (!cols.length) return '<div class="hint">No fields.</div>';
      var h = '<div style="overflow:auto"><table class="m5-tbl"><thead><tr>';
      cols.forEach(function(c){ h += "<th>" + escHtml(c) + "</th>"; });
      h += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
      v.forEach(function(r){
        h += "<tr>";
        cols.forEach(function(c){
          var cv = r[c];
          if (cv == null) h += "<td>—</td>";
          else if (typeof cv === "object") h += "<td><code>" + escHtml(JSON.stringify(cv)) + "</code></td>";
          else h += "<td>" + escHtml(String(cv)) + "</td>";
        });
        h += "</tr>";
      });
      h += "</tbody></table></div>";
      return h;
    }
    var ul = '<ul class="m9-list">';
    for (var i = 0; i < v.length; i++) ul += "<li>" + osrM0ReportRenderValue(v[i], depth + 1) + "</li>";
    ul += "</ul>";
    return ul;
  }
  if (t === "object") {
    var keys = Object.keys(v);
    if (!keys.length) return '<div class="hint">No fields.</div>';
    var out = "";
    keys.forEach(function(k){
      out += '<details class="osr-m0-reference-section" open><summary>' + escHtml(k) + "</summary>" + osrM0ReportRenderValue(v[k], depth + 1) + "</details>";
    });
    return out;
  }
  return '<div>' + escHtml(String(v)) + "</div>";
}
function osrFormatM0ReportBodyHtml(state, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var noStateMsg = opts.noStateMsg != null ? opts.noStateMsg : "No M0 data.";
  var emptyMsg = opts.emptySectionsMsg != null ? opts.emptySectionsMsg : "M0 snapshot present but all sections are empty.";
  var keys = ["location", "chemical", "toxic", "acid", "materials", "tankComponents", "damage", "risk", "riskMatrix", "areaAffected", "gff", "pofMapping", "halfRemainingLife", "susceptibility", "managementQuestionnaire", "planning", "inspectionMethod"];
  var labels = { location: "Location", chemical: "Chemical", toxic: "Toxic", acid: "Acid", materials: "Materials", tankComponents: "Tank components", damage: "Damage", risk: "CoF dimensions & PoF scale", riskMatrix: "Risk matrix", areaAffected: "Area affected", gff: "GFF", pofMapping: "PoF mapping", halfRemainingLife: "Half remaining life", susceptibility: "Susceptibility", managementQuestionnaire: "Management questionnaire", planning: "Planning", inspectionMethod: "Inspection method" };
  if (!state || typeof state !== "object") {
    return '<p class="hint">' + escHtml(noStateMsg) + "</p>";
  }
  var chunks = [];
  chunks.push('<div class="osr-m0-meta"><strong>Title</strong> ' + escHtml(state.title || "") + " &nbsp; <strong>Date</strong> " + escHtml(state.date || "") + "</div>");
  var any = false;
  keys.forEach(function(k) {
    var raw = state[k];
    if (raw == null || String(raw).trim() === "") return;
    any = true;
    var lab = labels[k] || k;
    var parsed = osrM0TryParseJson(raw);
    chunks.push('<details class="osr-m0-reference-section" open>');
    chunks.push("<summary>" + escHtml(lab) + "</summary>");
    if (parsed != null) chunks.push(osrM0ReportRenderValue(parsed, 0));
    else chunks.push('<pre class="osr-m0-ro-pre">' + escHtml(String(raw)) + "</pre>");
    chunks.push("</details>");
  });
  if (!any) chunks.push('<p class="hint">' + escHtml(emptyMsg) + "</p>");
  return chunks.join("");
}

/** Embedded M0: fill printable summary (same structure as published M0 reference body). */
function m0_produceReport() {
  var el = document.getElementById("m0_reportContent");
  if (!el) return;
  if (typeof window.osrGetM0State !== "function" && typeof getState !== "function") {
    el.innerHTML = '<p class="hint">M0 editor is not available.</p>';
    el.style.display = "block";
    return;
  }
  var state = osrCallGetM0State();
  el.innerHTML = osrFormatM0ReportBodyHtml(state, {
    noStateMsg: "No M0 data to show.",
    emptySectionsMsg: "All M0 sections are empty."
  });
  el.style.display = "block";
}

function getRowProp(row,keys) { if(!row)return null; for(var i=0;i<keys.length;i++){if(row[keys[i]]!=null&&row[keys[i]]!=="")return row[keys[i]];} return null; }
function findFluid(name,lib) { if(!name||!lib)return null; var s=name.trim().toLowerCase(); for(var i=0;i<lib.length;i++){var r=lib[i];var n=(r.Fluid||r.fluid||r.name||r.Name||r.fluid_name||r.acid_name||r.acid||"").trim().toLowerCase();if(n===s)return r;} return null; }
function fmt(n,d) { return n==null?"—":Number(n).toFixed(d||2); }
function toCsvField(v) { return '"' + String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'; }
function parseCsvRows(text) {
  var rows = [], row = [], cell = "", inQuotes = false;
  var s = String(text || "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").replace(/\r/g, "\n");
  for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    var ch = s.charAt(i);
    if (inQuotes) {
      if (ch === '"') {
        if (s.charAt(i + 1) === '"') { cell += '"'; i++; }
        else inQuotes = false;
      } else {
        cell += ch;
      }
    } else {
      if (ch === '"') inQuotes = true;
      else if (ch === ",") { row.push(cell); cell = ""; }
      else if (ch === "\n") { row.push(cell); rows.push(row); row = []; cell = ""; }
      else cell += ch;
    }
  }
  if (cell.length || row.length) { row.push(cell); rows.push(row); }
  return rows.filter(function(r){
    for (var j = 0; j < r.length; j++) if (String(r[j] || "").trim() !== "") return true;
    return false;
  });
}
function vesselAssetToCsv(asset) {
  var payload = JSON.stringify(asset, null, 2);
  return "format,version,payload_json\n" + toCsvField("OpenStandard_RBI") + "," + toCsvField("1.0") + "," + toCsvField(payload) + "\n";
}
function vesselAssetFromCsv(text) {
  var rows = parseCsvRows(text);
  if (!rows.length) throw new Error("CSV is empty.");
  if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error("CSV has no data row.");
  var header = rows[0].map(function(c){ return String(c || "").trim().toLowerCase(); });
  var payloadIdx = header.indexOf("payload_json");
  if (payloadIdx < 0) payloadIdx = header.indexOf("payload");
  if (payloadIdx < 0) payloadIdx = 2;
  var payloadJson = (rows[1][payloadIdx] == null ? "" : String(rows[1][payloadIdx]));
  if (!payloadJson.trim()) throw new Error("CSV payload_json is empty.");
  var data = JSON.parse(payloadJson);
  if (!data || !data.sentinel_rbi) throw new Error("Not an OpenStandard_RBI asset file.");
  return data;
}
/** If CSV has format,version,payload_json (or payload) columns, return parsed JSON; else null. */
function tryParseCsvEmbeddedJsonPayload(text) {
  var rows = parseCsvRows(String(text || ""));
  if (!rows.length || rows.length < 2) return null;
  var header = rows[0].map(function(c){ return String(c || "").trim().toLowerCase(); });
  var idx = header.indexOf("payload_json");
  if (idx < 0) idx = header.indexOf("payload");
  if (idx < 0) return null;
  var payloadStr = rows[1][idx] == null ? "" : String(rows[1][idx]);
  if (!payloadStr.trim()) return null;
  try { return JSON.parse(payloadStr); } catch (_) { return null; }
}
/** Map reference-bar refLoad() type to keys produced by parseRulesCsv() / rules bundles. */
var REF_CSV_LIBRARY_KEYS = {
  location: ["location"],
  chem: ["chemical", "chem", "chemicals"],
  toxic: ["toxic"],
  acid: ["acid"],
  other: ["other", "other_inventory", "other_fluids", "other_chemistry"],
  material: ["materials", "material", "material_list"],
  tank_components: ["tankComponents", "tank_components", "components", "tank_component_library"],
  damage: ["damage"],
  gff: ["gff", "GFF", "generic_failure_frequency", "generic_failure_gff"],
  pof_mapping: ["pofMapping", "pof_mapping", "pof_numeric_bands"],
  half_remaining_life: ["halfRemainingLife", "half_remaining_life", "half_remaning_life", "halfRemaningLife"],
  susceptibility: ["susceptibility", "susceptibility_bands", "cracking_susceptibility"],
  management_questionnaire: ["managementQuestionnaire", "management_questionnaire", "management_system_questionnaire", "m3_management_questionnaire"],
  risk: ["risk"],
  consequence_areas: ["areaAffected", "consequence_areas", "area_affected"],
  risk_matrix: ["riskMatrix", "risk_matrix"],
  planning: ["planning"],
  inspection_method: ["inspectionMethod", "inspection_method"]
};
function refPickLibraryFromRulesCsvObject(rules, type) {
  if (!rules || typeof rules !== "object") return null;
  var keys = REF_CSV_LIBRARY_KEYS[type];
  if (!keys || !keys.length) return null;
  var i, k;
  for (i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    k = keys[i];
    if (rules[k] !== undefined && rules[k] !== null) return rules[k];
  }
  var lowerMap = {};
  Object.keys(rules).forEach(function(kk) { lowerMap[String(kk).toLowerCase()] = rules[kk]; });
  for (i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    k = keys[i].toLowerCase();
    if (lowerMap[k] !== undefined && lowerMap[k] !== null) return lowerMap[k];
  }
  return null;
}
function pickVesselCSV(cb) {
  var inp = document.createElement("input");
  inp.type = "file";
  inp.accept = ".csv";
  inp.onchange = function() {
    if (!inp.files.length) return;
    var r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = function() {
      try { cb(vesselAssetFromCsv(r.result), inp.files[0].name); }
      catch (e) { alert("Invalid vessel CSV: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e))); }
    };
    r.readAsText(inp.files[0]);
  };
  inp.click();
}

  }
}

/** Capture live M0 RBI Data (prefer explicit hooks from embedded GRP script). Used before Save JSON / CSV export. */
function osrCallGetM0State() {
  try {
    if (typeof window.osrGetM0State === "function") return window.osrGetM0State();
    if (typeof getState === "function") return getState();
  } catch (e) { console.warn("osrCallGetM0State", e); }
  return null;
}
function osrCallSetM0State(state) {
  try {
    if (typeof window.osrSetM0State === "function") return window.osrSetM0State(state);
    if (typeof setState === "function") return setState(state);
  } catch (e) { console.warn("osrCallSetM0State", e); }
}
/** Reliable CSV/HTML download (some browsers ignore programmatic click unless the anchor is in the document). */
function osrTriggerDownloadBlob(blob, filename) {
  var a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = filename || "download.csv";
  a.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  a.style.position = "fixed";
  a.style.left = "-9999px";
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(function() {
    try { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); } catch (e) {}
    if (a.parentNode) a.parentNode.removeChild(a);
  }, 250);
}
/** Published handout: would show File → combined CSV when M0 snapshot exists; that item is stripped on deliverable (see osrStripDeliverableFileMenuM0Items). Builder: keeps it hidden. */
function osrRefreshCombinedCsvMenuVisibility() {
  try {
    var btn = document.getElementById("fileMenuSaveCombinedCsv");
    if (!btn) return;
    var del = typeof isRuntimeDeliverableHtml === "function" && isRuntimeDeliverableHtml();
    var hasM0 = typeof window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot !== "undefined" && window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot != null;
    btn.style.display = del && hasM0 ? "" : "none";
  } catch (e) {}
}

/**
 * User / published handout only: remove M0 JSON/CSV actions and Save vessel + M0 snapshot (CSV).
 * Keeps Open/Save vessel CSV and Collapse/Expand all. Full builder bundle keeps the extended menu.
 */
function osrStripDeliverableFileMenuM0Items(rootDoc) {
  try {
    var doc = rootDoc || (typeof document !== "undefined" ? document : null);
    if (!doc || !doc.getElementById) return;
    var isExportClone = !!rootDoc;
    if (!isExportClone && typeof isRuntimeDeliverableHtml === "function" && !isRuntimeDeliverableHtml()) return;
    var menu = doc.getElementById("fileDropdownMenu");
    if (!menu) return;
    var removeById = function(id) {
      var el = doc.getElementById(id);
      if (el && el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
    };
    removeById("fileMenuSaveCombinedCsv");
    ["osrFileMenuM0OpenJson", "osrFileMenuM0SaveJson", "osrFileMenuM0ExportFullCsv", "osrFileMenuM0ExportChemCsv", "osrFileMenuM0ImportFullCsv"].forEach(function(fn) {
      var btn = menu.querySelector('button[onclick*="' + fn + '"]');
      if (btn && btn.parentNode) btn.parentNode.removeChild(btn);
    });
    var saveV = doc.getElementById("fileMenuSaveVesselCsv");
    if (saveV) saveV.setAttribute("title", "Save vessel payload as CSV (format,version,payload_json).");
  } catch (e) { console.warn("osrStripDeliverableFileMenuM0Items", e); }
}
function buildAssetWithRbiUserData(asset) {
  var copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(asset));
  if (hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp()) {
    try { copy.rbi_user_data_state = osrCallGetM0State(); } catch (e) { console.warn("buildAssetWithRbiUserData", e); }
  } else if (typeof window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot !== "undefined" && window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot != null) {
    try {
      copy.rbi_user_data_state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("buildAssetWithRbiUserData runtime M0", e);
    }
  }
  return copy;
}
function applyRbiUserDataAfterLoad(data) {
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object" || data.rbi_user_data_state == null) return;
  var rbiSnap = data.rbi_user_data_state;
  if (typeof OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED !== "undefined" && OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof osrCloneLockedM0Canonical === "function") {
    var canonLoad = osrCloneLockedM0Canonical();
    if (canonLoad) rbiSnap = canonLoad;
  }
  if (hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp()) {
    try { osrCallSetM0State(rbiSnap); } catch (e) { console.warn("applyRbiUserDataAfterLoad", e); }
  }
  try {
    if (typeof osrOnM0StateApplied === "function") osrOnM0StateApplied(rbiSnap);
  } catch (e2) { console.warn("applyRbiUserDataAfterLoad REF sync", e2); }
  delete data.rbi_user_data_state;
}
function isRuntimeDeliverableHtml() {
  try {
    return typeof document !== "undefined" && document.documentElement &&
      document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-osr-combined-export") === "1";
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

/** Deliverable HTML: use only embedded scripts + bundle — no browser-only stores that override the file. */
function osrUseOnlyEmbeddedDocumentData() {
  return typeof isRuntimeDeliverableHtml === "function" && isRuntimeDeliverableHtml();
}

function osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed() {
  try {
    if (!activeAsset || osrUseOnlyEmbeddedDocumentData()) return;
    localStorage.setItem("sentinel_backup", JSON.stringify(activeAsset));
  } catch (e) {}
}

    return dm || "screening_default";
  } catch (e) { return "screening_default"; }
}
