function finishVesselLoadFromDiskData(data, fname) {
  m2_data = null;
  var runtime = isRuntimeDeliverableHtml();
  if (runtime && data && typeof data === "object") {
    if (data.rbi_user_data_state != null) {
      try {
        window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data.rbi_user_data_state));
      } catch (e) {
        window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot = data.rbi_user_data_state;
      }
      try { delete data.rbi_user_data_state; } catch (e2) {}
    } else {
      window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot = null;
    }
  }
  activeAsset = data;
  if (!runtime) applyRbiUserDataAfterLoad(activeAsset);
  else if (hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp()) {
    try {
      if (typeof clearRbiDataStateForRuntime === "function") clearRbiDataStateForRuntime();
    } catch (e3) { console.warn("clearRbiDataStateForRuntime", e3); }
  }
  onAssetLoaded();
}
function loadFromDiskCSV() {
  pickVesselCSV(finishVesselLoadFromDiskData);
}
function loadFromDisk() { loadFromDiskCSV(); }

/** Parse Publish export HTML text and return the OpenStandard_RBI_HTML_Bundle object, or null. */
function osrExtractOpenstandardBundleFromHtml(htmlText) {
  try {
    var s = String(htmlText || "");
    var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(s, "text/html");
    var bel = doc.getElementById("openstandard-bundle");
    if (!bel) return null;
    var raw = (bel.textContent || "").replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim();
    if (!raw) return null;
    var bundle = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!bundle || bundle.format !== "OpenStandard_RBI_HTML_Bundle" || !bundle.vessel || !bundle.vessel.sentinel_rbi) return null;
    return bundle;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("osrExtractOpenstandardBundleFromHtml", e);
    return null;
  }
}

/** Apply in-memory bundle (same fields as script#openstandard-bundle in a publish export). */
function applyOpenstandardBundleObject(bundle) {
  m2_data = null;
  activeAsset = bundle.vessel;
  try {
    window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot = bundle.rbi_user_data_state != null
      ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(bundle.rbi_user_data_state))
      : null;
  } catch (es) {
    window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot = bundle.rbi_user_data_state || null;
  }
  if (bundle.rbi_user_data_state != null) {
    if (hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp()) {
      try { osrCallSetM0State(bundle.rbi_user_data_state); } catch (e2) { console.warn("applyOpenstandardBundleObject setState", e2); }
    }
    try {
      if (typeof osrOnM0StateApplied === "function") osrOnM0StateApplied(bundle.rbi_user_data_state);
    } catch (e3) { console.warn("applyOpenstandardBundleObject REF sync", e3); }
  }
  if (bundle.export_meta && typeof bundle.export_meta === "object") {
    try {
      var pt = document.getElementById("appProductTitle");
      if (pt && bundle.export_meta.analysisType != null) pt.textContent = String(bundle.export_meta.analysisType);
      var ti = document.getElementById("osrRuntimeTitleInput");
      if (ti && bundle.export_meta.runtimeFileTitle != null) ti.value = String(bundle.export_meta.runtimeFileTitle);
    } catch (em) { console.warn("applyOpenstandardBundleObject export_meta", em); }
  }
}

/** Open file picker for combined CSV or Publish export HTML (same data as Save all / Publish export). */
function loadCombinedCsvFromDisk() {
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode: cannot load.");
    return;
  }
  var inp = document.createElement("input");
  inp.type = "file";
  inp.accept = ".csv,.html,.htm,text/html";
  inp.onchange = function() {
    if (!inp.files.length) return;
    var file = inp.files[0];
    var fname = file.name || "";
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function() {
      var text = reader.result;
      try {
        var tryHtml = /\.html?$/i.test(fname) ||
          /id\s*=\s*["']openstandard-bundle["']/i.test(text) ||
          /id=["']openstandard-bundle["']/i.test(text);
        if (tryHtml) {
          var bundle = osrExtractOpenstandardBundleFromHtml(text);
          if (bundle) {
            applyOpenstandardBundleObject(bundle);
            var runtime = isRuntimeDeliverableHtml();
            if (runtime && hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp()) {
              try {
                if (typeof clearRbiDataStateForRuntime === "function") clearRbiDataStateForRuntime();
              } catch (e3) { console.warn("loadCombinedCsvFromDisk clearRbiDataStateForRuntime", e3); }
            }
            try {
              var gsu = $("global_status");
              if (gsu) gsu.textContent = "Loaded publish HTML: " + fname;
            } catch (e4) {}
            onAssetLoaded();
            return;
          }
          if (/\.html?$/i.test(fname)) {
            alert("This HTML file does not contain a valid Open-RBI publish bundle (expected script#openstandard-bundle).");
            return;
          }
        }
        finishVesselLoadFromDiskData(vesselAssetFromCsv(text), fname);
        try {
          var gsu2 = $("global_status");
          if (gsu2) gsu2.textContent = "Loaded combined CSV: " + fname;
        } catch (e5) {}
      } catch (e) {
        alert("Invalid combined CSV file: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };
  inp.click();
}

/** Push every module’s form state into activeAsset and sync M0 → REF; used before disk export. Returns false if read-only or no asset. Each module is isolated so one failure (common on runtime if a tab was never opened) does not block CSV download. */
function flushAllModulesForExport() {
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) return false;
  if (!activeAsset) return false;
  var m7PlanSnap = null;
  function safe(label, fn) {
    try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn("flushAllModulesForExport:" + label, e); }
  }
  safe("m7_snap", function() {
    if (typeof osrM7SnapshotPlan === "function") m7PlanSnap = osrM7SnapshotPlan(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi);
  });
  safe("m7_early", function() {
    if (typeof osrM7FlushM7NotesAndSelections === "function") osrM7FlushM7NotesAndSelections();
    if (typeof osrM7FlushInspectionPlanFromDom === "function") osrM7FlushInspectionPlanFromDom();
  });
  safe("saveCurrentTab", function() { saveCurrentTab(); });
  safe("m1", function() { m1_save(); });
  safe("m2", function() { m2_save(); });
  safe("m5", function() { m5_save(); });
  safe("m3", function() { m3_save(); });
  safe("m4", function() { m4_save(); });
  safe("m6", function() { m6_save(); });
  safe("m8", function() { m8_save(); });
  safe("m7", function() { osrFlushM7ForExport(m7PlanSnap); });
  if (hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp()) {
    safe("M0", function() { var st = osrCallGetM0State(); if (st != null) osrOnM0StateApplied(st); });
  }
  try { updateDots(); } catch (e2) { console.warn("flushAllModulesForExport:updateDots", e2); }
  if (typeof updateGlobalSaveBar === "function") {
    safe("globalBar", function() { updateGlobalSaveBar(currentTab); });
  }
  return true;
}

function saveToDiskCSV() {
  if (!activeAsset) {
    alert("No vessel is loaded. Use File → Load Json file (or open a bundle/handout), or reload if this published file should open with data.");
    return;
  }
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode is on (URL has ?readonly=1 or ?view=1). Remove that to save files.");
    return;
  }
  if (!flushAllModulesForExport()) return;
  /** Same merge as Save combined CSV (full export): include M0 RBI Data (rbi_user_data_state) when GRP/embed/snapshot exists — not vessel-only. */
  var toSave = buildAssetWithRbiUserData(activeAsset);
  var tag = toSave.sentinel_rbi.tag_number || "asset";
  var d = new Date();
  var dateStr = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  var timeStr = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
  var hasM0 = toSave && toSave.rbi_user_data_state != null;
  var name = tag + "_" + dateStr + "_" + timeStr + (hasM0 ? "_combined" : "") + ".csv";
  var blob = new Blob([vesselAssetToCsv(toSave)], {type:"text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
  osrTriggerDownloadBlob(blob, name);
  try {
    var gsu = $("global_status");
    if (gsu) gsu.textContent = "Saved vessel CSV" + (hasM0 ? " (vessel + M0 RBI Data)" : "") + ": " + name;
  } catch (e) {}
}
/** Vessel CSV plus RBI Data snapshot when GRP is embedded, or published runtime snapshot from the handout bundle. */
function saveCombinedToDiskCSV() {
  if (!activeAsset) {
    alert("No vessel is loaded. Open a CSV first.");
    return;
  }
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode is on (URL has ?readonly=1 or ?view=1). Remove that to save files.");
    return;
  }
  if (!flushAllModulesForExport()) return;
  var tag = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number || "asset";
  var d = new Date();
  var dateStr = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  var timeStr = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
  var embed = hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp();
  var hasRuntimeM0 = typeof window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot !== "undefined" && window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot != null;
  var combined = embed || hasRuntimeM0;
  var name = tag + "_" + dateStr + "_" + timeStr + (combined ? "_combined.csv" : ".csv");
  var toSave = combined ? buildAssetWithRbiUserData(activeAsset) : activeAsset;
  var blob = new Blob([vesselAssetToCsv(toSave)], {type:"text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
  osrTriggerDownloadBlob(blob, name);
  try {
    var gsu = $("global_status");
    if (gsu) gsu.textContent = "Saved CSV: " + name;
  } catch (e) {}
}
function saveToDisk() { saveToDiskCSV(); }

/** If this document was saved via Produce combined HTML, restore vessel + optional RBI Data and remove the embed tag. */
function tryConsumeOpenstandardBundle() {
  try {
    var bel = document.getElementById("openstandard-bundle");
    if (!bel || !bel.textContent) return false;
    var raw = bel.textContent.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim();
    if (!raw) return false;
    var bundle = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!bundle || bundle.format !== "OpenStandard_RBI_HTML_Bundle" || !bundle.vessel || !bundle.vessel.sentinel_rbi) return false;
    applyOpenstandardBundleObject(bundle);
    if (bel.parentNode) bel.parentNode.removeChild(bel);
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("tryConsumeOpenstandardBundle", e);
    return false;
  }
}

/** Apply analysis type + default title from &lt;script id="osr-source-metadata"&gt; (runs once at startup). */
function syncOsrHeaderTitleFromMetadata() {
  try {
    var el = document.getElementById("osr-source-metadata");
    var titleEl = document.getElementById("appProductTitle");
    var inp = document.getElementById("osrRuntimeTitleInput");
    var o = { analysisType: "OpenRBI Tank-RBI June 2026", runtimeFileTitle: "" };
    if (el && el.textContent) {
      var p = JSON.parse(el.textContent.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim());
      if (p && typeof p === "object") {
        if (p.analysisType != null) o.analysisType = String(p.analysisType);
        if (p.runtimeFileTitle != null) o.runtimeFileTitle = String(p.runtimeFileTitle).trim();
      }
    }
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = o.analysisType || "OpenRBI Tank-RBI June 2026";
    if (inp && !String(inp.value || "").trim() && o.runtimeFileTitle) inp.value = o.runtimeFileTitle;
  } catch (e) { console.warn("syncOsrHeaderTitleFromMetadata", e); }
}

/** Filename metadata: JSON in head plus optional #osrRuntimeTitleInput (input overrides JSON). */
function getOsSourceMetadata() {
  var d = { runtimeFileTitle: "", analysisType: "OpenRBI Tank-RBI June 2026" };
  try {
    var el = document.getElementById("osr-source-metadata");
    if (el && el.textContent) {
      var o = JSON.parse(el.textContent.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim());
      if (o && typeof o === "object") {
        if (o.runtimeFileTitle != null) d.runtimeFileTitle = String(o.runtimeFileTitle).trim();
        if (o.analysisType != null) d.analysisType = String(o.analysisType).trim();
      }
    }
    var inp = document.getElementById("osrRuntimeTitleInput");
    if (inp) {
      var iv = String(inp.value || "").trim();
      if (iv) d.runtimeFileTitle = iv;
    }
  } catch (e) { console.warn("getOsSourceMetadata", e); }
  return d;
}
function osrFilenameSlug(s, fallback, maxLen) {
  var t = String(s == null ? "" : s).trim();
  if (!t) t = fallback != null ? String(fallback).trim() : "export";
  t = t.replace(/[^\w\-.]+/g, "_").replace(/_+/g, "_").replace(/^_|_$/g, "") || "export";
  maxLen = maxLen || 96;
  if (t.length > maxLen) t = t.slice(0, maxLen).replace(/_+$/, "");
  return t;
}

/** One demo/RBI location row from M1 asset register (Site / Facility, Unit / Area, System). */
function osrLocationSitesRowFromM1Vessel(vessel) {
  if (!vessel || !vessel.sentinel_rbi) return null;
  var m1 = vessel.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset || {};
  var loc = m1.location || {};
  var sn = String(loc.site_name || "").trim();
  var ar = String(loc.area || "").trim();
  var sy = String(loc.system || "").trim();
  if (!sn && !ar && !sy) return null;
  return { "Site / Facility": sn, "Unit / Area": ar, "System": sy };
}

function osrUnshiftLocationSiteRow(sites, row) {
  if (!row || !Array.isArray(sites)) return;
  var sn = String(row["Site / Facility"] || "").trim();
  var ar = String(row["Unit / Area"] || "").trim();
  var sy = String(row["System"] || "").trim();
  var dup = sites.some(function(r) {
    return String(r["Site / Facility"] || r.site_name || "").trim() === sn &&
      String(r["Unit / Area"] || r.area || "").trim() === ar &&
      String(r["System"] || r.system || "").trim() === sy;
  });
  if (!dup) sites.unshift(row);
}

function osrDeepCloneJson(x) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Rules object matching #demo-rules-json shape, taken from live REF (what the page is using at export time). */
function osrSnapshotRulesObjectFromRef() {
  var out = {};
  try {
    var dm = (typeof DEMO_RULES === "object" && DEMO_RULES && !Array.isArray(DEMO_RULES)) ? DEMO_RULES : {};
    out.title = typeof dm.title === "string" ? dm.title : "";
    out.date = typeof dm.date === "string" ? dm.date : "";
  } catch (e) {
    out.title = "";
    out.date = "";
  }
  if (!out.date) {
    var d = new Date();
    out.date = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  }
  if (typeof REF === "undefined" || !REF) return out;

  if (OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED && typeof osrCloneDefaultDemoLocation === "function") {
    out.location = osrCloneDefaultDemoLocation();
  } else if (REF.locationLib != null) {
    var locC = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.locationLib);
    if (locC != null) out.location = locC;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.chemLib) && REF.chemLib.length) {
    var ch = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.chemLib);
    if (ch != null) out.chemical = ch;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.toxLib) && REF.toxLib.length) {
    var tx = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.toxLib);
    if (tx != null) out.toxic = { fluid_properties_library: tx };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.acidLib) && REF.acidLib.length) {
    var ac = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.acidLib);
    if (ac != null) out.acid = { acid_properties_library: ac };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.otherLib) && REF.otherLib.length) {
    var ot = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.otherLib);
    if (ot != null) out.other = { fluid_properties_library: ot };
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.materialLib) && REF.materialLib.length) {
    var mat = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.materialLib);
    if (mat != null) out.materials = mat;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.tankComponentLib) && REF.tankComponentLib.length) {
    var tcSnap = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.tankComponentLib);
    if (tcSnap != null) out.tankComponents = tcSnap;
  }
  if (REF.screenLib != null) {
    var sc = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.screenLib);
    if (sc != null) out.damage = sc;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.gffLib) && REF.gffLib.length) {
    var gf = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.gffLib);
    if (gf != null) out.gff = gf;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.pofMapping) && REF.pofMapping.length) {
    var pm = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.pofMapping);
    if (pm != null) out.pofMapping = pm;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.halfRemainingLife) && REF.halfRemainingLife.length) {
    var hr = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.halfRemainingLife);
    if (hr != null) out.halfRemainingLife = hr;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(REF.susceptibilityBands) && REF.susceptibilityBands.length) {
    var su = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.susceptibilityBands);
    if (su != null) out.susceptibility = su;
  }
  if (REF.managementQuestionnaire != null && typeof REF.managementQuestionnaire === "object") {
    var mq = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.managementQuestionnaire);
    if (mq != null) out.managementQuestionnaire = mq;
  }
  if (REF.riskConfig != null && typeof REF.riskConfig === "object") {
    var rk = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.riskConfig);
    if (rk != null) out.risk = rk;
  }
  if (REF.riskMatrix != null && typeof REF.riskMatrix === "object") {
    var rm = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.riskMatrix);
    if (rm != null) out.riskMatrix = rm;
  }
  if (REF.consequenceAreas != null && typeof REF.consequenceAreas === "object") {
    var ca = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.consequenceAreas);
    if (ca != null) out.areaAffected = ca;
  }
  if (REF.planningLib != null && typeof REF.planningLib === "object") {
    var pl = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.planningLib);
    if (pl != null) out.planning = pl;
  }
  if (REF.inspectionMethods != null && typeof REF.inspectionMethods === "object") {
    var im = osrDeepCloneJson(REF.inspectionMethods);
    if (im != null) out.inspectionMethod = im;
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Push M0 RBI Data (GRP) section JSON into REF so exports and modules match what is in the M0 tables.
 * Without this, Produce combined HTML only snapshots in-memory REF (from initial demo-rules / CSV loads),
 * not edits stored only in M0 textareas — runtime files then open with empty libraries and no dropdowns.
 */
function osrHydrateRefFromM0Snapshot(state) {
  if (!state || typeof state !== "object" || typeof refApplyRulesFromObject !== "function") return 0;
  if (OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof osrCloneLockedM0Canonical === "function") {
    var canon = osrCloneLockedM0Canonical();
    if (canon) state = canon;
  } else if (OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED && typeof osrLockedM0LocationJsonString === "function") {
    state.location = osrLockedM0LocationJsonString();
  }
  var bundle = {};
  if (state.title != null && state.title !== "") bundle.title = String(state.title);
  if (state.date != null && state.date !== "") bundle.date = String(state.date);
  function addParsed(stateKey, ruleKey) {
    var raw = state[stateKey];
    if (raw == null || raw === "") return;
    if (typeof raw === "object") {
      try {
        bundle[ruleKey] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(raw));
      } catch (e) {
        bundle[ruleKey] = raw;
      }
      return;
    }
    var s = String(raw).trim();
    if (!s) return;
    try {
      bundle[ruleKey] = JSON.parse(s);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("osrHydrateRefFromM0Snapshot parse " + stateKey, e);
    }
  }
  addParsed("location", "location");
  addParsed("chemical", "chemical");
  addParsed("toxic", "toxic");
  addParsed("acid", "acid");
  addParsed("materials", "materials");
  addParsed("tankComponents", "tankComponents");
  addParsed("damage", "damage");
  addParsed("risk", "risk");
  addParsed("riskMatrix", "riskMatrix");
  addParsed("areaAffected", "areaAffected");
  addParsed("gff", "gff");
  addParsed("pofMapping", "pofMapping");
  addParsed("halfRemainingLife", "halfRemainingLife");
  addParsed("susceptibility", "susceptibility");
  addParsed("managementQuestionnaire", "managementQuestionnaire");
  addParsed("planning", "planning");
  addParsed("inspectionMethod", "inspectionMethod");
  if (!OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED && typeof REF !== "undefined" && REF != null) {
    var locRaw = state.location;
    if (locRaw == null || (typeof locRaw === "string" && !String(locRaw).trim())) {
      REF.locationLib = { sites: [] };
      if (!REF.locationLibName) REF.locationLibName = "M0 Location";
    }
  }
  var keys = Object.keys(bundle);
  if (keys.length <= (bundle.title ? 1 : 0) + (bundle.date ? 1 : 0)) return 0;
  return refApplyRulesFromObject(bundle, "M0 RBI Data (embedded snapshot)");
}

/** After M0 JSON/CSV load or combined-CSV vessel open: push M0 sections into REF, refresh library pills, align demo-rules JSON (for export/reset consistency). */
function osrOnM0StateApplied(state) {
  if (!state || typeof state !== "object") return;
  try {
    if (OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof osrCloneLockedM0Canonical === "function") {
      var canonApply = osrCloneLockedM0Canonical();
      if (canonApply) state = canonApply;
    } else if (OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED && typeof osrLockedM0LocationJsonString === "function") {
      state.location = osrLockedM0LocationJsonString();
    }
    osrHydrateRefFromM0Snapshot(state);
    var snap = osrSnapshotRulesObjectFromRef();
    var dre = document.getElementById("demo-rules-json");
    if (dre && snap) dre.textContent = JSON.stringify(snap);
    try {
      DEMO_RULES = snap;
    } catch (dr) { /* ignore */ }
    if (typeof refSyncPills === "function") refSyncPills();
    try {
      if (typeof m1_syncLocationLibFromM0 === "function") m1_syncLocationLibFromM0();
      if (typeof m1_popLocationSelects === "function") m1_popLocationSelects(!!activeAsset);
      if (typeof m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom === "function") m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom();
      if (typeof m1_renderComponentDesignTable === "function") m1_renderComponentDesignTable();
    } catch (eLoc) { console.warn("osrOnM0StateApplied M1 location", eLoc); }
    try {
      if (typeof currentTab === "number") {
        if (currentTab === 6 && typeof m6_renderPlanningSummary === "function") m6_renderPlanningSummary();
        if (currentTab === 7 && typeof m7_refreshPlanningRiskHeader === "function") m7_refreshPlanningRiskHeader();
      }
    } catch (e2) { /* ignore */ }
    try {
      if (typeof m5_refreshDamageMechanismList === "function") m5_refreshDamageMechanismList();
    } catch (eM5) { console.warn("osrOnM0StateApplied M3 damage list", eM5); }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("osrOnM0StateApplied", e);
  }
}

/** Location rules in exports always use the locked M0 default (not user-edited or M1-injected rows). */
function osrEnsureLocationRulesForSnapshot(rulesObj, vessel) {
  if (!rulesObj || typeof rulesObj !== "object") return;
  if (OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED && typeof osrCloneDefaultDemoLocation === "function") {
    rulesObj.location = osrCloneDefaultDemoLocation();
    return;
  }
  var row = osrLocationSitesRowFromM1Vessel(vessel);
  if (!row) return;
  if (!rulesObj.location || typeof rulesObj.location !== "object") rulesObj.location = { sites: [] };
  var sites = Array.isArray(rulesObj.location.sites) ? rulesObj.location.sites.slice() : [];
  osrUnshiftLocationSiteRow(sites, row);
  rulesObj.location.sites = sites;
}

/** True when embedded M0 (GRP) snapshot has no user content (empty title and sections). */
function osrRbiUserDataStateIsEmpty(state) {
  if (!state || typeof state !== "object") return true;
  if (String(state.title || "").trim()) return false;
  for (var k in state) {
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(state, k)) continue;
    if (k === "title" || k === "date") continue;
    var v = state[k];
    if (v == null || v === "") continue;
    if (typeof v !== "string") return false;
    var s = v.trim();
    if (!s) continue;
    try {
      var j = JSON.parse(s);
      if (j == null) continue;
      if (Array.isArray(j)) { if (j.length > 0) return false; continue; }
      if (typeof j === "object") {
        var keys = Object.keys(j);
        if (keys.length === 0) continue;
        if (keys.length === 1 && j.sites && Array.isArray(j.sites) && j.sites.length === 0) continue;
        return false;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/** True when vessel record has no user-entered data (fresh reset template). */
function osrVesselIsBlankForExport(vessel) {
  if (!vessel || !vessel.sentinel_rbi) return true;
  var s = vessel.sentinel_rbi;
  if (String(s.tag_number || "").trim()) return false;
  if (String(s.asset_id || "").trim()) return false;
  if (String(s.description || "").trim()) return false;
  var m1 = s.module1_asset || {};
  if (String(m1.tag || "").trim() || String(m1.name || "").trim() || String(m1.description || "").trim()) return false;
  var loc = m1.location || {};
  if (String(loc.site_name || "").trim() || String(loc.area || "").trim() || String(loc.system || "").trim()) return false;
  if (String(loc.bunded_area || "").trim()) return false;
  var dc = m1.design_conditions || {};
  if (dc.design_temperature_c != null || dc.design_pressure_mpa != null || dc.nominal_thickness_mm != null || dc.corrosion_allowance_mm != null) return false;
  var oc = m1.operating_conditions || {};
  if (oc.operating_pressure_mpa != null || oc.operating_temperature_c != null || oc.vessel_liquid_level_pct != null) return false;
  if (m1.vessel_volume_l != null) return false;
  if (s.module2_chemistry != null) return false;
  if (s.module3_damage != null) return false;
  if (s.module4_release != null) return false;
  if (s.module5_consequence != null) return false;
  if (s.module6_risk != null) return false;
  if (s.module8_references != null) {
    var m8 = s.module8_references;
    if (typeof m8 === "string" && m8.trim() !== "") return false;
    if (typeof m8 === "object" && !Array.isArray(m8) && Object.keys(m8).length > 0) return false;
    if (Array.isArray(m8) && m8.length > 0) return false;
  }
  if (s.module1_freeform != null && String(s.module1_freeform).trim() !== "") return false;
  if (s.module10_freeform != null && String(s.module10_freeform).trim() !== "") return false;
  var m7keys = ["module7_replicated_calcs", "module7_custom_inspection_rows", "module7_calc_inspection_selections", "module7_calc_freq_yrs", "module7_calc_comment", "module7_calc_inspection_type", "module7_selected_inspection_methods", "module7_calc_row_excluded"];
  for (var i = 0; i < m7keys.length; i++) {
    var mk = m7keys[i];
    if (s[mk] == null) continue;
    if (Array.isArray(s[mk]) && s[mk].length === 0) continue;
    if (typeof s[mk] === "object" && !Array.isArray(s[mk]) && Object.keys(s[mk]).length === 0) continue;
    if (typeof s[mk] === "string" && s[mk].trim() === "") continue;
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function osrExportUsesEmptyEmbeddedRulesOnly(vessel, rbiUserDataState) {
  return osrVesselIsBlankForExport(vessel) && (rbiUserDataState == null || osrRbiUserDataStateIsEmpty(rbiUserDataState));
}

/** Replace #demo-rules-json in the export clone with the in-memory rules snapshot (not the stale HTML source). */
function osrWriteExportedDemoRulesFromSource(doc, vessel, rbiUserDataState) {
  if (!doc) return;
  var el = doc.getElementById("demo-rules-json");
  if (!el) return;
  try {
    if (osrExportUsesEmptyEmbeddedRulesOnly(vessel, rbiUserDataState)) {
      var d0 = new Date();
      el.textContent = JSON.stringify({
        title: "",
        date: d0.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d0.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d0.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")
      });
      return;
    }
    var snap = osrSnapshotRulesObjectFromRef();
    osrEnsureLocationRulesForSnapshot(snap, vessel);
    el.textContent = JSON.stringify(snap);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("osrWriteExportedDemoRulesFromSource", e);
  }
}

/** Align RBI Data snapshot location table with M1 so reopening the builder shows the runtime asset site in the Location section. */
function osrMergeM1LocationIntoRbiUserDataState(state, vessel) {
  if (!state || typeof state !== "object") return;
  if (OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED || OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED) return;
  var row = osrLocationSitesRowFromM1Vessel(vessel);
  if (!row) return;
  try {
    var raw = state.location;
    var obj = null;
    if (typeof raw === "string" && raw.trim()) {
      try { obj = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { obj = null; }
    }
    if (!obj || typeof obj !== "object") obj = { sites: [] };
    var sites = Array.isArray(obj.sites) ? obj.sites.slice() : [];
    osrUnshiftLocationSiteRow(sites, row);
    obj.sites = sites;
    state.location = JSON.stringify(obj);
  } catch (e) { console.warn("osrMergeM1LocationIntoRbiUserDataState", e); }
}

/** Re-run module loaders from activeAsset so serialized HTML matches vessel data (e.g. M1 location in M9 narrative and lists). */
function osrSyncDomFromAssetForExport() {
  if (!activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  try {
    if (typeof m1_load === "function") m1_load();
    if (typeof m2_load === "function") m2_load();
    if (typeof m5_load === "function") m5_load();
    if (typeof m3_load === "function") m3_load();
    if (typeof m4_load === "function") m4_load();
    if (typeof m6_load === "function") m6_load();
    if (typeof m7_load === "function") m7_load();
    if (typeof m8_load === "function") m8_load();
    if (typeof m9_load === "function") m9_load();
  } catch (e) { console.warn("osrSyncDomFromAssetForExport", e); }
  try {
    if (typeof updateHeader === "function") updateHeader();
    if (typeof refSyncPills === "function") refSyncPills();
  } catch (e2) { console.warn("osrSyncDomFromAssetForExport header/ref", e2); }
}

/** Build read-only M0 reference markup for published runtime (no GRP script). */
function osrBuildReadonlyM0ReferenceMarkup(state) {
  var parts = [];
  parts.push('<div class="panel" id="panel0">');
  parts.push('<details class="osr-module-details" open id="osrMod0">');
  parts.push('<summary class="osr-module-summary module-title-row" style="margin-bottom:0">');
  parts.push('<h2 style="color:var(--accent);margin:0">M0 RBI Data — reference (read-only)</h2>');
  parts.push('<div class="osr-module-actions" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">');
  parts.push(
    '<button type="button" class="hBtn rulesTopBtn" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); osrM0ReferencePrint();" title="Print M0 reference (black text on white)">&#128424; Print</button>'
  );
  parts.push("</div>");
  parts.push("</summary>");
  parts.push(
    '<div class="osr-module-inner osr-m0-reference-inner"><div class="osr-module-asset-line" aria-live="polite"></div>'
  );
  parts.push('<p class="hint" style="margin-bottom:14px">Fixed in this published file. Use <strong>M1–M9</strong> for analysis work.</p>');
  parts.push(osrFormatM0ReportBodyHtml(state, {
    noStateMsg: "No M0 reference snapshot in this file.",
    emptySectionsMsg: "M0 snapshot present but all sections are empty."
  }));
  parts.push(
    '<p class="osr-module-footer" aria-hidden="true">© 2026 OpenRBI. All rights reserved. Unauthorised copying, redistribution, resale, hosting, modification, or commercial use is not permitted without written permission.</p>'
  );
  parts.push("</div></details></div>");
  return parts.join("");
}

/** Insert M0 tab + read-only panel into export doc after GRP module strip. */
function osrInjectReadonlyM0IntoExportDoc(doc, state) {
  var tabs = doc.getElementById("tabs");
  var p1 = doc.getElementById("panel1");
  if (!tabs || !tabs.firstChild || !p1 || !p1.parentNode) return;
  var tab0 = doc.createElement("div");
  tab0.className = "tab";
  tab0.setAttribute("data-mod", "0");
  tab0.setAttribute("onclick", "switchTab(0)");
  tab0.innerHTML = '<span class="dot done" id="dot0"></span>M0 reference (read-only)';
  tabs.insertBefore(tab0, tabs.firstChild);
  var holder = doc.createElement("div");
  holder.innerHTML = osrBuildReadonlyM0ReferenceMarkup(state).trim();
  var newP0 = holder.firstElementChild;
  if (newP0) p1.parentNode.insertBefore(newP0, p1);
}

/** Full current page as one downloadable .html: strips builder/file UI, removes RBI Data module from the file, embeds demo-rules from live REF (not the original HTML), shrinks demo asset stub, injects bundle (vessel + rbi_user_data_state + export_meta). */
function produceCombinedHtmlFile() {
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode: cannot produce a combined HTML file.");
    return;
  }
  if (!activeAsset) {
    alert("Load a vessel first (File → Load Json file) before producing combined HTML.");
    return;
  }
  try {
    flushAllModulesForExport();
    osrSyncDomFromAssetForExport();
    var metaForExport = getOsSourceMetadata();
    var rbiSnap = hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp() ? osrCallGetM0State() : null;
    if (rbiSnap != null && osrRbiUserDataStateIsEmpty(rbiSnap)) rbiSnap = null;
    if (rbiSnap != null) {
      try {
        osrHydrateRefFromM0Snapshot(rbiSnap);
        if (typeof refSyncPills === "function") refSyncPills();
      } catch (eh) {
        console.warn("produceCombinedHtmlFile hydrate from M0", eh);
      }
    }
    var vesselCopy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeAsset));
    var exportEmptyTemplate = osrExportUsesEmptyEmbeddedRulesOnly(vesselCopy, rbiSnap);
    if (exportEmptyTemplate) {
      var nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      if (vesselCopy.sentinel_rbi) {
        vesselCopy.sentinel_rbi.date_created = nowIso;
        vesselCopy.sentinel_rbi.last_modified = nowIso;
        vesselCopy.sentinel_rbi.audit_trail = [];
      }
      /* Do not leak builder #osr-source-metadata title when the user cleared the live title — that reads as stale/wrong data. */
      metaForExport = { runtimeFileTitle: "", analysisType: metaForExport.analysisType };
    }
    var bundle = {
      format: "OpenStandard_RBI_HTML_Bundle",
      version: "1.0",
      vessel: vesselCopy,
      rbi_user_data_state: rbiSnap,
      export_meta: {
        runtimeFileTitle: metaForExport.runtimeFileTitle,
        analysisType: metaForExport.analysisType
      }
    };
    if (bundle.rbi_user_data_state != null && typeof bundle.rbi_user_data_state === "object") {
      osrMergeM1LocationIntoRbiUserDataState(bundle.rbi_user_data_state, bundle.vessel);
    }
    var json = JSON.stringify(bundle);
    var safeJson = json.replace(/</g, "\\u003c");

    var parser = new DOMParser();
    var doc = parser.parseFromString("<!DOCTYPE html>\n" + document.documentElement.outerHTML, "text/html");
    if (!doc || !doc.documentElement || doc.querySelector("parsererror")) {
      throw new Error("Could not parse document for export.");
    }

    function rmById(id) {
      var n = doc.getElementById(id);
      if (n && n.parentNode) n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
    }

    rmById("gdu_fileInput");
    rmById("gdu_csvImportInput");
    rmById("gdu_documentCsvInput");
    rmById("gdu_produceReportBtn");
    rmById("osr-source-metadata");
    rmById("headerTopLeftRow");
    /* Runtime: remove RBI Data module (tab, panel, GRP CSS, GRP script). Snapshot stays in openstandard-bundle.rbi_user_data_state. */
    (function stripRuntimeEmbeddedRbiDataModule() {
      var gduCssMarker = "/* ─── Embedded RBI Data app (GRP) — scoped to #gduRoot ─── */";
      var hd = doc.head;
      if (hd) {
        var stList = hd.querySelectorAll("style");
        for (var si = 0; si < stList.length; si++) {
          var st = stList[si];
          var sc = st.textContent || "";
          var mx = sc.indexOf(gduCssMarker);
          if (mx >= 0) st.textContent = sc.slice(0, mx).replace(/\s+$/g, "");
        }
      }
      var t0 = doc.querySelector(".tab[data-mod=\"0\"]");
      if (t0 && t0.parentNode) t0.parentNode.removeChild(t0);
      var p0 = doc.getElementById("panel0");
      if (p0 && p0.parentNode) {
        var prev = p0.previousSibling;
        while (prev && prev.nodeType === 3 && !(String(prev.textContent || "").trim())) prev = prev.previousSibling;
        var pv = prev && (prev.nodeValue != null ? prev.nodeValue : prev.textContent || "");
        if (prev && prev.nodeType === 8 && pv.indexOf("MODULE 0: RBI USER DATA") >= 0) p0.parentNode.removeChild(prev);
        p0.parentNode.removeChild(p0);
      }
      var gduSc = doc.getElementById("osr-gdu-embed-script");
      if (gduSc && gduSc.parentNode) gduSc.parentNode.removeChild(gduSc);
      else {
        var scripts = doc.querySelectorAll("script");
        for (var sj = scripts.length - 1; sj >= 0; sj--) {
          var tx = scripts[sj].textContent || "";
          if (tx.indexOf("Embedded RBI Data (GRP) script") >= 0 && scripts[sj].parentNode) {
            scripts[sj].parentNode.removeChild(scripts[sj]);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    })();

    osrInjectReadonlyM0IntoExportDoc(doc, bundle.rbi_user_data_state);

    osrWriteExportedDemoRulesFromSource(doc, bundle.vessel, bundle.rbi_user_data_state);

    var da = doc.getElementById("demo-asset-json");
    if (da) da.textContent = OSR_EXPORT_MIN_DEMO_ASSET_JSON;

    Array.prototype.slice.call(doc.querySelectorAll("script[src]")).forEach(function(snode) {
      var src = (snode.getAttribute("src") || "");
      if (src.indexOf("html2pdf") >= 0 && snode.parentNode) {
        snode.parentNode.removeChild(snode);
      }
    });

    var root = doc.documentElement;
    if (!root.getAttribute("data-osr-combined-export")) {
      root.setAttribute("data-osr-combined-export", "1");
    }

    var bodyEl = doc.body;
    if (!bodyEl) throw new Error("Export document has no body.");
    var bundleEl = doc.createElement("script");
    bundleEl.setAttribute("type", "application/json");
    bundleEl.setAttribute("id", "openstandard-bundle");
    bundleEl.textContent = safeJson;
    bodyEl.insertBefore(bundleEl, bodyEl.firstChild);

    if (typeof osrStripDeliverableFileMenuM0Items === "function") osrStripDeliverableFileMenuM0Items(doc);

    var html = "<!DOCTYPE html>\n" + doc.documentElement.outerHTML;
    var meta = getOsSourceMetadata();
    var tag = (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number) ? String(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number) : "asset";
    tag = tag.replace(/[^\w\-.]+/g, "_").replace(/^_|_$/g, "") || "asset";
    var titleSlug = osrFilenameSlug(meta.runtimeFileTitle, tag, 80);
    var analysisSlug = osrFilenameSlug(meta.analysisType, "Pressure_Vessel_analysis", 80);
    var d = new Date();
    var dateStr = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    var timeStr = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
    var name = titleSlug + "_" + analysisSlug + "_" + dateStr + "_" + timeStr + "_publish.html";
    var blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + html], { type: "text/html;charset=utf-8" });
    osrTriggerDownloadBlob(blob, name);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("produceCombinedHtmlFile", e);
    alert("Could not produce combined HTML: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
  }
}

function saveToDiskWithoutM8() {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  if (!flushAllModulesForExport()) return;
  var copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeAsset));
  if (copy.sentinel_rbi) {
    copy.sentinel_rbi.module8_references = null;
    copy.sentinel_rbi.module10_freeform = null;
    if (copy.sentinel_rbi.module_status) copy.sentinel_rbi.module_status.module8 = null;
  }
  var tag = copy.sentinel_rbi.tag_number || "asset";
  var d = new Date();
  var dateStr = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  var timeStr = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
  var name = tag + "_" + dateStr + "_" + timeStr + "_noM8.csv";
  var blob = new Blob([vesselAssetToCsv(copy)], {type:"text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
  osrTriggerDownloadBlob(blob, name);
}

/**
 * True blank-builder state: no libraries in REF, minimal embedded rules JSON in the DOM,
 * and DEMO_RULES / DEMO_ASSET globals aligned (so export and “Load demo vessel” match).
 */
function osrResetBuilderRulesAndLibrariesToEmpty() {
  osrResetRefToEmpty();
  var d = new Date();
  var ds = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  var minimalRules = { title: "", date: ds };
  try {
    var dre = document.getElementById("demo-rules-json");
    if (dre) dre.textContent = JSON.stringify(minimalRules);
    DEMO_RULES = minimalRules;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("osrResetBuilderRulesAndLibrariesToEmpty rules", e);
  }
  try {
    var dae = document.getElementById("demo-asset-json");
    if (dae) dae.textContent = OSR_EXPORT_MIN_DEMO_ASSET_JSON;
    var parsedAsset = JSON.parse(OSR_EXPORT_MIN_DEMO_ASSET_JSON);
    DEMO_ASSET = parsedAsset;
  } catch (e2) {
    console.warn("osrResetBuilderRulesAndLibrariesToEmpty asset", e2);
  }
  if (typeof refSyncPills === "function") refSyncPills();
}

/** Convert M0 state to path,value CSV rows. */
function osrM0StateToCsv(state){
  var keys = ["location","chemical","toxic","acid","materials","tankComponents","damage","risk","riskMatrix","areaAffected","gff","pofMapping","halfRemainingLife","susceptibility","managementQuestionnaire","planning","inspectionMethod"];
  var labels = {
    location:"Location", chemical:"Chemical", toxic:"Toxic", acid:"Acid", materials:"Materials", tankComponents:"Tank components",
    damage:"Damage", risk:"CoF dimensions & PoF scale", riskMatrix:"Risk matrix", areaAffected:"Area affected",
    gff:"GFF", pofMapping:"PoF mapping", halfRemainingLife:"Half remaining life", susceptibility:"Susceptibility",
    managementQuestionnaire:"Management questionnaire", planning:"Planning", inspectionMethod:"Inspection method"
  };
  function parseJsonMaybe(v){
    var s = v == null ? "" : String(v).trim();
    if (!s) return null;
    if (s.charAt(0) !== "{" && s.charAt(0) !== "[") return null;
    try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function asArrayOfObjects(v){
    if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length && typeof v[0] === "object" && v[0] != null) return v;
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      var kk = Object.keys(v);
      for (var i=0;i<kk.length;i++){
        var a = v[kk[i]];
        if (Array.isArray(a) && a.length && typeof a[0] === "object" && a[0] != null) return a;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  function scalar(x){
    if (x == null) return "";
    if (typeof x === "string" || typeof x === "number" || typeof x === "boolean") return String(x);
    try { return JSON.stringify(x); } catch (e) { return String(x); }
  }
  state = state && typeof state === "object" ? state : {};
  var rows = [];
  var title = state.title == null ? "" : String(state.title);
  var date = state.date == null ? "" : String(state.date);
  rows.push(toCsvField("OpenRBI M0 RBI Data Export") + "," + toCsvField("Generated") + "," + toCsvField(new Date().toISOString()));
  rows.push(toCsvField("Title") + "," + toCsvField(title));
  rows.push(toCsvField("Date") + "," + toCsvField(date));
  rows.push("");
  keys.forEach(function(k){
    var lab = labels[k] || k;
    rows.push(toCsvField("SECTION") + "," + toCsvField(lab));
    var raw = state[k];
    var parsed = parseJsonMaybe(raw);
    if (parsed == null) {
      var txt = raw == null ? "" : String(raw).trim();
      if (!txt) rows.push(toCsvField("No data"));
      else rows.push(toCsvField(txt));
      rows.push("");
      return;
    }
    var arr = asArrayOfObjects(parsed);
    if (arr && arr.length) {
      var cols = [];
      arr.forEach(function(r){
        Object.keys(r||{}).forEach(function(c){ if (cols.indexOf(c) < 0) cols.push(c); });
      });
      if (!cols.length) rows.push(toCsvField("No rows"));
      else {
        rows.push(cols.map(function(c){ return toCsvField(c); }).join(","));
        arr.forEach(function(r){
          rows.push(cols.map(function(c){ return toCsvField(scalar(r ? r[c] : "")); }).join(","));
        });
      }
      rows.push("");
      return;
    }
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      rows.push(toCsvField("field") + "," + toCsvField("value"));
      Object.keys(parsed).forEach(function(pk){
        rows.push(toCsvField(pk) + "," + toCsvField(scalar(parsed[pk])));
      });
      rows.push("");
      return;
    }
    rows.push(toCsvField(scalar(parsed)));
    rows.push("");
  });
  return rows.join("\n") + "\n";
}

/** Download M0 RBI Data snapshot as CSV (embedded GRP app only). */
function saveRbiDataToDisk() {
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode: cannot save.");
    return;
  }
  if (!hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp()) {
    alert("M0 RBI Data editor is not in this file (e.g. published handout is read-only). Use Save combined CSV (full export) or Save vessel + M0 snapshot where available.");
    return;
  }
  try {
    if (typeof $ !== "function") $ = function(id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
    var state = osrCallGetM0State();
    var rawTitle = (state && state.title) ? String(state.title) : "";
    var titleSlug = rawTitle.replace(/[^\w\-.]+/g, "_").replace(/^_|_$/g, "").slice(0, 72) || "RBI_Data";
    var d = new Date();
    var dateStr = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    var timeStr = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
    var name = titleSlug + "_RBI_Data_" + dateStr + "_" + timeStr + ".csv";
    var blob = new Blob([osrM0StateToCsv(state)], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
    osrTriggerDownloadBlob(blob, name);
    try {
      var gsu = $("global_status");
      if (gsu) gsu.textContent = "Saved RBI Data CSV: " + name;
    } catch (e) {}
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("saveRbiDataToDisk", e);
    alert("Save RBI Data failed: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
  }
}

function onAssetLoaded() {
  try {
    var wsUnlock = document.getElementById("openrbiM0Workspace");
    if (wsUnlock && !wsUnlock.classList.contains("openrbi-m0-workspace--locked")) {
      document.body.classList.remove("openrbi-awaiting-disclaimer");
    }
    if (typeof $ !== "function") $ = function(id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
    if (typeof REF === "undefined" || REF == null) {
      REF = { locationLib: null, locationLibName: null, chemLib: [], chemLibName: null, toxLib: [], toxLibName: null, acidLib: [], acidLibName: null, otherLib: [], otherLibName: null, materialLib: [], materialLibName: null, tankComponentLib: [], tankComponentLibName: null, screenLib: null, screenLibName: null, gffLib: [], gffLibName: null, pofMapping: [], pofMappingName: null, halfRemainingLife: [], halfRemainingLifeName: null, susceptibilityBands: [], susceptibilityBandsName: null, managementQuestionnaire: null, managementQuestionnaireName: null, riskConfig: null, riskConfigName: null, consequenceDimensions: null, consequenceDimensionsName: null, consequenceAreas: null, consequenceAreasName: null, riskMatrix: null, riskMatrixName: null, planningLib: null, planningLibName: null, inspectionMethods: null, inspectionMethodsName: null };
    }
    if (typeof TAB_STATUS_IDS === "undefined" || TAB_STATUS_IDS == null) TAB_STATUS_IDS = {0:null,1:"m1",2:"m2",3:"m5",4:"m3",5:"m4",6:"m6",7:"m7",8:"m8",9:"m9"};
    updateHeader(); updateDots();
    var tb = $("tabs"), rb = $("refBar");
    if (activeAsset) {
      if (tb) tb.style.display = "flex";
      if (rb) rb.style.display = "block";
      refSyncPills();
      if (document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-layout") === "long-scroll" && typeof osrHydrateAllPanelsForLongScroll === "function") {
        osrHydrateAllPanelsForLongScroll();
      } else {
        if (!currentTab) switchTab(1);
        else switchTab(currentTab, true);
      }
    } else {
      /* No vessel: keep the same tab strip as loaded mode; header shows “No asset loaded”; load via File → Load Json file. */
      if (tb) tb.style.display = "flex";
      if (rb) rb.style.display = "none";
      if (document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-layout") === "long-scroll" && typeof osrHydrateBlankModulesForLongScroll === "function") {
        osrHydrateBlankModulesForLongScroll();
      } else if (typeof switchTab === "function") {
        switchTab(1, true);
      }
    }
  } catch(e) { console.error("onAssetLoaded", e); }
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  if (typeof osrRefreshCombinedCsvMenuVisibility === "function") osrRefreshCombinedCsvMenuVisibility();
  if (typeof initM3SectionCollapsibles === "function") initM3SectionCollapsibles();
  if (typeof osrScrollMainToTop === "function") osrScrollMainToTop();
}

function updateHeader() {
  var captions = document.querySelectorAll(".osr-module-asset-line");
  function clearCaptions() {
    captions.forEach(function(el) {
      el.textContent = "";
    });
  }
  if (!activeAsset) {
    if ($("noAsset")) $("noAsset").style.display = "";
    clearCaptions();
    return;
  }
  var s = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi, m1 = s.module1_asset || {}, loc = m1.location || {};
  if ($("noAsset")) $("noAsset").style.display = "none";
  var tag = s.tag_number || "—";
  var nm = (m1.name || s.description || "").trim();
  var eqType = ((m1.equipment_type || "").trim() || "Pressure Vessel");
  var namePart = (nm ? nm + " · " : "") + eqType;
  var lp = [loc.site_name, loc.area, loc.system].filter(Boolean);
  var locationPart = lp.length ? lp.join(" › ") : "";
  var line = tag + (namePart ? " " + namePart : "") + (locationPart ? " " + locationPart : "");
  captions.forEach(function(el) {
    el.textContent = line;
  });
}

function updateDots() {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  var ms = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module_status;
  for (var i=1;i<=9;i++) {
    var d = $("dot"+i);
    if (!d) continue;
    var st = (i===9) ? (activeAsset ? "done" : "empty") : ms["module"+i];
    d.className = "dot "+(st==="complete"||st==="done"?"done":st==="in_progress"?"wip":"empty");
  }
}

/** Push current M0 (GRP) state into REF / demo-rules without leaving the tab — same effect as Save when switching away from M0. Returns true if sync ran. */
function osrRefreshM0IntoApp() {
  if (!activeAsset) {
    alert("Load a vessel first (File → Load Json file, or open a bundle file).");
    return false;
  }
  if ((typeof window.osrGetM0State !== "function" && typeof getState !== "function") || typeof osrOnM0StateApplied !== "function") {
    alert("M0 RBI Data editor is not available in this file.");
    return false;
  }
  try {
    if (typeof OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED !== "undefined" && OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData === "function") {
      osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData();
    }
    var stM0 = osrCallGetM0State();
    osrOnM0StateApplied(stM0);
    var taRm = document.getElementById("gdu_riskMatrix");
    if (taRm && stM0.riskMatrix != null && String(stM0.riskMatrix).trim() !== "") {
      taRm.value = typeof stM0.riskMatrix === "string" ? stM0.riskMatrix : JSON.stringify(stM0.riskMatrix, null, 2);
    }
    var gsu = document.getElementById("global_status");
    if (gsu) gsu.textContent = (typeof OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED !== "undefined" && OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED)
      ? "M0 fixed reference re-synced to libraries for M1–M9."
      : "M0 refreshed — libraries updated for M1–M9.";
    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("osrRefreshM0IntoApp", e);
    alert("Refresh failed: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
    return false;
  }
}

/** Tab index = top bar M1–M9. */
function osrRefreshModuleFromM0(tabIndex) {
  var n = parseInt(tabIndex, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 9) return;
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode: cannot refresh.");
    return;
  }
  if (!activeAsset) {
    alert("Load a vessel first.");
    return;
  }
  if (typeof saveCurrentTab === "function" && typeof currentTab === "number" && currentTab === 0) {
    try {
      saveCurrentTab();
    } catch (e0) {
      console.warn("osrRefreshModuleFromM0 save M0 first", e0);
    }
  }
  if (typeof saveCurrentTab === "function" && typeof currentTab === "number" && currentTab === n) {
    try {
      saveCurrentTab();
    } catch (eSave) {
      console.warn("osrRefreshModuleFromM0 saveCurrentTab", eSave);
    }
  }
  if (typeof osrRefreshM0IntoApp !== "function" || !osrRefreshM0IntoApp()) return;
  try {
    switch (n) {
      case 1:
        if (typeof m1_load === "function") m1_load();
        break;
      case 2:
        if (typeof m2_load === "function") m2_load();
        break;
      case 3:
        if (typeof m5_load === "function") m5_load();
        break;
      case 4:
        if (typeof m3_load === "function") m3_load();
        break;
      case 5:
        if (typeof m4_load === "function") m4_load();
        break;
      case 6:
        if (typeof m6_load === "function") m6_load();
        break;
      case 7:
        if (typeof m7_load === "function") m7_load();
        break;
      case 8:
        if (typeof m8_load === "function") m8_load();
        break;
      case 9:
        if (typeof m9_load === "function") m9_load();
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
    if (typeof refSyncPills === "function") refSyncPills();
    if (n === 4 && REF.chemLib && REF.chemLib.length && typeof m3_popFluidSelect === "function") m3_popFluidSelect();
    if (typeof TAB_STATUS_IDS !== "undefined") {
      var sid = TAB_STATUS_IDS[n];
      if (sid) {
        var statusEl = document.getElementById(sid + "_status");
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = "Updated — " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
      }
    }
    var gsu = document.getElementById("global_status");
    if (gsu) gsu.textContent = "Module " + n + ": M0 applied to libraries and module reloaded.";
  } catch (e2) {
    console.error("osrRefreshModuleFromM0", e2);
    alert("Reload failed: " + (e2 && e2.message ? e2.message : String(e2)));
  }
}

function saveCurrentTab() {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  switch(currentTab) {
    case 0:
      /* M0 edits (including Risk Matrix cell colours) live in the GRP table until pushed to REF; other modules read REF. */
      if (typeof OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED !== "undefined" && OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData === "function") {
        osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData();
      }
      if (typeof osrOnM0StateApplied === "function") {
        try {
          var stM0 = osrCallGetM0State();
          if (stM0 != null) osrOnM0StateApplied(stM0);
          var taRm = document.getElementById("gdu_riskMatrix");
          if (taRm && stM0.riskMatrix != null && String(stM0.riskMatrix).trim() !== "") {
            taRm.value = typeof stM0.riskMatrix === "string" ? stM0.riskMatrix : JSON.stringify(stM0.riskMatrix, null, 2);
          }
        } catch (eM0) {
          console.warn("M0→REF sync on tab leave", eM0);
        }
      }
      break;
    case 1: m1_save(); break;
    case 2: m2_save(); break;
    case 3: m5_save(); break;
    case 4: m3_save(); break;
    case 5: m4_save(); break;
    case 6: m6_save(); break;
    case 7: m7_save(); break;
    case 8: m8_save(); break;
    case 9: /* Report is read-only */ break;
  }
  updateGlobalSaveBar(currentTab);
}

/**
 * Flush all modules to memory, then download combined CSV (vessel + M0 RBI snapshot when embedded).
 * Filename: {Title from header}_Export_{YYYY-MM-DD}_{HH-mm-ss}_combined.csv (title falls back to asset tag).
 */
function saveCombinedCsvExport() {
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode: cannot save.");
    return;
  }
  if (!activeAsset) {
    alert("Load a vessel first (File → Load Json file), then use Save combined CSV (full export).");
    return;
  }
  try {
    if (!flushAllModulesForExport()) return;
    var meta = typeof getOsSourceMetadata === "function" ? getOsSourceMetadata() : { runtimeFileTitle: "", analysisType: "" };
    var tag = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number ? String(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number) : "asset";
    var titleSlug = typeof osrFilenameSlug === "function" ? osrFilenameSlug(meta.runtimeFileTitle, tag, 80) : String(tag).replace(/[^\w\-.]+/g, "_") || "asset";
    var d = new Date();
    var dateStr = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    var timeStr = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
    var embed = hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp();
    var hasRuntimeM0 = typeof window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot !== "undefined" && window.__osrRuntimeM0Snapshot != null;
    var combined = embed || hasRuntimeM0;
    var name = titleSlug + "_Export_" + dateStr + "_" + timeStr + (combined ? "_combined.csv" : ".csv");
    var toSave = combined ? buildAssetWithRbiUserData(activeAsset) : activeAsset;
    var blob = new Blob([vesselAssetToCsv(toSave)], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
    osrTriggerDownloadBlob(blob, name);
    var gsu = $("global_status");
    if (gsu) gsu.textContent = "Combined CSV save: " + name;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("saveCombinedCsvExport", e);
    alert("Save combined CSV (full export) failed: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
  }
}

function osrFocusDisclaimer(ev) {
  try {
    if (ev) { ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation(); }
    document.querySelectorAll("#tabs .tab").forEach(function(t){ t.classList.remove("active"); });
    var td = document.getElementById("tabDisclaimer");
    if (td) td.classList.add("active");
    var g = document.getElementById("openrbiDisclaimerGate");
    if (g && typeof g.scrollIntoView === "function") {
      g.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    }
  } catch (e) { console.warn("osrFocusDisclaimer", e); }
}

function switchTab(num, skipSave, skipScroll) {
  try {
    if (currentTab && activeAsset && !skipSave) saveCurrentTab();
  } catch (eSave) {
    console.warn("switchTab saveCurrentTab", eSave);
  }
  currentTab = num;
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(function(t){t.classList.toggle("active",parseInt(t.dataset.mod)===num);});
  document.querySelectorAll(".panel").forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove("active");});
  var panel = $("panel"+num);
  if(panel) panel.classList.add("active");
  var rb0 = $("refBar");
  if (rb0) rb0.style.display = (num === 0) ? "none" : (activeAsset ? "block" : "none");
  refSyncPills();
  if(num===4 && REF.chemLib&&REF.chemLib.length) m3_popFluidSelect();
  try {
    switch(num) {
      case 0: break;
      case 1: m1_load(); break;
      case 2: m2_load(); break;
      case 3: m5_load(); break;
      case 4: m3_load(); break;
      case 5: m4_load(); break;
      case 6: m6_load(); break;
      case 7: m7_load(); break;
      case 8: m8_load(); break;
      case 9: /* Report stays blank until user clicks Produce report */ break;
    }
  } catch(e) { console.error("switchTab "+num+" failed:", e); }
  updateGlobalSaveBar(num);
  if (document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-layout") === "long-scroll") {
    try {
      var modWrap = $("osrMod" + num);
      if (modWrap && modWrap.tagName === "DETAILS") modWrap.setAttribute("open", "");
      if (!skipScroll && typeof osrScrollToPanelInMain === "function") osrScrollToPanelInMain(num);
    } catch (eScroll) { /* ignore */ }
  }
}
window.switchTab = switchTab;
window.osrFocusDisclaimer = osrFocusDisclaimer;

/** Long-scroll with no vessel: run module loaders that support blank state (M3 damage UI, etc.). */
function osrHydrateBlankModulesForLongScroll() {
  if (typeof switchTab !== "function") return;
  if (typeof m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded === "function") {
    try { m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded(); } catch (eLib) { console.warn("osrHydrateBlankModules M0 damage lib", eLib); }
  }
  for (var hi = 0; hi <= 9; hi++) {
    switchTab(hi, true, true);
  }
  if (typeof m5_load === "function") {
    try { m5_load(); } catch (eM3) { console.warn("osrHydrateBlankModules m5_load", eM3); }
  }
  if (typeof initM3SectionCollapsibles === "function") initM3SectionCollapsibles();
  switchTab(0, true, true);
  if (typeof osrScrollMainToTop === "function") osrScrollMainToTop();
}

/** Long-scroll: walk M0–M9 so each panel is populated from activeAsset.
 *  Uses skipSave=true on each switch so we never write stale DOM back into activeAsset
 *  (required after File → Reset M1–M9, JSON load, or any full asset replace). */
function osrHydrateAllPanelsForLongScroll() {
  if (typeof switchTab !== "function") return;
  if (!activeAsset) {
    osrHydrateBlankModulesForLongScroll();
    return;
  }
  for (var hi = 0; hi <= 9; hi++) {
    switchTab(hi, true, true);
  }
  switchTab(0, true, true);
  if (typeof osrScrollMainToTop === "function") osrScrollMainToTop();
}

function refreshCurrentModule(){
  if(!currentTab)return;
  try {
    switch(currentTab) {
      case 0: break;
      case 1: m1_load(); break;
      case 2: m2_load(); break;
      case 3: m5_load(); break;
      case 4: m3_load(); break;
      case 5: m4_load(); break;
      case 6: m6_load(); break;
      case 7: m7_load(); break;
      case 8: m8_load(); break;
      case 9: /* Report stays blank until user clicks Produce report */ break;
    }
    refSyncPills();
    if(currentTab===4&&REF.chemLib&&REF.chemLib.length)m3_popFluidSelect();
    var sid=TAB_STATUS_IDS[currentTab];
    if(sid){ var statusEl=$(sid+"_status"); if(statusEl)statusEl.textContent="Refreshed — "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString(); }
  } catch(e) { console.error("refresh failed:", e); }
}

var TAB_STATUS_IDS={0:null,1:"m1",2:"m2",3:"m5",4:"m3",5:"m4",6:"m6",7:"m7",8:"m8",9:"m9"};
function updateGlobalSaveBar(num){
  if (typeof TAB_STATUS_IDS === "undefined" || TAB_STATUS_IDS == null) TAB_STATUS_IDS = {0:null,1:"m1",2:"m2",3:"m5",4:"m3",5:"m4",6:"m6",7:"m7",8:"m8",9:"m9"};
  if (num===0) {
    if ($("global_status")) {
      var rt = typeof isRuntimeDeliverableHtml === "function" && isRuntimeDeliverableHtml();
      var m0Fixed = typeof OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED !== "undefined" && OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED;
      $("global_status").textContent = m0Fixed
        ? "M0 RBI Data — fixed approved reference (view only). M1–M9 use this embedded data."
        : (rt ? "M0 reference (read-only) — not editable" : "M0 RBI Data — use File menu for JSON/CSV and handouts; collapse/expand via module sections");
    }
    var b0 = $("globalSaveBtn");
    if (b0) { b0.style.display = "none"; }
    return;
  }
  var sid = TAB_STATUS_IDS[num];
  var statusEl=sid?$(sid+"_status"):null;
  var btn=$("globalSaveBtn");
  if($("global_status")) $("global_status").textContent=statusEl?statusEl.textContent:"Ready";
  if(btn){ btn.textContent=(num===9)?"Print report \u2191":"Save M"+num+" \u2191"; btn.style.display=(num===9)?"none":""; }
}

function setModuleStatus(num, status) {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module_status["module"+num] = status;
  updateDots();
}

function auditLog(modNum, action) {
  if (!activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var s = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
  if (!Array.isArray(s.audit_trail)) s.audit_trail = [];
  s.audit_trail.push({timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),module:modNum,action:action,user:null});
  s.last_modified = new Date().toISOString();
}

function osrNormalizeTheme(t) {
  var v = String(t || "").toLowerCase();
  if (v === "dark" || v === "light" || v === "grey" || v === "gray" || v === "medium" || v === "half-light") {
    if (v === "gray" || v === "medium" || v === "half-light") return "grey";
    return v;
  }
  return "grey";
}
function osrSyncThemeButtons() {
  var c = osrNormalizeTheme(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme"));
  var btns = document.querySelectorAll(".osr-theme-btn[data-osr-theme]");
  for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
    var b = btns[i];
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("data-osr-theme") === c ? "true" : "false");
  }
  var el = document.getElementById("themeIcon");
  if (el) el.textContent = c === "dark" ? "\u263E" : c === "grey" ? "\u26C5" : "\u2600";
}
function osrSetTheme(theme) {
  var t = osrNormalizeTheme(theme);
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", t);
  osrSyncThemeButtons();
  if (typeof window.osrSyncGduRootThemeFromShell === "function") {
    try { window.osrSyncGduRootThemeFromShell(t); } catch (eG) { console.warn("osrSyncGduRootThemeFromShell", eG); }
  }
}
function applyDefaultTheme() {
  osrSetTheme("grey");
}
function toggleTheme() {
  var c = osrNormalizeTheme(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme"));
  var next = c === "dark" ? "grey" : c === "grey" ? "light" : "dark";
  osrSetTheme(next);
}
function updateThemeIcon() {
  osrSyncThemeButtons();
}
applyDefaultTheme();

var OSR_TEXT_SIZE_KEY = "osr_text_size";
var OSR_TEXT_SIZE_DEFAULT = 3;
var OSR_TEXT_SIZE_ZOOM = [0.85, 0.92, 1, 1.08, 1.16];
function osrNormalizeTextSize(n) {
  n = parseInt(n, 10);
  if (isNaN(n) || n < 1) return OSR_TEXT_SIZE_DEFAULT;
  if (n > 5) return 5;
  return n;
}
function osrIsTridentIE() {
  return /MSIE|Trident\//.test(navigator.userAgent || "");
}
function osrZoomForTextSize(size) {
  return OSR_TEXT_SIZE_ZOOM[osrNormalizeTextSize(size) - 1];
}
function osrResetWindowScroll() {
  try {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    if (document.documentElement) document.documentElement.scrollTop = 0;
    if (document.body) document.body.scrollTop = 0;
  } catch (eScroll) {}
}
function osrResetViewportScroll() {
  try {
    osrResetWindowScroll();
    var main = document.getElementById("osrMainScroll");
    if (main) main.scrollTop = 0;
  } catch (eScroll) {}
}
/** Scroll the main document column to top (long-scroll layout); also clears window scroll (IE / Chrome). */
function osrScrollMainToTop() {
  osrResetViewportScroll();
}
/** Scroll only #osrMainScroll to a module panel — avoids scrollIntoView moving the window and clipping #header. */
function osrScrollToPanelInMain(num) {
  var main = document.getElementById("osrMainScroll");
  var scrollPanel = document.getElementById("panel" + num);
  if (!main || !scrollPanel) return;
  try {
    var mainRect = main.getBoundingClientRect();
    var panelRect = scrollPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
    var target = main.scrollTop + (panelRect.top - mainRect.top) - 12;
    if (main.scrollTo) main.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, target), behavior: "smooth" });
    else main.scrollTop = Math.max(0, target);
    osrResetWindowScroll();
  } catch (eScroll) {
    try {
      if (scrollPanel.scrollIntoView) scrollPanel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      osrResetWindowScroll();
    } catch (e2) {}
  }
}
function osrApplyTextSize(size) {
  size = osrNormalizeTextSize(size);
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-text-size", String(size));
  var z = osrZoomForTextSize(size);
  var main = document.getElementById("osrMainScroll");
  var bar = document.getElementById("osrM345ScenarioBar");
  var rb = document.getElementById("readonlyBanner");
  var ws = document.getElementById("osrWorkspace");
  var zoomVal = z === 1 ? "" : String(z);
  document.body.style.zoom = "1";
  if (ws) ws.style.zoom = "";
  if (osrIsTridentIE()) {
    if (main) main.style.zoom = zoomVal;
    if (bar) bar.style.zoom = zoomVal;
    if (rb) rb.style.zoom = zoomVal;
  } else {
    if (main) main.style.zoom = "";
    if (bar) bar.style.zoom = "";
    if (rb) rb.style.zoom = "";
  }
  var btns = document.querySelectorAll(".osr-text-size-btn[data-osr-text-size]");
  for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {
    var b = btns[i];
    var s = parseInt(b.getAttribute("data-osr-text-size"), 10);
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", s === size ? "true" : "false");
  }
}
function osrSetTextSize(size) {
  size = osrNormalizeTextSize(size);
  osrApplyTextSize(size);
  try { localStorage.setItem(OSR_TEXT_SIZE_KEY, String(size)); } catch (e) {}
}
function osrInitTextSizeFromStorage() {
  var v = null;
  try { v = localStorage.getItem(OSR_TEXT_SIZE_KEY); } catch (e) {}
  osrApplyTextSize(v != null ? v : OSR_TEXT_SIZE_DEFAULT);
}
osrInitTextSizeFromStorage();

var OSR_LAYOUT_RULER_KEY = "osr_layout_ruler";
var osrLayoutRulerResizeTimer = null;
function osrRefreshLayoutRuler(){
  var wrap=document.getElementById("osrLayoutRulerWrap");
  var track=document.getElementById("osrLayoutRulerTrack");
  if(!wrap||!track||wrap.hidden)return;
  var w=Math.floor(document.documentElement.clientWidth||window.innerWidth||0);
  if(w<240)w=240;
  track.style.width=w+"px";
  track.innerHTML="";
  var frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
  for(var x=0;x<=w;x+=100){
    var lab=document.createElement("span");
    lab.className="osr-layout-ruler-label"+(x===0?" osr-layout-ruler-label--edge":"");
    lab.style.left=x+"px";
    lab.textContent=String(x);
    frag.appendChild(lab);
  }
  track.appendChild(frag);
}
function osrApplyLayoutRuler(on){
  var wrap=document.getElementById("osrLayoutRulerWrap");
  var btn=document.getElementById("osrLayoutRulerBtn");
  if(wrap){
    if(on){
      wrap.removeAttribute("hidden");
      wrap.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
    }else{
      wrap.setAttribute("hidden","");
      wrap.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
    }
  }
  if(btn){
    btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed",on?"true":"false");
    btn.textContent=on?"Ruler on":"Ruler";
    btn.title=on
      ? "Horizontal pixel ruler on: numbers are CSS pixels from the viewport left edge. Minor ticks every 10px; medium every 50px; major every 100px. Resize refreshes. Click to hide."
      : "Show a horizontal pixel ruler under the header for layout checks and trainee guidance. Saved in this browser.";
  }
  if(on)osrRefreshLayoutRuler();
}
function osrToggleLayoutRuler(){
  var wrap=document.getElementById("osrLayoutRulerWrap");
  var on=wrap&&!wrap.hasAttribute("hidden");
  osrApplyLayoutRuler(!on);
  try{ localStorage.setItem(OSR_LAYOUT_RULER_KEY,!on?"1":"0"); }catch(e){}
}
function osrInitLayoutRulerFromStorage(){
  var v=null;
  try{ v=localStorage.getItem(OSR_LAYOUT_RULER_KEY); }catch(e){}
  osrApplyLayoutRuler(v==="1");
}
function osrOnLayoutRulerResize(){
  var wrap=document.getElementById("osrLayoutRulerWrap");
  if(!wrap||wrap.hasAttribute("hidden"))return;
  if(osrLayoutRulerResizeTimer)clearTimeout(osrLayoutRulerResizeTimer);
  osrLayoutRulerResizeTimer=setTimeout(function(){
    osrLayoutRulerResizeTimer=null;
    osrRefreshLayoutRuler();
  },80);
}
osrInitLayoutRulerFromStorage();
window.addEventListener("resize",osrOnLayoutRulerResize,{passive:true});

var OSR_TAB_RAIL_KEY = "osrModuleTabRailVisible";
function osrSetModuleTabRailVisible(show, persist) {
  var ws = document.getElementById("osrWorkspace");
  var hideBtn = document.getElementById("osrTabRailHideBtn");
  var showBtn = document.getElementById("osrTabRailShowBtn");
  if (!ws) return;
  if (show) {
    ws.classList.remove("osr-tabs-collapsed");
  } else {
    ws.classList.add("osr-tabs-collapsed");
  }
  if (hideBtn) hideBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", show ? "true" : "false");
  if (showBtn) {
    if (show) showBtn.setAttribute("hidden", "");
    else showBtn.removeAttribute("hidden");
    showBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", show ? "false" : "true");
  }
  if (persist !== false) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(OSR_TAB_RAIL_KEY, show ? "1" : "0"); } catch (e) {}
  }
}
function osrInitModuleTabRailFromStorage() {
  var v = null;
  try { v = localStorage.getItem(OSR_TAB_RAIL_KEY); } catch (e) {}
  if (v === "0") osrSetModuleTabRailVisible(false, false);
}
osrInitModuleTabRailFromStorage();

/** M3 panel collapsibles — M0-style section + .collapsed (no native <details> in #panel3). */
function initM3SectionCollapsibles(root) {
  root = root || document.getElementById("panel3");
  if (!root || !root.querySelectorAll) return;
  root.querySelectorAll(".m3-section").forEach(function(section) {
    var summary = section.querySelector(":scope > summary");
    if (!summary) return;
    summary.setAttribute("role", "button");
    if (summary.dataset.m3CollapseBound !== "1") {
      summary.dataset.m3CollapseBound = "1";
      if (section.dataset.m3Default === "collapsed") section.classList.add("collapsed");
      summary.setAttribute("aria-expanded", section.classList.contains("collapsed") ? "false" : "true");
      summary.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
        if (e.target.closest("button,a,input,select,textarea,label")) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        section.classList.toggle("collapsed");
        summary.setAttribute("aria-expanded", section.classList.contains("collapsed") ? "false" : "true");
      });
      summary.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
        if (e.key !== "Enter" && e.key !== " ") return;
        if (e.target.closest("button,a,input,select,textarea")) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        section.classList.toggle("collapsed");
        summary.setAttribute("aria-expanded", section.classList.contains("collapsed") ? "false" : "true");
      });
    } else {
      summary.setAttribute("aria-expanded", section.classList.contains("collapsed") ? "false" : "true");
    }
  });
}
function osrCollapseM3Sections() {
  document.querySelectorAll("#panel3 .m3-section").forEach(function(section) {
    section.classList.add("collapsed");
    var summary = section.querySelector(":scope > summary");
    if (summary) summary.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
  });
}
function osrExpandM3Sections() {
  document.querySelectorAll("#panel3 .m3-section").forEach(function(section) {
    section.classList.remove("collapsed");
    var summary = section.querySelector(":scope > summary");
    if (summary) summary.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
  });
}
window.initM3SectionCollapsibles = initM3SectionCollapsibles;

  });
  if (typeof window.osrCollapseAllM0Sections === "function") {
    try { window.osrCollapseAllM0Sections(); } catch (eM0) { console.warn("osrCollapseAllM0Sections", eM0); }

  document.querySelectorAll("details").forEach(function(d){ d.setAttribute("open",""); });
  /* Long-scroll empty file: M3 may never have had m5_load until user opens a tab — ensure blank calc UI exists. */

    if (!mw || !String(mw.innerHTML || "").trim()) {
      try { m5_load(); } catch (eM3) { console.warn("appExpandAll m5_load", eM3); }

  if (typeof osrExpandM3Sections === "function") osrExpandM3Sections();
  document.querySelectorAll(".m5-calc-body").forEach(function(body){
    body.classList.remove("is-collapsed");
    var btn=body.closest(".card")&&body.closest(".card").querySelector(".m5-calc-head button[aria-label]");
    if(btn){ btn.innerHTML=typeof m5_iconChevronDown!=="undefined"?m5_iconChevronDown:"&#9660;"; btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true"); btn.setAttribute("aria-label","Collapse"); }
  });
  if (typeof window.osrExpandAllM0Sections === "function") {
    try { window.osrExpandAllM0Sections(); } catch (eM0) { console.warn("osrExpandAllM0Sections", eM0); }
  }
}

function osrFileMenuM0SaveJson() {

}
