/** File menu: full vessel JSON (same merge as combined CSV export — includes M0 snapshot when embedded). */
function osrEscapeXml(s) {
  return String(s)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
}
function osrSanitizeXmlName(name) {
  var n = String(name == null ? "element" : name);
  if (!/^[A-Za-z_]/.test(n)) n = "n_" + n;
  return n.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]/g, "_");
}
function osrObjectHasUnsafeXmlKeys(obj) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== "object" || Array.isArray(obj)) return false;
  var keys = Object.keys(obj);
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    if (osrSanitizeXmlName(keys[i]) !== keys[i]) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function osrJsonToXml(val, tagName) {
  tagName = osrSanitizeXmlName(tagName || "root");
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return "<" + tagName + "/>";
  if (typeof val === "boolean" || typeof val === "number") {
    return "<" + tagName + ">" + osrEscapeXml(String(val)) + "</" + tagName + ">";
  }
  if (typeof val === "string") {
    return "<" + tagName + ">" + osrEscapeXml(val) + "</" + tagName + ">";
  }
  if (Array.isArray(val)) {
    var items = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < val.length; i++) items += osrJsonToXml(val[i], "item");
    return "<" + tagName + ">" + items + "</" + tagName + ">";
  }
  if (typeof val === "object") {
    if (osrObjectHasUnsafeXmlKeys(val)) {
      return "<" + tagName + " encoding=\"json\">" + osrEscapeXml(JSON.stringify(val)) + "</" + tagName + ">";
    }
    var inner = "";
    var keys = Object.keys(val);
    for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) inner += osrJsonToXml(val[keys[k]], keys[k]);
    return "<" + tagName + ">" + inner + "</" + tagName + ">";
  }
  return "<" + tagName + ">" + osrEscapeXml(String(val)) + "</" + tagName + ">";
}
function osrCoerceXmlText(s) {
  if (s === "" || s == null) return null;
  if (s === "true") return true;
  if (s === "false") return false;
  if (/^-?(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?$/.test(s)) return Number(s);
  return s;
}
function osrXmlElementToJson(el) {
  if (!el || el.nodeType !== 1) return null;
  if (el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute("encoding") === "json") {
    var raw = (el.textContent || "").trim();
    if (!raw) return {};
    try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch (eJson) { console.warn("osrXmlElementToJson json", eJson); return {}; }
  }
  var elems = [];
  var cn = el.childNodes;
  for (var i = 0; i < cn.length; i++) {
    if (cn[i].nodeType === 1) elems.push(cn[i]);
  }
  if (!elems.length) return osrCoerceXmlText((el.textContent || "").trim());
  var allItem = elems.length > 0;
  for (var j = 0; j < elems.length; j++) {
    if (elems[j].nodeName !== "item") { allItem = false; break; }
  }
  if (allItem) {
    var arr = [];
    for (var a = 0; a < elems.length; a++) arr.push(osrXmlElementToJson(elems[a]));
    return arr;
  }
  var groups = {};
  for (var g = 0; g < elems.length; g++) {
    var nm = elems[g].nodeName;
    if (!groups[nm]) groups[nm] = [];
    groups[nm].push(osrXmlElementToJson(elems[g]));
  }
  var out = {};
  var gkeys = Object.keys(groups);
  for (var gi = 0; gi < gkeys.length; gi++) {
    var gn = gkeys[gi];
    out[gn] = groups[gn].length === 1 ? groups[gn][0] : groups[gn];
  }
  return out;
}
function osrParseVesselXmlText(text) {
  var raw = String(text || "").replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim();
  if (!raw) throw new Error("XML file is empty.");
  var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(raw, "application/xml");
  if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) throw new Error("Could not parse XML.");
  if (doc.getElementsByTagName("parsererror").length) {
    var pe = doc.getElementsByTagName("parsererror")[0];
    throw new Error((pe && (pe.textContent || pe.innerText)) ? String(pe.textContent || pe.innerText).trim() : "Invalid XML.");
  }
  return osrXmlElementToJson(doc.documentElement);
}
function osrVesselExportFilename(ext) {
  var meta = typeof getOsSourceMetadata === "function" ? getOsSourceMetadata() : { runtimeFileTitle: "", analysisType: "" };
  var tag = activeAsset && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number
    ? String(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number) : "asset";
  var titleSlug = typeof osrFilenameSlug === "function" ? osrFilenameSlug(meta.runtimeFileTitle, tag, 80) : String(tag).replace(/[^\w\-.]+/g, "_") || "asset";
  var d = new Date();
  var dateStr = d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  var timeStr = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, "0");
  return titleSlug + "_circuit_" + dateStr + "_" + timeStr + "." + ext;
}
function osrApplyLoadedVesselObject(j, fname, kind) {
  kind = kind || "file";
  if (j && j.format === "OpenStandard_RBI_HTML_Bundle" && j.vessel && j.vessel.sentinel_rbi) {
    applyOpenstandardBundleObject(j);
    if (typeof onAssetLoaded === "function") onAssetLoaded();
    try {
      var gsu = typeof $ === "function" ? $("global_status") : document.getElementById("global_status");
      if (gsu) gsu.textContent = "Loaded bundle " + kind + ": " + fname;
    } catch (e4) {}
    return true;
  }
  if (j && j.sentinel_rbi) {
    finishVesselLoadFromDiskData(j, fname);
    try {
      var gsu2 = typeof $ === "function" ? $("global_status") : document.getElementById("global_status");
      if (gsu2) gsu2.textContent = "Loaded " + kind + ": " + fname;
    } catch (e5) {}
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** File menu: load vessel JSON (same shape as Save as Json file) or publish bundle JSON. */
function osrLoadVesselJsonFile() {
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode: cannot load.");
    return;
  }
  var inp = document.createElement("input");
  inp.type = "file";
  inp.accept = ".json,application/json";
  inp.onchange = function() {
    if (!inp.files.length) return;
    var file = inp.files[0];
    var fname = file.name || "";
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onerror = function() {
      alert("Could not read the file from disk.");
    };
    reader.onload = function() {
      var text = reader.result;
      if (text == null || (typeof text === "string" && text.length === 0)) {
        alert("The selected file is empty.");
        return;
      }
      try {
        var j = JSON.parse(String(text).replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim());
        if (osrApplyLoadedVesselObject(j, fname, "JSON")) return;
        alert("Unrecognised JSON: expected a vessel object with sentinel_rbi, or OpenStandard_RBI_HTML_Bundle.");
      } catch (e) {
        alert("Invalid JSON file: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };
  inp.click();
}
/** File menu: load vessel XML (same data as Save all as XML / JSON). */
function osrLoadVesselXmlFile() {
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    alert("Read-only mode: cannot load.");
    return;
  }
  var inp = document.createElement("input");
  inp.type = "file";
  inp.accept = ".xml,application/xml,text/xml";
  inp.onchange = function() {
    if (!inp.files.length) return;
    var file = inp.files[0];
    var fname = file.name || "";
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onerror = function() {
      alert("Could not read the file from disk.");
    };
    reader.onload = function() {
      var text = reader.result;
      if (text == null || (typeof text === "string" && text.length === 0)) {
        alert("The selected file is empty.");
        return;
      }
      try {
        var j = osrParseVesselXmlText(text);
        if (osrApplyLoadedVesselObject(j, fname, "XML")) return;
        alert("Unrecognised XML: expected a vessel object with sentinel_rbi, or OpenStandard_RBI_HTML_Bundle.");
      } catch (e) {
        alert("Invalid XML file: " + (e && e.message ? e.message : String(e)));
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };
  inp.click();
}

var M1_EQUIPMENT_TYPE = "Storage Tank (atmospheric API 650)";
var M1_DEFAULT_DESIGN_TEMP_C = 93;
var M1_DEFAULT_DESIGN_PRESSURE_MPA = 0;
function m1_resolveDesignTempC(dc) {
  return dc && dc.design_temperature_c != null && dc.design_temperature_c !== "" ? dc.design_temperature_c : M1_DEFAULT_DESIGN_TEMP_C;
}
function m1_resolveDesignPresMpa(dc) {
  return dc && dc.design_pressure_mpa != null && dc.design_pressure_mpa !== "" ? dc.design_pressure_mpa : M1_DEFAULT_DESIGN_PRESSURE_MPA;
}
function m1_ensureApi650EquipmentType(m) {
  if (m) m.equipment_type = M1_EQUIPMENT_TYPE;
}
function m1_setDateField(id, iso) {
  var el = $(id);
  if (!el) return;
  var raw = iso != null ? String(iso).trim() : "";
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(raw)) el.value = raw;
  else if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(raw)) el.value = raw.slice(0, 10);
  else el.value = "";
}

function m1_setFoundationValue(val) {
  var el = $("m1_foundation");
  if (!el) return;
  var v = val != null ? String(val).trim() : "";
  if (!v) { el.value = ""; return; }
  var found = false;
  for (var i = 0; i < el.options.length; i++) {
    if (el.options[i].value === v) { found = true; break; }
  }
  if (!found) {
    var o = document.createElement("option");
    o.value = v;
    o.textContent = v + " (imported)";
    el.appendChild(o);
  }
  el.value = v;
}

  }
  $("m1_tag").value = m.tag || "";
  $("m1_name").value = m.name || "";

  if (!m.design_conditions) m.design_conditions = {};

function m1_save() {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  var m = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset;
  if (!m) { activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset = {}; m = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset; }
  m.tag = $("m1_tag").value.trim();
  m.name = $("m1_name").value.trim();
  m.description = $("m1_desc").value.trim();
  m1_ensureApi650EquipmentType(m);
  var installRaw = $("m1_installDate") ? String($("m1_installDate").value || "").trim() : "";
  m.vessel_new_date = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(installRaw) ? installRaw : null;
  if ($("m1_editor") && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) {
    if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_freeform) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_freeform = "";
    activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_freeform = $("m1_editor").innerHTML.trim() || "";
    m.notes = "";
  }
  m.location = { site_name: $("m1_site").value.trim(), area: $("m1_area").value.trim(), system: $("m1_system").value.trim() };
  m.design_conditions = {
    design_temperature_c: numOrNull($("m1_tempC").value) != null ? numOrNull($("m1_tempC").value) : M1_DEFAULT_DESIGN_TEMP_C,
    design_pressure_mpa: numOrNull($("m1_presMPa").value) != null ? numOrNull($("m1_presMPa").value) : M1_DEFAULT_DESIGN_PRESSURE_MPA,
    nominal_thickness_mm: numOrNull($("m1_nomThk").value),
    corrosion_allowance_mm: numOrNull($("m1_corrAllow").value)
  };
  m.operating_conditions = {
    operating_pressure_mpa: numOrNull($("m1_opPres").value),
    operating_temperature_c: numOrNull($("m1_opTemp").value),
    vessel_liquid_level_pct: numOrNull($("m1_liqLevel").value)
  };
  m.tank_data = {
    nominal_capacity_m3: numOrNull($("m1_capM3") && $("m1_capM3").value),
    inside_diameter_m: numOrNull($("m1_diamM") && $("m1_diamM").value),
    shell_height_m: numOrNull($("m1_heightM") && $("m1_heightM").value),
    roof_type: ($("m1_roofType") && $("m1_roofType").value || "").trim() || null,
    release_prevention_barrier: ($("m1_rpb") && $("m1_rpb").value || "").trim() || null,
    assessment_basis: {
      installation_date: installRaw || null,
      construction_code: ($("m1_constructionCode") && $("m1_constructionCode").value || "").trim() || null,
      shell_courses: numOrNull($("m1_shellCourses") && $("m1_shellCourses").value),
      bottom_configuration: ($("m1_bottomType") && $("m1_bottomType").value || "").trim() || null,
      normal_operating_inventory_m3: numOrNull($("m1_normalInvM3") && $("m1_normalInvM3").value),
      max_fill_level_pct: numOrNull($("m1_maxFillPct") && $("m1_maxFillPct").value),
      max_controlled_filling_height_m: numOrNull($("m1_maxFillHeightM") && $("m1_maxFillHeightM").value),
      foundation: ($("m1_foundation") && $("m1_foundation").value || "").trim() || null,
      dike_length_m: numOrNull($("m1_dikeLengthM") && $("m1_dikeLengthM").value),
      dike_width_m: numOrNull($("m1_dikeWidthM") && $("m1_dikeWidthM").value),
      dike_height_m: numOrNull($("m1_dikeHeightM") && $("m1_dikeHeightM").value),
      dike_capacity_m3: numOrNull($("m1_dikeCapM3") && $("m1_dikeCapM3").value)
    }
  };
  if (typeof m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom === "function") m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom();
  var m1NotesEl = $("m1_notes");
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_notes = m1NotesEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m1_notes") : "";
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number = m.tag;
  setModuleStatus(1, "complete");
  auditLog(1, "saved");
  updateHeader();
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  $("m1_status").textContent = "Saved — " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
  m1_dirty = false;
  m2_attachM1DomSyncListeners();
  if (typeof m2_syncInheritedFromM1Dom === "function") m2_syncInheritedFromM1Dom();
  if (typeof osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom === "function") osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom();
  if (typeof m5_data !== "undefined" && m5_data && typeof m5_populateMinWall === "function") {
    try { m5_populateMinWall(); } catch (eM3) { console.warn("m1_save M3 component refresh", eM3); }
  }
}

var _osrEditorSavedRange = null;
var _osrEditorSavedEd = null;
var _osrEditorBookmark = null;
var _osrEditorDomBusy = false;
var _osrEditorGlobalInited = false;

function osrEditorRichSelector() {
  return "#m1_editor, #m8_editor, .osr-mod-notes-editor";
}

function osrEditorPrepareBlocks(ed) {
  if (!ed) return;
  var h = String(ed.innerHTML || "").trim();
  if (!h || h === "<br>" || h === "<br/>") ed.innerHTML = "<p><br></p>";
}

function osrEditorNormalizeFormatBlockArg(arg) {
  if (arg == null || arg === "") return null;
  var s = String(arg).trim().toLowerCase();
  if (/^<[a-z0-9]+>$/.test(s)) return s;
  if (/^(h[1-6]|p|div|blockquote|pre)$/.test(s)) return "<" + s + ">";
  return String(arg);
}

function osrEditorSaveBookmark(ed) {
  if (!ed) return;
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  if (!sel || !sel.rangeCount) return;
  var range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
  var c = range.commonAncestorContainer;
  if (c.nodeType === 3) c = c.parentNode;
  if (!ed.contains(c)) return;
  var pre = document.createRange();
  pre.selectNodeContents(ed);
  pre.setEnd(range.startContainer, range.startOffset);
  var start = pre.toString().length;
  var end = start + range.toString().length;
  _osrEditorBookmark = { ed: ed, start: start, end: end };
  _osrEditorSavedEd = ed;
}

function osrEditorRestoreBookmark(ed) {
  if (!_osrEditorBookmark || _osrEditorBookmark.ed !== ed) return false;
  ed.focus();
  var start = _osrEditorBookmark.start, end = _osrEditorBookmark.end;
  var walker = document.createTreeWalker(ed, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null);
  var pos = 0, startNode = null, startOff = 0, endNode = null, endOff = 0, tn;
  while ((tn = walker.nextNode())) {
    var len = tn.textContent.length;
    if (!startNode && pos + len >= start) { startNode = tn; startOff = Math.max(0, start - pos); }
    if (!endNode && pos + len >= end) { endNode = tn; endOff = Math.max(0, end - pos); break; }
    pos += len;
  }
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  var r = document.createRange();
  if (!startNode) {
    r.selectNodeContents(ed);
    r.collapse(false);
  } else {
    if (!endNode) { endNode = startNode; endOff = startOff; }
    r.setStart(startNode, Math.min(startOff, startNode.textContent.length));
    r.setEnd(endNode, Math.min(endOff, endNode.textContent.length));
  }
  sel.removeAllRanges();
  sel.addRange(r);
  _osrEditorSavedRange = r.cloneRange();
  _osrEditorSavedEd = ed;
  return true;
}

function osrEditorRestoreSelectionOrBookmark(ed) {
  if (!ed) return false;
  if (osrEditorRestoreBookmark(ed)) return true;
  if (_osrEditorSavedEd === ed && _osrEditorSavedRange) return osrEditorRestoreSelection(ed);
  return false;
}

function osrEditorSaveSelection(ed) {
  if (_osrEditorDomBusy) return;
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  if (!sel || sel.rangeCount === 0) return;
  var r = sel.getRangeAt(0);
  var container = r.commonAncestorContainer;
  if (container.nodeType === 3) container = container.parentNode;
  var rootEd = ed;
  if (!rootEd && container && container.closest) rootEd = container.closest(osrEditorRichSelector());
  if (!rootEd || !rootEd.contains(container)) return;
  _osrEditorSavedRange = r.cloneRange();
  _osrEditorSavedEd = rootEd;
}

/** Snapshot editor selection before toolbar control takes focus; never clears a prior snapshot. */
function osrEditorSnapshotSelection(ed) {
  if (!ed) return;
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  if (!sel || sel.rangeCount === 0) return;
  var r = sel.getRangeAt(0);
  var container = r.commonAncestorContainer;
  if (container.nodeType === 3) container = container.parentNode;
  if (!ed.contains(container)) return;
  _osrEditorSavedRange = r.cloneRange();
  _osrEditorSavedEd = ed;
  osrEditorSaveBookmark(ed);
}

function osrEditorRestoreSelection(ed) {
  ed = ed || _osrEditorSavedEd;
  if (!ed) return false;
  ed.focus();
  if (!_osrEditorSavedRange) return false;
  try {
    var sel = window.getSelection();
    sel.removeAllRanges();
    sel.addRange(_osrEditorSavedRange);
    return true;
  } catch (eR) {
    _osrEditorSavedRange = null;
    return false;
  }
}

/** Wrap bare text / inline nodes that sit directly under the editor in <p> blocks. */
function osrEditorWrapLooseEditorContent(ed) {
  if (!ed) return;
  _osrEditorDomBusy = true;
  try {
  var blockRe = /^(P|H1|H2|H3|H4|H5|H6|UL|OL|TABLE|BLOCKQUOTE|PRE|HR|DIV)$/i;
  var i = 0;
  while (i < ed.childNodes.length) {
    var ch = ed.childNodes[i];
    if (ch.nodeType === 1 && blockRe.test(ch.nodeName)) { i++; continue; }
    if (ch.nodeType === 3 && !String(ch.textContent || "").trim()) { ed.removeChild(ch); continue; }
    var p = document.createElement("p");
    p.className = "osr-block-normal";
    ed.insertBefore(p, ch);
    while (i < ed.childNodes.length) {
      var c2 = ed.childNodes[i];
      if (c2 === p) { i++; continue; }
      if (c2.nodeType === 1 && blockRe.test(c2.nodeName)) break;
      if (c2.nodeType === 3 && !String(c2.textContent || "").trim()) { ed.removeChild(c2); continue; }
      p.appendChild(c2);
    }
    if (!p.textContent.trim() && !p.querySelector("img,br")) {
      p.innerHTML = "<br>";
    }
    i = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(ed.childNodes, p) + 1;
  }
  } finally {
    _osrEditorDomBusy = false;
  }
}

function osrEditorBlockFromNode(ed, node) {
  if (!node || !ed) return null;
  if (node.nodeType === 3) node = node.parentNode;
  while (node && node !== ed) {
    if (/^(P|H1|H2|H3|H4|H5|H6|BLOCKQUOTE|PRE|LI)$/i.test(node.nodeName)) return node;
    if (node.nodeName === "DIV" && node.parentNode === ed) return node;
    node = node.parentNode;
  }
  return null;
}

function osrEditorChangeElementTag(el, tagName) {
  if (!el || !tagName) return el;
  if (el.nodeName.toLowerCase() === String(tagName).toLowerCase()) return el;
  var neu = document.createElement(tagName);
  while (el.firstChild) neu.appendChild(el.firstChild);
  el.parentNode.replaceChild(neu, el);
  return neu;
}

/** Set block text size via CSS class on the paragraph (reliable across all freeform editors). */
function osrEditorSetBlockSize(ed, sizeKey) {
  if (!ed) return false;
  var legacy = { p: "normal", h1: "large", h2: "medium", h3: "small" };
  if (legacy[sizeKey]) sizeKey = legacy[sizeKey];
  var classMap = { normal: "osr-block-normal", large: "osr-block-large", medium: "osr-block-medium", small: "osr-block-small" };
  var cls = classMap[sizeKey] || "osr-block-normal";
  osrEditorWrapLooseEditorContent(ed);
  ed.focus();
  if (!osrEditorRestoreSelectionOrBookmark(ed)) {
    var sel0 = window.getSelection();
    if (!sel0 || !sel0.rangeCount) {
      var r0 = document.createRange();
      r0.selectNodeContents(ed);
      r0.collapse(false);
      sel0.removeAllRanges();
      sel0.addRange(r0);
    }
  }
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  if (!sel || !sel.rangeCount) return false;
  var range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
  var block = osrEditorBlockFromNode(ed, range.startContainer);
  if (!block) {
    block = document.createElement("p");
    try {
      range.surroundContents(block);
    } catch (eWrap) {
      var frag = range.extractContents();
      if (frag && frag.childNodes && frag.childNodes.length) block.appendChild(frag);
      else block.appendChild(document.createTextNode(range.toString() || "\u00a0"));
      range.insertNode(block);
    }
  }
  if (block.nodeName !== "P") block = osrEditorChangeElementTag(block, "p");
  block.classList.remove("osr-block-normal", "osr-block-large", "osr-block-medium", "osr-block-small");
  block.classList.add(cls);
  var r = document.createRange();
  r.selectNodeContents(block);
  sel.removeAllRanges();
  sel.addRange(r);
  _osrEditorSavedRange = r.cloneRange();
  _osrEditorSavedEd = ed;
  osrEditorSaveBookmark(ed);
  return true;
}

/** @deprecated use osrEditorSetBlockSize — kept for formatBlock callers */
function osrEditorSetBlockTag(ed, tagName) {
  return osrEditorSetBlockSize(ed, tagName);
}

function osrEditorFireDirty(ed, tb) {
  if (!ed) return;
  try { ed.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); } catch (eIn) {}
  osrEditorToolbarMarkDirty(tb);
}

function osrEditorExecCommand(ed, cmd, arg) {
  if (!ed) return false;
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) return false;
  osrEditorPrepareBlocks(ed);
  ed.focus();
  if (_osrEditorSavedEd === ed && _osrEditorSavedRange) {
    osrEditorRestoreSelection(ed);
  } else {
    var sel0 = window.getSelection();
    if (sel0 && sel0.rangeCount) {
      var anc0 = sel0.getRangeAt(0).commonAncestorContainer;
      if (anc0.nodeType === 3) anc0 = anc0.parentNode;
      if (!ed.contains(anc0)) {
        var rEnd = document.createRange();
        rEnd.selectNodeContents(ed);
        rEnd.collapse(false);
        sel0.removeAllRanges();
        sel0.addRange(rEnd);
        _osrEditorSavedRange = rEnd.cloneRange();
        _osrEditorSavedEd = ed;
      }
    } else if (!(_osrEditorSavedEd === ed && _osrEditorSavedRange)) {
      var rStart = document.createRange();
      rStart.selectNodeContents(ed);
      rStart.collapse(false);
      var sel1 = window.getSelection();
      if (sel1) { sel1.removeAllRanges(); sel1.addRange(rStart); }
      _osrEditorSavedRange = rStart.cloneRange();
      _osrEditorSavedEd = ed;
    }
  }
  var ok = false;
  if (cmd === "formatBlock" && arg) {
    ok = osrEditorSetBlockSize(ed, String(arg).replace(/^<|>$/g, "").toLowerCase());
  } else {
    try { ok = document.execCommand(cmd, false, arg || null); } catch (eCmd) {}
  }
  if (ok) osrEditorSaveSelection(ed);
  return ok;
}

function osrEditorForToolbar(tb) {
  if (!tb) return null;
  var id = tb.getAttribute("data-osr-editor");
  if (id && $(id)) return $(id);
  var wrap = tb.parentElement;
  return wrap ? wrap.querySelector(osrEditorRichSelector()) : null;
}

function osrEditorTbKeepSelection(ev) {
  var tb = ev && ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest(".m1-toolbar, .m8-toolbar, .osr-mod-notes-toolbar") : null;
  if (!tb) return;
  var ed = osrEditorForToolbar(tb);
  if (ed) osrEditorSnapshotSelection(ed);
}

function osrEditorToolbarMarkDirty(tb) {
  if (!tb) return;
  var d = tb.getAttribute("data-osr-dirty");
  if (d === "m1") m1_dirty = true;
  else if (d === "m8") m8_dirty = true;
}

function osrEditorStripInlineStyle(root, styleKeys) {
  if (!root) return;
  function walk(node) {
    if (!node) return;
    if (node.nodeType === 1) {
      styleKeys.forEach(function(k) {
        if (node.style) node.style[k] = "";
      });
      if (node.getAttribute && node.getAttribute("style") === "") node.removeAttribute("style");
      if (styleKeys.indexOf("fontSize") >= 0 && node.classList) {
        node.classList.remove("osr-block-large", "osr-block-medium", "osr-block-small", "osr-block-normal");
      }
      var ch = Array.prototype.slice.call(node.childNodes);
      ch.forEach(walk);
    }
  }
  if (root.nodeType === 11) {
    Array.prototype.slice.call(root.childNodes).forEach(walk);
  } else {
    walk(root);
  }
}

function osrEditorApplyInlineFormat(ed, styleMap) {
  if (!ed || !styleMap) return false;
  osrEditorPrepareBlocks(ed);
  osrEditorRestoreSelectionOrBookmark(ed);
  ed.focus();
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  if (!sel || !sel.rangeCount) return false;
  var range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
  var anc = range.commonAncestorContainer;
  if (anc.nodeType === 3) anc = anc.parentNode;
  if (!ed.contains(anc)) return false;
  var styleKeys = Object.keys(styleMap);
  if (range.collapsed) {
    var el = range.startContainer;
    if (el.nodeType === 3) el = el.parentNode;
    while (el && el !== ed) {
      if (el.nodeType === 1 && el.nodeName === "SPAN" && (el.style.fontSize || el.style.fontFamily)) {
        styleKeys.forEach(function(k) { el.style[k] = styleMap[k]; });
        osrEditorSaveSelection(ed);
        return true;
      }
      el = el.parentNode;
    }
    var span = document.createElement("span");
    styleKeys.forEach(function(k) { span.style[k] = styleMap[k]; });
    span.appendChild(document.createTextNode("\u200B"));
    range.insertNode(span);
    var nr = document.createRange();
    nr.setStart(span.firstChild, 1);
    nr.collapse(true);
    sel.removeAllRanges();
    sel.addRange(nr);
  } else {
    var frag = range.extractContents();
    osrEditorStripInlineStyle(frag, styleKeys);
    var span = document.createElement("span");
    styleKeys.forEach(function(k) { span.style[k] = styleMap[k]; });
    span.appendChild(frag);
    range.insertNode(span);
    var nr2 = document.createRange();
    nr2.selectNodeContents(span);
    sel.removeAllRanges();
    sel.addRange(nr2);
  }
  osrEditorSaveSelection(ed);
  return true;
}

var OSR_EDITOR_TOOLBAR_VERSION = "2";
var OSR_EDITOR_FONTS = {
  "aptos-body": { label: "Aptos (Body)", stack: "'Segoe UI', Aptos, system-ui, sans-serif" },
  "aptos-display": { label: "Aptos Display", stack: "'Segoe UI Variable Display', 'Segoe UI', Aptos, sans-serif" },
  "calibri": { label: "Calibri", stack: "Calibri, Carlito, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" },
  "consolas": { label: "Consolas", stack: "Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace" }
};
var OSR_EDITOR_FONT_SIZES = [8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 36];

function osrEditorFontFamilyOptionsHtml() {
  var h = "";
  Object.keys(OSR_EDITOR_FONTS).forEach(function(k) {
    var f = OSR_EDITOR_FONTS[k];
    h += '<option value="' + k + '"' + (k === "aptos-body" ? " selected" : "") + ' style="font-family:' + f.stack + '">' + f.label + "</option>";
  });
  return h;
}

function osrEditorFontSizeOptionsHtml() {
  var h = "";
  OSR_EDITOR_FONT_SIZES.forEach(function(pt) {
    h += '<option value="' + pt + '"' + (pt === 12 ? " selected" : "") + ">" + pt + "</option>";
  });
  return h;
}

function osrEditorApplyFontFamily(selEl) {
  var v = selEl ? selEl.value : "";
  if (!v || !OSR_EDITOR_FONTS[v]) return;
  var tb = selEl.closest(".m1-toolbar, .m8-toolbar, .osr-mod-notes-toolbar");
  var ed = osrEditorForToolbar(tb);
  if (!ed) return;
  osrEditorApplyInlineFormat(ed, { fontFamily: OSR_EDITOR_FONTS[v].stack });
  osrEditorFireDirty(ed, tb);
  ed.focus();
}

function osrEditorApplyFontSize(selEl) {
  var v = selEl ? selEl.value : "";
  if (!v) return;
  var tb = selEl.closest(".m1-toolbar, .m8-toolbar, .osr-mod-notes-toolbar");
  var ed = osrEditorForToolbar(tb);
  if (!ed) return;
  osrEditorApplyInlineFormat(ed, { fontSize: v + "pt" });
  osrEditorFireDirty(ed, tb);
  ed.focus();
}

function osrEditorBindToolbarSelects(tb) {
  if (!tb) return;
  tb.querySelectorAll("select.osr-editor-font-family").forEach(function(sel) {
    if (sel._osrFontBound) return;
    sel._osrFontBound = true;
    sel.addEventListener("mousedown", function() { osrEditorSnapshotSelection(osrEditorForToolbar(tb)); });
    sel.addEventListener("change", function() { osrEditorApplyFontFamily(sel); });
  });
  tb.querySelectorAll("select.osr-editor-font-size").forEach(function(sel) {
    if (sel._osrFontSizeBound) return;
    sel._osrFontSizeBound = true;
    sel.addEventListener("mousedown", function() { osrEditorSnapshotSelection(osrEditorForToolbar(tb)); });
    sel.addEventListener("change", function() { osrEditorApplyFontSize(sel); });
  });
}

function osrEditorStandardToolbarInnerHtml() {
  return '<select class="osr-editor-font-family" title="Font" aria-label="Font">' + osrEditorFontFamilyOptionsHtml() + "</select>"
    + '<select class="osr-editor-font-size" title="Font size" aria-label="Font size">' + osrEditorFontSizeOptionsHtml() + "</select>"
    + '<span class="osr-tb-sep" aria-hidden="true"></span>'
    + '<button type="button" onmousedown="osrEditorTbKeepSelection(event)" onclick="osrEditorToolbarInsertLink(event)" title="Insert link">&#128279; Link</button>'
    + '<button type="button" onmousedown="osrEditorTbKeepSelection(event)" onclick="osrEditorToolbarInsertImage(event)" title="Insert image (JPG, PNG)">&#128247; Image</button>';
}

/** Build Word-style toolbar: font, size, link, image. */
function osrEditorNormalizeToolbar(tb) {
  if (!tb) return;
  if (tb.getAttribute("data-osr-tb-version") === OSR_EDITOR_TOOLBAR_VERSION) return;
  var ed = osrEditorForToolbar(tb);
  if (!ed && tb.nextElementSibling) {
    var sib = tb.nextElementSibling;
    if (sib.matches && sib.matches(osrEditorRichSelector())) {
      ed = sib;
      if (sib.id) tb.setAttribute("data-osr-editor", sib.id);
    }
  }
  if (ed && ed.id && !tb.getAttribute("data-osr-editor")) tb.setAttribute("data-osr-editor", ed.id);
  tb.innerHTML = osrEditorStandardToolbarInnerHtml();
  tb.setAttribute("data-osr-tb-version", OSR_EDITOR_TOOLBAR_VERSION);
  tb.removeAttribute("data-osr-tb-minimal");
  tb.removeAttribute("data-osr-tb-upgraded");
  osrEditorBindToolbarSelects(tb);
}

function osrEditorParseFontSizePt(val) {
  if (!val) return "";
  var m = String(val).match(/([\d.]+)/);
  return m ? String(Math.round(parseFloat(m[1]))) : "";
}

function osrEditorMatchFontKey(stack) {
  if (!stack) return "aptos-body";
  var s = String(stack).toLowerCase().replace(/['"]/g, "");
  var keys = Object.keys(OSR_EDITOR_FONTS);
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var parts = OSR_EDITOR_FONTS[keys[i]].stack.toLowerCase().split(",");
    for (var j = 0; j < parts.length; j++) {
      var p = parts[j].trim().replace(/['"]/g, "");
      if (p && s.indexOf(p) >= 0) return keys[i];
    }
  }
  return "aptos-body";
}

function osrEditorToolbarForEditor(ed) {
  if (!ed) return null;
  var prev = ed.previousElementSibling;
  if (prev && prev.matches && prev.matches(".m1-toolbar, .m8-toolbar, .osr-mod-notes-toolbar")) return prev;
  var wrap = ed.parentElement;
  return wrap ? wrap.querySelector(".m1-toolbar, .m8-toolbar, .osr-mod-notes-toolbar") : null;
}

function osrEditorSyncToolbarFromSelection(ed) {
  var tb = osrEditorToolbarForEditor(ed);
  if (!tb) return;
  var fontSel = tb.querySelector("select.osr-editor-font-family");
  var sizeSel = tb.querySelector("select.osr-editor-font-size");
  if (!fontSel && !sizeSel) return;
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  if (!sel || !sel.rangeCount) return;
  var node = sel.anchorNode;
  if (!node || !ed.contains(node)) return;
  if (node.nodeType === 3) node = node.parentNode;
  var fontKey = "aptos-body";
  var sizePt = "12";
  while (node && node !== ed) {
    if (node.nodeType === 1 && node.style) {
      if (node.style.fontFamily) fontKey = osrEditorMatchFontKey(node.style.fontFamily);
      if (node.style.fontSize) sizePt = osrEditorParseFontSizePt(node.style.fontSize) || sizePt;
    }
    node = node.parentNode;
  }
  if (fontSel && fontSel.value !== fontKey) fontSel.value = fontKey;
  if (sizeSel && sizePt && sizeSel.value !== sizePt) {
    var has = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < sizeSel.options.length; i++) {
      if (sizeSel.options[i].value === sizePt) { has = true; break; }
    }
    if (has) sizeSel.value = sizePt;
  }
}

function osrEditorInitToolbars() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".m1-toolbar, .m8-toolbar, .osr-mod-notes-toolbar").forEach(function(tb) {
    osrEditorNormalizeToolbar(tb);
    osrEditorBindToolbarSelects(tb);
    if (tb._osrTbBound) return;
    tb._osrTbBound = true;
    tb.addEventListener("mousedown", function(ev) {
      var ed = osrEditorForToolbar(tb);
      if (ed) osrEditorSnapshotSelection(ed);
    }, true);
  });
  if (!window._osrSelChangeBound) {
    window._osrSelChangeBound = true;
    document.addEventListener("selectionchange", function() {
      if (_osrEditorDomBusy) return;
      var sel = window.getSelection();
      if (!sel || !sel.rangeCount) return;
      var n = sel.anchorNode;
      if (!n) return;
      if (n.nodeType === 3) n = n.parentNode;
      var ed = n.closest && n.closest(osrEditorRichSelector());
      if (ed) {
        osrEditorSaveSelection(ed);
        osrEditorSyncToolbarFromSelection(ed);
      }
    });
  }
}

/** One init for all freeform / doc-style editors — runs once at startup. */
function osrEditorInitAll() {
  if (_osrEditorGlobalInited) return;
  _osrEditorGlobalInited = true;
  osrEditorInitToolbars();
  osrEditorInitRichEditors();
}

function osrEditorInitRichEditors() {
  document.querySelectorAll(osrEditorRichSelector()).forEach(function(ed) {
    if (ed._osrRichEdBound) return;
    ed._osrRichEdBound = true;
    ed.addEventListener("mouseup", function() { osrEditorSaveSelection(ed); });
    ed.addEventListener("keyup", function() { osrEditorSaveSelection(ed); });
    ed.addEventListener("mousedown", osrEditor_onEditorMousedown);
    ed.addEventListener("paste", osrEditorOnPaste);
    ed.addEventListener("focus", function() {
      osrEditorPrepareBlocks(ed);
      osrModNotes_sanitizeEditorDom(ed);
      osrEditorEnsureTypableBlocks(ed);
      osrEditorSaveSelection(ed);
    });
  });
}

function osrEditorInsertLink(ed, onDirty) {
  if (!ed) return;
  osrEditorPrepareBlocks(ed);
  if (!osrEditorRestoreSelectionOrBookmark(ed)) {
    ed.focus();
    var sel0 = window.getSelection();
    if (sel0 && !sel0.rangeCount) {
      var r0 = document.createRange();
      r0.selectNodeContents(ed);
      r0.collapse(false);
      sel0.removeAllRanges();
      sel0.addRange(r0);
    }
  }
  var url = prompt("Enter URL:");
  if (!url) return;
  url = url.trim();
  if (!url) return;
  if (url.indexOf("http") !== 0 && url.indexOf("mailto:") !== 0) url = "https://" + url;
  osrEditorRestoreSelectionOrBookmark(ed);
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  var text = (sel && sel.toString()) || url;
  document.execCommand("insertHTML", false, '<a href="' + url.replace(/"/g, "&quot;") + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + text.replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;") + "</a>");
  osrEditorSaveSelection(ed);
  if (onDirty) onDirty();
}

function osrEditorToolbarInsertLink(ev) {
  var tb = ev && ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest(".m1-toolbar, .m8-toolbar, .osr-mod-notes-toolbar") : null;
  var ed = osrEditorForToolbar(tb);
  osrEditorInsertLink(ed, function() { osrEditorFireDirty(ed, tb); });
}

function osrEditorToolbarInsertImage(ev) {
  var tb = ev && ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest(".m1-toolbar, .m8-toolbar, .osr-mod-notes-toolbar") : null;
  var ed = osrEditorForToolbar(tb);
  osrEditorSnapshotSelection(ed);
  osrEditorInsertImage(ed, function() { osrEditorFireDirty(ed, tb); });
}

function m1_cmd(cmd, arg) {
  var ed = $("m1_editor");
  if (!ed) return;
  osrEditorExecCommand(ed, cmd, arg);
  m1_dirty = true;
}

function m1_insertLink() {
  osrEditorInsertLink($("m1_editor"), function() { m1_dirty = true; });
}

var OSR_IMG_WRAP_MODES = [
  { id: "inline", label: "In line with text" },
  { id: "square-left", label: "Square — left" },
  { id: "square-right", label: "Square — right" },
  { id: "center", label: "Center" },
  { id: "top-bottom", label: "Top and bottom" },
  { id: "behind", label: "Behind text" },
  { id: "front", label: "In front of text" }
];
var _osrImgLayoutCtx = null;

function osrEditorGetWrapBox(img) {
  var p = img && img.parentElement;
  return (p && p.classList && p.classList.contains("osr-img-wrap")) ? p : null;
}

function osrEditorRemoveWrapBox(img) {
  var box = osrEditorGetWrapBox(img);
  if (!box || !box.parentNode) return img;
  box.parentNode.insertBefore(img, box);
  box.remove();
  return img;
}

function osrEditorSyncWrapBoxStyles(box, wrap, widthVal) {
  if (!box) return;
  wrap = wrap || box.getAttribute("data-wrap") || "square-left";
  box.setAttribute("data-wrap", wrap);
  box.style.cssFloat = "";
  box.style.float = "";
  box.style.display = "";
  box.style.clear = "";
  box.style.margin = "";
  box.style.marginLeft = "";
  box.style.marginRight = "";
  box.style.width = "";
  box.style.maxWidth = "";
  box.style.verticalAlign = "";
  if (wrap === "inline") {
    box.style.display = "inline-block";
    box.style.verticalAlign = "text-bottom";
    box.style.margin = "0 6px 2px 0";
    if (widthVal) box.style.width = widthVal;
    else box.style.maxWidth = "42%";
  } else if (wrap === "square-right") {
    box.style.cssFloat = "right";
    box.style.display = "block";
    box.style.clear = "right";
    box.style.margin = "2px 0 10px 14px";
    if (widthVal) box.style.width = widthVal;
  } else if (wrap === "center") {
    box.style.display = "block";
    box.style.clear = "both";
    box.style.margin = "12px auto";
    if (widthVal) box.style.width = widthVal;
  } else if (wrap === "top-bottom") {
    box.style.display = "block";
    box.style.clear = "both";
    box.style.margin = "12px 0";
    box.style.width = "100%";
    box.style.maxWidth = "100%";
  } else {
    box.style.cssFloat = "left";
    box.style.display = "block";
    box.style.clear = "left";
    box.style.margin = "2px 14px 10px 0";
    if (widthVal) box.style.width = widthVal;
  }
}

function osrEditorEnsureImageWrapper(img, ed) {
  if (!img || !ed || !ed.contains(img)) return null;
  var wrap = img.getAttribute("data-wrap") || "square-left";
  img.classList.add("osr-note-img");
  if (wrap === "behind" || wrap === "front") {
    osrEditorRemoveWrapBox(img);
    return null;
  }
  var box = osrEditorGetWrapBox(img);
  var widthVal = "";
  if (box && box.style.width) widthVal = box.style.width;
  else if (img.getAttribute("data-resized") && img.style.width && img.style.width !== "100%") widthVal = img.style.width;
  if (!box) {
    box = document.createElement("span");
    box.className = "osr-img-wrap";
    box.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
    img.parentNode.insertBefore(box, img);
    box.appendChild(img);
  }
  box.setAttribute("data-wrap", wrap);
  img.setAttribute("data-wrap", wrap);
  img.style.width = "100%";
  img.style.maxWidth = "100%";
  img.style.height = "auto";
  img.style.display = "block";
  img.style.float = "none";
  img.style.margin = "0";
  img.style.clear = "none";
  osrEditorSyncWrapBoxStyles(box, wrap, widthVal);
  return box;
}

function osrEditorUnwrapImage(img, ed) {
  if (!img || !ed || !ed.contains(img)) return;
  var box = osrEditorEnsureImageWrapper(img, ed);
  var node = box || img;
  var guard = 0;
  while (guard++ < 12) {
    var par = node.parentElement;
    if (!par || par === ed) break;
    var tag = par.tagName;
    if (tag !== "P" && tag !== "DIV" && tag !== "FIGURE") break;
    var onlyNode = true;
    for (var i = 0; i < par.childNodes.length; i++) {
      var n = par.childNodes[i];
      if (n === node) continue;
      if (n.nodeType === 3 && !String(n.textContent || "").trim()) continue;
      if (n.nodeType === 1 && n.tagName === "BR") continue;
      onlyNode = false;
      break;
    }
    if (!onlyNode) break;
    par.parentNode.insertBefore(node, par);
    if (!par.childNodes.length) par.remove();
  }
}

function osrEditorSyncImageWrapStyles(img) {
  if (!img || img.tagName !== "IMG") return;
  var wrap = img.getAttribute("data-wrap") || "square-left";
  img.classList.add("osr-note-img");
  var ed = img.closest("#m1_editor, #m8_editor, .osr-mod-notes-editor");
  if (wrap === "behind" || wrap === "front") {
    osrEditorRemoveWrapBox(img);
    img.style.cssFloat = "";
    img.style.float = "";
    img.style.display = "";
    img.style.clear = "";
    img.style.margin = "";
    img.style.position = "";
    img.style.opacity = "";
    img.style.zIndex = "";
    img.style.left = "";
    img.style.top = "";
    img.style.pointerEvents = "";
    if (wrap === "behind") {
      if (ed) ed.style.position = "relative";
      img.style.position = "absolute";
      img.style.left = "8%";
      img.style.top = "12px";
      img.style.maxWidth = "75%";
      img.style.zIndex = "0";
      img.style.opacity = "0.35";
      img.style.pointerEvents = "none";
    } else {
      img.style.display = "inline-block";
      img.style.position = "relative";
      img.style.zIndex = "2";
      img.style.margin = "4px 8px";
      img.style.maxWidth = "48%";
    }
    return;
  }
  var box = osrEditorGetWrapBox(img);
  var w = (box && box.style.width) || (img.getAttribute("data-resized") && img.style.width !== "100%" ? img.style.width : "");
  if (ed) osrEditorEnsureImageWrapper(img, ed);
  else if (box) osrEditorSyncWrapBoxStyles(box, wrap, w);
}

function osrEditorPlaceCaretAfter(node, ed) {
  if (!node || !ed) return;
  try {
    ed.focus();
    var range = document.createRange();
    var sel = window.getSelection();
    range.setStartAfter(node);
    range.collapse(true);
    sel.removeAllRanges();
    sel.addRange(range);
  } catch (eC) {}
}

/** Ensure a normal paragraph exists after an image/wrap so the caret can land and accept typing. */
function osrEditorInsertParagraphAfterIfNeeded(node) {
  if (!node || !node.parentNode) return null;
  var next = node.nextSibling;
  while (next && next.nodeType === 3 && !String(next.textContent || "").replace(/\u200B/g, "").trim()) next = next.nextSibling;
  if (!next) {
    var p = document.createElement("p");
    p.className = "osr-block-normal";
    p.innerHTML = "<br>";
    node.parentNode.appendChild(p);
    return p;
  }
  if (next.nodeType === 1 && (next.tagName === "IMG" || (next.classList && next.classList.contains("osr-img-wrap")))) {
    var pMid = document.createElement("p");
    pMid.className = "osr-block-normal";
    pMid.innerHTML = "<br>";
    node.parentNode.insertBefore(pMid, next);
    return pMid;
  }
  if (next.nodeType === 1 && (next.tagName === "P" || next.tagName === "DIV")) {
    if (!String(next.textContent || "").replace(/\u200B/g, "").trim() && !next.querySelector("img")) {
      if (!next.className) next.className = "osr-block-normal";
      if (!next.innerHTML || next.innerHTML === "") next.innerHTML = "<br>";
    }
    return next;
  }
  var p2 = document.createElement("p");
  p2.className = "osr-block-normal";
  p2.innerHTML = "<br>";
  node.parentNode.insertBefore(p2, next);
  return p2;
}

function osrEditorEnsureTypableBlocks(ed) {
  if (!ed) return;
  _osrEditorDomBusy = true;
  try {
    osrEditorWrapLooseEditorContent(ed);
    ed.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(function(img) {
      if (!ed.contains(img)) return;
      if (!img.getAttribute("data-wrap")) img.setAttribute("data-wrap", "square-left");
      osrEditorEnsureImageWrapper(img, ed);
      osrEditorUnwrapImage(img, ed);
      osrEditorSyncImageWrapStyles(img);
    });
    ed.querySelectorAll(".osr-img-wrap").forEach(function(box) {
      osrEditorInsertParagraphAfterIfNeeded(box);
    });
    ed.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(function(img) {
      if (!ed.contains(img) || img.closest(".osr-img-wrap")) return;
      osrEditorInsertParagraphAfterIfNeeded(img);
    });
    if (ed.childNodes.length === 1) {
      var only = ed.firstChild;
      if (only && only.nodeType === 1 && (only.tagName === "IMG" || (only.classList && only.classList.contains("osr-img-wrap")))) {
        var pOnly = document.createElement("p");
        pOnly.className = "osr-block-normal";
        pOnly.innerHTML = "<br>";
        ed.appendChild(pOnly);
      }
    }
    var h = String(ed.innerHTML || "").trim();
    if (!h || h === "<br>" || h === "<br/>") {
      ed.innerHTML = "<p class=\"osr-block-normal\"><br></p>";
    }
  } finally {
    _osrEditorDomBusy = false;
  }
}

function osrEditorFireDirtyForEd(ed) {
  if (!ed) return;
  var tb = osrEditorToolbarForEditor(ed);
  if (tb) osrEditorFireDirty(ed, tb);
  else if (ed.id === "m1_editor") m1_dirty = true;
  else if (ed.id === "m8_editor") m8_dirty = true;
}

function osrEditorInsertPastedImageDataUrl(ed, dataUrl) {
  if (!ed || !dataUrl) return;
  osrEditorPrepareBlocks(ed);
  osrEditorRestoreSelectionOrBookmark(ed);
  document.execCommand("insertHTML", false, osrEditorInsertImageHtml(dataUrl, "square-left"));
  ed.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(function(im) { osrEditorUnwrapImage(im, ed); });
  osrEditorNormalizeImages(ed);
  osrModNotes_sanitizeEditorDom(ed);
  osrEditorEnsureTypableBlocks(ed);
  var lastWrap = ed.querySelector(".osr-img-wrap:last-of-type");
  var lastImg = lastWrap ? null : ed.querySelector("img:last-of-type");
  var land = lastWrap ? osrEditorInsertParagraphAfterIfNeeded(lastWrap) : (lastImg ? osrEditorInsertParagraphAfterIfNeeded(lastImg) : ed.querySelector("p:last-of-type"));
  if (land) {
    ed.focus();
    var range = document.createRange();
    range.selectNodeContents(land);
    range.collapse(true);
    var sel = window.getSelection();
    if (sel) { sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(range); }
  }
  osrEditorFireDirtyForEd(ed);
}

function osrEditorOnPaste(ev) {
  var ed = ev.currentTarget;
  if (!ed || (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE)) return;
  var dt = ev.clipboardData;
  if (!dt) return;
  var items = dt.items;
  if (items) {
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      var it = items[i];
      if (it.type && it.type.indexOf("image/") === 0) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        var file = it.getAsFile();
        if (!file) return;
        var reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function() { osrEditorInsertPastedImageDataUrl(ed, reader.result); };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    osrEditorNormalizeImages(ed);
    osrModNotes_sanitizeEditorDom(ed);
    osrEditorEnsureTypableBlocks(ed);
    osrEditorFireDirtyForEd(ed);
  }, 0);
}

function osrEditor_onEditorMousedown(ev) {
  var ed = ev.currentTarget;
  if (!ed || (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE)) return;
  if (ed.classList && ed.classList.contains("osr-mod-notes-editor")) osrModNotes_prepareEditor(ed);
  else osrEditorPrepareBlocks(ed);
  var t = ev.target;
  if (t === ed) return;
  var block = t.closest && t.closest(".osr-img-wrap, [contenteditable='false']");
  if (block && ed.contains(block) && block !== ed) {
    ev.preventDefault();
    var node = block.classList && block.classList.contains("osr-img-wrap") ? block : (block.closest(".osr-img-wrap") || block);
    osrEditorPlaceCaretAfter(node, ed);
    var land = osrEditorInsertParagraphAfterIfNeeded(node);
    if (land) {
      ed.focus();
      var range = document.createRange();
      range.selectNodeContents(land);
      range.collapse(true);
      var sel = window.getSelection();
      if (sel) { sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(range); }
    }
  }
}

function osrEditorNormalizeImages(ed) {
  if (!ed) return;
  ed.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(function(img) {
    img.classList.add("osr-note-img");
    if (!img.getAttribute("data-wrap")) img.setAttribute("data-wrap", "square-left");
    var wrap = img.getAttribute("data-wrap");
    if ((wrap === "square-left" || wrap === "square-right" || wrap === "center") && !img.getAttribute("data-resized")) {
      img.setAttribute("data-resized", "1");
      img.style.width = wrap === "center" ? "60%" : "45%";
    }
    osrEditorUnwrapImage(img, ed);
    osrEditorSyncImageWrapStyles(img);
  });
}

function osrEditorInsertImageHtml(src, wrap) {
  wrap = wrap || "square-left";
  var w = wrap === "top-bottom" ? "100%" : wrap === "center" ? "60%" : "45%";
  var srcEsc = String(src).replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  var imgTag = '<img src="' + srcEsc + '" class="osr-note-img" data-wrap="' + wrap + '" data-resized="1" alt="" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:0;">';
  if (wrap === "behind" || wrap === "front") return imgTag;
  return '<span class="osr-img-wrap" contenteditable="false" data-wrap="' + wrap + '" data-resized="1" style="width:' + w + ';">' + imgTag + "</span>";
}

function osrEditorInsertImage(ed, onDirty) {
  if (!ed) return;
  osrEditorSnapshotSelection(ed);
  var inp = document.createElement("input");
  inp.type = "file";
  inp.accept = "image/jpeg,image/jpg,image/png,image/gif,image/webp";
  inp.onchange = function() {
    if (!inp.files || !inp.files[0]) return;
    var f = inp.files[0];
    var r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = function() {
      osrEditorRestoreSelectionOrBookmark(ed);
      document.execCommand("insertHTML", false, osrEditorInsertImageHtml(r.result, "square-left"));
      ed.querySelectorAll("img").forEach(function(im) { osrEditorUnwrapImage(im, ed); });
      osrEditorNormalizeImages(ed);
      if (onDirty) onDirty();
      osrModNotes_sanitizeEditorDom(ed);
      osrEditorEnsureTypableBlocks(ed);
    };
    r.readAsDataURL(f);
  };
  inp.click();
}

function osrEditorSetImageWidth(img, val) {
  if (!img) return;
  var wrap = img.getAttribute("data-wrap") || "square-left";
  var box = osrEditorGetWrapBox(img);
  val = (val || "").trim();
  if (!val) {
    img.removeAttribute("data-resized");
    if (box) box.removeAttribute("data-resized");
    val = wrap === "top-bottom" ? "100%" : wrap === "center" ? "60%" : "45%";
    img.setAttribute("data-resized", "1");
    if (box) box.setAttribute("data-resized", "1");
  } else {
    img.setAttribute("data-resized", "1");
    if (box) box.setAttribute("data-resized", "1");
    if (wrap !== "top-bottom" && val.indexOf("%") < 0) {
      var n = parseInt(val, 10);
      val = (isNaN(n) ? 300 : Math.max(80, Math.min(1200, n))) + "px";
    }
  }
  if (box) {
    osrEditorSyncWrapBoxStyles(box, wrap, wrap === "top-bottom" ? "100%" : val);
    img.style.width = "100%";
    img.style.maxWidth = "100%";
  } else {
    if (wrap === "top-bottom") { img.style.width = "100%"; img.style.maxWidth = "100%"; }
    else { img.style.width = val; img.style.maxWidth = "none"; }
  }
  osrEditorSyncImageWrapStyles(img);
}

function osrEditorCloseImageLayout() {
  var pop = document.getElementById("osr-img-layout-pop");
  if (pop) { pop.classList.remove("on"); pop.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); }
  document.querySelectorAll("img.osr-img-selected").forEach(function(im) { im.classList.remove("osr-img-selected"); });
  document.querySelectorAll(".osr-img-wrap.osr-img-selected").forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove("osr-img-selected"); });
  _osrImgLayoutCtx = null;
}

function osrEditorShowImageLayout(img, onDirty) {
  if (!img || img.tagName !== "IMG") return;
  osrEditorImageLayoutInit();
  var pop = document.getElementById("osr-img-layout-pop");
  var grid = document.getElementById("osr-img-wrap-grid");
  var wIn = document.getElementById("osr-img-layout-width");
  if (!pop || !grid) return;
  document.querySelectorAll("img.osr-img-selected").forEach(function(im) { im.classList.remove("osr-img-selected"); });
  document.querySelectorAll(".osr-img-wrap.osr-img-selected").forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove("osr-img-selected"); });
  img.classList.add("osr-img-selected");
  var selBox = osrEditorGetWrapBox(img);
  if (selBox) selBox.classList.add("osr-img-selected");
  _osrImgLayoutCtx = { img: img, onDirty: onDirty };
  var curWrap = img.getAttribute("data-wrap") || "square-left";
  grid.innerHTML = OSR_IMG_WRAP_MODES.map(function(m) {
    return '<button type="button" data-wrap="' + m.id + '" class="' + (m.id === curWrap ? "sel" : "") + '">' + m.label + "</button>";
  }).join("");
  if (wIn) {
    var box = osrEditorGetWrapBox(img);
    wIn.value = (box && box.style.width) || img.style.width || (curWrap === "top-bottom" ? "100%" : curWrap === "center" ? "60%" : "45%");
    wIn.disabled = curWrap === "top-bottom";
  }
  var rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();
  pop.style.left = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 290, Math.max(8, rect.left)) + "px";
  pop.style.top = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 220, rect.bottom + 6) + "px";
  pop.classList.add("on");
  pop.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
}

function osrEditorDeleteImage() {
  if (!_osrImgLayoutCtx || !_osrImgLayoutCtx.img) return;
  var img = _osrImgLayoutCtx.img;
  var ed = img.closest("#m1_editor, #m8_editor, .osr-mod-notes-editor");
  var box = osrEditorGetWrapBox(img);
  var node = box || img;
  if (node.parentNode) node.parentNode.removeChild(node);
  if (ed) {
    try {
      var sel = window.getSelection();
      if (sel) {
        var r = document.createRange();
        r.selectNodeContents(ed);
        r.collapse(false);
        sel.removeAllRanges();
        sel.addRange(r);
      }
    } catch (eCaret) {}
  }
  if (_osrImgLayoutCtx.onDirty) _osrImgLayoutCtx.onDirty();
  osrEditorCloseImageLayout();
}

function osrEditorApplyImageLayout() {
  if (!_osrImgLayoutCtx || !_osrImgLayoutCtx.img) return;
  var img = _osrImgLayoutCtx.img;
  var ed = img.closest("#m1_editor, #m8_editor, .osr-mod-notes-editor");
  var grid = document.getElementById("osr-img-wrap-grid");
  var wIn = document.getElementById("osr-img-layout-width");
  var sel = grid && grid.querySelector("button.sel");
  if (sel) {
    var wrap = sel.getAttribute("data-wrap");
    img.setAttribute("data-wrap", wrap);
    if (wrap === "top-bottom" && wIn && !(wIn.value || "").trim()) wIn.value = "100%";
    if (wrap === "center" && wIn && !(wIn.value || "").trim()) wIn.value = "60%";
  }
  osrEditorSetImageWidth(img, wIn ? wIn.value : "");
  if (ed) {
    osrEditorUnwrapImage(img, ed);
    osrEditorSyncImageWrapStyles(img);
    var box = osrEditorGetWrapBox(img);
    osrEditorPlaceCaretAfter(box || img, ed);
  } else {
    osrEditorSyncImageWrapStyles(img);
  }
  if (_osrImgLayoutCtx.onDirty) _osrImgLayoutCtx.onDirty();
  osrEditorCloseImageLayout();
}

function osrEditorImageClick(ev) {
  var t = ev.target;
  if (t && t.tagName === "IMG" && t.closest("#m1_editor, #m8_editor, .osr-mod-notes-editor")) {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    document.querySelectorAll("img.osr-img-selected").forEach(function(im) { im.classList.remove("osr-img-selected"); });
    document.querySelectorAll(".osr-img-wrap.osr-img-selected").forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove("osr-img-selected"); });
    t.classList.add("osr-img-selected");
    var bx = osrEditorGetWrapBox(t);
    if (bx) bx.classList.add("osr-img-selected");
    return;
  }
  if (!ev.target.closest("#osr-img-layout-pop")) osrEditorCloseImageLayout();
}

function osrEditorImageDblClick(ev, onDirty) {
  var img = ev.target;
  if (!img || img.tagName !== "IMG") return;
  ev.preventDefault();
  ev.stopPropagation();
  osrEditorShowImageLayout(img, onDirty);
}

    + ".osr-img-wrap[data-wrap='square-left']{float:left;margin:2px 14px 10px 0}"
    + ".osr-img-wrap[data-wrap='square-right']{float:right;margin:2px 0 10px 14px}"
    + ".osr-img-wrap[data-wrap='center']{display:block;clear:both;margin:12px auto}"
    + ".osr-img-wrap[data-wrap='top-bottom']{display:block;clear:both;width:100%;margin:12px 0}"
    + "img[data-wrap='square-left'],img:not([data-wrap]){display:block;float:left;max-width:48%;margin:2px 14px 10px 0}"
    + "img[data-wrap='square-right']{display:block;float:right;max-width:48%;margin:2px 0 10px 14px}"
    + "img[data-wrap='center']{display:block;float:none;clear:both;margin:12px auto}"
    + "img[data-wrap='top-bottom']{display:block;float:none;clear:both;width:100%;max-width:100%;margin:12px 0}";
}

function osrEditorImageLayoutInit() {
  if (window._osrImgLayoutInited) return;
  var pop = document.getElementById("osr-img-layout-pop");
  if (!pop) return;
  window._osrImgLayoutInited = true;
  pop.addEventListener("click", function(ev) {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    var t = ev.target;
    if (!t || !t.closest) return;
    if (t.closest("#osr-img-layout-apply")) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      osrEditorApplyImageLayout();
      return;
    }
    if (t.closest("#osr-img-layout-close")) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      osrEditorCloseImageLayout();
      return;
    }
    if (t.closest("#osr-img-layout-delete")) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      osrEditorDeleteImage();
      return;
    }
    var wrapBtn = t.closest("#osr-img-wrap-grid button[data-wrap]");
    if (wrapBtn) {
      var grid = document.getElementById("osr-img-wrap-grid");
      var wIn = document.getElementById("osr-img-layout-width");
      if (grid) grid.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove("sel"); });
      wrapBtn.classList.add("sel");
      var mode = wrapBtn.getAttribute("data-wrap");
      if (wIn) {
        wIn.disabled = mode === "top-bottom";
        if (mode === "top-bottom") wIn.value = "100%";
        else if (mode === "center" && !(wIn.value || "").trim()) wIn.value = "60%";
      }
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener("click", function(ev) {
    if (!_osrImgLayoutCtx) return;
    if (ev.target.closest("#osr-img-layout-pop")) return;
    if (ev.target.closest("img.osr-note-img") || ev.target.closest(".osr-img-wrap")) return;
    osrEditorCloseImageLayout();
  });
}

}
if (document.readyState === "loading") {
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", osrModNotesDomReady);
} else {
  osrModNotesDomReady();
}

/** Rich notes for M2–M7: same toolbar pattern as M1 freeform (HTML stored in module notes fields). */
function osrModNotes_prepareEditor(edOrId) {
  var ed = typeof edOrId === "string" ? $(edOrId) : edOrId;
  if (!ed) return;
  if (typeof READONLY_MODE !== "undefined" && READONLY_MODE) {
    ed.contentEditable = "false";
    ed.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false");
    return;
  }
  ed.contentEditable = "true";
  ed.setAttribute("contenteditable", "true");
  var h = String(ed.innerHTML || "").trim();
  if (!h || h === "<br>" || h === "<br/>") ed.innerHTML = "<p><br></p>";
}
function osrModNotes_initEditors() {
  if (window._osrModNotesInited) return;
  window._osrModNotesInited = true;
  document.querySelectorAll(".osr-mod-notes-editor").forEach(function(ed) {
    if (ed._osrModNotesBound) return;
    ed._osrModNotesBound = true;
    ed.addEventListener("keydown", function() { osrModNotes_prepareEditor(ed); });
  });
}
function osrModNotes_htmlFromStored(raw) {
  if (raw == null || raw === "") return "";
  var s = String(raw);
  var t = s.trim();
  if (!/^<[a-zA-Z!\/]/.test(t)) {
    return "<p>" + s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/\r\n|\r|\n/g, "</p><p>") + "</p>";
  }
  var box = document.createElement("div");
  box.innerHTML = s;
  box.querySelectorAll("script,iframe,object,style,link,meta").forEach(function(n) { n.remove(); });
  box.querySelectorAll("[id]").forEach(function(n) {
    var id = n.getAttribute("id") || "";
    if (/^m\d+_(?:sea_)?notes$/i.test(id)) n.removeAttribute("id");
  });
  box.querySelectorAll("[contenteditable]").forEach(function(n) { n.removeAttribute("contenteditable"); });
  return box.innerHTML;
}
/** Remove pasted/layout HTML that blocks typing (non-editable overlays, duplicate editor shells). */
function osrModNotes_sanitizeEditorDom(ed) {
  if (!ed) return;
  var kids = ed.children;
  if (kids.length === 1) {
    var only = kids[0];
    if (only.tagName === "IMG") {
      osrEditorEnsureImageWrapper(only, ed);
      osrEditorUnwrapImage(only, ed);
    } else if (only.getAttribute && only.getAttribute("contenteditable") === "false" && !(only.classList && only.classList.contains("osr-img-wrap"))) {
      while (only.firstChild) ed.insertBefore(only.firstChild, only);
      only.remove();
    }
  }
  ed.querySelectorAll("[contenteditable='false']").forEach(function(node) {
    if (node.classList && node.classList.contains("osr-img-wrap")) return;
    if (node === ed) return;
    node.removeAttribute("contenteditable");
  });
  ed.querySelectorAll("img[data-wrap='behind']").forEach(function(img) {
    img.style.pointerEvents = "none";
  });
  var er = ed.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (er.height > 0) {
    ed.querySelectorAll("div,section,article,span,p").forEach(function(node) {
      if (node === ed || !ed.contains(node)) return;
      if (node.closest && node.closest(".osr-img-wrap")) return;
      var st = node.style;
      var pos = st.position || "";
      if (pos !== "absolute" && pos !== "fixed") return;
      var r = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.height >= er.height * 0.45 && r.width >= er.width * 0.45) {
        node.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        node.style.position = "";
        node.style.left = "";
        node.style.top = "";
        node.style.right = "";
        node.style.bottom = "";
        node.style.width = "";
        node.style.height = "";
        node.style.zIndex = "";
        node.removeAttribute("contenteditable");
      }
    });
  }
}
function osrModNotes_getStored(editorId) {
  var ed = $(editorId);
  if (!ed) return "";
  var h = String(ed.innerHTML || "").trim();
  if (!h || h === "<p></p>" || h === "<p><br></p>" || h === "<p><br/></p>" || h === "<br>" || h === "<br/>") return "";
  return h;
}
function osrModNotes_setFromStored(editorId, raw) {
  var ed = $(editorId);
  if (!ed) return;
  ed.innerHTML = osrModNotes_htmlFromStored(raw || "");
  osrEditorNormalizeImages(ed);
  osrModNotes_sanitizeEditorDom(ed);
  osrModNotes_prepareEditor(ed);
  if (raw && String(raw).trim()) osrEditorWrapLooseEditorContent(ed);
}
function osrModNotes_cmd(editorId, cmd, arg) {
  var ed = $(editorId);
  if (!ed) return;
  osrModNotes_prepareEditor(ed);
  osrEditorExecCommand(ed, cmd, arg);
}

  osrEditorInsertLink($(editorId), null);
}
function osrModNotes_insertImage(editorId) {
  osrEditorInsertImage($(editorId), null);
}
function osrModNotes_editorDblClick(ev) {
  osrEditorImageDblClick(ev, null);
}

/** Parse M0 location JSON (object, sites array, or string) into { sites: [...] } shape for REF. */
function m1_parseLocationLibObject(data){
  if(data==null||data==="")return null;
  var d=data;
  if(typeof d==="string"){
    var s=String(d).trim();
    if(!s)return null;
    try{d=JSON.parse(s);}catch(e){return null;}
  }
  if(Array.isArray(d))return{sites:d};
  if(typeof d!=="object")return null;
  if(Array.isArray(d.sites)||Array.isArray(d.facilities)||Array.isArray(d.locations))return d;
  var keys=Object.keys(d);
  for(var i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
    if(Array.isArray(d[keys[i]])&&d[keys[i]].length&&typeof d[keys[i]][0]==="object"){
      var out={};
      out[keys[i]]=d[keys[i]];
      if(keys[i]==="sites")return out;
      out.sites=d[keys[i]];
      return out;
    }
  }
  return d;
}
/** Read the live M0 Location section (textarea / locked default) into REF.locationLib. */
function m1_syncLocationLibFromM0(){
  if(typeof REF==="undefined"||REF==null)return false;
  var parsed=null;
  var ta=document.getElementById("gdu_location");
  var locLocked=typeof OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED!=="undefined"&&!!OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED;
  if(ta){
    var raw=String(ta.value||"").trim();
    if(raw){
      parsed=m1_parseLocationLibObject(ta.value);
    } else if(locLocked&&typeof window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString==="function"){
      parsed=m1_parseLocationLibObject(window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString());
    } else {
      parsed={sites:[]};
    }
  } else if(locLocked&&typeof window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString==="function"){
    parsed=m1_parseLocationLibObject(window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString());
  } else {
    parsed={sites:[]};
  }
  REF.locationLib=parsed||{sites:[]};
  if(!REF.locationLibName)REF.locationLibName="M0 Location";
  return true;
}
function m1_getLocRows(){
  if(typeof m1_syncLocationLibFromM0==="function")m1_syncLocationLibFromM0();
  var d=REF.locationLib; if(!d)return [];
  if(typeof d==="string"){
    var parsed=m1_parseLocationLibObject(d);
    if(parsed)d=parsed; else return [];
  }
  if(Array.isArray(d)){
    return d.map(function(r){return {
      site:r.site_name||r.site||r.Site||r.facility||r.Facility||r["Site / Facility"]||"",
      area:r.area||r.Area||r.unit||r.Unit||r.unit_area||r["Unit / Area"]||"",
      system:r.system||r.System||r.sys||r["System"]||""
    };});
  }
  var sites=d.sites||d.facilities||d.locations||[];
  if(Array.isArray(sites)&&sites.length){
    // Support flat rows inside "sites": { "Site / Facility", "Unit / Area", "System" }.
    if (sites[0] && typeof sites[0] === "object" && !Array.isArray(sites[0]) &&
        ("Site / Facility" in sites[0] || "Unit / Area" in sites[0] || "System" in sites[0])) {
      return sites.map(function(r){return {
        site:r.site_name||r.site||r.Site||r.facility||r.Facility||r["Site / Facility"]||"",
        area:r.area||r.Area||r.unit||r.Unit||r.unit_area||r["Unit / Area"]||"",
        system:r.system||r.System||r.sys||r["System"]||""
      };});
    }
    var rows=[];
    sites.forEach(function(s){
      var sn=s.name||s.site_name||s.site||"";
      var areas=s.areas||s.units||s.unit_areas||[];
      if(!areas.length){rows.push({site:sn,area:"",system:""});return;}
      areas.forEach(function(a){
        var an=a.name||a.area||a.unit||"";
        var systems=a.systems||a.system_list||[];
        if(!systems.length){rows.push({site:sn,area:an,system:""});return;}
        systems.forEach(function(sy){
          rows.push({site:sn,area:an,system:typeof sy==="string"?sy:(sy.name||sy.system||"")});
        });
      });
    });
    return rows;
  }
  return [];
}

function m1_getLocSites(){
  var rows=m1_getLocRows(), s=new Set();
  rows.forEach(function(r){if(r.site)s.add(r.site);});
  return Array.from(s).sort();
}
function m1_getLocAreas(site){
  var rows=m1_getLocRows(), s=new Set();
  rows.forEach(function(r){if(r.site===site&&r.area)s.add(r.area);});
  return Array.from(s).sort();
}
function m1_getLocSystems(site,area){
  var rows=m1_getLocRows(), s=new Set();
  rows.forEach(function(r){if(r.site===site&&r.area===area&&r.system)s.add(r.system);});
  return Array.from(s).sort();
}

function m1_fillSelectOptions(el, values, selected, placeholder){
  if(!el)return;
  var esc = (typeof escapeHtml === "function") ? escapeHtml : escHtml;
  var seen={}, html='<option value="">'+esc(placeholder||"— select —")+"</option>";
  (values||[]).forEach(function(v){
    var t=String(v||"").trim();
    if(!t||seen[t])return;
    seen[t]=true;
    html+='<option value="'+esc(t)+'">'+esc(t)+'</option>';
  });
  var sel=String(selected||"").trim();
  el.innerHTML=html;
  el.value=sel;
  if(el.value!==sel) el.value="";
}
function m1_setLocImportWarn(kind, on){
  var el=$(kind==="site"?"m1_siteImportWarn":kind==="area"?"m1_areaImportWarn":"m1_systemImportWarn");
  if(!el)return;
  el.style.display=on?"inline":"none";
}
function m1_onSiteChanged(){
  var siteEl=$("m1_site"), areaEl=$("m1_area"), sysEl=$("m1_system");
  if(!siteEl||!areaEl||!sysEl)return;
  var site=String(siteEl.value||"").trim();
  m1_setLocImportWarn("site",false);
  m1_setLocImportWarn("area",false);
  m1_setLocImportWarn("system",false);
  m1_fillSelectOptions(areaEl,m1_getLocAreas(site),"","— select unit / area (M0 Location) —");
  m1_fillSelectOptions(sysEl,[],"","— select system (M0 Location) —");
}
function m1_onAreaChanged(){
  var siteEl=$("m1_site"), areaEl=$("m1_area"), sysEl=$("m1_system");
  if(!siteEl||!areaEl||!sysEl)return;
  var site=String(siteEl.value||"").trim();
  var area=String(areaEl.value||"").trim();
  m1_setLocImportWarn("area",false);
  m1_setLocImportWarn("system",false);
  m1_fillSelectOptions(sysEl,m1_getLocSystems(site,area),"","— select system (M0 Location) —");
}
function m1_blankComponentDesignRow(){
  return { component_name:"", material_spec:"", nominal_thickness_mm:null, course_bottom_elevation_m:null };
}
function m1_courseBottomElevationFromRow(row){
  if(!row||typeof row!=="object") return null;
  if(row.course_bottom_elevation_m!=null&&row.course_bottom_elevation_m!==""){
    var v=Number(row.course_bottom_elevation_m);
    return Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=0?v:null;
  }
  if(row.nominal_height_m!=null&&row.nominal_height_m!==""){
    var v2=Number(row.nominal_height_m);
    return Number.isFinite(v2)&&v2>=0?v2:null;
  }
  return null;
}
function m1_migrateComponentDesignElevationFields(m){
  if(!m||!Array.isArray(m.component_design)) return;
  m.component_design.forEach(function(r){
    if(r.course_bottom_elevation_m==null&&r.nominal_height_m!=null){
      r.course_bottom_elevation_m=r.nominal_height_m;
      delete r.nominal_height_m;
    }
  });
}
function m1_isShellCourseComponentName(name){
  return /shell\s+course\s*\d+/i.test(String(name||"").trim());
}
function m1_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(name){
  var m=String(name||"").match(/shell\s+course\s*(\d+)/i);
  return m?parseInt(m[1],10):null;
}
/** H₀ — bottom-of-course elevation (m above tank bottom) from Component design, by course index. */
function m1_getShellCourseBottomElevationM(courseIndex){
  if(!Number.isFinite(courseIndex)||courseIndex<1) return null;
  var tb=$("m1_componentDesignTbody");
  if(tb){
    var live=null;
    tb.querySelectorAll("tr.m1-cd-data-row").forEach(function(tr){
      var name=typeof m1_readComponentNameFromRow==="function"?m1_readComponentNameFromRow(tr):"";
      if(m1_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(name)!==courseIndex) return;
      var hInp=tr.querySelector("input.m1-cd-bottom");
      var h=hInp?numOrNull(hInp.value):null;
      if(h!=null&&h>=0) live=h;
    });
    if(live!=null) return live;
  }
  var rows=typeof m1_getComponentDesignRows==="function"?m1_getComponentDesignRows():[];
  var i, elev=null;
  for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    if(m1_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(rows[i].component_name)===courseIndex){
      elev=m1_courseBottomElevationFromRow(rows[i]);
      break;
    }
  }
  return elev;
}
function m1_getShellCourseBottomElevationsFromComponentDesign(){
  var out=[], hasVal=false;
  var rows=typeof m1_getComponentDesignRows==="function"?m1_getComponentDesignRows():[];
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    var ci=m1_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(r.component_name);
    if(!ci) return;
    var elev=m1_courseBottomElevationFromRow(r);
    if(elev==null) return;
    out[ci-1]=elev;
    hasVal=true;
  });
  if(hasVal) return out;
  var tb=$("m1_componentDesignTbody");
  if(tb){
    tb.querySelectorAll("tr.m1-cd-data-row").forEach(function(tr){
      var name=typeof m1_readComponentNameFromRow==="function"?m1_readComponentNameFromRow(tr):"";
      var ci=m1_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(name);
      if(!ci) return;
      var hInp=tr.querySelector("input.m1-cd-bottom");
      var h=hInp?numOrNull(hInp.value):null;
      if(h==null||h<0) return;
      out[ci-1]=h;
      hasVal=true;
    });
  }
  return hasVal?out:null;
}
function m1_migrateShellCourseHeightsToComponentDesign(m, storedHeights){
  if(!m||!Array.isArray(storedHeights)||!storedHeights.length) return;
  m1_ensureComponentDesignRows(m);
  m1_migrateComponentDesignElevationFields(m);
  var rows=m.component_design, elev=0, i;
  for(i=0;i<storedHeights.length;i++){
    var ci=i+1;
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      if(m1_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(r.component_name)===ci&&m1_courseBottomElevationFromRow(r)==null){
        r.course_bottom_elevation_m=elev;
        delete r.nominal_height_m;
      }
    });
    var cht=Number(storedHeights[i]);
    if(Number.isFinite(cht)&&cht>0) elev+=cht;
  }
}
function m1_updateComponentDesignHeightField(tr){
  if(!tr) return;
  var hInp=tr.querySelector("input.m1-cd-bottom");
  if(!hInp) return;
  var name=typeof m1_readComponentNameFromRow==="function"?m1_readComponentNameFromRow(tr):"";
  var isCourse=m1_isShellCourseComponentName(name);
  var ci=m1_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(name);
  hInp.disabled=!isCourse;
  hInp.readOnly=!isCourse;
  hInp.tabIndex=isCourse?0:-1;
  hInp.placeholder=isCourse?(ci===1?"0":"H₀"):"—";
  hInp.title=isCourse?"Height of bottom of course above tank bottom (H₀), m — required from drawings":"";
  if(!isCourse) hInp.value="";
}
var M1_TANK_COMPONENT_FALLBACK=(function(){
  var out=[], i;
  for(i=1;i<=30;i++) out.push("Shell Course "+i);
  out.push("Additional Shell Course",
    "Tank Bottom \u2014 Central Area","Tank Bottom \u2014 Edge / Critical Zone","Annular Ring Plate",
    "Fixed Roof","Floating Roof","Roof Plate","Top Angle","Wind Girder",
    "Bottom-to-Shell Weld","Shell Vertical Weld","Shell Horizontal Weld",
    "Foundation / Ringwall","Dike / Bund","Other");
  return out;
})();
function m1_tankComponentRowName(row){
  if(!row||typeof row!=="object")return "";
  return String(row.component_name||row.Component||row.component||row.name||row.label||"").trim();
}
function m1_tankComponentRowIsOther(row){
  var n=m1_tankComponentRowName(row);
  if(/^other$/i.test(n))return true;
  var f=row.is_other!=null?row.is_other:(row.other!=null?row.other:row.allow_custom);
  return f===true||f==="yes"||f==="true"||f==="1"||f===1;
}
function m1_getTankComponentLibRows(){
  var rows=(typeof REF!=="undefined"&&REF&&Array.isArray(REF.tankComponentLib)&&REF.tankComponentLib.length)?REF.tankComponentLib.slice():null;
  if(!rows){
    return M1_TANK_COMPONENT_FALLBACK.map(function(n,i){
      return {component_name:n,sort_order:i+1,category:"",is_other:n==="Other"?"yes":""};
    });
  }
  return rows.sort(function(a,b){
    var sa=Number(a&&a.sort_order), sb=Number(b&&b.sort_order);
    if(Number.isFinite(sa)&&Number.isFinite(sb)&&sa!==sb)return sa-sb;
    return m1_tankComponentRowName(a).localeCompare(m1_tankComponentRowName(b));
  });
}
function m1_getTankComponentOptionLabels(){
  return m1_getTankComponentLibRows().map(m1_tankComponentRowName).filter(function(s){return !!s;});
}
function m1_tankComponentOtherLabel(){
  var rows=m1_getTankComponentLibRows(), i;
  for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++){ if(m1_tankComponentRowIsOther(rows[i])) return m1_tankComponentRowName(rows[i]); }
  return "Other";
}
function m1_tankComponentLibHasOtherOption(){
  return m1_getTankComponentLibRows().some(m1_tankComponentRowIsOther);
}
function m1_resolveTankComponentLabel(val){
  var s=String(val||"").trim();
  if(!s)return "";
  var rows=m1_getTankComponentLibRows(), i, lab;
  for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    lab=m1_tankComponentRowName(rows[i]);
    if(!lab)continue;
    if(lab===s||lab.toLowerCase()===s.toLowerCase())return lab;
  }
  return s;
}
function m1_componentSelectState(name){
  var resolved=m1_resolveTankComponentLabel(name);
  if(!resolved)return {select:"",other:""};
  var rows=m1_getTankComponentLibRows(), otherLab=m1_tankComponentOtherLabel(), i, lab;
  for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    lab=m1_tankComponentRowName(rows[i]);
    if(!lab)continue;
    if(lab.toLowerCase()===resolved.toLowerCase()){
      if(m1_tankComponentRowIsOther(rows[i]))return {select:otherLab,other:""};
      return {select:lab,other:""};
    }
  }
  if(m1_tankComponentLibHasOtherOption())return {select:otherLab,other:resolved};
  return {select:"",other:resolved};
}
function m1_tankComponentOptionsMarkup(selected){
  var html='<option value="">&#8212; select component &#8212;</option>';
  var state=m1_componentSelectState(selected);
  var sel=state.select;
  var matched=false;
  m1_getTankComponentLibRows().forEach(function(row){
    var opt=m1_tankComponentRowName(row);
    if(!opt)return;
    var isSel=!matched&&sel&&opt===sel;
    if(isSel)matched=true;
    html+='<option value="'+escHtml(opt)+'"'+(isSel?' selected':'')+'>'+escHtml(opt)+'</option>';
  });
  return html;
}
function m1_onComponentTypeChanged(selEl){
  if(!selEl)return;
  var tr=selEl.closest?selEl.closest("tr.m1-cd-data-row"):null;
  if(!tr)return;
  var otherInp=tr.querySelector("input.m1-cd-name-other");
  if(!otherInp)return;
  var otherLab=typeof m1_tankComponentOtherLabel==="function"?m1_tankComponentOtherLabel():"Other";
  otherInp.style.display=selEl.value===otherLab?"":"none";
  if(selEl.value!==otherLab)otherInp.value="";
  m1_updateComponentDesignHeightField(tr);
}
window.m1_onComponentTypeChanged=m1_onComponentTypeChanged;

  var rows=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset.component_design;
