}
function m1_ensureActiveModule1Asset(promptUser){
  if(!activeAsset||!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi){
    if(promptUser&&typeof alert==="function") alert("Load a vessel first (File menu).");
    return null;
  }
  var s=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
  if(!s.module1_asset){
    s.module1_asset={
      tag:"",name:"",description:"",vessel_new_date:null,notes:"",
      location:{site_name:"",area:"",system:""},
      equipment_type:M1_EQUIPMENT_TYPE,
      design_conditions:{design_temperature_c:M1_DEFAULT_DESIGN_TEMP_C,design_pressure_mpa:M1_DEFAULT_DESIGN_PRESSURE_MPA,nominal_thickness_mm:null,corrosion_allowance_mm:null},
      operating_conditions:{operating_pressure_mpa:null,operating_temperature_c:null,vessel_liquid_level_pct:null},
      tank_data:{nominal_capacity_m3:null,inside_diameter_m:null,shell_height_m:null,roof_type:null,release_prevention_barrier:null,assessment_basis:{}},
      component_design:[m1_blankComponentDesignRow()]
    };
  }
  return s.module1_asset;
}
function m1_ensureComponentDesignRows(m){
  if(!m)return;
  if(!Array.isArray(m.component_design)) m.component_design=[];
  if(!m.component_design.length) m.component_design=[m1_blankComponentDesignRow()];
  m1_migrateComponentDesignElevationFields(m);
}
function m1_bindComponentDesignUi(){
  var addBtn=document.getElementById("m1_compDesignAddBtn");
  if(addBtn&&!addBtn.dataset.m1CdBound){
    addBtn.dataset.m1CdBound="1";
    addBtn.addEventListener("click",function(ev){
      ev.preventDefault();
      if(typeof m1_componentDesignRowAddAtEnd==="function") m1_componentDesignRowAddAtEnd();
    });
  }
  var tb=document.getElementById("m1_componentDesignTbody");
  if(tb&&!tb.dataset.m1CdBound){
    tb.dataset.m1CdBound="1";
    tb.addEventListener("click",function(ev){
      var t=ev.target;
      if(!t||!t.closest)return;
      var addBtnRow=t.closest("button.m2-icon-btn.m2-add");
      var delBtnRow=t.closest("button.m2-icon-btn.m2-del");
      if(addBtnRow){
        ev.preventDefault();
        var tr=addBtnRow.closest("tr.m1-cd-data-row");
        var idx=tr?parseInt(tr.getAttribute("data-idx"),10):NaN;
        if(typeof m1_componentDesignRowAdd==="function") m1_componentDesignRowAdd(Number.isFinite(idx)?idx:-1);
        return;
      }
      if(delBtnRow&&!delBtnRow.disabled){
        ev.preventDefault();
        var tr2=delBtnRow.closest("tr.m1-cd-data-row");
        var idx2=tr2?parseInt(tr2.getAttribute("data-idx"),10):NaN;
        if(Number.isFinite(idx2)&&typeof m1_componentDesignRowDel==="function") m1_componentDesignRowDel(idx2);
      }
    });
  }
}
function m1_normalizeMaterialSpec(spec){
  return String(spec||"").trim().replace(/\s*\(saved\)\s*$/i,"").trim();
}
function m1_materialPartsKey(s){
  return String(s||"").toLowerCase().split("\u00b7").map(function(p){return p.trim();}).filter(Boolean);
}
function m1_materialPartLooseEqual(a,b){
  var p=String(a||"").trim().toLowerCase();
  var q=String(b||"").trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!p||!q) return false;
  if(p===q) return true;
  if(p.indexOf(q)===0||q.indexOf(p)===0) return true;
  var pn=p.replace(/\s*\(\d+c\)\s*$/i,"").trim();
  var qn=q.replace(/\s*\(\d+c\)\s*$/i,"").trim();
  return pn===qn||pn.indexOf(qn)===0||qn.indexOf(pn)===0;
}
function m1_materialPartsMatch(saved, candidate){
  var pa=m1_materialPartsKey(saved), pb=m1_materialPartsKey(candidate);
  if(!pa.length||!pb.length) return false;
  if(pa.length>pb.length) return false;
  for(var i=0;i<pa.length;i++){
    if(!m1_materialPartLooseEqual(pa[i], pb[i])) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel(spec){
  var s=m1_normalizeMaterialSpec(spec);
  if(!s) return "";
  var lib=REF.materialLib||[];
  for(var i=0;i<lib.length;i++){
    if(m1_materialSpecMatchesSelection(lib[i], s)) return m1_materialSpecLabel(lib[i], i);
  }
  return s;
}
function m1_materialSpecLabel(m, idx){
  if(typeof m5_materialDisplayLabel==="function"){
    var d=m5_materialDisplayLabel(m);
    if(d)return d;
  }
  if(typeof m5_materialName==="function") return m5_materialName(m)||("Material "+(idx+1));
  var v=getRowProp(m,["specification","material_spec","material_name","Material","name","spec"]);
  return v?String(v):("Material "+(idx+1));
}
function m1_materialSpecMatchesSelection(m, selected){
  var sel=m1_normalizeMaterialSpec(selected);
  if(!sel)return false;
  if(m1_materialSpecLabel(m,0)===sel)return true;
  if(typeof m5_materialName==="function"&&m5_materialName(m)===sel)return true;
  if(typeof m5_materialDescription==="function"&&m5_materialDescription(m)===sel)return true;
  var selLc=sel.toLowerCase();
  var candidates=[];
  candidates.push(m1_materialSpecLabel(m,0));
  if(typeof m5_materialName==="function") candidates.push(m5_materialName(m));
  if(typeof m5_materialDescription==="function") candidates.push(m5_materialDescription(m));
  var spec=typeof m5_materialName==="function"?m5_materialName(m):"";
  var temp=getRowProp(m,["design_temp_C","design_temp","Design_Temp_C","Design_Temp","design_temp_c"]);
  var form=getRowProp(m,["product_form","Product_Form","product form","Product Form"]);
  candidates.push([spec,temp,form].filter(function(v){return v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=="";}).map(function(v){return String(v).trim();}).join(" \u00b7 "));
  for(var ci=0;ci<candidates.length;ci++){
    var c=String(candidates[ci]||"").trim();
    if(!c) continue;
    var cLc=c.toLowerCase();
    if(cLc===selLc) return true;
    if(cLc.indexOf(selLc)===0||selLc.indexOf(cLc)===0) return true;
    if(m1_materialPartsMatch(sel, c)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function m1_materialSpecOptionsMarkup(selected){
  var html='<option value="">— select material (M0) —</option>';
  var lib=REF.materialLib||[];
  if(!lib.length){
    html+='<option value="" disabled>(Load M0 Materials first)</option>';
    return html;
  }
  var sel=m1_normalizeMaterialSpec(selected);
  var matchedLabel="";
  lib.forEach(function(m,i){
    var n=m1_materialSpecLabel(m,i);
    var isSel=!matchedLabel&&m1_materialSpecMatchesSelection(m,sel);
    if(isSel) matchedLabel=n;
    html+='<option value="'+escHtml(n)+'"'+(isSel?' selected':'')+'>'+escHtml(n)+'</option>';
  });
  if(sel&&!matchedLabel){
    html+='<option value="'+escHtml(sel)+'" selected>'+escHtml(sel)+'</option>';
  }
  return html;
}

  return '<svg class="m1-cd-del-ico" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 6h18"/><path d="M8 6V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h6a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H7a1 1 0 0 1-1-1L5 6"/><path d="M10 11v6"/><path d="M14 11v6"/></svg>';
}
function m1_renderComponentDesignTable(){
  m1_bindComponentDesignUi();
  var tb=$("m1_componentDesignTbody");
  if(!tb)return;
  if(!activeAsset||!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi){
    tb.innerHTML='<tr class="m1-cd-data-row"><td colspan="5" class="hint">Load a tank to edit component design.</td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  var m=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset;
  if(!m) m=m1_ensureActiveModule1Asset(false);
  if(!m){
    tb.innerHTML='<tr class="m1-cd-data-row"><td colspan="5" class="hint">Load a tank to edit component design.</td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  m1_ensureComponentDesignRows(m);
  tb.innerHTML="";
  var rows=m.component_design;
  var disMat=!REF.materialLib||!REF.materialLib.length;
  rows.forEach(function(row,idx){
    var compState=m1_componentSelectState(row.component_name);
    var mat=row.material_spec!=null?m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel(row.material_spec):"";
    var thk=row.nominal_thickness_mm!=null&&row.nominal_thickness_mm!==""?String(row.nominal_thickness_mm):"";
    var htVal=m1_courseBottomElevationFromRow(row);
    var ht=htVal!=null?String(htVal):"";
    var isCourse=m1_isShellCourseComponentName(row.component_name);
    var ci=m1_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(row.component_name);
    var delDis=rows.length<=1?" disabled":"";
    var otherLab=m1_tankComponentOtherLabel();
    var otherDisp=compState.select===otherLab?"":"none";
    var tr=document.createElement("tr");
    tr.className="m1-cd-data-row";
    tr.setAttribute("data-idx",String(idx));
    tr.innerHTML=
      '<td class="m1-cd-td-actions"><div class="m2-comp-actions-inner">'+
      '<button type="button" class="m2-icon-btn m2-add" title="Add row below" aria-label="Add row below" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m1_componentDesignRowAdd('+idx+')">+</button>'+
      '<button type="button" class="m2-icon-btn m2-del" title="Delete this component row" aria-label="Delete row"'+delDis+' onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m1_componentDesignRowDel('+idx+')">'+m1_cdDeleteIconSvg()+'</button>'+
      '</div></td>'+
      '<td><select class="m1-cd-component" onchange="m1_onComponentTypeChanged(this);m1_onComponentDesignInput()">'+m1_tankComponentOptionsMarkup(row.component_name)+'</select>'+
      '<input type="text" class="m1-cd-name-other" placeholder="Specify component" oninput="m1_onComponentDesignInput()" style="margin-top:4px;display:'+otherDisp+'" value="'+escHtml(compState.other)+'"/></td>'+
      '<td><select class="m1-cd-material"'+(disMat?' disabled':'')+' onchange="m1_onComponentDesignInput();if(typeof m5_syncMinWallMaterialsFromM1Dom===\'function\')m5_syncMinWallMaterialsFromM1Dom();">'+m1_materialSpecOptionsMarkup(mat)+'</select></td>'+
      '<td><input type="number" class="m1-cd-thk" min="0" step="0.1" placeholder="mm" oninput="m1_onComponentDesignInput()" value="'+escHtml(thk)+'"/></td>'+
      '<td><input type="number" class="m1-cd-bottom" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="'+(isCourse?(ci===1?"0":"H₀"):"—")+'" title="'+(isCourse?"Height of bottom of course above tank bottom (H₀), m":"")+'" oninput="m1_onComponentDesignHeightInput()" value="'+escHtml(ht)+'"'+(isCourse?"":" disabled readonly tabindex=\"-1\"")+'/></td>';
    tb.appendChild(tr);
    m1_updateComponentDesignHeightField(tr);
  });
}
function m1_readComponentNameFromRow(tr){
  var compSel=tr.querySelector("select.m1-cd-component");
  var otherInp=tr.querySelector("input.m1-cd-name-other");
  var compVal=compSel?String(compSel.value||"").trim():"";
  var otherLab=typeof m1_tankComponentOtherLabel==="function"?m1_tankComponentOtherLabel():"Other";
  if(compVal===otherLab){
    var custom=otherInp?String(otherInp.value||"").trim():"";
    return custom||otherLab;
  }
  return compVal;
}
function m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom(){
  if(!activeAsset||!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi)return;
  var m=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset;
  if(!m)return;
  var tb=$("m1_componentDesignTbody");
  if(!tb)return;
  var next=[];
  tb.querySelectorAll("tr.m1-cd-data-row").forEach(function(tr){
    var matSel=tr.querySelector("select.m1-cd-material");
    var thkInp=tr.querySelector("input.m1-cd-thk");
    var htInp=tr.querySelector("input.m1-cd-bottom");
    var compName=m1_readComponentNameFromRow(tr);
    var isCourse=m1_isShellCourseComponentName(compName);
    next.push({
      component_name:compName,
      material_spec:matSel&&matSel.value?m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel(matSel.value):"",
      nominal_thickness_mm:thkInp?numOrNull(thkInp.value):null,
      course_bottom_elevation_m:(isCourse&&htInp)?numOrNull(htInp.value):null
    });
  });
  if(next.length)m.component_design=next;
  else m.component_design=[m1_blankComponentDesignRow()];
}
function m1_componentDesignRowAdd(afterIdx){
  var m=m1_ensureActiveModule1Asset(true);
  if(!m)return;
  m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom();
  m1_ensureComponentDesignRows(m);
  var i=parseInt(afterIdx,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(i)||i<0)i=m.component_design.length-1;
  m.component_design.splice(i+1,0,m1_blankComponentDesignRow());
  m1_renderComponentDesignTable();
  m1_dirty=true;
}
function m1_componentDesignRowAddAtEnd(){
  var m=m1_ensureActiveModule1Asset(true);
  if(!m)return;
  m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom();
  m1_ensureComponentDesignRows(m);
  m.component_design.push(m1_blankComponentDesignRow());
  m1_renderComponentDesignTable();
  m1_dirty=true;
}
function m1_componentDesignRowDel(idx){
  var m=m1_ensureActiveModule1Asset(true);
  if(!m)return;
  m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom();
  m1_ensureComponentDesignRows(m);
  if(m.component_design.length<=1)return;
  var i=parseInt(idx,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(i)||i<0||i>=m.component_design.length)return;
  var label=(m.component_design[i].component_name||"").trim()||("row "+(i+1));
  if(!confirm('Delete component "'+label+'"? This cannot be undone.'))return;
  m.component_design.splice(i,1);
  m1_renderComponentDesignTable();
  m1_dirty=true;
}
function m1_onComponentDesignInput(){
  m1_dirty=true;
  if(typeof m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom==="function") m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom();
}
function m1_onComponentDesignHeightInput(){
  m1_dirty=true;
  if(typeof m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom==="function") m1_syncComponentDesignFromDom();
  if(typeof osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom==="function") osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom();
}
window.m1_onComponentDesignHeightInput=m1_onComponentDesignHeightInput;
window.m1_componentDesignRowAdd=m1_componentDesignRowAdd;
window.m1_componentDesignRowAddAtEnd=m1_componentDesignRowAddAtEnd;
window.m1_componentDesignRowDel=m1_componentDesignRowDel;
window.m1_renderComponentDesignTable=m1_renderComponentDesignTable;

function m1_popLocationSelects(keepValues, locOverride){
  if(typeof m1_syncLocationLibFromM0==="function")m1_syncLocationLibFromM0();
  var m = activeAsset && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset;
  var loc = locOverride || (m ? (m.location || {}) : {});
  var siteEl=$("m1_site"), areaEl=$("m1_area"), sysEl=$("m1_system");
  if(!siteEl||!areaEl||!sysEl)return;
  var siteVal = keepValues ? String(loc.site_name||"").trim() : String(siteEl.value||"").trim();
  var areaVal = keepValues ? String(loc.area||"").trim() : String(areaEl.value||"").trim();
  var sysVal  = keepValues ? String(loc.system||"").trim() : String(sysEl.value||"").trim();
  m1_setLocImportWarn("site",false);
  m1_setLocImportWarn("area",false);
  m1_setLocImportWarn("system",false);
  m1_fillSelectOptions(siteEl,m1_getLocSites(),siteVal,"— select site (M0 Location) —");
  if(siteVal && !siteEl.value) m1_setLocImportWarn("site",true);
  m1_fillSelectOptions(areaEl,m1_getLocAreas(siteVal),areaVal,"— select unit / area (M0 Location) —");
  if(areaVal && !areaEl.value) m1_setLocImportWarn("area",true);
  m1_fillSelectOptions(sysEl,m1_getLocSystems(siteVal,areaVal),sysVal,"— select system (M0 Location) —");
  if(sysVal && !sysEl.value) m1_setLocImportWarn("system",true);
  if ($("m1_bunded") && loc) $("m1_bunded").value = (loc.bunded_area === "Yes" || loc.bunded_area === "No") ? loc.bunded_area : "";
}

var m2_data = null;

function m2_normalizeOtherItems(d) {
  if (!d || !d.other_items || !Array.isArray(d.other_items)) return;
  d.other_items.forEach(function(it) {
    if (!it.fluid_name && it.substance_name) it.fluid_name = String(it.substance_name).trim();
    if (it.percent_total === undefined || it.percent_total === null) it.percent_total = "";
    if (it.molecular_weight === undefined) it.molecular_weight = null;
    if (it.notes === undefined || it.notes === null) it.notes = "";
    var fn = (it.fluid_name || "").trim();
    if (fn && REF.otherLib && REF.otherLib.length) {
      var f = findFluid(fn, REF.otherLib);
      if (f) it.molecular_weight = m2_fluidMW(f);
    }
  });
}

function m2_blank() {
  return {chemistry_name:"",design_pressure_mpa:null,operating_temperature_c:null,
    stored_product:{name:"",specific_gravity:null,liquid_density_kg_m3:null,vapour_blanketing:""},
    stored_liquid:{liquid_density_kg_m3:null,viscosity_cp:null,molecular_weight:null,normal_boiling_point_c:null,storage_temperature_c:null,design_temperature_c:null,specific_gravity:null,flash_point_c:null,autoignition_temperature_c:null,product_value_usd:null},
    chemistry:[],mixture_properties:{nbp_mix_c:null,mw_mix_kg_kmol:null,rho_mix_kg_m3:null},
    suggested_representative_fluid:null,toxic_items:[],acid_items:[],other_items:[],specialist_engineering_assessment:"",notes:""};
}
function m2_ensureStoredProductShape(d){
  if(!d)return;
  if(!d.stored_product||typeof d.stored_product!=="object")d.stored_product={name:"",specific_gravity:null,liquid_density_kg_m3:null,vapour_blanketing:""};
  var sp=d.stored_product;
  if(sp.name===undefined)sp.name="";
  if(sp.vapour_blanketing===undefined)sp.vapour_blanketing="";
  if(!d.stored_liquid||typeof d.stored_liquid!=="object")d.stored_liquid={liquid_density_kg_m3:null,viscosity_cp:null,molecular_weight:null,normal_boiling_point_c:null,storage_temperature_c:null,design_temperature_c:null,specific_gravity:null,flash_point_c:null,autoignition_temperature_c:null,product_value_usd:null};
}
function m2_numFieldVal(id){
  var el=$(id); if(!el)return null;
  var t=String(el.value||"").trim();
  if(t==="")return null;
  var n=parseFloat(t.replace(/,/g,"."));
  return Number.isFinite(n)?n:null;
}
function m2_setNumField(id,v){
  var el=$(id); if(!el)return;
  el.value=v!=null&&Number.isFinite(v)?v:"";
}
function m2_readStoredProductDom(){
  if(!m2_data)return;
  m2_ensureStoredProductShape(m2_data);
  var sp=m2_data.stored_product, sl=m2_data.stored_liquid;
  sp.name=($("m2_storedProduct")&&$("m2_storedProduct").value||"").trim();
  sp.specific_gravity=m2_numFieldVal("m2_op_sg");
  sp.liquid_density_kg_m3=m2_numFieldVal("m2_op_liquidDensity");
  sp.vapour_blanketing=($("m2_vapourBlanket")&&$("m2_vapourBlanket").value||"").trim();
  sl.liquid_density_kg_m3=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_density");
  sl.viscosity_cp=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_viscosity");
  sl.molecular_weight=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_mw");
  sl.normal_boiling_point_c=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_nbp");
  sl.storage_temperature_c=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_storageTemp");
  sl.design_temperature_c=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_designTemp");
  sl.specific_gravity=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_sg");
  sl.flash_point_c=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_flashPt");
  sl.autoignition_temperature_c=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_ait");
  sl.product_value_usd=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_productValue");
}
function m2_writeStoredProductDom(){
  if(!m2_data)return;
  m2_ensureStoredProductShape(m2_data);
  var sp=m2_data.stored_product, sl=m2_data.stored_liquid;
  if($("m2_storedProduct"))$("m2_storedProduct").value=sp.name||"";
  m2_setNumField("m2_op_sg",sp.specific_gravity);
  m2_setNumField("m2_op_liquidDensity",sp.liquid_density_kg_m3);
  if($("m2_vapourBlanket"))$("m2_vapourBlanket").value=sp.vapour_blanketing||"";
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_density",sl.liquid_density_kg_m3);
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_viscosity",sl.viscosity_cp);
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_mw",sl.molecular_weight);
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_nbp",sl.normal_boiling_point_c);
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_storageTemp",sl.storage_temperature_c!=null?sl.storage_temperature_c:(m2_data.operating_temperature_c!=null?m2_data.operating_temperature_c:null));
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_sg",sl.specific_gravity!=null?sl.specific_gravity:sp.specific_gravity);
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_flashPt",sl.flash_point_c);
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_ait",sl.autoignition_temperature_c);
  m2_setNumField("m2_liq_productValue",sl.product_value_usd);
}
function m2_ensureM2Data(){
  if(m2_data){
    m2_ensureStoredProductShape(m2_data);
    return m2_data;
  }
  if(activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry){
    m2_data=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry));
  }else{
    m2_data=m2_blank();
  }
  m2_ensureStoredProductShape(m2_data);
  return m2_data;
}
function m2_showRepStatus(msg){
  var st=$("m2_status");
  if(st&&msg)st.textContent=msg;
}
function m2_setRepresentativeFluid(name){
  m2_ensureM2Data();
  m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid=(name||"").trim()||null;
  var rs=$("m2_repSelect");
  if(rs){
    if(m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid){
      var ok=false,v=m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid;
      for(var i=0;i<rs.options.length;i++){ if(rs.options[i].value===v){ ok=true; break; } }
      rs.value=ok?v:"";
      if(!ok)m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid=null;
    }else rs.value="";
  }
  m2_updateRepHint();
  m2_applyRepFluidToStoredLiquid();
  if(m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid){
    var fs=$("m3_fluidSel");
    if(fs)fs.value=m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid;
    if(typeof m3_fluidChanged==="function")m3_fluidChanged();
  }
}
function m2_applyRepFluidToStoredLiquid(){
  if(!m2_data||!REF.chemLib||!REF.chemLib.length)return;
  var name=(m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid||"").trim();
  if(!name)return;
  var f=findFluid(name,REF.chemLib);
  if(!f)return;
  m2_ensureStoredProductShape(m2_data);
  var sp=m2_data.stored_product, sl=m2_data.stored_liquid;
  var rho=m2_fluidRho(f), mw=m2_fluidMW(f), nbp=m2_fluidNBP(f), vis=m2_fluidViscosity(f), ait=m2_fluidAIT(f);
  if(rho!=null){
    sp.liquid_density_kg_m3=rho;
    sl.liquid_density_kg_m3=rho;
    var sg=Math.round((rho/997)*1000)/1000;
    if(sg>0){
      if(sp.specific_gravity==null)sp.specific_gravity=sg;
      if(sl.specific_gravity==null)sl.specific_gravity=sg;
    }
  }
  if(mw!=null) sl.molecular_weight=mw;
  if(nbp!=null) sl.normal_boiling_point_c=nbp;
  if(vis!=null) sl.viscosity_cp=vis;
  if(ait!=null&&ait>0) sl.autoignition_temperature_c=ait;
  m2_writeStoredProductDom();
}

function m2_numFromM1Input(id){
  var el=$(id); if(!el)return null;
  var t=String(el.value||"").trim();
  if(t==="")return null;
  var n=parseFloat(t.replace(/,/g,"."));
  return Number.isFinite(n)?n:null;
}
/** Effective M1 design / operating numbers: prefer live Module 1 inputs, then saved module1_asset (same contract as M2). Used by M3–M7 inherited rows and release selects. */
function osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating() {
  if (!activeAsset) return { design_conditions: {}, operating_conditions: {} };
  var m1 = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset || {};
  var dc = m1.design_conditions || {};
  var oc = m1.operating_conditions || {};
  var m2 = typeof m2_data !== "undefined" && m2_data ? m2_data : (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry || null);
  var dT = m2_numFromM1Input("m1_tempC"); if (dT == null) dT = dc.design_temperature_c != null ? dc.design_temperature_c : null;
  var dP = m2_numFromM1Input("m1_presMPa"); if (dP == null) dP = dc.design_pressure_mpa != null ? dc.design_pressure_mpa : null;
  var nom = m2_numFromM1Input("m1_nomThk"); if (nom == null) nom = dc.nominal_thickness_mm != null ? dc.nominal_thickness_mm : null;
  var ca = m2_numFromM1Input("m1_corrAllow"); if (ca == null) ca = dc.corrosion_allowance_mm != null ? dc.corrosion_allowance_mm : null;
  var oP = m2_numFromM1Input("m1_opPres"); if (oP == null) oP = oc.operating_pressure_mpa != null ? oc.operating_pressure_mpa : (m2 && m2.design_pressure_mpa != null ? m2.design_pressure_mpa : null);
  var oT = m2_numFromM1Input("m1_opTemp"); if (oT == null) oT = oc.operating_temperature_c != null ? oc.operating_temperature_c : (m2 && m2.operating_temperature_c != null ? m2.operating_temperature_c : null);
  var liq = m2_numFromM1Input("m1_liqLevel"); if (liq == null) liq = oc.vessel_liquid_level_pct != null ? oc.vessel_liquid_level_pct : null;
  return {
    design_conditions: { design_temperature_c: dT, design_pressure_mpa: dP, nominal_thickness_mm: nom, corrosion_allowance_mm: ca },
    operating_conditions: { operating_pressure_mpa: oP, operating_temperature_c: oT, vessel_liquid_level_pct: liq }
  };
}
/** Tank inside diameter (mm): live M1 inside diameter (m) × 1000, then saved tank_data.inside_diameter_m. */
function osrEffectiveM1TankInsideDiameterMm(){
  if(typeof m2_numFromM1Input!=="function")return null;
  var dm=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_diamM");
  if(dm==null&&activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset){
    var td=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset.tank_data||{};
    if(td.inside_diameter_m!=null)dm=numOrNull(String(td.inside_diameter_m));
  }
  if(dm==null||!Number.isFinite(dm)||dm<=0)return null;
  return Math.round(dm*1000*100)/100;
}
function m5_syncTankDiameterFromM1Dom(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  var d=typeof osrEffectiveM1TankInsideDiameterMm==="function"?osrEffectiveM1TankInsideDiameterMm():null;
  if(d==null)return;
  (m5_data.min_wall_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){ c.diameter_mm=d; });
  (m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){ c.diameter_mm=d; });
  ["internal","external"].forEach(function(surface){
    var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
    var cont=typeof $==="function"?$(contId):null;
    if(!cont)return;
    cont.querySelectorAll(".m5_diameter").forEach(function(el){ el.value=String(d); });
  });
}

/** Construction / installation date (YYYY-MM-DD): live M1 input, then saved module1_asset. Module 3 "Date new" rows use this. */
function osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate() {
  if (!activeAsset || typeof $ !== "function") return null;
  var el = $("m1_installDate") || $("m1_vesselNewDate");
  if (el) {
    var raw = el.value != null ? String(el.value).trim() : "";
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(raw)) return raw;
  }
  var m1 = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset;
  if (!m1 || m1.vessel_new_date == null) return null;
  var s = String(m1.vessel_new_date).trim();
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(s)) return s.slice(0, 10);
  return null;
}
/** Design pressure (MPa gauge): live M1 input, then M0/M1 asset design_conditions — min-wall readout beside Date new. */
function m5_effectiveDesignPressureMpaDisplay() {
  if (!activeAsset || typeof $ !== "function") return "";
  var el = $("m1_presMPa");
  if (el) {
    var raw = el.value != null ? String(el.value).trim() : "";
    if (raw !== "") {
      var n = parseFloat(raw);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) return String(n);
    }
  }
  var dc = {};
  if (typeof osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating === "function") {
    dc = osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating().design_conditions || {};
  } else if (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset) {
    dc = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset.design_conditions || {};
  }
  var v = dc.design_pressure_mpa;
  if (v == null || v === "") return "";
  return String(v);
}

}
/** Module 3 summary row under title — live M1 design fields (same source as min-wall hidden inputs). */
function m3_syncHeaderInheritedFromM1Dom() {

    if (typeof m5_syncMinWallMaterialsFromM1Dom === "function") m5_syncMinWallMaterialsFromM1Dom();
    if (typeof m5_populateMinWall === "function") m5_populateMinWall();
  } catch (e0) { console.warn("osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom M5", e0); }
  try {
    var m2ref = typeof m2_data !== "undefined" && m2_data ? m2_data : (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry || null);
    if (typeof m3_popPressureSelect === "function") m3_popPressureSelect(m2ref);
    if (typeof m3_popTemperatureSelect === "function") m3_popTemperatureSelect(m2ref);
    if (typeof m4_syncVolumeFromM1Dom === "function") m4_syncVolumeFromM1Dom();
  } catch (e1) { console.warn("osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom M4 release", e1); }
  try {
    if (typeof m3_applyTankReleaseUI === "function" && (typeof currentTab === "undefined" || currentTab === 4 || document.getElementById("m3_releaseCourse"))) {
      m3_applyTankReleaseUI();
      if (typeof m3_tryCalculateHoles === "function" && m3_data && m3_data.holes && m3_data.holes.length) m3_tryCalculateHoles(true);
    }
  } catch (eM4r) { console.warn("osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom M4 release", eM4r); }
  try {
    if (typeof m7_syncInheritedDesignFromM1Dom === "function") m7_syncInheritedDesignFromM1Dom();
  } catch (e2) { console.warn("osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom M7", e2); }
  try {
    if (typeof m6_calc === "function") m6_calc();
  } catch (e3) { console.warn("osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom M6", e3); }
}
/** M2 inherited-from-M1 + read-only design temp: prefer live Module 1 inputs, then saved module1_asset (fixes unsaved M1 edits / long-scroll). */
function m2_syncInheritedFromM1Dom(){
  var m1=(activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset)||{};
  var dc=m1.design_conditions||{};
  var oc=m1.operating_conditions||{};
  var dT=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_tempC"); if(dT==null)dT=dc.design_temperature_c!=null?dc.design_temperature_c:null;
  var dP=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_presMPa"); if(dP==null)dP=dc.design_pressure_mpa!=null?dc.design_pressure_mpa:null;
  var oP=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_opPres"); if(oP==null)oP=oc.operating_pressure_mpa!=null?oc.operating_pressure_mpa:null;
  var oT=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_opTemp"); if(oT==null)oT=oc.operating_temperature_c!=null?oc.operating_temperature_c:null;
  var sumEl = $("m2_m1SummaryLine");
  if (sumEl) {
    var tagEl = $("m1_tag");
    var tag = tagEl && String(tagEl.value || "").trim() ? String(tagEl.value).trim() : (m1.tag || "");
    var eq = (m1.equipment_type || "").trim() || "—";
    var bits = [];
    if (tag) bits.push("Tag " + tag);
    bits.push(eq);
    bits.push("Design temp " + (dT != null ? dT + " °C" : "—"));
    bits.push("Design P " + (dP != null ? dP + " MPa g" : "—"));
    bits.push("Op. P " + (oP != null ? oP + " MPa g" : "—"));
    bits.push("Op. T " + (oT != null ? oT + " °C" : "—"));
    sumEl.textContent = "From M1 · " + bits.join(" · ");
  }
  var ro=function(id,v){var el=$(id);if(el)el.value=v!=null&&v!==""?v:"";};
  ro("m2_op_tag",($("m1_tag")&&String($("m1_tag").value||"").trim())||m1.tag||"");
  ro("m2_op_designTemp",dT);
  ro("m2_op_designPres",dP);
  ro("m2_op_opTemp",oT);
  ro("m2_op_opPres",oP);
  ro("m2_op_capM3",m2_numFromM1Input("m1_capM3"));
  ro("m2_op_normalInv",m2_numFromM1Input("m1_normalInvM3"));
  ro("m2_op_fillPct",m2_numFromM1Input("m1_liqLevel"));
  ro("m2_op_maxFill",m2_numFromM1Input("m1_maxFillPct"));
  ro("m2_op_maxFillHeight",m2_numFromM1Input("m1_maxFillHeightM"));
  ro("m2_liq_designTemp",dT);
  if(m2_data&&m2_data.stored_liquid)m2_data.stored_liquid.design_temperature_c=dT;
}
function m2_attachM1DomSyncListeners(){
  if(typeof window._m2_m1DomBound!=="undefined"&&window._m2_m1DomBound)return;
  window._m2_m1DomBound=true;
  ["m1_tag","m1_tempC","m1_presMPa","m1_opPres","m1_opTemp","m1_nomThk","m1_corrAllow","m1_liqLevel","m1_installDate","m1_diamM","m1_heightM","m1_shellCourses","m1_capM3","m1_normalInvM3","m1_maxFillPct","m1_maxFillHeightM"].forEach(function(id){
    var el=$(id); if(!el)return;
    var fn=function(){
      if(typeof m2_syncInheritedFromM1Dom==="function")m2_syncInheritedFromM1Dom();
      if(typeof osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom==="function")osrSyncInheritedModulesFromM1Dom();
    };
    el.addEventListener("input",fn);
    el.addEventListener("change",fn);
  });
}

function m2_load() {
  m2_attachM1DomSyncListeners();
  var s = activeAsset ? activeAsset.sentinel_rbi : null;
  var m1 = s ? s.module1_asset : null;
  if ($("m2_warnM1")) $("m2_warnM1").style.display = m1 ? "none" : "block";
  if (!m1 && $("m2_m1SummaryLine")) $("m2_m1SummaryLine").textContent = "";

  if (activeAsset && s) {
    m2_data = s.module2_chemistry ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.module2_chemistry)) : m2_blank();
  } else if (!m2_data) {
    m2_data = m2_blank();
  }
  m2_ensureStoredProductShape(m2_data);
  var oc = m1&&m1.operating_conditions?m1.operating_conditions:{};
  var op=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_opPres"); if(op==null) op=oc.operating_pressure_mpa!=null?oc.operating_pressure_mpa:null;
  var ot=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_opTemp"); if(ot==null) ot=oc.operating_temperature_c!=null?oc.operating_temperature_c:null;
  if (op != null) m2_data.design_pressure_mpa = op;
  if (ot != null) m2_data.operating_temperature_c = ot;
  var chemNameEl=$("m2_chemName");
  if(chemNameEl) chemNameEl.value = m2_data.chemistry_name||"";
  m2_syncInheritedFromM1Dom();
  m2_writeStoredProductDom();
  if(!m2_data.other_items||!Array.isArray(m2_data.other_items)) m2_data.other_items=[];
  m2_normalizeOtherItems(m2_data);
  if(REF.toxLib.length) m2_popToxSelect();
  m2_popOtherSelect();
  m2_renderToxTable(); m2_renderOtherTable();
  m2_popRepDropdown();
  if(m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid){
    var rs=$("m2_repSelect");
    if(rs&&rs.value!==m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid){
      var v=m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid.trim();
      if(v){
        var ok=false; for(var ri=0;ri<rs.options.length;ri++){ if(rs.options[ri].value===v){ ok=true; break; } }
        if(ok) rs.value=v;
      }
    }
  }
  m2_updateRepHint();
  if($("m2_sea_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m2_sea_notes", m2_data.specialist_engineering_assessment || "");
  if($("m2_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m2_notes", m2_data.notes || "");
  if($("m2_status")) $("m2_status").textContent = "Loaded";
  if (typeof m4_syncHeaderChemistryFromM2Dom === "function") m4_syncHeaderChemistryFromM2Dom();
}

/** Module 4 title row: show M2 analysis / chemistry name (live field, then in-memory, then saved asset). */
function m4_syncHeaderChemistryFromM2Dom() {
  if (typeof $ !== "function") return;
  var out = $("m4_hdr_chemName");
  if (!out) return;
  var name = "";
  var chemIn = $("m2_chemName");
  if (chemIn && String(chemIn.value || "").trim() !== "") {
    name = String(chemIn.value).trim();
  }
  if (!name && typeof m2_data !== "undefined" && m2_data && m2_data.chemistry_name != null && String(m2_data.chemistry_name).trim() !== "") {
    name = String(m2_data.chemistry_name).trim();
  }
  if (!name && activeAsset && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry.chemistry_name != null) {
    name = String(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry.chemistry_name).trim();
  }
  if (!name) {
    var hid = $("m3_m2name");
    if (hid && String(hid.value || "").trim() !== "") name = String(hid.value).trim();
  }
  out.textContent = name || "\u2014";
}

function m2_chemNameChanged(){
  var el=$("m2_chemName");
  var name=el&&el.value?el.value.trim():"";
  if(m2_data) m2_data.chemistry_name=name;
  var m3NameEl=$("m3_m2name");
  if(m3NameEl) m3NameEl.value=name;
  if (typeof m4_syncHeaderChemistryFromM2Dom === "function") m4_syncHeaderChemistryFromM2Dom();
}

function m2_save() {
  if (!activeAsset||!m2_data) return;
  m2_saveSelChem(); m2_saveSelTox(); m2_saveSelOther();
  m2_data.chemistry_name = $("m2_chemName").value.trim();
  m2_readStoredProductDom();
  var m1 = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset;
  var oc = m1&&m1.operating_conditions?m1.operating_conditions:{};
  m2_data.design_pressure_mpa = oc.operating_pressure_mpa != null ? oc.operating_pressure_mpa : m2_data.design_pressure_mpa;
  m2_data.operating_temperature_c = oc.operating_temperature_c != null ? oc.operating_temperature_c : m2_data.operating_temperature_c;
  var repSel=$("m2_repSelect"); if(repSel) m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid=(repSel.value||"").trim()||null;
  var m2SeaEl = $("m2_sea_notes"); m2_data.specialist_engineering_assessment = m2SeaEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m2_sea_notes") : "";
  var m2NotesEl = $("m2_notes"); m2_data.notes = m2NotesEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m2_notes") : "";
  m2_calcMixProps();
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m2_data));
  setModuleStatus(2,"complete"); auditLog(2,"saved");
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  $("m2_status").textContent = "Saved — "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION: Industry screening — Chemistry (fluid properties, mixture Eq 3.A.1, representative fluid)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/** Hydrocarbon-range fluids only — Representative fluid dropdown & NBP match (Industry screening library Fluid column). */
var M2_REP_FLUID_ONLY={"C5":1,"C6-C8":1,"C9-C12":1,"C13-C16":1,"C17-C25":1,"C25+":1};
function m2_isRepresentativeFluidChoice(name){var n=(name||"").trim();return n&&M2_REP_FLUID_ONLY[n];}
function m2_fluidName(row){return row?getRowProp(row,["Fluid","fluid","name","Name","fluid_name","acid_name","acid"])||"":""}
function m2_fluidMW(row){if(!row)return null;var k=["MW","mw","MolWt","MolecularWeight","Molecular_Weight","molecular_weight"];var v=numOrNull(getRowProp(row,k));if(v!=null)return v;if(row.values)return numOrNull(getRowProp(row.values,k));return null;}
function m2_fluidNBP(row){if(!row)return null;var k=["NBP","nbp","NBP_C","BoilPt_C","BoilPt","NormalBoilingPoint","boiling_point","BoilingPoint"];var v=numOrNull(getRowProp(row,k));if(v!=null)return v;if(row.values)return numOrNull(getRowProp(row.values,k));return null;}
function m2_fluidRho(row){if(!row)return null;var k=["Rho","rho","LiquidDensity","Density","density","rho_l","liquid_density"];var v=numOrNull(getRowProp(row,k));if(v!=null)return v;if(row.values)return numOrNull(getRowProp(row.values,k));return null;}
function m2_fluidViscosity(row){if(!row)return null;var k=["Viscosity_cP","Viscosity","viscosity_cp","viscosity","ViscosityCp","dynamic_viscosity_cp"];var v=numOrNull(getRowProp(row,k));if(v!=null)return v;if(row.values)return numOrNull(getRowProp(row.values,k));return null;}
function m2_fluidAIT(row){if(!row)return null;var k=["AIT","ait","AutoignitionTemperature","autoignition_temperature"];var v=numOrNull(getRowProp(row,k));if(v!=null)return v;if(row.values)return numOrNull(getRowProp(row.values,k));return null;}

function m2_popChemSelect(){
  if(typeof m2_renderChemTable==="function") m2_renderChemTable();
}
function m2_popToxSelect(){
  if(typeof m2_renderToxTable==="function") m2_renderToxTable();
}
function m2_toxOptionMarkup(selectedName){
  var html='<option value="">— select chemical —</option>';
  if(!REF.toxLib||!REF.toxLib.length)return html;
  REF.toxLib.forEach(function(f){
    var n=m2_fluidName(f); if(!n)return;
    html+='<option value="'+escHtml(n)+'"'+(selectedName===n?' selected':'')+'>'+escHtml(n)+'</option>';
  });
  return html;
}
function m2_ensureToxRow(){
  if(!m2_data)return;
  if(!m2_data.toxic_items||!m2_data.toxic_items.length)m2_data.toxic_items=[{fluid_name:"",percent_total:"",molecular_weight:null}];
}
function m2_toxMolePercentSum(){
  if(!m2_data||!m2_data.toxic_items)return 0;
  var t=0;
  m2_data.toxic_items.forEach(function(it){ t+=parseFloat(it.percent_total)||0; });
  return Math.round(t*100)/100;
}
function m2_updateToxMix(){
  if(!m2_data)return;
  var sum=m2_toxMolePercentSum();
  var sumLine=$("m2_toxMoleSumLine");
  if(sumLine){
    var hasFluid=m2_data.toxic_items.some(function(it){ return (it.fluid_name||"").trim(); });
    var hasAny=m2_data.toxic_items.some(function(it){ return (parseFloat(it.percent_total)||0)>0; });
    if(!hasFluid&&!hasAny){ sumLine.textContent="Mol % total: —"; sumLine.className="m2-comp-td-pct m2-mol-total-cell"; }
    else {
      sumLine.textContent="Mol % total: "+fmt(sum,2)+(Math.abs(sum-100)<0.05?" (≈100%)":"");
      sumLine.className="m2-comp-td-pct m2-mol-total-cell"+(Math.abs(sum-100)>=0.05?" warn":" ok");
    }
  }
  var pill=$("m2_toxSummaryPill");
  if(pill){
    var hf=m2_data.toxic_items.some(function(it){ return !!(it&&(it.fluid_name||"").trim()); });
    var hp=m2_data.toxic_items.some(function(it){ return (parseFloat(it.percent_total)||0)>0; });
    if(!hf&&!hp) pill.textContent="Toxic mixture — choose chemical & mole %";
    else if(hf&&hp) pill.textContent="Toxic mixture — active";
    else pill.textContent="Toxic mixture — enter mole %";
  }
  var mwPill=$("m2_toxMW");
  if(mwPill){
    var sX=0,sMW=0;
    m2_data.toxic_items.forEach(function(it){
      var pct=parseFloat(it.percent_total)||0; if(pct<=0)return;
      var x=pct/100;
      var f=(it.fluid_name&&REF.toxLib&&REF.toxLib.length)?findFluid(it.fluid_name,REF.toxLib):null;
      var mw=f?m2_fluidMW(f):null; if(mw==null)return;
      sX+=x; sMW+=x*mw;
    });
    if(sX>0) mwPill.textContent=fmt(sMW/sX,1)+" kg/kmol";
    else mwPill.textContent="—";
  }
}
function m2_renderToxTable(){
  var tb=$("m2_toxTbody"); if(!tb||!m2_data)return;
  m2_ensureToxRow();
  tb.innerHTML="";
  m2_data.toxic_items.forEach(function(it,idx){
    var fn=(it.fluid_name||"").trim();
    var pct=it.percent_total!=null?String(it.percent_total):"";
    var tr=document.createElement("tr");
    tr.className="m2-tox-data-row";
    tr.setAttribute("data-idx",String(idx));
    var delDis=m2_data.toxic_items.length<=1?' disabled':'';
    var disLib=!REF.toxLib||!REF.toxLib.length?' disabled':'';
    tr.innerHTML='<td class="m2-comp-td-num">'+(idx+1)+'</td>'+
      '<td><select class="m2-tox-select-fluid"'+disLib+' onchange="m2_toxChanged()">'+m2_toxOptionMarkup(fn)+'</select></td>'+
      '<td class="m2-comp-td-pct"><input class="m2-tox-input-pct" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.01" placeholder="e.g. 100" oninput="m2_toxChanged()" value="'+escHtml(pct)+'"/></td>'+
      '<td class="m2-comp-td-actions"><div class="m2-comp-actions-inner">'+
      '<button type="button" class="m2-icon-btn m2-add" onclick="m2_toxRowAdd('+idx+')" aria-label="Add line below">+</button>'+
      '<button type="button" class="m2-icon-btn m2-del" onclick="m2_toxRowDel('+idx+')" aria-label="Remove line"'+delDis+'>&#8722;</button>'+
      '</div></td>';
    tb.appendChild(tr);
  });
  m2_updateToxMix();
}
function m2_syncToxicFromInputs(){
  if(!m2_data)return;
  var tb=$("m2_toxTbody"); if(!tb)return;
  var rows=tb.querySelectorAll("tr.m2-tox-data-row");
  var next=[];
  for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    var tr=rows[i];
    var sel=tr.querySelector("select.m2-tox-select-fluid");
    var inp=tr.querySelector("input.m2-tox-input-pct");
    var fn=sel&&sel.value?sel.value.trim():"";
    var pct=inp&&inp.value?inp.value.trim():"";
    var f=fn&&REF.toxLib&&REF.toxLib.length?findFluid(fn,REF.toxLib):null;
    next.push({fluid_name:fn,percent_total:pct,molecular_weight:f?m2_fluidMW(f):null});
  }
  if(next.length)m2_data.toxic_items=next;
}
function m2_toxRowAdd(afterIdx){
  if(!m2_data)return;
  m2_syncToxicFromInputs();
  m2_data.toxic_items.splice(afterIdx+1,0,{fluid_name:"",percent_total:"",molecular_weight:null});
  m2_renderToxTable();
}
function m2_toxRowDel(idx){
  if(!m2_data||m2_data.toxic_items.length<=1)return;
  m2_syncToxicFromInputs();
  m2_data.toxic_items.splice(idx,1);
  m2_renderToxTable();
}
function m2_toxChanged(){ m2_syncToxicFromInputs(); m2_updateToxMix(); }

function m2_otherOptionMarkup(selectedName){
  var html='<option value="">— select chemical —</option>';
  var seen={}, sel=(selectedName||"").trim();
  if(REF.otherLib&&REF.otherLib.length){
    REF.otherLib.forEach(function(f){
      var n=m2_fluidName(f); if(!n||seen[n])return; seen[n]=1;
      html+='<option value="'+escHtml(n)+'"'+(sel===n?' selected':'')+'>'+escHtml(n)+'</option>';
    });
  }
  if(sel && !seen[sel]){
    html+='<option value="'+escHtml(sel)+'" selected>'+escHtml(sel)+' (custom)</option>';
  }
  return html;
}

    }
  }

  if(pill){
    var hf=m2_data.other_items.some(function(it){ return !!(((it.fluid_name||"").trim())||((it.substance_name||"").trim())); });

      var fn=((it.fluid_name||it.substance_name)||"").trim();

}

  var rows=tb.querySelectorAll("tr.m2-chem-data-row");
  var next=[];
  for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    var tr=rows[i];
    var sel=tr.querySelector("select.m2-comp-select-fluid");
    var inp=tr.querySelector("input.m2-comp-input-pct");
    var fn=sel&&sel.value?sel.value.trim():"";
    var pct=inp&&inp.value?inp.value.trim():"";
    var f=fn&&REF.chemLib&&REF.chemLib.length?findFluid(fn,REF.chemLib):null;
    next.push({fluid_library_selection:{name:fn,values:f||null},percent_total:pct});
  }
  if(next.length)m2_data.chemistry=next;
}

function m2_popRepDropdown(){
  var sel=$("m2_repSelect"); if(!sel)return;
  sel.innerHTML='<option value="">— select —</option>';
  if(!REF.chemLib.length){
    sel.disabled=true;
    var hint=$("m2_repHint"); if(hint) hint.textContent="Load chemical library in M0 to choose representative fluid";
    return;
  }
  REF.chemLib.forEach(function(f){
    var n=m2_fluidName(f); if(!n||!m2_isRepresentativeFluidChoice(n))return;
    var nbp=m2_fluidNBP(f), mw=m2_fluidMW(f), rho=m2_fluidRho(f), vis=m2_fluidViscosity(f);
    var parts=[]; if(nbp!=null)parts.push("NBP "+fmt(nbp)+"°C"); if(mw!=null)parts.push("MW "+fmt(mw,1)); if(rho!=null)parts.push("ρ "+fmt(rho,1)); if(vis!=null)parts.push("μ "+fmt(vis,2)+" cP");
    var label=parts.length?n+" — "+parts.join(", "):n;
    var o=document.createElement("option");o.value=n;o.textContent=label;sel.appendChild(o);
  });
  if(sel.options.length<=1){
    sel.disabled=true;
    if(m2_data) m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid=null;
    var hint2=$("m2_repHint"); if(hint2) hint2.textContent="M0 chemical library has no API 581 representative hydrocarbon cuts (C5 … C25+).";
    return;
  }
  sel.disabled=false;
  if(m2_data&&m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid){
    var v=m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid.trim();
    if(v){
      var ok=false; for(var i=0;i<sel.options.length;i++){ if(sel.options[i].value===v){ ok=true; break; } }
      if(ok) sel.value=v;
      else { m2_data.suggested_representative_fluid=null; sel.value=""; }
    }
  }
}

}
function m2_updateRepHint(){
  var hint=$("m2_repHint"); if(!hint)return;
  if(!REF.chemLib.length){hint.textContent="Load chemical library in M0 to choose representative fluid";return;}
  hint.textContent="Select a representative fluid from the M0 chemical library.";
}
function m2_chemChanged(){ m2_syncChemistryFromInputs(); m2_updateMix(); }

function m2_molePercentSum(){
  if(!m2_data||!m2_data.chemistry)return 0;
  var t=0;
  m2_data.chemistry.forEach(function(it){ t+=parseFloat(it.percent_total)||0; });
  return Math.round(t*100)/100;
}

function m2_calcMixProps(){
  if(!m2_data)return;
  var items=m2_data.chemistry, sX=0, sNBP=0, sMW=0, sRho=0, hasNBP=false, hasMW=false, hasRho=false;
  items.forEach(function(it){
    var pct=parseFloat(it.percent_total)||0; if(pct<=0)return;
    var x=pct/100; sX+=x;
    var vals=it.fluid_library_selection?it.fluid_library_selection.values:null; if(!vals)return;
    var nbp=m2_fluidNBP(vals); if(nbp!=null){sNBP+=x*nbp;hasNBP=true;}
    var mw=m2_fluidMW(vals); if(mw!=null){sMW+=x*mw;hasMW=true;}
    var rho=m2_fluidRho(vals); if(rho!=null){sRho+=x*rho;hasRho=true;}
  });
  if(sX>0){var n=1/sX;m2_data.mixture_properties={nbp_mix_c:hasNBP?Math.round(sNBP*n*100)/100:null,mw_mix_kg_kmol:hasMW?Math.round(sMW*n*100)/100:null,rho_mix_kg_m3:hasRho?Math.round(sRho*n*100)/100:null};}
  else{m2_data.mixture_properties={nbp_mix_c:null,mw_mix_kg_kmol:null,rho_mix_kg_m3:null};}
}
function m2_updateMix(){
  m2_calcMixProps(); if(!m2_data)return;
  var mp=m2_data.mixture_properties;
  var mixNbp=$("m2_mixNBP"); if(mixNbp) mixNbp.textContent=mp.nbp_mix_c!=null?fmt(mp.nbp_mix_c):"\u2014";
  var mixMw=$("m2_mixMW"); if(mixMw) mixMw.textContent=mp.mw_mix_kg_kmol!=null?fmt(mp.mw_mix_kg_kmol):"\u2014";
  var mixRho=$("m2_mixRho"); if(mixRho) mixRho.textContent=mp.rho_mix_kg_m3!=null?fmt(mp.rho_mix_kg_m3):"\u2014";
  var sumLine=$("m2_moleSumLine");
  if(sumLine){
    var hasFluid=m2_data.chemistry.some(function(it){ return it&&it.fluid_library_selection&&(it.fluid_library_selection.name||"").trim(); });
    var hasAny=m2_data.chemistry.some(function(it){ return (parseFloat(it.percent_total)||0)>0; });
    var sum=m2_molePercentSum();
    sumLine.className="m2-comp-td-pct m2-mol-total-cell";
    if(!hasFluid&&!hasAny){ sumLine.textContent="Mol % total: —"; }
    else {
      sumLine.textContent="Mol % total: "+fmt(sum,2)+(Math.abs(sum-100)<0.05?" (≈100%)":"");
      sumLine.className+=" "+(Math.abs(sum-100)>=0.05?"warn":"ok");
    }
  }
  var pill=$("m2_mixSummaryPill");
  if(pill){
    var hf=m2_data.chemistry.some(function(it){ return !!(it&&it.fluid_library_selection&&(it.fluid_library_selection.name||"").trim()); });
    var hp=m2_data.chemistry.some(function(it){ return (parseFloat(it.percent_total)||0)>0; });
    if(!hf&&!hp) pill.textContent="Mixture — choose chemical & mole %";
    else pill.textContent=mp.nbp_mix_c!=null?"Mixture — active":"Mixture — enter mole %";
  }
  m2_updateRepHint();
}

function m2_saveSelOther(){ m2_syncOtherFromInputs(); }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 4 — RELEASE RATE ESTIMATION

var m3_data=null;
/** Reference atmosphere (MPa absolute) added to M1 gauge storage pressure for Industry screening Part 3 §4.3 P_s (psia basis). */
var M3_PATM_REF_MPA = 0.101325;

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION: PCC-3 §6, Appendix B — Damage mechanism screening (M3)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry(){
  var g={diameter_m:null,shell_height_m:null,max_fill_pct:100,max_controlled_filling_height_m:null,shell_courses:1,course_bottom_elevations_m:null,dike_m3:null};
  if(typeof m2_numFromM1Input==="function"){
    var dm=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_diamM"); if(dm!=null) g.diameter_m=dm;
    var hm=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_heightM"); if(hm!=null) g.shell_height_m=hm;
    var sc=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_shellCourses"); if(sc!=null&&sc>=1) g.shell_courses=sc;
    var mf=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_maxFillPct"); if(mf==null) mf=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_liqLevel");
    if(mf!=null) g.max_fill_pct=Math.min(Math.max(mf,0),100);
    var mfh=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_maxFillHeightM"); if(mfh!=null&&mfh>0) g.max_controlled_filling_height_m=mfh;
    var dk=m2_numFromM1Input("m1_dikeCapM3"); if(dk!=null) g.dike_m3=dk;
  }
  if(activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset){
    var m1=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset, td=m1.tank_data||{}, ab=td.assessment_basis||{}, oc=m1.operating_conditions||{};
    if(g.diameter_m==null&&td.inside_diameter_m!=null) g.diameter_m=Number(td.inside_diameter_m);
    if(g.shell_height_m==null&&td.shell_height_m!=null) g.shell_height_m=Number(td.shell_height_m);
    if(g.shell_courses===1&&ab.shell_courses!=null) g.shell_courses=parseInt(ab.shell_courses,10)||1;
    if(g.max_fill_pct===100){
      var mf2=ab.max_fill_level_pct!=null?Number(ab.max_fill_level_pct):(oc.vessel_liquid_level_pct!=null?Number(oc.vessel_liquid_level_pct):100);
      if(Number.isFinite(mf2)) g.max_fill_pct=Math.min(Math.max(mf2,0),100);
    }
    if(g.max_controlled_filling_height_m==null&&ab.max_controlled_filling_height_m!=null){
      var mfh2=Number(ab.max_controlled_filling_height_m);
      if(Number.isFinite(mfh2)&&mfh2>0) g.max_controlled_filling_height_m=mfh2;
    }
    if(g.dike_m3==null&&ab.dike_capacity_m3!=null) g.dike_m3=Number(ab.dike_capacity_m3);
  }
  var cdBottoms=typeof m1_getShellCourseBottomElevationsFromComponentDesign==="function"?m1_getShellCourseBottomElevationsFromComponentDesign():null;
  if(cdBottoms&&cdBottoms.some(function(h){return h!=null&&Number.isFinite(h);})){
    g.course_bottom_elevations_m=cdBottoms;
  }
  return g;
}
/** Elevation H₀ of bottom of course i (m above tank bottom) — M1 Component design only; no estimate if blank. */
function m3_getCourseElevationM(courseIndex,geom){
  if(!Number.isFinite(courseIndex)||courseIndex<1) return null;
  if(!geom) geom=m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry();
  var elev=typeof m1_getShellCourseBottomElevationM==="function"?m1_getShellCourseBottomElevationM(courseIndex):null;
  if(elev!=null&&Number.isFinite(elev)&&elev>=0) return elev;
  return null;
}
/** API 581 h_liq — explicit M1 height, else shell height × max fill %. */
function m3_resolveMaxFillHeightM(geom){
  if(!geom) geom=m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry();
  if(geom.max_controlled_filling_height_m!=null&&Number.isFinite(geom.max_controlled_filling_height_m)&&geom.max_controlled_filling_height_m>0)
    return geom.max_controlled_filling_height_m;
  if(geom.shell_height_m!=null&&Number.isFinite(geom.shell_height_m)&&geom.shell_height_m>0){
    var fillFrac=(Number.isFinite(geom.max_fill_pct)&&geom.max_fill_pct>0)?Math.min(geom.max_fill_pct,100)/100:1;
    return geom.shell_height_m*fillFrac;
  }
  return null;
}
function m3_calcInventoryAboveElevationL(diamM,shellHeightM,fillPct,elevM,fillHeightM){
  if(!Number.isFinite(diamM)||diamM<=0)return null;
  var liquidSurfaceM=null;
  if(Number.isFinite(fillHeightM)&&fillHeightM>0) liquidSurfaceM=fillHeightM;
  else if(Number.isFinite(shellHeightM)&&shellHeightM>0){
    var fillFrac=(Number.isFinite(fillPct)&&fillPct>0)?Math.min(fillPct,100)/100:1;
    liquidSurfaceM=shellHeightM*fillFrac;
  }
  if(liquidSurfaceM==null) return null;
  var elev=Number.isFinite(elevM)?elevM:0;
  var hAbove=Math.max(0,liquidSurfaceM-elev);
  var r=diamM/2;
  return Math.PI*r*r*hAbove*1000;
}
function m3_defaultCourseElevationM(courseIndex,nCourses,shellHeightM){
  return m3_getCourseElevationM(courseIndex, typeof m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry==="function"?m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry():null);
}
function m3_defaultLiquidHeadAboveCourseM(courseIndex,nCourses,shellHeightM,maxFillPct){
  if(!Number.isFinite(courseIndex)||courseIndex<1) courseIndex=1;
  var geom=m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry();
  if(!Number.isFinite(nCourses)||nCourses<1) nCourses=geom.shell_courses||1;
  if(!Number.isFinite(shellHeightM)||shellHeightM<=0) shellHeightM=geom.shell_height_m;
  var liquidHm=m3_resolveMaxFillHeightM(geom);
  if(liquidHm==null){
    if(!Number.isFinite(shellHeightM)||shellHeightM<=0) return null;
    var fillFrac=(Number.isFinite(maxFillPct)&&maxFillPct>0)?Math.min(maxFillPct,100)/100:(geom.max_fill_pct/100);
    liquidHm=shellHeightM*fillFrac;
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(liquidHm)) return null;
  var elev=m3_getCourseElevationM(courseIndex,geom);
  if(elev==null||!Number.isFinite(elev)) return null;
  var H=liquidHm-elev;
  return H>0?H:null;
}
function m3_getShellCourseReleaseOptions(){
  var out=[], geom=m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry();
  if(geom.shell_height_m&&geom.diameter_m){
    var i;
    for(i=1;i<=geom.shell_courses;i++){
      var elev=m3_defaultCourseElevationM(i,geom.shell_courses,geom.shell_height_m);
      var liqH=m3_defaultLiquidHeadAboveCourseM(i,geom.shell_courses,geom.shell_height_m,geom.max_fill_pct);
      var lbl="Shell Course "+i;
      if(liqH!=null) lbl+=" — LHT="+liqH.toFixed(2)+" m";
      else if(elev==null) lbl+=" — enter Course bottom (m) in M1";
      else lbl+=" — LHT n/a";
      out.push({id:"course_"+i,course_index:i,elevation_m:elev,liquid_head_m:liqH,label:lbl});
    }
  }
  return out;
}
function m3_getReleaseCourseContext(componentId){
  var geom=m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry(), opts=m3_getShellCourseReleaseOptions(), row=null;
  if(componentId){ for(var i=0;i<opts.length;i++){ if(opts[i].id===componentId){ row=opts[i]; break; } } }
  if(!row&&opts.length) row=opts[0];
  if(!row) return {component_id:null,course_index:null,elevation_m:null,liquid_head_m:null,inventory_l:null,dike_m3:geom.dike_m3};
  var elev=row.elevation_m, head=row.liquid_head_m;
  var hliq=m3_resolveMaxFillHeightM(geom);
  var inv=(elev!=null&&geom.diameter_m&&geom.shell_height_m)?m3_calcInventoryAboveElevationL(geom.diameter_m,geom.shell_height_m,geom.max_fill_pct,elev,hliq):null;
  return {component_id:row.id,course_index:row.course_index,elevation_m:elev,liquid_head_m:head,inventory_l:inv,dike_m3:geom.dike_m3};
}
function m3_getReleaseFluidRho(){
  if(typeof m2_data!=="undefined"&&m2_data){
    m2_ensureStoredProductShape(m2_data);
    var sl=m2_data.stored_liquid||{}, sp=m2_data.stored_product||{};
    if(sl.liquid_density_kg_m3!=null&&Number.isFinite(Number(sl.liquid_density_kg_m3))) return Number(sl.liquid_density_kg_m3);
    if(sp.liquid_density_kg_m3!=null&&Number.isFinite(Number(sp.liquid_density_kg_m3))) return Number(sp.liquid_density_kg_m3);
  }
  if(m3_data&&m3_data.representative_fluid&&m3_data.representative_fluid.selected_values) return m2_fluidRho(m3_data.representative_fluid.selected_values);
  return null;
}
function m3_getEffectiveReleaseVolumeL(data){
  if(!data) return null;
  if(data.inventory_above_release_l!=null&&Number.isFinite(Number(data.inventory_above_release_l))) return Number(data.inventory_above_release_l);
  if(data.vessel_volume_l!=null&&Number.isFinite(Number(data.vessel_volume_l))) return Number(data.vessel_volume_l);
  return null;
}
function m3_popReleaseCourseSelect(){
  var sel=$("m3_releaseCourse"); if(!sel)return;
  var opts=m3_getShellCourseReleaseOptions();
  sel.innerHTML="";
  if(!opts.length){ sel.innerHTML='<option value="">&#8212; Complete M1 tank geometry &#8212;</option>'; return; }
  opts.forEach(function(o){ var opt=document.createElement("option"); opt.value=o.id; opt.textContent=o.label; sel.appendChild(opt); });
  var saved=m3_data&&m3_data.release_tank_component_id?m3_data.release_tank_component_id:null;
  if(saved&&sel.querySelector('option[value="'+saved+'"]')) sel.value=saved;
  else if(m3_data&&m3_data.release_course_index!=null) sel.value="course_"+m3_data.release_course_index;
}
function m3_releaseCourseChanged(){
  var sel=$("m3_releaseCourse"); if(!sel)return;
  var ctx=m3_getReleaseCourseContext(sel.value);
  var headEl=$("m3_hydroHeadM"), invEl=$("m3_invAboveL"), dpEl=$("m3_hydroDPkPa"), volEl=$("m3_volumeL");
  if(headEl) headEl.value=ctx.liquid_head_m!=null?ctx.liquid_head_m.toFixed(3):"";
  if(invEl) invEl.value=ctx.inventory_l!=null?Math.round(ctx.inventory_l):"";
  if(volEl&&ctx.inventory_l!=null) volEl.value=Math.round(ctx.inventory_l*10)/10;
  var rho=m3_getReleaseFluidRho();
  if(dpEl){
    var dPkPa=(ctx.liquid_head_m!=null&&rho!=null&&rho>0)?(rho*9.80665*ctx.liquid_head_m/1000):null;
    dpEl.value=dPkPa!=null?dPkPa.toFixed(2):"";
  }
  if(m3_data){
    m3_data.release_tank_component_id=ctx.component_id;
    m3_data.release_course_index=ctx.course_index;
    m3_data.hydrostatic_head_m=ctx.liquid_head_m;
    m3_data.inventory_above_release_l=ctx.inventory_l;
    m3_data.vessel_volume_l=ctx.inventory_l;
    if(ctx.inventory_l!=null&&rho!=null&&rho>0) m3_data.inventory_mass_kg=(ctx.inventory_l/1000)*rho;
  }
}
function m3_applyTankReleaseUI(){
  m3_popReleaseCourseSelect();
  m3_releaseCourseChanged();
  m3_phaseChanged();
}

  return {scenario_name:"",representative_fluid:{selected_name:null,selected_values:null},
    phase:"liquid",storage_pressure_mpa:null,storage_pressure_abs_mpa:null,storage_pressure_source:"operating",back_pressure_mpa:0.101325,
    storage_temperature_c:null,storage_temperature_source:"operating",discharge_coefficient:0.61,k_ratio:1.3,
    release_tank_component_id:null,release_course_index:null,hydrostatic_head_m:null,inventory_above_release_l:null,inventory_mass_kg:null,
    vessel_volume_l:null,holes:[],selected_hole_for_damage:null,specialist_engineering_assessment:"",notes:""};
}

function m3_load() {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  var s = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi, m2 = m2_data || s.module2_chemistry;
  if (m2) {
    $("m3_m2name").value = m2.chemistry_name||"";
    $("m3_warnM2").style.display = "none";
  } else { $("m3_warnM2").style.display = "block"; }
  if (typeof m4_syncHeaderChemistryFromM2Dom === "function") m4_syncHeaderChemistryFromM2Dom();
  m3_data = s.module4_release ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.module4_release)) : m3_blank();
  if(m3_data.storage_pressure_abs_mpa==null&&m3_data.storage_pressure_mpa!=null&&Number.isFinite(parseFloat(m3_data.storage_pressure_mpa)))
    m3_data.storage_pressure_abs_mpa=parseFloat(m3_data.storage_pressure_mpa)+M3_PATM_REF_MPA;
  $("m3_scenario").value = m3_data.scenario_name||"";
  $("m3_phase").value = m3_data.phase||"liquid";
  var dmSel=$("m3_dispersionMethod"); if(dmSel){var dm=osrDispersionMethodFromSource(); dmSel.value=(dm==="screening_default"?dm:"screening_default");}
  m3_popPressureSelect(m2);
  var src=m3_data.storage_pressure_source||"operating";
  var sel=$("m3_P1"); var opt=sel.querySelector('option[value="'+src+'"]'); if(opt)opt.selected=true; else if(sel.options.length)sel.selectedIndex=0;
  $("m3_P2").value = m3_data.back_pressure_mpa!=null?m3_data.back_pressure_mpa:"0.101325";
  m3_popTemperatureSelect(m2);
  var tSrc=m3_data.storage_temperature_source||"operating";
  var tSel=$("m3_T"); var tOpt=tSel.querySelector('option[value="'+tSrc+'"]'); if(tOpt)tOpt.selected=true; else if(tSel.options.length)tSel.selectedIndex=0;
  $("m3_Cd").value = m3_data.discharge_coefficient!=null?m3_data.discharge_coefficient:"0.61";
  $("m3_k").value = m3_data.k_ratio!=null?m3_data.k_ratio:"1.3";
  m3_applyTankReleaseUI();
  if(m3_data.release_tank_component_id){
    var rcs=$("m3_releaseCourse"); if(rcs) rcs.value=m3_data.release_tank_component_id;
    m3_releaseCourseChanged();
  }
  if(REF.chemLib.length){
    m3_popFluidSelect();
    var inh = m2 && m2.suggested_representative_fluid ? String(m2.suggested_representative_fluid).trim() : "";
    if(inh&&!$("m3_fluidSel").value){$("m3_fluidSel").value=inh;m3_fluidChanged();}
  }
  if(m3_data.representative_fluid&&m3_data.representative_fluid.selected_name){
    $("m3_fluidSel").value=m3_data.representative_fluid.selected_name;
    m3_updateFluidPills(m3_data.representative_fluid.selected_values);
  }
  if(m3_data.holes&&m3_data.holes.length){m3_renderResults();}
  if($("m3_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m3_notes", m3_data.notes || "");
  if($("m3_sea_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m3_sea_notes", m3_data.specialist_engineering_assessment || "");
  $("m3_status").textContent = "Loaded";
  if(typeof m4_syncInheritedFromM4Release==="function") m4_syncInheritedFromM4Release();
}
function m3_renderDamageMechs(){
  var el=$("m3_damageMechList"); if(!el)return;
  var m3Damage=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage:null;
  var ids=m3Damage&&m3Damage.selected_mechanisms?m3Damage.selected_mechanisms:[];
  if(!ids.length){el.textContent="None selected. Complete M3 to select damage mechanisms.";el.className="hint";el.style.padding="6px 0";return;}
  var rows=[];
  ids.forEach(function(id){
    var def=m5_defsMap[id]||m5_lookupDef(id,"");
    var name=def?m5_fName(def):id;
    var insp=def?(def.inspection_methods||def.inspection||[]):[];
    var inspTxt=Array.isArray(insp)&&insp.length?insp.join("; "):"";
    rows.push({name:name,insp:inspTxt});
  });
  el.innerHTML=rows.map(function(r){
    var h='<div style="padding:4px 0;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)">';
    h+='<div style="font-weight:600">'+r.name+'</div>';
    if(r.insp) h+='<div class="hint" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:2px">&#128269; PCC-3 inspection: '+r.insp+'</div>';
    h+='</div>';
    return h;
  }).join("");
  el.className=""; el.style.padding="6px 0";
}

function m3_save() {
  if (!activeAsset||!m3_data) return;
  m3_syncDomToData();
  if(typeof m3_tryCalculateHoles==="function")m3_tryCalculateHoles(true);
  var m3NotesEl = $("m3_notes"); m3_data.notes = m3NotesEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m3_notes") : "";
  var m3SeaEl = $("m3_sea_notes"); m3_data.specialist_engineering_assessment = m3SeaEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m3_sea_notes") : "";
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m3_data));
  setModuleStatus(4,"complete"); auditLog(4,"saved");
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  $("m3_status").textContent = "Saved — "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
  if(typeof m4_syncInheritedFromM4Release==="function")try{m4_syncInheritedFromM4Release();}catch(eM4s){}
  if(typeof m4_syncFlammableToPhase==="function")try{m4_syncFlammableToPhase();}catch(eM5f){}
  if(typeof m4_maybeAutoBuildModels==="function")try{m4_maybeAutoBuildModels(true);}catch(eM5b){}
  if(typeof m4_updateReleaseRateWarnings==="function")try{m4_updateReleaseRateWarnings();}catch(eM5w){}
}

function m3_getStorageTemperatureC(){
  var src=$("m3_T").value;
  var s=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
  var m2=m2_data||(s?s.module2_chemistry:null);
  var eff = typeof osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating === "function" ? osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating() : null;
  var dc = eff && eff.design_conditions ? eff.design_conditions : {};
  var oc = eff && eff.operating_conditions ? eff.operating_conditions : {};
  if (!eff && s) {
    var m1=s.module1_asset;
    dc=m1&&m1.design_conditions?m1.design_conditions:{};
    oc=m1&&m1.operating_conditions?m1.operating_conditions:{};
  }
  if(src==="operating")return oc.operating_temperature_c!=null?parseFloat(oc.operating_temperature_c):(m2&&m2.operating_temperature_c!=null?parseFloat(m2.operating_temperature_c):null);
  if(src==="design")return dc.design_temperature_c!=null?parseFloat(dc.design_temperature_c):null;
  return null;
}

function m3_getStoragePressureMPa(){
  var src=$("m3_P1").value;
  var s=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
  var m2=m2_data||(s?s.module2_chemistry:null);
  var eff = typeof osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating === "function" ? osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating() : null;
  var dc = eff && eff.design_conditions ? eff.design_conditions : {};
  var oc = eff && eff.operating_conditions ? eff.operating_conditions : {};
  if (!eff && s) {
    var m1=s.module1_asset;
    dc=m1&&m1.design_conditions?m1.design_conditions:{};
    oc=m1&&m1.operating_conditions?m1.operating_conditions:{};
  }
  if(src==="operating")return oc.operating_pressure_mpa!=null?parseFloat(oc.operating_pressure_mpa):(m2&&m2.design_pressure_mpa!=null?parseFloat(m2.design_pressure_mpa):null);
  if(src==="design")return dc.design_pressure_mpa!=null?parseFloat(dc.design_pressure_mpa):null;
  return null;
}
/** Industry screening Part 3 §4.3: P_s in absolute MPa — M1 design/operating are gauge; add reference atmosphere (not downstream back pressure). */
function m3_getStoragePressureAbsoluteMPa(){
  var g=m3_getStoragePressureMPa();
  if(g==null||!Number.isFinite(g))return null;
  return g+M3_PATM_REF_MPA;
}

    m3_releaseCourseChanged();

  }
}

  $("m3_gasFields").style.display="none";
  $("m3_equation").value="Eq. (5.5): W = C32 * Cd * An * sqrt(2 * rho * g * LHTabove,i)";
