  if(typeof m4_syncFlammableToPhase==="function") m4_syncFlammableToPhase();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION: Industry screening / PCC-3 §8 — Release (orifice flow, standard hole sizes, Inst/Cont)
   Hole sizes aligned with GFF by hole size (Small, Medium, Large, Rupture).
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var M3_HOLES = [
  {name:"Small",  dia_mm:6.25,  label:"6.25 mm"},
  {name:"Medium", dia_mm:25,    label:"25 mm"},
  {name:"Large",  dia_mm:100,   label:"100 mm"},
  {name:"Rupture",dia_mm:150,   label:"150 mm"}
];

function m3_liquidQ(Cd,A,rho,dP_Pa){
  if(rho<=0||dP_Pa<=0)return 0;
  return Cd*A*Math.sqrt(2*rho*dP_Pa);
}

function m3_gasQ(Cd,A,P1_Pa,P2_Pa,T_K,k,MW){
  if(P1_Pa<=0||T_K<=0||MW<=0||k<=0)return 0;
  var R=8314; var pr=P2_Pa/P1_Pa; var pc=Math.pow(2/(k+1),k/(k-1));
  if(pr<=pc){
    return Cd*A*P1_Pa*Math.sqrt(MW/(R*T_K)*k*Math.pow(2/(k+1),(k+1)/(k-1)));
  } else {
    return Cd*A*P1_Pa*Math.sqrt(2*MW/(R*T_K)*(k/(k-1))*(Math.pow(pr,2/k)-Math.pow(pr,(k+1)/k)));
  }
}

function m3_syncDomToData(){
  if(!m3_data)return;
  var scen=$("m3_scenario"); if(scen)m3_data.scenario_name=scen.value.trim();
  var ph=$("m3_phase"); if(ph)m3_data.phase=ph.value;
  var p1=$("m3_P1"); if(p1)m3_data.storage_pressure_source=p1.value||"operating";
  var pg=m3_getStoragePressureMPa();
  m3_data.storage_pressure_mpa=pg;
  m3_data.storage_pressure_abs_mpa=(pg!=null&&Number.isFinite(pg))?pg+M3_PATM_REF_MPA:null;
  var p2=$("m3_P2"); m3_data.back_pressure_mpa=p2?numOrNull(p2.value):m3_data.back_pressure_mpa;
  var tsel=$("m3_T"); if(tsel)m3_data.storage_temperature_source=tsel.value||"operating";
  m3_data.storage_temperature_c=m3_getStorageTemperatureC();
  var cd=$("m3_Cd");   m3_data.discharge_coefficient=cd?numOrNull(cd.value):m3_data.discharge_coefficient;
  m3_data.vessel_volume_l=typeof m3_getEffectiveReleaseVolumeL==="function"?m3_getEffectiveReleaseVolumeL(m3_data):null;
  var rcs=$("m3_releaseCourse");
  if(rcs&&rcs.value){
    m3_data.release_tank_component_id=rcs.value;
    m3_data.release_course_index=parseInt(String(rcs.value).replace("course_",""),10)||null;
  }
  m3_data.hydrostatic_head_m=numOrNull($("m3_hydroHeadM")?$("m3_hydroHeadM").value:null);
  m3_data.inventory_above_release_l=numOrNull($("m3_invAboveL")?$("m3_invAboveL").value:null);
  if(m3_data.inventory_above_release_l!=null) m3_data.vessel_volume_l=m3_data.inventory_above_release_l;
  var rhoSync=m3_getReleaseFluidRho();
  if(m3_data.inventory_above_release_l!=null&&rhoSync!=null&&rhoSync>0) m3_data.inventory_mass_kg=(m3_data.inventory_above_release_l/1000)*rhoSync;
  var kEl=$("m3_k"); m3_data.k_ratio=kEl?numOrNull(kEl.value):m3_data.k_ratio;
  var fluidSel=$("m3_fluidSel");
  if(fluidSel&&fluidSel.value&&REF.chemLib&&REF.chemLib.length){
    var row=REF.chemLib.find(function(r){return getRowProp(r,["Fluid","fluid","name"])===fluidSel.value;});
    if(row)m3_data.representative_fluid={selected_name:fluidSel.value,selected_values:row};
  }
}
/** @returns {boolean} true if hole release rates were computed */
function m3_tryCalculateHoles(silent){
  if(!m3_data)return false;
  m3_syncDomToData();
  m3_releaseCourseChanged();
  var relCtx=m3_getReleaseCourseContext($("m3_releaseCourse")?$("m3_releaseCourse").value:null);
  var H=relCtx.liquid_head_m;
  if(H==null||H<=0){if(!silent)alert("Select a shell course with valid liquid head — complete M1 inside diameter, maximum controlled filling height (or max fill %), and Course bottom (m) for that shell course in Component design.");return false;}
  var rho=m3_getReleaseFluidRho();
  if(!rho){if(!silent)alert("Liquid density required — complete M2 Stored product properties or select representative fluid.");return false;}
  var Cd=m3_data.discharge_coefficient!=null?m3_data.discharge_coefficient:(numOrNull($("m3_Cd")?$("m3_Cd").value:null)||0.61);
  var dP_Pa=rho*9.80665*H;
  m3_data.phase="liquid";
  m3_data.hydrostatic_head_m=H;
  m3_data.inventory_above_release_l=relCtx.inventory_l;
  m3_data.release_tank_component_id=relCtx.component_id;
  m3_data.release_course_index=relCtx.course_index;
  if(relCtx.inventory_l!=null){
    m3_data.vessel_volume_l=relCtx.inventory_l;
    m3_data.inventory_mass_kg=(relCtx.inventory_l/1000)*rho;
  }
  m3_data.storage_pressure_mpa=dP_Pa/1e6;
  m3_data.storage_pressure_abs_mpa=null;
  m3_data.back_pressure_mpa=M3_PATM_REF_MPA;
  m3_data.holes=[];
  M3_HOLES.forEach(function(h){
    var A=Math.PI*Math.pow(h.dia_mm/1000/2,2);
    var Q=m3_liquidQ(Cd,A,rho,dP_Pa);
    m3_data.holes.push({hole_name:h.name,hole_label:h.label,diameter_mm:h.dia_mm,area_m2:A,release_rate_kg_s:Q,liquid_head_m:H,inventory_l:relCtx.inventory_l});
  });
  if(!m3_data.selected_hole_for_damage&&m3_data.holes.length) m3_data.selected_hole_for_damage=m3_data.holes[0].hole_name;
  if(!silent)m3_renderResults();
  return true;
}
function m3_calculate(){
  if(!m3_data)return;
  if(m3_tryCalculateHoles(false))m3_renderResults();
}
function m3_holesHaveReleaseRates(holes){
  return !!(holes&&holes.length&&holes.some(function(h){return(h.release_rate_kg_s||0)>0;}));
}
/** Release holes for M5 — live M4 calc, saved M4, or recalculate from inputs. */
function m4_getReleaseHolesForConsequence(){
  var fallback=function(){return M3_HOLES.map(function(h){return{hole_name:h.name,hole_label:h.label,diameter_mm:h.dia_mm,release_rate_kg_s:0};});};
  if(!activeAsset||!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi)return fallback();
  if(typeof m3_data==="undefined"||!m3_data){
    var saved0=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release;
    if(saved0)m3_data=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(saved0));
  }
  if(m3_data&&m3_holesHaveReleaseRates(m3_data.holes))return m3_data.holes;
  var saved=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release;
  if(saved&&m3_holesHaveReleaseRates(saved.holes))return saved.holes;
  if(typeof m3_tryCalculateHoles==="function"&&m3_data&&m3_tryCalculateHoles(true)&&m3_holesHaveReleaseRates(m3_data.holes)){
    activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m3_data));
    return m3_data.holes;
  }
  if(saved&&saved.holes&&saved.holes.length)return saved.holes;
  if(m3_data&&m3_data.holes&&m3_data.holes.length)return m3_data.holes;
  return fallback();
}
function m4_updateReleaseRateWarnings(){
  var warnM4=$("m4_warnM3"), warnZero=$("m4_warnZeroRates");
  if(!activeAsset){if(warnM4)warnM4.style.display="block";if(warnZero)warnZero.style.display="none";return;}
  var saved=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release;
  var holes=m4_getReleaseHolesForConsequence();
  var hasRates=m3_holesHaveReleaseRates(holes);
  if(warnM4)warnM4.style.display=!saved?"block":"none";
  if(warnZero)warnZero.style.display=!hasRates?"block":"none";
}

function m3_renderResults(){
  if(!m3_data||!m3_data.holes||!m3_data.holes.length){$("m3_results").innerHTML='<div class="hint">No results</div>';return;}
  var m2=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry:null;
  var holeName=m3_data.selected_hole_for_damage||(m3_data.holes[0]?m3_data.holes[0].hole_name:null);
  var volEff=typeof m3_getEffectiveReleaseVolumeL==="function"?m3_getEffectiveReleaseVolumeL(m3_data):null;
  var capacityL=volEff!=null?volEff:(m3_data.inventory_above_release_l!=null?parseFloat(m3_data.inventory_above_release_l):(m3_data.vessel_volume_l!=null?parseFloat(m3_data.vessel_volume_l):null));
  var rho=m3_getReleaseFluidRho();
  if(!rho&&m3_data.representative_fluid&&m3_data.representative_fluid.selected_values) rho=m2_fluidRho(m3_data.representative_fluid.selected_values);
  var fullMassKg=m3_data.inventory_mass_kg!=null?m3_data.inventory_mass_kg:(capacityL!=null&&rho!=null&&rho>0?(capacityL/1000)*rho:null);
  var dispMethod=osrDispersionMethodFromSource();
  var dispSel=$("m3_dispersionMethod"); if(dispSel)dispSel.value=dispMethod;
  var showScreeningCol=(dispMethod==="screening_default"||dispMethod==="both"||dispMethod==="pcc3");
  var html='<div class="hint" style="margin-bottom:8px">PCC-3: time-to-empty (&lt;2 min=Inst, 2–10 min=Trans, &#8805;10 min=Cont). Industry screening: hole &#8804;6.25 mm=Cont; else 4536 kg in &#8805;180 s OR mass&gt;4536 kg emptied in &#8804;180 s=Inst.</div>';
  html+='<div class="hint" style="margin-bottom:8px">Double-click a row or tick to select hole for damage scenario</div>';
  var header='<tr><th style="width:36px;text-align:center" title="Selected hole for damage scenario">&#10003;</th><th>Hole</th><th>Dia (mm)</th><th>Area (m²)</th><th>Rate (kg/s)</th><th>Release in 3 min</th><th>Full contents</th><th>Time to empty</th>';
  if(showScreeningCol)header+='<th>Industry screening</th>';
  html+='<table class="rtbl" id="m3_holesTable">'+header+'</tr>';
  m3_data.holes.forEach(function(h){
    var rate=h.release_rate_kg_s||0;
    var release3min=rate*180;
    var timeEmptyMin=null; if(fullMassKg!=null&&rate>0) timeEmptyMin=fullMassKg/rate/60;
    var timeEmptySec=timeEmptyMin!=null?timeEmptyMin*60:null;
    var fullStr=fullMassKg!=null?fmt(fullMassKg,2)+' kg ('+fmt(capacityL,0)+' L above course)':'—';
    var timeStr=timeEmptyMin!=null?fmt(timeEmptyMin,2)+' min':(fullMassKg!=null&&rate<=0?'—':'—');
    var release3minDisp=(fullMassKg!=null&&release3min>=fullMassKg)?'Full Contents in &lt; 3 mins':fmt(release3min,2)+' kg';
    var screening_default="—";
    var dia=h.diameter_mm!=null?parseFloat(h.diameter_mm):null;
    if(dia!=null&&rate>0){
      if(dia<=6.25){screening_default="Cont";}
      else{
        var t4536=4536/rate;
        var massEmptiedQuick=(fullMassKg!=null&&fullMassKg>4536&&timeEmptySec!=null&&timeEmptySec<=180);
        screening_default=(t4536<=180||massEmptiedQuick)?"Inst":"Cont";
      }
    }
    var safeHn=String(h.hole_name||"").replace(/\\/g,"\\\\").replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    var isSel=holeName&&h.hole_name===holeName;
    var chk=isSel?' checked="checked"':'';
    var row='<td style="text-align:center" onclick="event.stopPropagation()"><input type="checkbox" class="m3-hole-select" data-hole-name="'+escHtml(h.hole_name)+'"'+chk+' onchange="m4_selectHoleForDamage(\''+safeHn+'\')" title="Select for damage scenario"/></td>';
    row+='<td>'+escHtml(h.hole_name)+' ('+escHtml(h.hole_label)+')</td><td>'+fmt(h.diameter_mm,2)+'</td><td>'+h.area_m2.toExponential(3)+'</td><td>'+fmt(rate,4)+'</td><td>'+release3minDisp+'</td><td>'+fullStr+'</td><td>'+timeStr+'</td>';
    if(showScreeningCol)row+='<td>'+screening_default+'</td>';
    html+='<tr data-hole-name="'+escHtml(h.hole_name)+'" ondblclick="m4_selectHoleForDamage(\''+safeHn+'\')" title="Double-click or tick to select for damage scenario">'+row+'</tr>';
  });
  html+='</table>';
  $("m3_results").innerHTML=html;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 5 — CONSEQUENCE AGGREGATION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════ */

var m4_data=null;

function m4_blank(){
  return {consequence_types:{flammable:"",toxic:"",nfnt:""},models:[],outputs:[],specialist_engineering_assessment:"",notes:""};
}

function m4_getReleasePhase(){
  var phaseEl=$("m3_phase");
  if(phaseEl&&phaseEl.value) return String(phaseEl.value).toLowerCase();
  if(typeof m3_data!=="undefined"&&m3_data&&m3_data.phase) return String(m3_data.phase).toLowerCase();
  var m3=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release:null;
  if(m3&&m3.phase) return String(m3.phase).toLowerCase();
  var ep=$("m4_m3phase");
  if(ep&&ep.value) return String(ep.value).toLowerCase();
  return "";
}
function m4_suggestFlammable(){
  var phase=m4_getReleasePhase();
  if(phase==="liquid")return"Pool Fire";
  if(phase==="gas")return"Jet Fire";
  if(phase==="two-phase")return"Jet Fire";
  return"Pool Fire";
}
function m4_flammableInconsistentWithPhase(flam,phase){
  flam=String(flam||"").trim();
  phase=String(phase||"").toLowerCase();
  if(!flam||!phase)return false;
  if(phase==="gas"||phase==="two-phase") return flam==="Pool Fire";
  if(phase==="liquid") return flam==="Jet Fire";
  return false;
}
function m4_refreshFlammableHint(){
  var sug=m4_suggestFlammable();
  var hintEl=$("m4_flammHint");
  if(!hintEl)return;
  var cur=$("m4_flamm")?String($("m4_flamm").value||"").trim():"";
  var phase=m4_getReleasePhase();
  if(!cur) hintEl.textContent="Suggested: "+sug+" (liquid\u2192Pool Fire; gas\u2192Jet Fire; two-phase\u2192Jet Fire). Click Suggest to apply.";
  else if(m4_flammableInconsistentWithPhase(cur,phase)) hintEl.textContent="Release phase suggests "+sug+" (current: "+cur+"). Click Suggest to apply.";
  else if(cur===sug) hintEl.textContent="Applied: "+sug;
  else hintEl.textContent="Suggested: "+sug+" (liquid\u2192Pool Fire; gas\u2192Jet Fire; two-phase\u2192Jet Fire). Current: "+cur+".";
}
/** Push saved M4 phase into the dropdown when opening M5 before M4 has loaded (avoids defaulting to Liquid). */
function m4_ensureM3PhaseFromSaved(){
  if(typeof m3_data!=="undefined"&&m3_data) return;
  var saved=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release:null;
  var phaseEl=$("m3_phase");
  if(saved&&saved.phase&&phaseEl) phaseEl.value=saved.phase;
}
function m4_syncFlammableToPhase(){
  if(!$("m4_flamm"))return;
  var cur=String($("m4_flamm").value||"").trim();
  var phase=m4_getReleasePhase();
  if(!cur||m4_flammableInconsistentWithPhase(cur,phase)) m4_applyFlammableSuggestion();
  else m4_refreshFlammableHint();
}
function m4_applyFlammableSuggestion(){
  var sug=m4_suggestFlammable();
  var sel=$("m4_flamm"); if(!sel)return;
  var hasOpt=Array.from(sel.options).some(function(o){return o.value===sug;});
  if(hasOpt){sel.value=sug; if(m4_data)m4_data.consequence_types.flammable=sug;}
  m4_refreshFlammableHint();
  if(typeof m4_maybeAutoBuildModels==="function")m4_maybeAutoBuildModels(true);
}
function m4_consequenceTypesFromDom(){
  return [$("m4_flamm"),$("m4_toxic"),$("m4_nfnt")].map(function(el){return el?String(el.value||"").trim():"";}).filter(Boolean);
}
function m4_onConsequenceTypeChange(){
  if(typeof m4_maybeAutoBuildModels==="function")m4_maybeAutoBuildModels(true);
}
/** Rebuild consequence area table when types are selected (silent — no alert if none). */
function m4_maybeAutoBuildModels(silent){
  if(!activeAsset||!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi)return;
  if(!m4_consequenceTypesFromDom().length)return;
  if(typeof m4_buildModels==="function")m4_buildModels(!!silent);
}
/** Module 5 inherited-from-M4 read-only fields: prefer live M4 Release Inputs in the DOM, then saved module4_release (long-scroll and unsaved edits). */
function m4_syncInheritedFromM4Release(){
  if(!activeAsset)return;
  var m3=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release;
  var scenEl=$("m3_scenario"), fluidEl=$("m3_fluidSel"), phaseEl=$("m3_phase");
  function domTrim(el){ return el?String(el.value||"").trim():"";}
  var scen=scenEl?domTrim(scenEl):(m3?m3.scenario_name||"":"");
  var fluid=fluidEl?domTrim(fluidEl):(m3&&m3.representative_fluid?m3.representative_fluid.selected_name||"":"");
  var phase=(typeof m4_getReleasePhase==="function"?m4_getReleasePhase():(phaseEl?(phaseEl.value||""):(m3?m3.phase||"":"")));
  var es=$("m4_m3scen"), ef=$("m4_m3fluid"), ep=$("m4_m3phase");
  if(es) es.value=scen;
  if(ef) ef.value=fluid;
  if(ep) ep.value=phase;
  if(typeof m4_syncVolumeFromM1Dom==="function") m4_syncVolumeFromM1Dom();
}
function m4_load(){
  if(!activeAsset)return;
  if(typeof m4_ensureM3PhaseFromSaved==="function") m4_ensureM3PhaseFromSaved();
  m4_syncInheritedFromM4Release();
  var s=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi, m3=s.module4_release;
  if(m3){
    $("m4_warnM3").style.display="none";
    if(m3.holes&&m3.holes.length){
      var h='<table class="rtbl"><tr><th>Hole</th><th>Rate (kg/s)</th></tr>';
      m3.holes.forEach(function(r){h+='<tr><td>'+escHtml(r.hole_name)+'</td><td>'+fmt(r.release_rate_kg_s,4)+'</td></tr>';});
      h+='</table>'; $("m4_m3data").innerHTML=h;
    } else if($("m4_m3data")) $("m4_m3data").innerHTML="";
  } else {
    $("m4_warnM3").style.display="block";
    if($("m4_m3data")) $("m4_m3data").innerHTML="";
  }
  m4_data=s.module5_consequence?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.module5_consequence)):m4_blank();
  $("m4_flamm").value=m4_data.consequence_types.flammable||"";
  $("m4_toxic").value=m4_data.consequence_types.toxic||"";
  $("m4_nfnt").value=m4_data.consequence_types.nfnt||"";
  if($("m4_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m4_notes", m4_data.notes || "");
  if($("m4_sea_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m4_sea_notes", m4_data.specialist_engineering_assessment || "");
  m4_syncFlammableToPhase();
  m4_maybeAutoBuildModels(true);
  m4_updateReleaseRateWarnings();
  m4_renderOutputs();
  $("m4_status").textContent="Loaded";
}

function m4_save(){
  if(!activeAsset||!m4_data)return;
  m4_data.consequence_types={flammable:$("m4_flamm").value,toxic:$("m4_toxic").value,nfnt:$("m4_nfnt").value};
  var m4NotesEl = $("m4_notes"); m4_data.notes = m4NotesEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m4_notes") : "";
  var m4SeaEl = $("m4_sea_notes"); m4_data.specialist_engineering_assessment = m4SeaEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m4_sea_notes") : "";
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module5_consequence=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m4_data));
  setModuleStatus(5,"complete"); auditLog(5,"saved");
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  $("m4_status").textContent="Saved — "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION: PCC-3 §8 / Industry screening — Consequence models (flammable, toxic, NFNT), area/distance
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function m4_buildModels(silent){
  if(!activeAsset||!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi)return;
  if(!m4_data){
    var s=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
    m4_data=(s.module5_consequence?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.module5_consequence)):m4_blank());
    $("m4_flamm").value=m4_data.consequence_types.flammable||"";
    $("m4_toxic").value=m4_data.consequence_types.toxic||"";
    $("m4_nfnt").value=m4_data.consequence_types.nfnt||"";
  }
  var types=m4_consequenceTypesFromDom();
  if(!types.length){if(!silent)alert("Select at least one consequence type.");return;}
  var holes=m4_getReleaseHolesForConsequence();
  holes=holes.map(function(h){if(h.diameter_mm==null){var def=M3_HOLES.find(function(d){return d.name===h.hole_name;});if(def)h.diameter_mm=def.dia_mm;}return h;});
  var m3=activeAsset?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release:null;
  var capacityL=typeof osrEffectiveM1VesselVolumeL==="function"?osrEffectiveM1VesselVolumeL():null;
  if(capacityL==null&&m3&&m3.vessel_volume_l!=null) capacityL=parseFloat(m3.vessel_volume_l);
  var rho=null; if(m3&&m3.representative_fluid&&m3.representative_fluid.selected_values) rho=m2_fluidRho(m3.representative_fluid.selected_values);
  var fullMassKg=null; if(capacityL!=null&&rho!=null&&rho>0) fullMassKg=(capacityL/1000)*rho;
  m4_data.models=[];m4_data.outputs=[];
  types.forEach(function(type){
    holes.forEach(function(h){
      var rate=h.release_rate_kg_s||0;
      var timeEmptyMin=null; if(fullMassKg!=null&&rate>0) timeEmptyMin=fullMassKg/rate/60;
      var pcc3="—", screening_default="—";
      if(timeEmptyMin!=null){if(timeEmptyMin<2)pcc3="Inst";else if(timeEmptyMin>=10)pcc3="Cont";else pcc3="Trans";}
      var dia=h.diameter_mm!=null?parseFloat(h.diameter_mm):null;
      var timeEmptySec=timeEmptyMin!=null?timeEmptyMin*60:null;
      if(dia!=null&&rate>0){if(dia<=6.25)screening_default="Cont";else{var t4536=4536/rate;var massEmptiedQuick=(fullMassKg!=null&&fullMassKg>4536&&timeEmptySec!=null&&timeEmptySec<=180);screening_default=(t4536<=180||massEmptiedQuick)?"Inst":"Cont";}}
      var dispType=pcc3+"/"+screening_default;
      var area=0, dist=0;
      if(type.indexOf("Pool")>=0){area=Math.PI*Math.pow(Math.sqrt(rate*0.5),2);dist=Math.sqrt(area/Math.PI)*2;}
      else if(type.indexOf("Jet")>=0){area=rate*15;dist=Math.sqrt(rate)*10;}
      else if(type.indexOf("Flash")>=0){area=rate*50;dist=Math.sqrt(rate)*20;}
      else if(type.indexOf("VCE")>=0){area=rate*100;dist=Math.sqrt(rate)*30;}
      else if(type.indexOf("BLEVE")>=0){area=rate*200;dist=Math.sqrt(rate)*40;}
      else{area=rate*20;dist=Math.sqrt(rate)*8;}
      var holeDisp=h.hole_name+(h.hole_label?(" "+h.hole_label):(h.diameter_mm!=null?" "+fmt(h.diameter_mm,0)+"mm":""));
      m4_data.models.push({type:type,hole:holeDisp,hole_name:h.hole_name,rate_kg_s:rate,consequence_area_m2:Math.round(area*100)/100,consequence_distance_m:Math.round(dist*100)/100,dispersion:dispType,dispersion_pcc3:pcc3,dispersion_screen:screening_default});
      m4_data.outputs.push({type:type,hole:holeDisp,hole_name:h.hole_name,rate_kg_s:rate,area_m2:Math.round(area*100)/100,distance_m:Math.round(dist*100)/100,dispersion:dispType,dispersion_pcc3:pcc3,dispersion_screen:screening_default});
    });
  });
  m4_data.consequence_types={flammable:$("m4_flamm").value,toxic:$("m4_toxic").value,nfnt:$("m4_nfnt").value};
  var m4NotesElBuild=$("m4_notes"); m4_data.notes=m4NotesElBuild?osrModNotes_getStored("m4_notes"):"";
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module5_consequence=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m4_data));
  if(typeof osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed==="function")try{osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();}catch(e){}
  if(typeof setModuleStatus==="function")try{setModuleStatus(5,"complete");}catch(e){}
  if(typeof auditLog==="function")try{auditLog(5,"consequence models built");}catch(e){}
  m4_updateReleaseRateWarnings();
  m4_renderOutputs();
}

function m4_clearModels(){
  if(!activeAsset||!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi)return;
  if(!m4_data){
    var s0=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
    m4_data=s0.module5_consequence?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s0.module5_consequence)):m4_blank();
  }
  m4_data.models=[];
  m4_data.outputs=[];
  m4_data.consequence_types={flammable:$("m4_flamm").value,toxic:$("m4_toxic").value,nfnt:$("m4_nfnt").value};
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module5_consequence=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m4_data));
  if(typeof osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed==="function")try{osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();}catch(e){}
  if(typeof setModuleStatus==="function")try{setModuleStatus(5,"complete");}catch(e){}
  if(typeof auditLog==="function")try{auditLog(5,"consequence outputs cleared");}catch(e){}
  m4_renderOutputs();
  var st=$("m4_status"); if(st) st.textContent="Outputs cleared — "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION: Industry screening Eq 1.4 — Level 1 probability-weighted flammable consequence
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/** Level 1 Industry screening Eq (1.4): probability-weighted flammable consequence area C_f^flam = (Σ gff_n × CA_f,n^flam) / gff_total.
 *  Optional modelsArg, gffArg so M6 can pass stored module5_consequence.models and module3_damage.generic_failure_gff.
 *  Returns { weightedArea_m2, band } or null if insufficient data. */
function m4_level1WeightedFlammableCA(modelsArg,gffArg){
  var models=modelsArg&&modelsArg.length?modelsArg:(m4_data&&m4_data.models?m4_data.models:[]);
  var gff=gffArg||(activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage||{}).generic_failure_gff:null);
  if(!gff||!models.length)return null;
  var flammTypes=["Pool Fire","Jet Fire","Flash Fire","VCE (Vapour Cloud Explosion)","BLEVE"];
  var flammModels=models.filter(function(m){return flammTypes.indexOf(m.type)>=0;});
  if(!flammModels.length)return null;
  var sumGffCa=0, sumGff=0;
  for(var n=0;n<flammModels.length;n++){
    var hn=flammModels[n].hole_name;
    var key=m4_gffKeyForHoleName(hn);
    if(!key)continue;
    var gffN=gff[key]; if(gffN==null||!Number.isFinite(gffN)||gffN<0)gffN=0;
    var ca=flammModels[n].consequence_area_m2!=null?flammModels[n].consequence_area_m2:flammModels[n].area_m2; if(ca==null||!Number.isFinite(ca))ca=0;
    sumGffCa+=gffN*ca; sumGff+=gffN;
  }
  var gffTotal=gff.total; if(gffTotal==null||!Number.isFinite(gffTotal)||gffTotal<=0)gffTotal=sumGff;
  if(gffTotal<=0)return null;
  var weightedArea=sumGffCa/gffTotal;
  var band=m4_consequenceAreaBand(weightedArea);
  return {weightedArea_m2:weightedArea,band:band};
}

function m4_consequenceAreaBand(areaM2){
  var cfg=REF.consequenceAreas; if(!cfg||!cfg.bands||!cfg.bands.length)return null;
  var a=parseFloat(areaM2); if(!Number.isFinite(a))return null;
  for(var i=0;i<cfg.bands.length;i++){
    var b=cfg.bands[i];
    if(a>=b.min&&(b.max==null||a<b.max))return b;
  }
  return cfg.bands[cfg.bands.length-1];
}
function m4_gffKeyForHoleName(holeName){
  var map={Small:"small",Medium:"medium",Large:"large",Rupture:"rupture"};
  return map[holeName]||null;
}
function m4_gffForHoleName(holeName,gff){
  if(!gff)return null;
  var k=m4_gffKeyForHoleName(holeName);
  if(!k)return null;
  var v=gff[k];
  if(v==null)return null;
  var n=Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n)?n:null;
}
/** Sort consequence models by hole size: Small → Medium → Large → Rupture (Industry screening); tie-break type then hole label. */
function m4_sortModelsByHoleSizeAsc(models){
  if(!models||!models.length)return [];
  function holeOrder(m){
    var raw=(m.hole_name||(m.hole?String(m.hole).split(/\s+/)[0]:""))||"";
    var token=String(raw).trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
    var ord={Small:1,Medium:2,Large:3,Rupture:4};
    if(ord.hasOwnProperty(token))return ord[token];
    var low=token.toLowerCase();
    if(low.indexOf("small")===0)return 1;
    if(low.indexOf("medium")===0)return 2;
    if(low.indexOf("large")===0)return 3;
    if(low.indexOf("rupture")===0)return 4;
    return 50;
  }
  return models.slice().sort(function(a,b){
    var oa=holeOrder(a), ob=holeOrder(b);
    if(oa!==ob)return oa-ob;
    var ta=String(a.type||""), tb=String(b.type||"");
    if(ta!==tb)return ta.localeCompare(tb);
    return String(a.hole||"").localeCompare(String(b.hole||""));
  });
}
function areaBandScoreToNum(band){ if(!band)return 0; var s=band.score; if(s==null)return 0; var n=parseInt(s); if(Number.isFinite(n))return n; var idx="ABCDE".indexOf(String(s).toUpperCase()); return idx>=0?idx+1:0; }
/** Band screening score for display: 1–5 (aligns with owner CoF scale); legacy A–E in CSV maps to same digits. */
function areaBandScoreLetter(band){ if(!band)return ""; var s=band.score; if(s==null)return ""; var n=parseInt(s,10); if(Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=1&&n<=5)return String(n); if(typeof s==="string"&&/^[A-E]$/i.test(s))return String("ABCDE".indexOf(s.toUpperCase())+1); return String(s); }
function m4_selectHoleForDamage(holeName){
  if(!activeAsset||!holeName)return;
  var s=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
  if(!s.module4_release)s.module4_release={};
  s.module4_release.selected_hole_for_damage=holeName;
  if(m3_data)m3_data.selected_hole_for_damage=holeName;
  m4_renderOutputs();
  m3_renderResults();
  m6_renderConsequenceAreas();
  if(typeof m6_calc==="function")m6_calc();
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
}
function m4_renderOutputs(){
  if(!m4_data||!m4_data.models.length){$("m4_outputs").innerHTML='<div class="hint">No outputs</div>';return;}
  var m3=activeAsset?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release:null;
  var sel=m3?m3.selected_hole_for_damage:null;
  var h='<div style="font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px">Maximum Consequence Areas</div>';
  h+='<div class="hint" style="margin-bottom:8px"><strong>Area Affected (CSV)</strong> gives <strong>screening bands</strong> tied to Industry screening-style modelling; <strong>Owner CoF</strong> is assigned using owner criteria in Libraries. Columns: Type, Hole, Rate (kg/s), Area (m²), Distance (m), Industry screening, Area band. Rows <strong>Small → Medium → Large → Rupture</strong>. Double-click a row (or use &#10003;) to select hole size for damage scenario.</div>';
  var hasBands=REF.consequenceAreas&&REF.consequenceAreas.bands&&REF.consequenceAreas.bands.length;
  if(!hasBands){h+='<div class="hint" style="margin-bottom:8px">Load Area Affected CSV to score areas by band (inputs to map into owner CoF)</div>';}
  var dispMethod=osrDispersionMethodFromSource();
  var showScreeningCol=(dispMethod==="screening_default"||dispMethod==="both"||dispMethod==="pcc3");
  var header='<tr><th style="width:36px;text-align:center" title="Selected hole for damage scenario">&#10003;</th><th>Type</th><th>Hole</th><th>Rate (kg/s)</th><th>Area (m²)</th><th>Distance (m)</th>';
  if(showScreeningCol)header+='<th>Industry screening</th>';
  if(hasBands)header+='<th title="From Area Affected CSV reference">Area band</th>';
  h+='<table class="rtbl" id="m4_outputsTable"><thead>'+header+'</tr></thead><tbody>';
  var displayModels=m4_sortModelsByHoleSizeAsc(m4_data.models);
  displayModels.forEach(function(m){
    var hn=m.hole_name||m.hole||"";
    var isSel=sel&&hn===sel;
    var cls=(sel&&!isSel)?"rm-row-greyed":"";
    var safeHn=String(hn).replace(/\\/g,"\\\\").replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    var screening_default=m.dispersion_screen||"—";
    var band=hasBands?m4_consequenceAreaBand(m.consequence_area_m2):null;
    var letter=band?areaBandScoreLetter(band):"";
    var bandCell=hasBands&&band?'<td><span class="consequence-score-badge band-accent" style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:600;font-size:11px">'+escHtml(band.label)+(letter?' ('+escHtml(letter)+')':'')+'</span></td>':(hasBands?'<td>—</td>':'');
    var chk=isSel?' checked="checked"':'';
    var row='<td style="text-align:center" onclick="event.stopPropagation()"><input type="checkbox" class="m4-hole-select" data-hole-name="'+escHtml(hn)+'"'+chk+' onchange="m4_selectHoleForDamage(\''+safeHn+'\')" title="Select for damage scenario"/></td>';
    row+='<td>'+escHtml(m.type)+'</td><td>'+escHtml(m.hole)+'</td><td>'+fmt(m.rate_kg_s,4)+'</td><td>'+fmt(m.consequence_area_m2)+'</td><td>'+fmt(m.consequence_distance_m)+'</td>';
    if(showScreeningCol)row+='<td>'+escHtml(screening_default)+'</td>';
    row+=bandCell;
    h+='<tr class="'+cls+'" data-hole-name="'+escHtml(hn)+'" ondblclick="m4_selectHoleForDamage(\''+safeHn+'\')" title="Double-click or tick to select for damage scenario">'+row+'</tr>';
  });
  h+='</tbody></table>';
  var lev1=m4_level1WeightedFlammableCA();
  if(lev1&&Number.isFinite(lev1.weightedArea_m2)){
    h+='<div class="hint" style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-size:12px">';
    h+='<strong>Level 1 (Industry screening Eq 1.4)</strong> — Probability-weighted flammable: C<sub>f</sub><sup>flam</sup> = '+fmt(lev1.weightedArea_m2)+' m²';
    if(lev1.band){var letter=areaBandScoreLetter(lev1.band); h+=' &nbsp; <span class="consequence-score-badge band-accent" style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:600;font-size:11px">'+escHtml(lev1.band.label)+(letter?' ('+escHtml(letter)+')':'')+'</span>';}
    h+=' <span style="color:var(--muted)">Map this screening-style figure to <strong>owner CoF</strong> per company rules — it is not itself the owner matrix.</span>';
    h+='</div>';
  }
  $("m4_outputs").innerHTML=h;
  if(typeof m4_updateReleaseRateWarnings==="function")m4_updateReleaseRateWarnings();
}

function m5_minWallCalcIsUsed(c){
  if(!c||typeof c!=="object") return false;
  if(String(c.calculation_title||"").trim()) return true;
  if(c.measured_thickness_mm!=null&&String(c.measured_thickness_mm).trim()!=="") return true;
  if(c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr!=null&&String(c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr).trim()!=="") return true;
  if(c.component_nominal_thickness_mm!=null&&String(c.component_nominal_thickness_mm).trim()!=="") return true;
  if(c.df_score!=null&&String(c.df_score).trim()!=="") return true;
  if(c.external_damage_mechanism&&String(c.external_damage_mechanism).trim()) return true;
  if(c.thinning_subtype&&String(c.thinning_subtype).trim()) return true;
  return false;
}
function m5_blank(){
  var m5row={calculation_title:"",component_type:"shell",diameter_mm:null,material_spec:null,stress_allow_mpa:null,joint_factor:1,apex_angle_deg:30,m_factor:1.54,c_factor:0.3,component_nominal_thickness_mm:null,measured_thickness_mm:null,measured_thickness_date:null,corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr:null,corrosion_rate_notes:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,start_date:null,thinning_subtype:"",thinning_subtype_custom:"",gff_hole_selection:{small:true,medium:false,large:false,rupture:false,total:false}};
  return {assessment_name:"",screening_source:"",external_environment_notes:"",thinning_subtype:"",thinning_subtype_custom:"",generic_failure:"vessel_kodrum_colbtm_filter_drum_reactor_coltop_colmid",generic_failure_calculation_title:"",generic_failure_gff:{small:null,medium:null,large:null,rupture:null,total:null},gff_hole_selection:{small:true,medium:false,large:false,rupture:false,total:false},management_questionnaire:{answers:{},pscore:null,fms:null},selected_mechanisms:[],filters:{material:[],temperature:[],process:[],loading:[]},min_wall_calcs:[m5row],external_min_wall_calcs:[],cracking_calcs:[{calculation_title:"",cracking_type:"",component_type:"shell",material_spec:null,susceptibility:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,last_inspection_date:null,start_date:null,confidence_level:"medium",insp_a:0,insp_b:0,insp_c:0,insp_d:0,comments:""}],other_calcs:[{calculation_title:"",mechanism_type:"",component_type:"shell",material_spec:null,pof_score:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,last_inspection_date:null,start_date:null,comments:""}],specialist_engineering_assessment:"",notes:""};
}

function m5_load(){
  if(!activeAsset){ m5_data=m5_blank(); m5_populateMinWall(); m5_renderCrackingCalcs(); m5_renderOtherCalcs(); if(typeof m5_refreshDamageMechanismList==="function")m5_refreshDamageMechanismList(); if(typeof initM3SectionCollapsibles==="function")initM3SectionCollapsibles(); return; }
  m5_data=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage)):m5_blank();
  if(m5_data.min_wall&&!m5_data.min_wall_calcs){var mw=m5_data.min_wall;mw.component_type=mw.component_type||"shell";m5_data.min_wall_calcs=[mw];delete m5_data.min_wall;}
  if(!m5_data.min_wall_calcs||!m5_data.min_wall_calcs.length)m5_data.min_wall_calcs=[{calculation_title:"",component_type:"shell",diameter_mm:null,material_spec:null,stress_allow_mpa:null,joint_factor:1,apex_angle_deg:30,m_factor:1.54,c_factor:0.3,component_nominal_thickness_mm:null,measured_thickness_mm:null,measured_thickness_date:null,corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr:null,corrosion_rate_notes:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,start_date:null}];
  if(!Array.isArray(m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs)) m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs=[];
  else m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs=m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_minWallCalcIsUsed==="function"&&m5_minWallCalcIsUsed(c); });
  if(m5_data.external_environment_notes==null)m5_data.external_environment_notes="";
  if(m5_data.thinning_subtype==null)m5_data.thinning_subtype="";
  if(m5_data.thinning_subtype_custom==null)m5_data.thinning_subtype_custom="";
  if(!m5_data.cracking_calcs||!m5_data.cracking_calcs.length)m5_data.cracking_calcs=[{calculation_title:"",cracking_type:"",component_type:"shell",material_spec:null,susceptibility:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,last_inspection_date:null,start_date:null,confidence_level:"medium",insp_a:0,insp_b:0,insp_c:0,insp_d:0,comments:""}];
  if(!m5_data.other_calcs||!m5_data.other_calcs.length)m5_data.other_calcs=[{calculation_title:"",mechanism_type:"",component_type:"shell",material_spec:null,pof_score:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,last_inspection_date:null,start_date:null,comments:""}];
  (m5_data.min_wall_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){ if(!c.df_time_basis)c.df_time_basis="t0"; if(c.measured_thickness_date===undefined)c.measured_thickness_date=null; if(c.corrosion_rate_notes===undefined)c.corrosion_rate_notes=null; if(c.thinning_subtype==null)c.thinning_subtype=""; if(c.thinning_subtype_custom==null)c.thinning_subtype_custom=""; if(c.joint_factor==null||c.joint_factor==="")c.joint_factor=m5_defaultJointFactor(); });
  if(m5_data.thinning_subtype||m5_data.thinning_subtype_custom){
    (m5_data.min_wall_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){
      if(!c.thinning_subtype&&m5_data.thinning_subtype)c.thinning_subtype=m5_data.thinning_subtype;
      if(!c.thinning_subtype_custom&&m5_data.thinning_subtype_custom)c.thinning_subtype_custom=m5_data.thinning_subtype_custom;
    });
  }
  (m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){ if(!c.df_time_basis)c.df_time_basis="t0"; if(c.external_damage_mechanism==null)c.external_damage_mechanism=""; if(c.measured_thickness_date===undefined)c.measured_thickness_date=null; if(c.corrosion_rate_notes===undefined)c.corrosion_rate_notes=null; if(c.joint_factor==null||c.joint_factor==="")c.joint_factor=m5_defaultJointFactor(); });
  (m5_data.cracking_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){ if(!c.df_time_basis)c.df_time_basis="t0"; if(c.last_inspection_date===undefined)c.last_inspection_date=null; });
  (m5_data.other_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){ if(!c.df_time_basis)c.df_time_basis="t0"; if(c.last_inspection_date===undefined)c.last_inspection_date=null; });
  if(!m5_data.generic_failure_gff||typeof m5_data.generic_failure_gff!=="object") m5_data.generic_failure_gff={small:null,medium:null,large:null,rupture:null,total:null};
  if(!m5_data.gff_hole_selection||typeof m5_data.gff_hole_selection!=="object") m5_data.gff_hole_selection={small:true,medium:false,large:false,rupture:false,total:false};
  m5_data.gff_hole_selection=m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m5_data);
  if(typeof m5_migratePerCalcGffHoleSelection==="function")m5_migratePerCalcGffHoleSelection();
  if(!m5_data.management_questionnaire||typeof m5_data.management_questionnaire!=="object") m5_data.management_questionnaire={answers:{},pscore:null,fms:null};
  if(!m5_data.management_questionnaire.answers||typeof m5_data.management_questionnaire.answers!=="object") m5_data.management_questionnaire.answers={};
  if(m5_data.generic_failure_calculation_title==null||m5_data.generic_failure_calculation_title===undefined)m5_data.generic_failure_calculation_title="";
  m5_populateGenericFailure();
  m5_populateMinWall();
  m5_renderCrackingCalcs();
  m5_renderOtherCalcs();
  if($("m5_sea_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m5_sea_notes", m5_data.specialist_engineering_assessment || "");
  if($("m5_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m5_notes", m5_data.notes || "");
  if(typeof m5_refreshDamageMechanismList==="function")m5_refreshDamageMechanismList();
  $("m5_status").textContent="Loaded";
  if(typeof initM3SectionCollapsibles==="function")initM3SectionCollapsibles();
}

function m5_materialName(m){
  var v=getRowProp(m,["specification","material_spec","material_name","Material","name","spec","Material_Spec","MATERIAL_SPEC","MATERIAL SPEC","MATERIAL SPEC.","TML / MARK","TML","Mark","Material Spec"]);
  if(v)return String(v);
  var k=Object.keys(m||{});
  for(var i=0;i<k.length;i++){var val=m[k[i]];if(typeof val==="string"&&val&&!k[i].toLowerCase().match(/^(stress|allow|mpa|id|index)$/))return val;}
  return "";
}
function m5_materialDescription(m){
  if(!m)return "";
  var spec=getRowProp(m,["specification","material_spec","Material_Spec","Spec","SPEC"]);
  var temp=getRowProp(m,["design_temp_C","design_temp","Design_Temp_C","Design_Temp","design_temp_c"]);
  var comp=getRowProp(m,["nominal_composition","composition","Composition","Nominal_Composition","nominal composition"]);
  var form=getRowProp(m,["product_form","Product_Form","product form","Product Form"]);
  var parts=[spec,temp,comp,form].filter(function(v){return v!=null&&String(v).trim()!=="";}).map(function(v){return String(v).trim();});
  return parts.length?parts.join(" · "):"";
}
function m5_materialDisplayLabel(m){
  var d=m5_materialDescription(m);
  if(d)return d;
  return m5_materialName(m)||"";
}
function m5_materialGroup(m){
  if(!m)return "";
  var v=getRowProp(m,["material_group","Material_Group","material group","Material Group","MATERIAL_GROUP"]);
  if(v!=null&&v!=="")return String(v);
  v=getRowProp(m,["nominal_composition","composition","Composition","Nominal_Composition","nominal composition"]);
  if(v!=null&&v!=="")return String(v);
  return "";
}
function m5_materialGroupDisplay(spec){
  var row=typeof m5_findMaterialRow==="function"?m5_findMaterialRow(spec):null;
  return row?m5_materialGroup(row):"";
}
/** True when M0 material group and damage mechanism material group overlap (exact or shared segment). */
function m5_materialGroupsOverlap(a, b){
  if(!a||!b) return false;
  var sa=String(a).trim().toLowerCase();
  var sb=String(b).trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!sa||!sb) return false;
  if(sa===sb) return true;
  if(sa.indexOf(sb)>=0||sb.indexOf(sa)>=0) return true;
  var pa=sa.split(/[,;/]/).map(function(x){return x.trim();}).filter(Boolean);
  var pb=sb.split(/[,;/]/).map(function(x){return x.trim();}).filter(Boolean);
  for(var i=0;i<pa.length;i++){
    for(var j=0;j<pb.length;j++){
      if(pa[i]===pb[j]) return true;
      if(pa[i].indexOf(pb[j])>=0||pb[j].indexOf(pa[i])>=0) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
/** Apply M3 calc material group to the M0 damage mechanism list Material group filter. */
function m5_applyMaterialGroupToDamageFilter(materialGroup){
  window.m5_activeCalcMaterialGroup=String(materialGroup||"").trim();
  if(typeof m5_populateFilters==="function") m5_populateFilters();
  var group=window.m5_activeCalcMaterialGroup;
  var matSel=$("m5_mat");
  var matSearch=$("m5_mat_search");
  if(!group){
    if(matSearch) matSearch.value="";
    if(matSel) matSel.value="";
    if(typeof m5_filterDropdown==="function"){
      m5_filterDropdown("m5_mat","m5_mat_search","material");
    }
    if(typeof m5_applyFilter==="function") m5_applyFilter();
    return;
  }
  var cache=window.m5_filterOptionCache&&window.m5_filterOptionCache.material?window.m5_filterOptionCache.material:[];
  var match="";
  for(var i=0;i<cache.length;i++){
    if(m5_materialGroupsOverlap(cache[i], group)){ match=cache[i]; break; }
  }
  if(matSearch) matSearch.value=match?"":group;
  if(typeof m5_filterDropdown==="function") m5_filterDropdown("m5_mat","m5_mat_search","material");
  if(matSel) matSel.value=match||"";
  if(typeof m5_applyFilter==="function") m5_applyFilter();
}
function m5_syncDamageFilterFromActiveCalc(surface){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
  var cont=$(contId);
  if(!cont) return;
  var tabRoot=cont.querySelector(".m5-mw-tabs-root");
  var activeIdx=tabRoot?parseInt(tabRoot.getAttribute("data-active-idx"),10):0;
  if(isNaN(activeIdx)||activeIdx<0) activeIdx=0;
  var grpRo=cont.querySelector('.m5_matGroupRo[data-idx="'+activeIdx+'"]');
  var grp=grpRo&&grpRo.value?String(grpRo.value).trim():"";
  if(!grp){
    var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_materialSel[data-idx="'+activeIdx+'"]');
    if(mat&&mat.value&&typeof m5_materialGroupDisplay==="function") grp=m5_materialGroupDisplay(mat.value)||"";
  }
  if(typeof m5_applyMaterialGroupToDamageFilter==="function") m5_applyMaterialGroupToDamageFilter(grp);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION: Industry screening — GFF (failure frequency), used in PoF = GFF × FMS × DF
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function m5_getGenericFailureOptions(){
  if (REF && Array.isArray(REF.gffLib) && REF.gffLib.length) {
    return REF.gffLib.map(function(row, idx) {
      var comp = getRowProp(row, ["Component Type", "component_type", "component", "Component"]);
      var equip = getRowProp(row, ["Equipment Type", "equipment_type", "equipment", "Equipment"]);
      var idRaw = ((equip || "") + "|" + (comp || "")).trim() || ("gff_row_" + (idx + 1));
      var id = String(idRaw).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");
      var toNum = function(v) { var n = Number(v); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null; };
      var label = equip && comp ? (String(equip) + " - " + String(comp)) : (comp || equip || ("GFF row " + (idx + 1)));
      return {
        id: id || ("gff_row_" + (idx + 1)),
        label: label,
        note: equip ? ("Equipment: " + String(equip)) : "Loaded from GFF library",
        gff_defaults: {
          small: toNum(getRowProp(row, ["Small", "small"])),
          medium: toNum(getRowProp(row, ["Medium", "medium"])),
          large: toNum(getRowProp(row, ["Large", "large"])),
          rupture: toNum(getRowProp(row, ["Rupture", "rupture"])),
          total: toNum(getRowProp(row, ["Total (failures/yr)", "Total", "total", "total_failures_per_year"]))
        }
      };
    });
  }
  return (M3_GENERIC_FAILURE_JSON && Array.isArray(M3_GENERIC_FAILURE_JSON.options)) ? M3_GENERIC_FAILURE_JSON.options : [];
}

function m5_isGffEmpty(gff){
  if (!gff || typeof gff !== "object") return true;
  return gff.small == null && gff.medium == null && gff.large == null && gff.rupture == null && gff.total == null;
}

/** GFF total (failures/yr): use table Total when present; else sum Small+Medium+Large+Rupture (Eq. 3.2). */
function m5_gffTotalHzFromObject(og){
  if(!og||typeof og!=="object")return null;
  var tv=og.total!=null?og.total:og["Total (failures/yr)"];
  var t=Number(tv);
  if(Number.isFinite(t)&&t>=0)return t;
  var sum=0,c=0;
  ["small","medium","large","rupture"].forEach(function(k){
    var v=Number(og[k]);
    if(Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=0){sum+=v;c++;}
  });
  return c?sum:null;
}

/** Default: one release-hole size (Small) drives working GFF; selection is exclusive (radio-like). */
function m5_gffHoleDefaults(){ return { small:true, medium:false, large:false, rupture:false, total:false }; }

function m5_gffHoleDamageOptions(){
  return [
    {key:"small",label:"Small (6 mm)"},
    {key:"medium",label:"Medium (25 mm)"},
    {key:"large",label:"Large (100 mm)"},
    {key:"rupture",label:"Rupture (whole vessel)"},
    {key:"total",label:"Total (consolidated — all sizes)"}
  ];
}
function m5_gffHoleSelectedKey(sel){
  var s=m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized({gff_hole_selection:sel||{}});
  if(s.total)return "total";
  if(s.rupture)return "rupture";
  if(s.large)return "large";
  if(s.medium)return "medium";
  return "small";
}
function m5_gffHoleSelectionFromKey(key){
  var keys=["small","medium","large","rupture","total"];
  var out={small:false,medium:false,large:false,rupture:false,total:false};
  if(keys.indexOf(key)>=0)out[key]=true; else out.small=true;
  return out;
}
function m5_htmlGffHoleDamageDropdown(sel,calcIdx,surface){
  var cur=m5_gffHoleSelectedKey(sel);
  var idxAttr=(calcIdx!=null&&calcIdx!=="")?' data-idx="'+parseInt(calcIdx,10)+'"':"";
  var surfAttr=surface?(' data-surface="'+String(surface).replace(/"/g,"&quot;")+'"'):'';
  var opts=m5_gffHoleDamageOptions().map(function(o){
    return '<option value="'+escHtml(o.key)+'"'+(o.key===cur?' selected':'')+'>'+escHtml(o.label)+'</option>';
  }).join("");
  return '<select class="m5_gffHoleDamageSel"'+idxAttr+surfAttr+' onchange="m5_gffHoleDropdownChange(this.value'+(calcIdx!=null&&calcIdx!==""?(','+parseInt(calcIdx,10)+",'"+surface+"'"):"")+')">'+opts+'</select>';
}
function m5_htmlGffHoleDamageField(calc,calcIdx,surface){
  if(calcIdx==null||calcIdx===""||!(surface==="internal"||surface==="external"))return "";
  m5_ensureCalcRowGffHole(calc,typeof m5_data!=="undefined"?m5_data:null);
  var holeSel=m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(calc,m5_data);
  var refBtn='<button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'m3_scenario_name\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button>';
  return '<div class="field m5-field-damage-hole"><label>Damage <span class="ref-std">(Industry screening)</span> '+refBtn+'</label>'+
    '<div class="hint" style="font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;margin:4px 0 6px;color:var(--muted)">hole size expected from the damage mechanism</div>'+
    m5_htmlGffHoleDamageDropdown(holeSel,calcIdx,surface)+
    '</div>';
}

/** Per COMP tab (min_wall_calcs row): hole size for working GFF; falls back to module-level legacy selection. */
function m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(calc,m3){
  if(calc&&calc.gff_hole_selection&&typeof calc.gff_hole_selection==="object")
    return m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized({gff_hole_selection:calc.gff_hole_selection});
  return m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m3||{});
}
function m5_ensureCalcRowGffHole(c,m3){
  if(!c)return;
  if(!c.gff_hole_selection||typeof c.gff_hole_selection!=="object"){
    c.gff_hole_selection=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(null,m3||m5_data)));
  }
  c.gff_hole_selection=m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized({gff_hole_selection:c.gff_hole_selection});
}
function m5_migratePerCalcGffHoleSelection(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  (m5_data.min_wall_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){ m5_ensureCalcRowGffHole(c,m5_data); });
  (m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs||[]).forEach(function(c){ m5_ensureCalcRowGffHole(c,m5_data); });
}
function m5_gffHoleSizeLabel(sel){
  if(!sel)return "Small";
  if(sel.total)return "Total";
  if(sel.rupture)return "Rupture";
  if(sel.large)return "Large";
  if(sel.medium)return "Medium";
  return "Small";
}

/** Canonical map: exactly one of small|medium|large|rupture|total is true (persisted on module3_damage / per calc row). */
function m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m3){
  var keys=["small","medium","large","rupture","total"];
  var d=m3&&m3.gff_hole_selection&&typeof m3.gff_hole_selection==="object"?m3.gff_hole_selection:null;
  var out={small:false,medium:false,large:false,rupture:false,total:false};
  if(!d){ out.small=true; return out; }
  var k,i,picked=null;
  for(i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
    k=keys[i];
    if(d[k]===true){ picked=k; break; }
  }
  if(picked){ out[picked]=true; return out; }
  for(i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
    k=keys[i];
    if(d[k]!==false){ out[k]=true; return out; }
  }
  out.small=true;
  return out;
}

/** Working GFF (failures/yr): selected hole column, or consolidated Total when Total is chosen. */
function m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject(og,m3OrHoleSel){
  if(!og||typeof og!=="object")return null;
  var sel=(m3OrHoleSel&&m3OrHoleSel.small!==undefined&&m3OrHoleSel.medium!==undefined)?m3OrHoleSel:m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m3OrHoleSel||{});
  if(sel.total)return m5_gffTotalHzFromObject(og);
  var sum=0,c=0;
  ["small","medium","large","rupture"].forEach(function(k){
    if(!sel[k])return;
    var v=Number(og[k]);
    if(Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=0){sum+=v;c++;}
  });
  return c?sum:null;
}

function m5_gffHoleDropdownChange(key,idx,surface){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  var holeBag=m5_gffHoleSelectionFromKey(key);
  if(idx!=null&&idx!==""&&!isNaN(parseInt(idx,10))&&(surface==="internal"||surface==="external")){
    var arrKey=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
    var ci=parseInt(idx,10);
    if(m5_data[arrKey]&&m5_data[arrKey][ci]){
      var c=m5_data[arrKey][ci];
      c.gff_hole_selection=holeBag;
      if(typeof m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine==="function")m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine(ci,surface);
      if(typeof m5_refreshThinDfCalcNarrative==="function")m5_refreshThinDfCalcNarrative(ci,surface);
      var root=document.querySelector('.m5-mw-tabs-root[data-m5-surface="'+surface+'"]');
      if(root){
        var tab=root.querySelector('.m5-mw-tab[data-tab-idx="'+ci+'"] .m5-mw-tab-hole');
        if(tab)tab.textContent="Hole: "+m5_gffHoleSizeLabel(c.gff_hole_selection);
      }
    }
    return;
  }
  m5_data.gff_hole_selection=holeBag;
  if(typeof m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines==="function")m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines();
}
function m5_gffHoleCheckboxChange(key,checked,idx,surface){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  var keys=["small","medium","large","rupture","total"];
  if(keys.indexOf(key)<0)return;
  var arrKey=(surface==="external")?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
  var holeBag=null;
  if(idx!=null&&idx!==""&&!isNaN(parseInt(idx,10))&&m5_data[arrKey]&&m5_data[arrKey][parseInt(idx,10)]){
    var ci=parseInt(idx,10);
    var c=m5_data[arrKey][ci];
    m5_ensureCalcRowGffHole(c,m5_data);
    holeBag=c.gff_hole_selection;
    if(checked){ keys.forEach(function(k){ holeBag[k]=(k===key); }); }
    else{
      holeBag[key]=false;
      if(!keys.some(function(k){ return holeBag[k]===true; }))holeBag.small=true;
    }
    c.gff_hole_selection=m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized({gff_hole_selection:holeBag});
    if(typeof m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine==="function")m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine(ci,surface||"internal");
    if(typeof m5_refreshThinDfCalcNarrative==="function")m5_refreshThinDfCalcNarrative(ci,surface||"internal");
    var root=document.querySelector('.m5-mw-tabs-root[data-m5-surface="'+(surface||"internal")+'"]');
    if(root){
      var tab=root.querySelector('.m5-mw-tab[data-tab-idx="'+ci+'"] .m5-mw-tab-hole');
      if(tab)tab.textContent=m5_gffHoleSizeLabel(c.gff_hole_selection);
    }
    return;
  }
  if(!m5_data.gff_hole_selection||typeof m5_data.gff_hole_selection!=="object")m5_data.gff_hole_selection=m5_gffHoleDefaults();
  if(checked){
    keys.forEach(function(k){ m5_data.gff_hole_selection[k]=(k===key); });
  }else{
    m5_data.gff_hole_selection[key]=false;
    var any=keys.some(function(k){ return m5_data.gff_hole_selection[k]===true; });
    if(!any)m5_data.gff_hole_selection.small=true;
  }
  if(typeof m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines==="function")m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines();
}

  if (REF && REF.managementQuestionnaire && typeof REF.managementQuestionnaire === "object") return REF.managementQuestionnaire;
  return M3_MANAGEMENT_QUESTIONNAIRE_JSON || {};
}

function m5_applyGenericFailureGffDefaults(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  var opts=m5_getGenericFailureOptions();
  var current=m5_data.generic_failure?String(m5_data.generic_failure):"";
  if(!current&&opts.length){
    var defaultOpt=opts.find(function(o){return o.id===M3_DEFAULT_GENERIC_FAILURE_ID;})||opts.find(function(o){return o.label&&o.label.indexOf("Vessel")>=0&&o.label.indexOf("KODRUM")>=0;});
    if(defaultOpt)current=defaultOpt.id;
    if(current)m5_data.generic_failure=current;
  }
  var selected=opts.find(function(o){return o.id===current;});
  if(selected&&selected.gff_defaults&&m5_isGffEmpty(m5_data.generic_failure_gff)){
    m5_data.generic_failure_gff={
      small:selected.gff_defaults.small,
      medium:selected.gff_defaults.medium,
      large:selected.gff_defaults.large,
      rupture:selected.gff_defaults.rupture,
      total:selected.gff_defaults.total
    };
  }
}
function m5_populateGenericFailure(){
  m5_applyGenericFailureGffDefaults();
  var sel=$("m5_genericFailure");
  var info=$("m5_genericFailureInfo");
  if(!sel){
    if(typeof m5_recalcManagementScores==="function")m5_recalcManagementScores();
    return;
  }
  var opts=m5_getGenericFailureOptions();
  var current=m5_data&&m5_data.generic_failure?String(m5_data.generic_failure):"";
  if(!current&&opts.length){
    var defaultOpt=opts.find(function(o){return o.id===M3_DEFAULT_GENERIC_FAILURE_ID;})||opts.find(function(o){return o.label&&o.label.indexOf("Vessel")>=0&&o.label.indexOf("KODRUM")>=0;});
    if(defaultOpt){current=defaultOpt.id; if(m5_data)m5_data.generic_failure=current;}
  }
  sel.innerHTML='<option value="">— select —</option>';
  opts.forEach(function(o){
    var op=document.createElement("option");
    op.value=o.id||"";
    op.textContent=o.label||o.id||"";
    op.dataset.note=o.note||"";
    sel.appendChild(op);
  });
  if(current){
    var hasCurrent=Array.prototype.some.call(sel.options,function(o){return o.value===current;});
    sel.value=hasCurrent?current:"";
  }
  if(info){
    var selected=opts.find(function(o){return o.id===sel.value;});
    info.textContent=selected&&selected.note?selected.note:"Select a row from the GFF library (equipment / component, Table 3.1).";
  }
  if (m5_data) {
    var currentSelected = opts.find(function(o){ return o.id===sel.value; });
    if (currentSelected && currentSelected.gff_defaults && m5_isGffEmpty(m5_data.generic_failure_gff)) {
      m5_data.generic_failure_gff = {
        small: currentSelected.gff_defaults.small,
        medium: currentSelected.gff_defaults.medium,
        large: currentSelected.gff_defaults.large,
        rupture: currentSelected.gff_defaults.rupture,
        total: currentSelected.gff_defaults.total
      };
    }
  }
  var titleEl=$("m5_genericFailureCalcTitle");
  if(titleEl&&m5_data)titleEl.value=(m5_data.generic_failure_calculation_title!=null&&m5_data.generic_failure_calculation_title!==undefined)?String(m5_data.generic_failure_calculation_title):"";

  m5_renderGenericFailureTable();
  if(typeof m5_recalcManagementScores==="function")m5_recalcManagementScores();
  if(typeof m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines==="function")m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines();
}

function m5_recalcManagementScores(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  if(!m5_data.management_questionnaire||typeof m5_data.management_questionnaire!=="object"){
    m5_data.management_questionnaire={answers:{},pscore:null,fms:null};
  }
  var cfg=m5_getManagementQuestionnaireConfig();
  var pscoreRaw = m5_data.management_questionnaire.pscore;
  if ((pscoreRaw == null || pscoreRaw === "") && cfg && cfg.final_score != null) pscoreRaw = cfg.final_score;
  var pscore = (pscoreRaw==null||pscoreRaw==="") ? null : Number(pscoreRaw);
  if (!Number.isFinite(pscore)) pscore = null;
  var fms=(pscore==null)?null:(2.38*Math.exp(-0.012*pscore));
  m5_data.management_questionnaire.pscore=pscore;
  m5_data.management_questionnaire.fms=fms;
}

function m5_managementAnswerChanged(qid,val){
  // Deprecated by final-score only flow; keep function for backward compatibility.
  if(!m5_data || !m5_data.management_questionnaire || typeof m5_data.management_questionnaire!=="object") return;
  var n=(val==null||val==="")?null:Number(val);
  m5_data.management_questionnaire.pscore = Number.isFinite(n)?n:null;
  m5_recalcManagementScores();
  if(typeof m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines==="function")m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines();
}

function m5_materialStress(m){
  var v=getRowProp(m,["stress_MPa","stress_allow_mpa","stress_allow","Stress_Allow","stress","allowable_stress","Allowable_Stress_MPa","STRESS_ALLOW_MPA","STRESS ALLOW. (MPa)","STRESS ALLOW","Stress Allow","Stress_Allow_MPa"]);
  if(v!=null&&v!==""){var n=Number(v);if(Number.isFinite(n))return n;}
  var k=Object.keys(m||{});
  for(var i=0;i<k.length;i++){if(/stress|allow/i.test(k[i])){var n=Number(m[k[i]]);if(Number.isFinite(n))return n;}}
  return null;
}
function m5_materialDetailFields(m){
  var map=[{keys:["specification","material_spec","Material_Spec","Spec","SPEC"],label:"Specification"},{keys:["material_group","Material_Group","material group","Material Group"],label:"Material group"},{keys:["design_temp_C","design_temp","Design_Temp_C","Design_Temp","design_temp_c"],label:"Design temp (°C)"},{keys:["product_form","Product_Form","product form","Product Form"],label:"Product form"},{keys:["UTS_MPa","UTS","uts","ultimate_tensile_strength"],label:"UTS (MPa)"},{keys:["SMYS_MPa","SMYS","smys","specified_minimum_yield"],label:"SMYS (MPa)"},{keys:["stress_MPa","stress_allow_mpa","Stress_Allow","stress","allowable_stress"],label:"Stress (MPa)"}];
  var out=[];
  map.forEach(function(x){var v=getRowProp(m,x.keys);if(v!=null&&v!=="")out.push(x.label+": "+v);});
  return out;
}

/** Parse course index from M1 component name e.g. "Shell Course 3". */
function m5_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(name){
  var m=String(name||"").match(/shell\s+course\s*(\d+)/i);
  if(m) return parseInt(m[1],10);
  m=String(name||"").match(/course[\s\-]*(\d+)/i);
  if(m) return parseInt(m[1],10);
  return null;
}
function m5_isTankShellCourseCalc(c){
  if(!c) return false;
  if(String(c.component_type||"").toLowerCase()==="shell_course") return true;
  if(m5_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(c.calculation_title)) return true;
  return false;
}
function m5_resolveShellCourseIndex(c){
  if(!c) return null;
  if(c.course_index!=null&&Number.isFinite(Number(c.course_index))) return parseInt(c.course_index,10);
  return m5_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(c.calculation_title);
}
function m5_getProductSpecificGravity(){
  var sg=null;
  if(typeof m2_numFieldVal==="function"){
    sg=m2_numFieldVal("m2_op_sg");
    if(sg==null) sg=m2_numFieldVal("m2_liq_sg");
  }
  if(sg==null&&activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry){
    var m2=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module2_chemistry;
    var sp=m2.stored_product||{}, sl=m2.stored_liquid||{};
    sg=sp.specific_gravity!=null?Number(sp.specific_gravity):(sl.specific_gravity!=null?Number(sl.specific_gravity):null);
  }
  return Number.isFinite(sg)&&sg>0?sg:1.0;
}
function m5_getLiquidHeadAboveCourseForTmin(courseIndex){
  if(!Number.isFinite(courseIndex)||courseIndex<1) return null;
  var geom=typeof m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry==="function"?m3_getM1ReleaseGeometry():{};
  var hliq=typeof m3_resolveMaxFillHeightM==="function"?m3_resolveMaxFillHeightM(geom):null;
  if(hliq==null&&geom.shell_height_m) hliq=geom.shell_height_m;
  if(!Number.isFinite(hliq)) return null;
  var elev=typeof m3_getCourseElevationM==="function"?m3_getCourseElevationM(courseIndex,geom):null;
  if(elev==null||!Number.isFinite(elev)) return null;
  var H=hliq-elev;
  return H>0?H:null;
}
/** API 650 one-foot metric: t_min = 4.9·D·(H_F−H_0)·G / (S·E) [mm]; CA added when provided. */
function m5_calcTankShellTminMetric(c,CA){
  if(!c||c.diameter_mm==null||c.stress_allow_mpa==null||c.joint_factor==null) return "—";
  var Dm=parseFloat(c.diameter_mm)/1000;
  var S=parseFloat(c.stress_allow_mpa);
  var E=parseFloat(c.joint_factor);
  if(!Number.isFinite(Dm)||Dm<=0||!Number.isFinite(S)||S<=0||!Number.isFinite(E)||E<=0||E>1) return "—";
  var ci=m5_resolveShellCourseIndex(c);
  if(!ci) return "—";
  var H=m5_getLiquidHeadAboveCourseForTmin(ci);
  if(H==null||H<=0) return "—";
  var G=m5_getProductSpecificGravity();
  var denom=S*E;
  if(denom<=0) return "Invalid";
  var tMin=(4.9*Dm*H*G)/denom;
  if(Number.isFinite(CA)&&CA>0) tMin+=CA;
  if(c&&typeof c==="object"){
    c.course_index=ci;
    c.liquid_head_above_course_m=Math.round(H*1000)/1000;
    c.liquid_specific_gravity=G;
  }
  return tMin>0?tMin.toFixed(2):"—";
}

function m5_calcTminValue(c,P,CA){
  if(!c) return "—";
  if(typeof m5_isTankShellCourseCalc==="function"&&m5_isTankShellCourseCalc(c)){
    return m5_calcTankShellTminMetric(c,CA);
  }
  if(c.diameter_mm==null||c.stress_allow_mpa==null||c.joint_factor==null||!P||!c.diameter_mm||!c.stress_allow_mpa||!c.joint_factor||c.joint_factor<=0||c.joint_factor>1)return "—";
  var D=c.diameter_mm,S=c.stress_allow_mpa,E=c.joint_factor;
  var R=D/2,L=D,denom,tMin,M,cosA,C;
  switch(c.component_type||"shell"){
    case "shell": denom=S*E-0.6*P; if(denom<=0)return "Invalid"; tMin=(P*R)/(denom); break;
    case "elliptical": denom=2*S*E-0.2*P; if(denom<=0)return "Invalid"; tMin=(P*D)/(denom); break;
    case "torispherical": M=parseFloat(c.m_factor)||1.54; denom=2*S*E-0.2*P; if(denom<=0)return "Invalid"; tMin=(P*L*M)/(denom); break;
    case "hemispherical": denom=4*S*E-0.4*P; if(denom<=0)return "Invalid"; tMin=(P*D)/(denom); break;
    case "conical": cosA=Math.cos((parseFloat(c.apex_angle_deg)||30)*Math.PI/180); if(cosA<=0)return "Invalid"; denom=(2*S*E-0.2*P)*cosA; if(denom<=0)return "Invalid"; tMin=(P*D)/(denom); break;
    case "toriconical": M=parseFloat(c.m_factor)||1.54; cosA=Math.cos((parseFloat(c.apex_angle_deg)||30)*Math.PI/180); if(cosA<=0)return "Invalid"; denom=2*S*E-0.2*P; if(denom<=0)return "Invalid"; var tKnuckle=(P*L*M)/(denom),tCone=(P*D)/(denom*cosA); tMin=Math.max(tKnuckle,tCone); break;
    case "flathead": C=parseFloat(c.c_factor)||0.3; if(C<=0||S*E<=0)return "Invalid"; tMin=D*Math.sqrt((C*P)/(S*E)); break;
    case "nozzle": case "largeopening": denom=S*E-0.6*P; if(denom<=0)return "Invalid"; tMin=(P*R)/(denom); break;
    default: denom=S*E-0.6*P; if(denom<=0)return "Invalid"; tMin=(P*R)/(denom); break;
  }
  return tMin.toFixed(2);
}

function m5_addCalc(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  if(!m5_data.min_wall_calcs)m5_data.min_wall_calcs=[];
  var prev=m5_data.min_wall_calcs.length?m5_data.min_wall_calcs[m5_data.min_wall_calcs.length-1]:null;
  var holeCopy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(prev,m5_data)));
  m5_data.min_wall_calcs.push({calculation_title:"",component_type:"shell_course",diameter_mm:null,material_spec:null,stress_allow_mpa:null,joint_factor:1,apex_angle_deg:30,m_factor:1.54,c_factor:0.3,component_nominal_thickness_mm:null,measured_thickness_mm:null,measured_thickness_date:null,corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr:null,corrosion_rate_notes:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,start_date:null,thinning_subtype:"",thinning_subtype_custom:"",gff_hole_selection:holeCopy});
  m5_renderMinWallCalcs("internal", { activeIdx: m5_data.min_wall_calcs.length - 1 });
}
function m5_addExternalCalc(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  if(!m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs)m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs=[];
  var prevE=m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs.length?m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs[m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs.length-1]:null;
  var holeCopyE=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(prevE,m5_data)));
  m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs.push({calculation_title:"",component_type:"shell",diameter_mm:null,material_spec:null,stress_allow_mpa:null,joint_factor:1,apex_angle_deg:30,m_factor:1.54,c_factor:0.3,component_nominal_thickness_mm:null,measured_thickness_mm:null,measured_thickness_date:null,corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr:null,corrosion_rate_notes:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,start_date:null,external_damage_mechanism:"",gff_hole_selection:holeCopyE});
  m5_renderMinWallCalcs("external", { activeIdx: m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs.length - 1 });
}

function m5_removeCalc(idx,surface){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var key=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data[key])return;
  var arr=m5_data[key];
  if(arr.length<=1)return;
  var row=arr[idx];
  var label=(surface==="external"?"EXT ":"Comp ")+(idx+1);
  if(row&&String(row.calculation_title||"").trim())label=String(row.calculation_title).trim();
  if(typeof window!=="undefined"&&window.confirm&&!window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete "'+label+'"?'))return;
  var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
  var cont=typeof $==="function"?$(contId):document.getElementById(contId);
  var prevRoot=cont&&cont.querySelector?cont.querySelector('.m5-mw-tabs-root[data-m5-surface="'+surface+'"]'):null;
  var pi=prevRoot?parseInt(prevRoot.getAttribute("data-active-idx"),10):NaN;
  var len=arr.length;
  var sel=(isNaN(pi)||pi<0||pi>=len)?0:pi;
  arr.splice(idx,1);
  var n=arr.length;
  var activeIdx=0;
  if(sel<idx)activeIdx=sel;
  else if(sel>idx)activeIdx=sel-1;
  else activeIdx=Math.min(idx,n-1);
  if(activeIdx<0)activeIdx=0;
  if(activeIdx>=n)activeIdx=Math.max(0,n-1);
  m5_renderMinWallCalcs(surface,{activeIdx:activeIdx});
}
function m5_removeLastCalc(surface){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var key=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data[key])return;
  if(!m5_data[key].length)return;
  m5_data[key].splice(m5_data[key].length-1,1);
  var n=m5_data[key].length;
  m5_renderMinWallCalcs(surface,{activeIdx:Math.max(0,n-1)});
}

var m5_iconChevronDown = '<svg class="m5-ico" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"/></svg>';

var m5_iconPlus = '<svg class="m5-ico" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>';

function m5_toggleCalcBody(btn){
  if(!btn || !btn.closest) return;
  var card = btn.closest(".card");
  if(!card) return;
  var body = card.querySelector(".m5-calc-body");
  if(!body) return;
  var collapsed = body.classList.toggle("is-collapsed");
  btn.innerHTML = collapsed ? m5_iconChevronUp : m5_iconChevronDown;
  btn.setAttribute("aria-label", collapsed ? "Expand" : "Collapse");
  btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", collapsed ? "false" : "true");
}

function m5_getCrackingTypes(){
  var mechs=m5_getMechs();
  if(!mechs.length)return [];
  return mechs.filter(function(m){
    var cat=(m.category||m.Category||"").toLowerCase();
    var name=(m5_fName(m)||"").toLowerCase();
    return cat.indexOf("crack")>=0||name.indexOf("crack")>=0;
  });
}
function m5_getOtherTypes(){
  var mechs=m5_getMechs();
  if(!mechs.length)return [];
  return mechs.filter(function(m){
    var cat=(m.category||m.Category||"").toLowerCase();
    var name=(m5_fName(m)||"").toLowerCase();
    return cat.indexOf("crack")<0&&name.indexOf("crack")<0;
  });
}

function m5_addCrackingCalc(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  if(!m5_data.cracking_calcs)m5_data.cracking_calcs=[];
  m5_data.cracking_calcs.push({calculation_title:"",cracking_type:"",component_type:"shell",material_spec:null,susceptibility:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,last_inspection_date:null,start_date:null,confidence_level:"medium",insp_a:0,insp_b:0,insp_c:0,insp_d:0,comments:""});
  m5_renderCrackingCalcs();
}

function m5_removeCrackingCalc(idx){
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data.cracking_calcs)return;
  if(m5_data.cracking_calcs.length<=1)return;
  m5_data.cracking_calcs.splice(idx,1);
  m5_renderCrackingCalcs();
}
function m5_removeLastCrackingCalc(){
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data.cracking_calcs)return;
  if(!m5_data.cracking_calcs.length)return;
  m5_data.cracking_calcs.splice(m5_data.cracking_calcs.length-1,1);
  m5_renderCrackingCalcs();
}

function m5_crackAssessmentOptions(selected){
  var opts=[
    {v:"specialist",t:"Specialist assessment"},
    {v:"nde_findings",t:"NDE / inspection findings"},
    {v:"screening_default_susceptibility",t:"Industry screening susceptibility"},
    {v:"conservative_default",t:"Conservative default"}
  ];
  var s=(selected==null?"":String(selected));
  return '<option value="">— select —</option>'+opts.map(function(o){return '<option value="'+o.v+'"'+(s===o.v?' selected':'')+'>'+o.t+'</option>';}).join("");
}
function m5_susceptibilityOptions(selected){
  var bands = Array.isArray(REF.susceptibilityBands) && REF.susceptibilityBands.length ? REF.susceptibilityBands : null;
  var opts;
  if(bands && bands.length){
    opts = bands.map(function(b){
      var sc = b.score!=null ? parseInt(b.score,10) : null;
      var lbl = (b.label!=null&&String(b.label).trim()!=="") ? String(b.label).trim() : "";
      var t = (Number.isFinite(sc) ? sc + (lbl ? " | " + lbl : "") : lbl) || "—";
      return {v: sc, t: t};
    }).filter(function(o){ return o.v!=null && Number.isFinite(o.v); });
  }
  if(!opts||!opts.length){
    opts=[
      {v:1,t:"1 | Low — not probable but check"},
      {v:2,t:"2 | Medium-low — possible but well above design temp and pressure"},
      {v:3,t:"3 | Moderate — possible but above operating temp approximately at design"},
      {v:4,t:"4 | Medium-high — below design and above operating"},
      {v:5,t:"5 | High — above ambient and below operating pressure and temp"}
    ];
  }
  var s=(selected==null?"":String(selected));
  return '<option value="">— select —</option>'+opts.map(function(o){return '<option value="'+o.v+'"'+(s===String(o.v)?' selected':'')+'>'+String(o.t).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;")+'</option>';}).join("");
}

function m5_renderCrackingCalcs(){
  var cont=$("m5_crackingCalcs"); if(!cont)return;
  var calcs=m5_data&&m5_data.cracking_calcs?m5_data.cracking_calcs:[];
