  var crackTypes=m5_getCrackingTypes();
  var crackOpts=crackTypes.map(function(m){var id=m5_fId(m),n=m5_fName(m);return '<option value="'+(id||n||"").replace(/"/g,"&quot;")+'" data-name="'+(n||"").replace(/"/g,"&quot;")+'">'+(n||id||"")+'</option>';}).join("");
  var compTypes=m5_getComponentTypeOptions();
  var compOptsCrack=compTypes.map(function(ct){var note=ct.factor==="C"?"C factor":ct.factor==="Special"?"reinforcement":"factor "+ct.factor;return '<option value="'+ct.id+'">'+ct.label+' ('+ct.ref+') — '+note+'</option>';}).join("");
  var lib=REF.materialLib||[];
  var matOpts=lib.map(function(m,i){var n=m5_materialName(m)||"Material "+(i+1);return '<option value="'+n.replace(/"/g,"&quot;")+'" data-idx="'+i+'">'+n+'</option>';}).join("");
  var html="";
  calcs.forEach(function(c,idx){
    var tit=String(c.calculation_title||"").replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;");
    var commVal=(c.comments||"").replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;");
    var comp=c.component_type||"shell";
    var inspA=(c.insp_a!=null?c.insp_a:0), inspB=(c.insp_b!=null?c.insp_b:0), inspC=(c.insp_c!=null?c.insp_c:0), inspD=(c.insp_d!=null?c.insp_d:0);
    var conf=(c.confidence_level||"medium");
    var susVal=(c.susceptibility!=null?c.susceptibility:(c.df_score!=null?c.df_score:""));
    var susOpts=m5_susceptibilityOptions(susVal);
    html+='<div class="card" style="margin-top:10px;padding:12px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent)" data-idx="'+idx+'">';
    html+='<div class="m5-calc-head"><span class="ttl">Component name</span><select class="m5_crackTitle m5_m1CompSel" data-idx="'+idx+'" title="Select a component registered in M1 Component design" onchange="m5_onM1ComponentSelectAux('+idx+',\'cracking\')">'+m5_m1ComponentSelectMarkup(tit)+'</select><div class="acts">'+(calcs.length>1?'<button type="button" class="w" onclick="m5_removeCrackingCalc('+idx+')" title="Remove" aria-label="Remove">'+m5_iconClose+'</button>':'')+'<button type="button" class="w" onclick="m5_toggleCalcBody(this)" aria-expanded="true" aria-label="Collapse">'+m5_iconChevronDown+'</button></div></div>';
    html+='<div class="m5-calc-body">';
    html+='<div class="g2"><div class="field"><label>Damage Mechanism</label><select class="m5_crackType" data-idx="'+idx+'" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')"><option value="">— select —</option>'+crackOpts+'</select></div>';
    html+='<div class="field"><label>Component type <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'component_type\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></label><select class="m5_crackComponentType" data-idx="'+idx+'" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')"><option value="">— select —</option>'+compOptsCrack+'</select></div></div>';
    var dnM1Cr=(typeof osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate==="function"?osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate():null)||"";
    html+='<div class="g2"><div class="field"><label>Date new <span class="hint" style="font-weight:500">(from M1)</span> <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'date_new\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></label><input type="text" readonly class="iro m5_crackStartDateRo" data-idx="'+idx+'" tabindex="-1" value="'+(String(dnM1Cr).replace(/"/g,"&quot;"))+'" placeholder="—" title="Date vessel new from Module 1 (Asset register)"/></div>';
    html+='<div class="field"><label>Susceptibility (1–5) <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'susceptibility\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></label><select class="m5_crackSusceptibility" data-idx="'+idx+'" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')">'+susOpts+'</select></div></div>';
    html+='<div class="g2"><div class="field"><label>Time basis</label><select class="m5_crackDfTime" data-idx="'+idx+'" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')">'+m5_dfTimeOptions(c.df_time_basis)+'</select></div>';
    html+='<div class="field"><label>Cracking assessment by <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'cracking_assessment\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></label><select class="m5_crackDfSource" data-idx="'+idx+'" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')">'+m5_crackAssessmentOptions(c.df_source)+'</select></div></div>';
    var lastInspDateEsc=(m5_normalizeDateString(c.last_inspection_date)||"").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");
    html+='<div class="g2"><div class="field"><label>Last inspection date <span class="ref-std">(inspection)</span> <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'last_inspection_date\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></label><input class="m5_crackLastInspDate m5-df-date-pick" data-idx="'+idx+'" type="text" placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" value="'+lastInspDateEsc+'" onpaste="m5_datePaste(event,this)" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')" oninput="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')" onfocus="m5_showDatePicker(this)" onclick="m5_showDatePicker(this)"/></div>';
    html+='<div class="field"><label>Next possible inspection date <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'next_inspection_date\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></label><input class="m5_crackDfDate m5-df-date-pick" data-idx="'+idx+'" type="text" placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" value="'+((m5_normalizeDateString(c.df_custom_date)||"").replace(/"/g,"&quot;"))+'" onpaste="m5_datePaste(event,this)" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')" oninput="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')" onfocus="m5_showDatePicker(this)" onclick="m5_showDatePicker(this)"/></div></div>';
    html+='<div class="g2"><div class="field"><label>Confidence prior / data quality <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'confidence_prior\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></label><select class="m5_crackConfidence" data-idx="'+idx+'" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')">'+m5_confidenceOptions(conf)+'</select></div></div>';
    html+='<div class="field"><label>Inspection effectiveness categories</label><div class="m5-insp-compact">';
    html+='<div class="ic" title="Highest effectiveness (best at finding/quantifying the mechanism)"><b>A</b><span class="il">highest confidence</span><input class="m5_crackInspA" data-idx="'+idx+'" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="'+inspA+'" oninput="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')"></div>';
    html+='<div class="ic" title="Good effectiveness"><b>B</b><span class="il">good confidence</span><input class="m5_crackInspB" data-idx="'+idx+'" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="'+inspB+'" oninput="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')"></div>';
    html+='<div class="ic" title="Moderate effectiveness"><b>C</b><span class="il">moderate confidence</span><input class="m5_crackInspC" data-idx="'+idx+'" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="'+inspC+'" oninput="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')"></div>';
    html+='<div class="ic" title="Lowest effectiveness"><b>D</b><span class="il">low confidence</span><input class="m5_crackInspD" data-idx="'+idx+'" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="'+inspD+'" oninput="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')"></div>';
    html+='</div></div></div>';
    html+='<div class="m5-df-result"><div class="hd">DF Result</div><div class="row"><div><div class="k">Susceptibility (at t)</div><div class="v m5_crackDfScoreResult" data-idx="'+idx+'">'+(c.df_score!=null?String(c.df_score)+' | '+m5_susceptibilityBandLabel(c.df_score):'—')+'</div></div><div><div class="k">Base D<sub>f</sub> (Table 2.C.1.3)</div><div class="v m5_crackDfFactorResult" data-idx="'+idx+'">'+(typeof m5_crack581DfCalc==="function"?(function(){var r=m5_crack581DfCalc(c);return r&&r.dfB!=null?String(r.dfB):"—";})():"—")+'</div></div><div><div class="k">D<sub>f</sub> (581, age adjusted)</div><div class="v m5_crackDfAdjResult" data-idx="'+idx+'">'+(typeof m5_crack581DfText==="function"?m5_crack581DfText(c):"—")+'</div></div></div></div>';
    html+=(typeof m5_htmlCrack581DfResult==="function"?m5_htmlCrack581DfResult(c,idx):"");
    var crackPofBand=(typeof m5_crackingPofBandUiText==="function"?m5_crackingPofBandUiText(c):"\u2014");
    html+='<div class="m5-df-screening-pof" style="margin-top:10px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font-size:11px;line-height:1.45"><div class="k" style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">PoF band <span class="ref-std">(M3 susceptibility \u2014 same in M6)</span></div><div class="v m5_crackScreeningPofResult" data-idx="'+idx+'" style="font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);color:var(--accent)">'+escHtml(crackPofBand)+'</div><div class="hint" style="font-size:10px;margin-top:6px;line-height:1.4">581 Part 2 cracking: PoF band = susceptibility above. D<sub>f</sub> from <strong>Table 2.C.1.3</strong> + <strong>age<sup>1.1</sup></strong>. Owner PoF Mapping (GFF\u00d7FMS\u00d7DF numeric \u2192 1\u20135) does <strong>not</strong> apply to cracking band.</div></div>';
    html+='<div class="field"><label>Material</label><select class="m5_crackMaterial" data-idx="'+idx+'" onchange="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+');m5_crackMaterialChangedFor('+idx+')"><option value="">— select —</option>'+matOpts+'</select></div>';
    html+='<div class="m5_crackMaterialDetails hint" data-idx="'+idx+'" style="margin-top:8px;padding:8px;background:var(--input);border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;min-height:1.5em">Select a material to see specification, design temp, composition, product form.</div>';
    html+='<div class="field"><label>Comments</label><textarea class="m5_crackComments" data-idx="'+idx+'" rows="4" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;min-height:80px" placeholder="Enter comments..." oninput="m5_syncCrackingFromUI('+idx+')">'+commVal+'</textarea></div></div></div>';
  });
  cont.innerHTML=html;
  calcs.forEach(function(c,idx){

    if(titEl){titEl.value=c.calculation_title||"";}
    var sel=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(sel&&c.cracking_type){sel.value=c.cracking_type;}
    var compSel=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackComponentType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(compSel&&(c.component_type||"shell")){compSel.value=c.component_type||"shell";}
    var susSel=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackSusceptibility[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(susSel&&(c.susceptibility!=null||c.df_score!=null)){var v=c.susceptibility!=null?c.susceptibility:c.df_score; susSel.value=String(v);}
    var dfTime=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackDfTime[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(dfTime&&c.df_time_basis){dfTime.value=String(c.df_time_basis);}
    var dfSource=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackDfSource[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(dfSource&&c.df_source){dfSource.value=String(c.df_source);}
    var dfDate=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackDfDate[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(dfDate&&c.df_custom_date){dfDate.value=m5_normalizeDateString(c.df_custom_date)||"";}
    var lastInspDate=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackLastInspDate[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(lastInspDate){lastInspDate.value=m5_normalizeDateString(c.last_inspection_date)||"";}
    var crackRo=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackStartDateRo[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(crackRo&&typeof osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate==="function"){crackRo.value=osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate()||"";}
    var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackMaterial[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    if(mat&&c.material_spec){mat.value=c.material_spec;}
    m5_crackMaterialChangedFor(idx);
  });
}

function m5_crackMaterialChangedFor(idx){
  var cont=$("m5_crackingCalcs"); if(!cont)return;
  var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackMaterial[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var det=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackMaterialDetails[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(!det)return;
  if(!mat||mat.selectedIndex<=0){det.textContent="Select a material to see specification, design temp, composition, product form.";return;}
  var lib=REF.materialLib; var i=parseInt(mat.options[mat.selectedIndex].dataset.idx,10);
  if(lib&&lib[i]){var m=lib[i], parts=m5_materialDetailFields(m); var esc=function(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");};
  det.innerHTML=parts.length?parts.map(function(p){return "<span style='display:block'>"+esc(p)+"</span>";}).join(""):"No details available.";}
  m5_syncCrackingFromUI(idx);
}

function m5_syncCrackingFromUI(idx){
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data.cracking_calcs||!m5_data.cracking_calcs[idx])return;
  var cont=$("m5_crackingCalcs"); if(!cont)return;
  var c=m5_data.cracking_calcs[idx];
  var tit=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackTitle[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var ct=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var compType=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackComponentType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var susceptibility=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackSusceptibility[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var dfTime=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackDfTime[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var dfSource=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackDfSource[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var dfDate=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackDfDate[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var lastInspDate=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackLastInspDate[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var conf=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackConfidence[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspA=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackInspA[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspB=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackInspB[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspC=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackInspC[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspD=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackInspD[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackMaterial[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var comm=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackComments[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  c.calculation_title=tit&&tit.value?String(tit.value).trim()||null:null;
  c.cracking_type=ct&&ct.value?ct.value:null;
  c.component_type=compType&&compType.value?compType.value:"shell";
  var susVal=susceptibility&&susceptibility.value?parseInt(susceptibility.value,10):null;
  c.susceptibility=Number.isFinite(susVal)?susVal:null;
  c.df_score=c.susceptibility!=null?c.susceptibility:null;
  c.df_time_basis=dfTime&&dfTime.value?dfTime.value:"t0";
  c.df_source=dfSource&&dfSource.value?dfSource.value:null;
  c.df_custom_date=m5_normalizeDateString(dfDate&&dfDate.value?dfDate.value:null);
  c.last_inspection_date=m5_normalizeDateString(lastInspDate&&lastInspDate.value?lastInspDate.value:null);
  c.confidence_level=conf&&conf.value?conf.value:"medium";
  c.insp_a=m5_nonNegInt(inspA&&inspA.value);
  c.insp_b=m5_nonNegInt(inspB&&inspB.value);
  c.insp_c=m5_nonNegInt(inspC&&inspC.value);
  c.insp_d=m5_nonNegInt(inspD&&inspD.value);
  c.start_date=typeof osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate==="function"?osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate():null;
  var scoreOut=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackDfScoreResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(scoreOut) scoreOut.textContent=(c.df_score!=null?String(c.df_score)+" | "+m5_susceptibilityBandLabel(c.df_score):"\u2014");
  if(typeof m5_refreshCrack581DfUi==="function") m5_refreshCrack581DfUi(c, idx);
  var screenOut=cont.querySelector('.m5_crackScreeningPofResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(screenOut && typeof m5_crackingPofBandUiText==="function"){
    screenOut.textContent = m5_crackingPofBandUiText(c) || "\u2014";
  }
  c.material_spec=mat&&mat.selectedIndex>0?mat.options[mat.selectedIndex].value:null;
  c.comments=comm&&comm.value?comm.value.trim()||null:null;
  if(typeof m5_refreshM3AuxGffLines==="function")m5_refreshM3AuxGffLines();
}

function m5_addOtherCalc(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  if(!m5_data.other_calcs)m5_data.other_calcs=[];
  m5_data.other_calcs.push({calculation_title:"",mechanism_type:"",component_type:"shell",material_spec:null,pof_score:null,df_score:null,df_time_basis:"t0",df_source:null,df_custom_date:null,last_inspection_date:null,start_date:null,comments:""});
  m5_renderOtherCalcs();
}
function m5_removeOtherCalc(idx){
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data.other_calcs)return;
  if(m5_data.other_calcs.length<=1)return;
  m5_data.other_calcs.splice(idx,1);
  m5_renderOtherCalcs();
}
function m5_removeLastOtherCalc(){
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data.other_calcs)return;
  if(!m5_data.other_calcs.length)return;
  m5_data.other_calcs.splice(m5_data.other_calcs.length-1,1);
  m5_renderOtherCalcs();
}
function m5_renderOtherCalcs(){
  var cont=$("m5_otherCalcs"); if(!cont)return;
  var calcs=m5_data&&m5_data.other_calcs?m5_data.other_calcs:[];

function m5_otherMaterialChangedFor(idx){
  var cont=$("m5_otherCalcs"); if(!cont)return;
  var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherMaterial[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var det=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherMaterialDetails[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(!det)return;
  if(!mat||mat.selectedIndex<=0){det.textContent="Select a material to see specification, design temp, composition, product form.";return;}
  var lib=REF.materialLib; var i=parseInt(mat.options[mat.selectedIndex].dataset.idx,10);
  if(lib&&lib[i]){var m=lib[i], parts=m5_materialDetailFields(m); var esc=function(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");};
  det.innerHTML=parts.length?parts.map(function(p){return "<span style='display:block'>"+esc(p)+"</span>";}).join(""):"No details available.";}
  m5_syncOtherFromUI(idx);
}
function m5_syncOtherFromUI(idx){
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data.other_calcs||!m5_data.other_calcs[idx])return;
  var cont=$("m5_otherCalcs"); if(!cont)return;
  var c=m5_data.other_calcs[idx];
  var tit=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherTitle[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var ot=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var compType=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherComponentType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var pof=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherPof[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var dfScore=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherDfScore[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var dfTime=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherDfTime[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var dfSource=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherDfSource[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var dfDate=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherDfDate[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var lastInspDate=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherLastInspDate[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var conf=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherConfidence[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspA=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherInspA[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspB=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherInspB[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspC=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherInspC[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspD=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherInspD[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherMaterial[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var comm=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherComments[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  c.calculation_title=tit&&tit.value?String(tit.value).trim()||null:null;
  c.mechanism_type=ot&&ot.value?ot.value:null;
  c.component_type=compType&&compType.value?compType.value:"shell";
  c.pof_score=pof&&pof.value?parseInt(pof.value,10):null;
  c.df_score=null;
  c.confidence_level=conf&&conf.value?conf.value:"medium";
  c.insp_a=m5_nonNegInt(inspA&&inspA.value);
  c.insp_b=m5_nonNegInt(inspB&&inspB.value);
  c.insp_c=m5_nonNegInt(inspC&&inspC.value);
  c.insp_d=m5_nonNegInt(inspD&&inspD.value);
  c.df_time_basis=dfTime&&dfTime.value?dfTime.value:"t0";
  c.df_source=dfSource&&dfSource.value?dfSource.value:null;
  c.df_custom_date=m5_normalizeDateString(dfDate&&dfDate.value?dfDate.value:null);
  c.last_inspection_date=m5_normalizeDateString(lastInspDate&&lastInspDate.value?lastInspDate.value:null);
  c.start_date=typeof osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate==="function"?osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate():null;
  var scoreOut=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherDfScoreResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(scoreOut) scoreOut.textContent=(c.df_score!=null?String(c.df_score)+" | "+m5_dfScoreBandLabel(c.df_score):"—");
  var dfOut=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherDfFactorResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(dfOut) dfOut.textContent=m5_damageFactorText(c.df_score);
  var dfAdjOut=cont.querySelector('.m5_otherDfAdjResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(dfAdjOut) dfAdjOut.textContent=m5_adjustedDamageFactorText(c.df_score, c.confidence_level, c.insp_a, c.insp_b, c.insp_c, c.insp_d);
  c.material_spec=mat&&mat.selectedIndex>0?mat.options[mat.selectedIndex].value:null;
  c.comments=comm&&comm.value?comm.value.trim()||null:null;
  if(typeof m5_refreshM3AuxGffLines==="function")m5_refreshM3AuxGffLines();
}

function m5_jointFactorOptionRows(){
  return [
    [1,"E = 1.00 Type 1 butt joint, full RT"],
    [0.9,"E = 0.90   Type 2 butt joint, full RT"],
    [0.85,"E = 0.85   Type 1 butt joint, spot RT"],
    [0.8,"E = 0.80   Type 2 butt joint, spot RT"],
    [0.7,"E = 0.70   Type 1 butt joint, no RT"],
    [0.65,"E = 0.65   Type 2 butt joint, no RT"],
    [0.6,"E = 0.60   Type 3 joint, no RT"]
  ];
}
function m5_defaultJointFactor() {
  return 1;
}
function m5_jointFactorMatchStored(n){
  if(n==null||n==="")return null;
  var x=typeof n==="number"?n:parseFloat(String(n),10);
  if(isNaN(x))return null;
  var rows=m5_jointFactorOptionRows(),i,v;
  for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    v=rows[i][0];
    if(Math.abs(x-v)<1e-6)return v;
  }
  if(Math.abs(x-0.95)<1e-6)return 0.9;
  if(Math.abs(x-0.75)<1e-6)return 0.7;
  return null;
}

function m5_mwSelectTab(surface, tabIdx){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  if(typeof m5_renderMinWallCalcs==="function"){m5_renderMinWallCalcs(surface,{activeIdx:tabIdx});}
}
function m5_findM1ComponentByName(name){
  var n=String(name||"").trim();
  if(!n)return null;
  var tb=typeof $==="function"?$("m1_componentDesignTbody"):null;
  if(tb){
    var found=null;
    tb.querySelectorAll("tr.m1-cd-data-row").forEach(function(tr){
      var cn=typeof m1_readComponentNameFromRow==="function"?m1_readComponentNameFromRow(tr):"";
      if(!m5_componentNamesMatch(cn,n))return;
      var matSel=tr.querySelector("select.m1-cd-material");
      var thkInp=tr.querySelector("input.m1-cd-thk");
      found={
        component_name:cn,
        material_spec:matSel&&matSel.value?(typeof m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel==="function"?m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel(matSel.value):String(matSel.value).trim()):"",
        nominal_thickness_mm:thkInp?numOrNull(thkInp.value):null
      };
    });
    if(found)return found;
  }
  var rows=typeof m1_getComponentDesignRows==="function"?m1_getComponentDesignRows():[];
  for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
    if(m5_componentNamesMatch(rows[i].component_name,n))return rows[i];
  }
  return null;
}
function m5_componentNamesMatch(a,b){
  var sa=String(a||"").trim(), sb=String(b||"").trim();
  if(!sa||!sb)return false;
  if(sa===sb||sa.toLowerCase()===sb.toLowerCase())return true;
  if(typeof m1_resolveTankComponentLabel==="function"){
    var ra=m1_resolveTankComponentLabel(sa), rb=m1_resolveTankComponentLabel(sb);
    if(ra&&rb&&ra===rb)return true;
  }
  return false;
}
/** Pull material, nominal t, diameter, and shell-course type from M1 Component design for this calc row. */
function m5_syncCalcRowFromM1Component(c){
  if(!c)return;
  var name=String(c.calculation_title||"").trim();
  if(!name)return;
  var m1row=m5_findM1ComponentByName(name);
  if(!m1row)return;
  if(m1row.material_spec){
    c.material_spec=typeof m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel==="function"?m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel(m1row.material_spec):String(m1row.material_spec).trim();
  }
  if(m1row.nominal_thickness_mm!=null)c.component_nominal_thickness_mm=m1row.nominal_thickness_mm;
  if(typeof osrEffectiveM1TankInsideDiameterMm==="function"){
    var d=osrEffectiveM1TankInsideDiameterMm();
    if(d!=null)c.diameter_mm=d;
  }
  var courseIdx=m5_parseShellCourseIndexFromName(name);
  if(courseIdx){
    c.component_type="shell_course";
    c.course_index=courseIdx;
  }
}
function m5_syncMinWallMaterialsFromM1Dom(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  ["min_wall_calcs","external_min_wall_calcs"].forEach(function(key){
    (m5_data[key]||[]).forEach(function(c){ m5_syncCalcRowFromM1Component(c); });
  });
  ["internal","external"].forEach(function(surface){
    var arrKey=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
    var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
    var cont=typeof $==="function"?$(contId):null;
    if(!cont||!m5_data[arrKey])return;
    m5_data[arrKey].forEach(function(c,idx){
      var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_materialSel[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
      if(mat&&c.material_spec)m5_setMaterialDropdownValue(mat,c.material_spec);
      var cnom=cont.querySelector('.m5_compNom[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
      if(cnom&&c.component_nominal_thickness_mm!=null&&c.component_nominal_thickness_mm!=="")cnom.value=String(c.component_nominal_thickness_mm);
      var compType=cont.querySelector('.m5_componentType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
      if(compType&&c.component_type)compType.value=c.component_type;
      if(typeof m5_materialChangedFor==="function")m5_materialChangedFor(idx,surface);
    });
  });
}
/** Unique material specs from M1 Component design (live table, then saved asset). */
function m1_getComponentDesignMaterialSpecs(){
  var specs=[], seen={};
  function add(spec){
    var s=typeof m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel==="function"?m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel(spec):String(spec||"").trim();
    if(!s||seen[s])return;
    seen[s]=1;
    specs.push(s);
  }
  var tb=typeof $==="function"?$("m1_componentDesignTbody"):document.getElementById("m1_componentDesignTbody");
  if(tb){
    tb.querySelectorAll("tr.m1-cd-data-row").forEach(function(tr){
      var sel=tr.querySelector("select.m1-cd-material");
      if(sel&&sel.value) add(sel.value);
    });
  }
  if(!specs.length){
    var rows=typeof m1_getComponentDesignRows==="function"?m1_getComponentDesignRows():[];
    rows.forEach(function(r){ add(r.material_spec); });
  }
  return specs;
}
function m5_materialLibIndexForRow(row){
  if(!row||!REF.materialLib||!REF.materialLib.length) return -1;
  for(var i=0;i<REF.materialLib.length;i++){ if(REF.materialLib[i]===row) return i; }
  var label=typeof m5_materialDisplayLabel==="function"?m5_materialDisplayLabel(row):m5_materialName(row);
  for(var j=0;j<REF.materialLib.length;j++){
    if(typeof m1_materialSpecMatchesSelection==="function"&&m1_materialSpecMatchesSelection(REF.materialLib[j], label)) return j;
  }
  return -1;
}
/** M3 Material Spec options — materials assigned in M1 Component design (stress from M0 lookup). */
function m5_m1MaterialSpecOptionsMarkup(){
  var html="";
  var specs=typeof m1_getComponentDesignMaterialSpecs==="function"?m1_getComponentDesignMaterialSpecs():[];
  specs.forEach(function(spec){
    var row=typeof m5_findMaterialRow==="function"?m5_findMaterialRow(spec):null;
    var libIdx=row?m5_materialLibIndexForRow(row):-1;
    var s=row?m5_materialStress(row):null;
    var escVal=String(spec).replace(/"/g,"&quot;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;");
    html+='<option value="'+escVal+'" data-stress="'+(s!=null?s:"")+'" data-idx="'+(libIdx>=0?libIdx:"")+'">'+escVal+(s!=null?" ("+s+" MPa)":"")+'</option>';
  });
  if(!specs.length){
    html+='<option value="" disabled>(Set materials in M1 Component design)</option>';
  }
  return html;
}
function m5_materialDropdownMatchesValue(optionValue, materialSpec){
  var ov=String(optionValue||"").trim();
  var spec=typeof m1_normalizeMaterialSpec==="function"?m1_normalizeMaterialSpec(materialSpec):String(materialSpec||"").trim();
  if(!spec) return false;
  if(ov===spec) return true;
  if(typeof m1_materialPartsMatch==="function"&&m1_materialPartsMatch(spec, ov)) return true;
  if(typeof m5_findMaterialRow==="function"){
    var row=m5_findMaterialRow(spec);
    if(row&&typeof m5_materialDisplayLabel==="function"&&m5_materialDisplayLabel(row)===ov) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
function m5_m1ComponentSelectMarkup(selectedName){
  var sel=String(selectedName||"").trim();
  var html='<option value="">— select component (M1) —</option>';
  var rows=[], seen={}, hasNamed=false;
  var tb=typeof $==="function"?$("m1_componentDesignTbody"):null;
  if(tb){
    tb.querySelectorAll("tr.m1-cd-data-row").forEach(function(tr){
      var nm=typeof m1_readComponentNameFromRow==="function"?m1_readComponentNameFromRow(tr):"";
      nm=String(nm||"").trim();
      if(!nm||seen[nm])return;
      seen[nm]=1;
      rows.push({component_name:nm});
    });
  }
  if(!rows.length) rows=typeof m1_getComponentDesignRows==="function"?m1_getComponentDesignRows():[];
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    var nm=String(r.component_name||"").trim();
    if(!nm||seen[nm])return;
    seen[nm]=1;
    hasNamed=true;
    html+='<option value="'+escHtml(nm)+'"'+(sel===nm?' selected':'')+'>'+escHtml(nm)+'</option>';
  });
  if(sel&&!seen[sel]){
    html+='<option value="'+escHtml(sel)+'" selected>'+escHtml(sel)+' (not in M1)</option>';
  }
  if(!hasNamed){
    html+='<option value="" disabled>(Add components in M1 Component design)</option>';
  }
  return html;
}
function m5_onM1ComponentSelect(idx,surface){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var arrKey=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
  var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data[arrKey]||!m5_data[arrKey][idx])return;
  var cont=$(contId); if(!cont)return;
  var c=m5_data[arrKey][idx];
  var compSel=cont.querySelector('.m5_m1CompSel[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var name=compSel&&compSel.value?String(compSel.value).trim():"";
  c.calculation_title=name||null;
  m5_syncCalcRowFromM1Component(c);
  var dia=cont.querySelector('.m5_diameter[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(dia)dia.value=c.diameter_mm!=null&&c.diameter_mm!==""?String(c.diameter_mm):"";
  var cnom=cont.querySelector('.m5_compNom[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(cnom)cnom.value=c.component_nominal_thickness_mm!=null&&c.component_nominal_thickness_mm!==""?String(c.component_nominal_thickness_mm):"";
  var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_materialSel[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(mat) m5_setMaterialDropdownValue(mat, c.material_spec);
  var compTypeSel=cont.querySelector('.m5_componentType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(compTypeSel&&c.component_type) compTypeSel.value=c.component_type;
  var tabRoot=cont.querySelector('.m5-mw-tabs-root');
  if(tabRoot){
    var tabTitle=tabRoot.querySelector('.m5-mw-tab[data-tab-idx="'+idx+'"] .m5-mw-tab-title');
    if(tabTitle)tabTitle.textContent=name||("Calculation "+(idx+1));
  }
  if(typeof m5_materialChangedFor==="function")m5_materialChangedFor(idx,surface);
  else if(typeof m5_calcTminFor==="function")m5_calcTminFor(idx,surface);
  if(typeof m5_dirty!=="undefined")m5_dirty=true;
}
function m5_setMaterialDropdownValue(matEl, materialSpec){
  if(!matEl) return;
  var spec=typeof m1_normalizeMaterialSpec==="function"?m1_normalizeMaterialSpec(materialSpec):String(materialSpec||"").trim();
  if(!spec){ matEl.value=""; return; }
  var matchIdx=-1, oi;
  for(oi=0;oi<matEl.options.length;oi++){
    if(typeof m5_materialDropdownMatchesValue==="function"?m5_materialDropdownMatchesValue(matEl.options[oi].value, spec):matEl.options[oi].value===spec){
      matchIdx=oi;
      break;
    }
  }
  if(matchIdx<0){
    var row=typeof m5_findMaterialRow==="function"?m5_findMaterialRow(spec):null;
    var s=row?m5_materialStress(row):null;
    var libIdx=row?m5_materialLibIndexForRow(row):-1;
    var opt=document.createElement("option");
    opt.value=spec;
    opt.textContent=spec+(s!=null?" ("+s+" MPa)":"");
    if(s!=null) opt.dataset.stress=String(s);
    if(libIdx>=0) opt.dataset.idx=String(libIdx);
    matEl.appendChild(opt);
    matchIdx=matEl.options.length-1;
  }
  matEl.selectedIndex=matchIdx;
}
/** M1 Component design picker for cracking / other calcs (same list as min-wall thinning). */
function m5_onM1ComponentSelectAux(idx, kind){
  kind=kind||"cracking";
  var arrKey=kind==="other"?"other_calcs":"cracking_calcs";
  var contId=kind==="other"?"m5_otherCalcs":"m5_crackingCalcs";
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data[arrKey]||!m5_data[arrKey][idx]) return;
  var cont=$(contId); if(!cont) return;
  var c=m5_data[arrKey][idx];
  var compSel=cont.querySelector('.m5_m1CompSel[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var name=compSel&&compSel.value?String(compSel.value).trim():"";
  c.calculation_title=name||null;
  var m1row=typeof m5_findM1ComponentByName==="function"?m5_findM1ComponentByName(name):null;
  if(m1row){
    c.material_spec=m1row.material_spec?String(m1row.material_spec).trim()||null:null;
  }
  var matSel=kind==="other"?".m5_otherMaterial":".m5_crackMaterial";
  var mat=cont.querySelector(matSel+'[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  m5_setMaterialDropdownValue(mat, c.material_spec);
  if(kind==="other" && typeof m5_otherMaterialChangedFor==="function") m5_otherMaterialChangedFor(idx);
  else if(kind==="cracking" && typeof m5_crackMaterialChangedFor==="function") m5_crackMaterialChangedFor(idx);
  else if(kind==="other" && typeof m5_syncOtherFromUI==="function") m5_syncOtherFromUI(idx);
  else if(kind==="cracking" && typeof m5_syncCrackingFromUI==="function") m5_syncCrackingFromUI(idx);
  if(typeof m5_dirty!=="undefined")m5_dirty=true;
}

function m5_syncCalcFromUI(idx,surface){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var arrKey=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
  var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
  if(!m5_data||!m5_data[arrKey]||!m5_data[arrKey][idx])return;
  var cont=$(contId); if(!cont)return;
  var c=m5_data[arrKey][idx];
  var tit=cont.querySelector('.m5_calcTitle[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var comp=cont.querySelector('.m5_componentType[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var dia=cont.querySelector('.m5_diameter[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_materialSel[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var jf=cont.querySelector('.m5_jointFactor[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var conf=cont.querySelector('.m5_confidenceSel[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspA=cont.querySelector('.m5_inspA[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspB=cont.querySelector('.m5_inspB[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspC=cont.querySelector('.m5_inspC[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var inspD=cont.querySelector('.m5_inspD[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var mf=cont.querySelector('.m5_mFactor[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var aa=cont.querySelector('.m5_apexAngle[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var cf=cont.querySelector('.m5_cFactor[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var cnom=cont.querySelector('.m5_compNom[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var tmm=cont.querySelector('.m5_measured[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var cr=cont.querySelector('.m5_corrRate[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var crNotes=cont.querySelector('.m5_corrRateNotes[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  c.calculation_title=tit&&tit.value?String(tit.value).trim()||null:(c.calculation_title!=null?c.calculation_title:null);
  if(comp) c.component_type=comp.value?comp.value:"shell";
  c.diameter_mm=typeof osrEffectiveM1TankInsideDiameterMm==="function"?osrEffectiveM1TankInsideDiameterMm():null;
  if(mat) c.material_spec=mat.selectedIndex>0?mat.options[mat.selectedIndex].value:null;
  if(mat) c.stress_allow_mpa=mat.selectedIndex>0&&mat.options[mat.selectedIndex].dataset.stress?numOrNull(mat.options[mat.selectedIndex].dataset.stress):null;
  c.joint_factor=jf?numOrNull(jf.value):null;
  c.df_score=null;
  c.confidence_level=conf&&conf.value?conf.value:"medium";
  c.insp_a=m5_nonNegInt(inspA&&inspA.value);
  c.insp_b=m5_nonNegInt(inspB&&inspB.value);
  c.insp_c=m5_nonNegInt(inspC&&inspC.value);
  c.insp_d=m5_nonNegInt(inspD&&inspD.value);
  c.start_date=typeof osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate==="function"?osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate():null;
  if(typeof m5_refreshThinReliabilityResults==="function")m5_refreshThinReliabilityResults(idx,surface);
  c.m_factor=mf?numOrNull(mf.value):(c.m_factor!=null?c.m_factor:1.54);
  c.apex_angle_deg=aa?numOrNull(aa.value):(c.apex_angle_deg!=null?c.apex_angle_deg:30);
  c.c_factor=cf?numOrNull(cf.value):(c.c_factor!=null?c.c_factor:0.3);
  if(cnom)c.component_nominal_thickness_mm=numOrNull(cnom.value);
  c.measured_thickness_mm=tmm?numOrNull(tmm.value):null;
  c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr=cr?numOrNull(cr.value):null;
  c.corrosion_rate_notes=crNotes&&String(crNotes.value).trim()?String(crNotes.value).trim():null;
  if(surface==="internal"){
    var sub=cont.querySelector('.m5_thinningSubtype[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    c.thinning_subtype=sub&&sub.value?String(sub.value):"";
  }
  if(surface==="external"){
    var edm=cont.querySelector('.m5_extDamageMech[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
    c.external_damage_mechanism=edm&&edm.value?String(edm.value).trim()||null:null;
  }
  var mdt=cont.querySelector('.m5_measuredDate[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  c.measured_thickness_date=m5_normalizeDateString(mdt&&mdt.value?mdt.value:null);
  if(typeof m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine==="function")m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine(idx,surface);
}

function m5_materialChangedFor(idx,surface){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
  var cont=$(contId); if(!cont)return;
  var mat=cont.querySelector('.m5_materialSel[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var grpRo=cont.querySelector('.m5_matGroupRo[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(grpRo){
    var grp="";
    if(mat&&mat.value&&typeof m5_materialGroupDisplay==="function") grp=m5_materialGroupDisplay(mat.value);
    grpRo.value=grp||"";
    var tabRoot=cont.querySelector(".m5-mw-tabs-root");
    var activeIdx=tabRoot?parseInt(tabRoot.getAttribute("data-active-idx"),10):0;
    if(!isNaN(activeIdx)&&activeIdx===idx&&typeof m5_applyMaterialGroupToDamageFilter==="function"){
      m5_applyMaterialGroupToDamageFilter(grp);
    }
  }
  if(surface==="internal"&&typeof m5_refreshThinningSubtypeForCalc==="function"){
    m5_refreshThinningSubtypeForCalc(idx, surface);
  }
  var det=cont.querySelector('.m5_materialDetails[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(det){
    if(!mat||mat.selectedIndex<=0){det.textContent="Select a material to see specification, design temp, composition, product form, UTS, SMYS, stress.";}
    else{var lib=REF.materialLib; var i=parseInt(mat.options[mat.selectedIndex].dataset.idx,10);
    if(lib&&lib[i]){var m=lib[i], parts=m5_materialDetailFields(m); var esc=function(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");};
    det.innerHTML=parts.length?parts.map(function(p){return "<span style='display:block'>"+esc(p)+"</span>";}).join(""):"No details available.";}}
  }
  m5_syncCalcFromUI(idx,surface);
  m5_calcTminFor(idx,surface);
}

function m5_calcRemainingWall(measuredStr,ffsStr){
  var m=parseFloat(measuredStr),f=parseFloat(ffsStr);
  if(isNaN(m)||isNaN(f))return "—";
  var r=m-f; return r.toFixed(2);
}
function m5_calcYearsToTmin(remWallStr,corrRateStr){
  var r=parseFloat(remWallStr),c=parseFloat(corrRateStr);
  if(isNaN(r)||isNaN(c)||c<=0)return "—";
  var y=r/c; return y.toFixed(1);
}
function m5_yearsElapsedSinceMeasurementDate(isoYmd){
  var norm=m5_normalizeDateString(isoYmd);
  if(!norm)return null;
  var p=norm.split("-");
  var y=parseInt(p[0],10), mo=parseInt(p[1],10)-1, d=parseInt(p[2],10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(y)||!Number.isFinite(mo)||!Number.isFinite(d))return null;
  var t0=new Date(y,mo,d);
  if(isNaN(t0.getTime()))return null;
  var now=new Date();
  var t1=new Date(now.getFullYear(),now.getMonth(),now.getDate());
  var ms=t1.getTime()-t0.getTime();
  if(ms<0)return 0;
  return ms/(365.25*24*3600*1000);
}
function m5_calcYearsToTminFromInspection(remWallStr,corrRateStr,measDateStr){
  var base=m5_calcYearsToTmin(remWallStr,corrRateStr);
  if(base==="—")return "—";
  var yInsp=parseFloat(base);
  if(isNaN(yInsp))return "—";
  var norm=m5_normalizeDateString(measDateStr);
  if(!norm)return base;
  var elapsed=m5_yearsElapsedSinceMeasurementDate(norm);
  if(elapsed==null)return base;
  var rem=yInsp-elapsed;
  if(rem<=0)return "0.0";
  return rem.toFixed(1);
}
function m5_calcHalfLife(yearsStr){
  var y=parseFloat(yearsStr);
  if(isNaN(y))return "—";
  return (y*0.5).toFixed(1);
}
/** Risk JSON in memory (M6) or Libraries — same document as M0 “CoF & PoF rules” / gdu_risk. */
function m6_riskConfigForGrPofLabels(){
  if(typeof m6_riskConfig!=="undefined"&&m6_riskConfig) return m6_riskConfig;
  if(typeof REF!=="undefined"&&REF&&REF.riskConfig) return REF.riskConfig;
  return null;
}
/**
 * PoF band labels from M0-editable risk JSON: probability.factors[].options (value 1–5, label = full text).
 * Returns { full, short } where short drops a leading "N –" so callers can still use "n + ' ' + short".
 */
function m6_grPofOptionMetaFromM0(score){
  var n=parseInt(score,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<1||n>5) return null;
  var cfg=m6_riskConfigForGrPofLabels();
  if(!cfg||!cfg.probability||!Array.isArray(cfg.probability.factors)||!cfg.probability.factors.length) return null;
  var fac=null;
  for(var fi=0;fi<cfg.probability.factors.length;fi++){
    var f=cfg.probability.factors[fi];
    if(f&&(f.id==="damage_rate"||f.id==="driving_probability")){ fac=f; break; }
  }
  if(!fac){
    for(var fj=0;fj<cfg.probability.factors.length;fj++){
      var f2=cfg.probability.factors[fj];
      if(f2&&f2.id==="damage_mechanism"){ fac=f2; break; }
    }
  }
  if(!fac) fac=cfg.probability.factors[0];
  if(!fac||!Array.isArray(fac.options)) return null;
  var sv=String(n);
  for(var i=0;i<fac.options.length;i++){
    var o=fac.options[i];
    if(!o) continue;
    if(String(o.value)!==sv) continue;
    var full=o.label!=null?String(o.label).trim():"";
    if(!full) return null;
    var re=new RegExp("^\\s*"+n+"\\s*[\\u2013\\u2014\\-]\\s*");
    var shortStr=full.replace(re,"").trim();
    return { full: full, short: shortStr||full };
  }
  return null;
}
/** PoF band (1–5): PoF Mapping row label → M0 risk probability.factors → built-in fallback. */
function m5_pofScoreLabel(score){
  if(score==null)return "—";
  var pm=typeof m6_grPofOptionMetaFromPofMapping==="function"?m6_grPofOptionMetaFromPofMapping(score):null;
  if(pm&&pm.short) return pm.short;
  var meta=typeof m6_grPofOptionMetaFromM0==="function"?m6_grPofOptionMetaFromM0(score):null;
  if(meta&&meta.short) return meta.short;
  var n=parseInt(score,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(n))return String(score);
  var labels={
    1:"1 — low frequency",
    2:"2 — med-low frequency",
    3:"3 — medium frequency",
    4:"4 — med-high frequency",
    5:"5 — high frequency"
  };
  return labels[n]||String(score);
}
/** Row header for risk matrix: PoF band digit only (5 … 1; 5 = highest frequency at top). */
function m6_pofMatrixRowLabel(n){
  var ni=parseInt(n,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(ni)||ni<1||ni>5)return String(n);
  return String(ni);
}
/** Row header text for risk matrix: band digit + short frequency band label (5 = top row). */
function m6_pofMatrixRowHeader(n){
  var ni=parseInt(n,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(ni)||ni<1||ni>5)return String(n);
  var parts={5:"5 high",4:"4 Med high",3:"3 med",2:"2 med low",1:"1 low"};
  return parts[ni]||String(ni);
}
/** Thinning DF ordinal (1–5) per Industry screening — not the PoF band historical-frequency scale. */
function m5_dfScoreBandLabel(score){
  if(score==null)return "—";
  var n=parseInt(score,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(n))return String(score);
  var labels={1:"very low damage",2:"low damage",3:"moderate damage",4:"high damage",5:"very high damage"};
  return labels[n]||String(score);
}
/** PoF mapping row score from CSV/JSON: digits 1–5 or letters A–E (A=highest→5 … E=lowest→1). */
function m5_normalizePofBandScore(v){
  if(v==null||v==="")return null;
  var s=String(v).trim();
  if(/^[1-5]$/.test(s))return parseInt(s,10);
  var u=s.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  if(u==="A")return 5;
  if(u==="B")return 4;
  if(u==="C")return 3;
  if(u==="D")return 2;
  if(u==="E")return 1;
  var n=parseInt(s,10);
  return Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=1&&n<=5?n:null;
}
/** Label for cracking susceptibility ordinal (1–5) from Libraries or defaults. */
function m5_susceptibilityBandLabel(score){
  var n=parseInt(score,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<1||n>5)return "—";
  var bands=Array.isArray(REF.susceptibilityBands)?REF.susceptibilityBands:null;
  if(bands&&bands.length){
    for(var i=0;i<bands.length;i++){
      var sc=bands[i].score!=null?parseInt(bands[i].score,10):null;
      if(sc===n&&bands[i].label!=null&&String(bands[i].label).trim()!=="")return String(bands[i].label).trim();
    }
  }
  var fb={1:"Low — not probable but check",2:"Medium-low — possible but well above design",3:"Moderate — possible near design",4:"Medium-high — below design, above operating",5:"High — above ambient, below operating"};
  return fb[n]||String(n);
}
/** M3/M6 cracking PoF band text — susceptibility only (581 Part 2). No GFF×FMS×DF PoF Mapping. */
function m5_crackingPofBandUiText(c){
  if(!c) return "\u2014";
  if(c.pof_score != null){
    var pg = parseInt(c.pof_score, 10);
    if(Number.isFinite(pg) && pg >= 1 && pg <= 5)
      return pg + " | " + (typeof m5_pofScoreLabel === "function" ? m5_pofScoreLabel(pg) : String(pg));
  }
  var susRaw = c.susceptibility != null ? c.susceptibility : c.df_score;
  var sn = susRaw != null ? parseInt(susRaw, 10) : NaN;
  if(Number.isFinite(sn) && sn >= 1 && sn <= 5 && typeof m5_susceptibilityBandLabel === "function")
    return sn + " | " + m5_susceptibilityBandLabel(sn);
  return "\u2014";
}

/** Cracking: show PoF band (pof_score) with grPofLabelFn, else susceptibility — never use DF ordinal as PoF band. */
function m5_crackingPofOrSusceptibilityDisplay(c, grPofLabelFn){
  if(!c) return "—";
  grPofLabelFn = grPofLabelFn || (typeof m5_pofScoreLabel==="function" ? m5_pofScoreLabel : function(x){ return String(x); });
  if(c.pof_score != null){
    var pg = parseInt(c.pof_score, 10);
    if(Number.isFinite(pg) && pg >= 1 && pg <= 5) return pg + " " + grPofLabelFn(pg);
  }
  var susRaw = c.susceptibility != null ? c.susceptibility : c.df_score;
  var sn = susRaw != null ? parseInt(susRaw, 10) : NaN;
  if(Number.isFinite(sn) && sn >= 1 && sn <= 5 && typeof m5_susceptibilityBandLabel==="function")
    return sn + " " + m5_susceptibilityBandLabel(sn);
  return "—";
}
/** Other mechanism row: PoF band from GFF×FMS×DF mapping when complete, else manual pof_score — not df_score. */
function m5_otherGrPofDisplay(c, m3, grPofLabelFn){
  if(!c) return "—";
  grPofLabelFn = grPofLabelFn || (typeof m5_pofScoreLabel==="function" ? m5_pofScoreLabel : function(x){ return String(x); });

  if(band != null && band >= 1 && band <= 5) return band + " " + grPofLabelFn(band);
  if(c.pof_score != null){
    var p = parseInt(c.pof_score, 10);
    if(Number.isFinite(p) && p >= 1 && p <= 5) return p + " " + grPofLabelFn(p);
  }
  return "—";
}

  var opts=[
    {v:"1",t:"1 | Very low damage"},

  ];
  var s=(selected==null?"":String(selected));

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   API RP 581 §4.5.7 — modified thinning reliability (from Art.html)
   Calculated Df,thin for min-wall; PoF = GFF × FMS × Df,thin
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var M5_THIN_GFF_SCALE = 1.56e-4;
var M5_THIN_DS = [1, 2, 4];
var M5_THIN_PRIORS = { low: [0.5, 0.3, 0.2], medium: [0.7, 0.2, 0.1], high: [0.8, 0.15, 0.05] };
var M5_THIN_COND = {
  p1: [0.33, 0.4, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9],
  p2: [0.33, 0.33, 0.3, 0.2, 0.09],
  p3: [0.33, 0.27, 0.2, 0.1, 0.01]
};
function m5_thinNormCDF(x) {
  var t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(x));
  var d = 0.3989423 * Math.exp(-x * x / 2);
  var p = d * t * (0.3193815 + t * (-0.3565638 + t * (1.781478 + t * (-1.821256 + t * 1.330274))));
  return x > 0 ? 1 - p : p;
}
function m5_thinPowCo(c, n) { return n > 0 ? Math.pow(c, n) : 1; }
function m5_thinCalcI(pr, co, nD, nC, nB, nA) {
  var counts = [0, nD, nC, nB, nA], p = 1, i;
  for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) p *= m5_thinPowCo(co[i], counts[i]);
  return pr * p;
}
function m5_thinCalcArtModified(t, a, r, tmin, ca) {
  if (t == null || t <= 0 || tmin == null) return null;
  var caVal = ca != null && ca >= 0 ? ca : 0;
  var denom = tmin + caVal;
  if (denom <= 0) return null;
  var remaining = t - (Math.max(a || 0, 0) * (r || 0));
  return Math.max(1 - remaining / denom, 0);
}
function m5_thinCalcArtOverT(a, r, t) {
  if (r == null || t == null || t <= 0) return null;
  return Math.max((Math.max(a || 0, 0) * r) / t, 0);
}
function m5_thinBetaThin(DSk, Art, SRp, covDt, covSf, covP) {
  var num = (1 - DSk * Art) - SRp;
  var den = Math.sqrt(
    DSk * DSk * Art * Art * covDt * covDt +
    (1 - DSk * Art) * (1 - DSk * Art) * covSf * covSf +
    SRp * SRp * covP * covP
  );
  return den > 0 ? num / den : null;
}
function m5_thinResolveSRp(SR14, SR15) {
  var SRp = null, gov = null, note = "", warn = "";
  if (SR14 != null && SR15 != null) {
    SRp = Math.max(SR14, SR15);
    gov = SR15 > SR14 ? "2.15" : "2.14";
    note = "Governs: Eq. (" + gov + ")";
  } else if (SR14 != null) {
    SRp = SR14; gov = "2.14";
    warn = "Eq. (2.15) not calculated (need P and D).";
  } else if (SR15 != null) {
    SRp = SR15; gov = "2.15";
    warn = "Eq. (2.14) not calculated (need t_min and S).";
  } else {
    warn = "Neither Eq. (2.14) nor (2.15) could be calculated.";
  }
  return { SRp: SRp, gov: gov, note: note, warn: warn };
}
function m5_parseMpaFromMaterialField(s, useMin) {
  if (s == null || s === "") return null;
  var parts = String(s).match(/[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?/g);
  if (!parts || !parts.length) return null;
  var nums = parts.map(function (x) { return parseFloat(x); }).filter(function (x) { return Number.isFinite(x); });
  if (!nums.length) return null;
  return useMin ? Math.min.apply(null, nums) : Math.max.apply(null, nums);
}
function m5_findMaterialRow(spec) {
  if (!spec || !REF.materialLib || !REF.materialLib.length) return null;
  var want = (typeof m1_normalizeMaterialSpec === "function" ? m1_normalizeMaterialSpec(spec) : String(spec).trim()).toLowerCase();
  for (var i = 0; i < REF.materialLib.length; i++) {
    var row = REF.materialLib[i];
    if (typeof m1_materialSpecMatchesSelection === "function" && m1_materialSpecMatchesSelection(row, want)) return row;
    var n = m5_materialName(row);
    if (n && String(n).trim().toLowerCase() === want) return row;
    var d = typeof m5_materialDescription === "function" ? m5_materialDescription(row) : "";
    if (d && String(d).trim().toLowerCase() === want) return row;
  }
  return null;
}
function m5_materialStrengthFromCalc(c) {
  var row = m5_findMaterialRow(c && c.material_spec);
  var YS = null, TS = null, S = c && c.stress_allow_mpa != null ? Number(c.stress_allow_mpa) : null;
  if (row) {
    YS = m5_parseMpaFromMaterialField(getRowProp(row, ["SMYS_MPa", "SMYS", "smys"]), true);
    TS = m5_parseMpaFromMaterialField(getRowProp(row, ["UTS_MPa", "UTS", "uts"]), false);
    if (S == null) S = m5_parseMpaFromMaterialField(getRowProp(row, ["stress_MPa", "stress_allow_mpa", "Stress_Allow", "stress"]), false);
  }
  return { YS: YS, TS: TS, S: S };
}
function m5_vesselAgeYears() {
  if (typeof osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate !== "function") return null;
  var d = osrEffectiveM1VesselNewDate();
  if (!d) return null;
  var t0 = new Date(d + "T12:00:00");
  if (isNaN(t0.getTime())) return null;
  var yrs = (Date.now() - t0.getTime()) / (365.25 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);
  return yrs >= 0 ? yrs : 0;
}
function m5_calcTminNumeric(c, P, CA) {
  if (typeof m5_calcTminValue !== "function") return null;
  var v = m5_calcTminValue(c, P, CA);
  if (v == null || v === "\u2014" || v === "Invalid") return null;
  var n = parseFloat(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
}
function m5_thinReliabilityFmt(n, d) {
  if (n == null || !Number.isFinite(n)) return "\u2014";
  if (typeof fmt === "function") return fmt(n, d != null ? d : 4);
  if (Math.abs(n) >= 1000 || (Math.abs(n) > 0 && Math.abs(n) < 0.0001)) return n.toExponential(4);
  return n.toFixed(d != null ? d : 4);
}
function m5_thinReliabilityCalc(c) {
  if (!c || typeof c !== "object") return null;
  var t = c.measured_thickness_mm != null ? Number(c.measured_thickness_mm) : null;
  var r = c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr != null ? Number(c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr) : null;
  var age = m5_vesselAgeYears();
  if (!Number.isFinite(t) || !Number.isFinite(r) || age == null) return null;
  var eff = typeof osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating === "function" ? osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating() : { design_conditions: {}, operating_conditions: {} };
  var dc = eff.design_conditions || {};
  var oc = eff.operating_conditions || {};
  var P = oc.operating_pressure_mpa != null ? Number(oc.operating_pressure_mpa) : (dc.design_pressure_mpa != null ? Number(dc.design_pressure_mpa) : null);
  var CA = dc.corrosion_allowance_mm != null ? Number(dc.corrosion_allowance_mm) : 0;
  var tmin = m5_calcTminNumeric(c, P, CA);
  var str = m5_materialStrengthFromCalc(c);
  var YS = str.YS, TS = str.TS, S = str.S;
  var E = c.joint_factor != null ? Number(c.joint_factor) : null;
  if (!Number.isFinite(E) || E <= 0) E = 1;
  var D = c.diameter_mm != null ? Number(c.diameter_mm) : null;
  var ArtMod = m5_thinCalcArtModified(t, age, r, tmin, CA);
  var Art212 = m5_thinCalcArtOverT(age, r, t);
  var Art = ArtMod != null ? ArtMod : Art212;
  var FSThin = (YS != null && TS != null) ? ((YS + TS) / 2) * 1.1 * E : null;
  var tLim = tmin;
  var SR14 = (FSThin > 0 && t > 0 && S != null && tLim != null) ? (S * E / FSThin) * (tLim / t) : null;
  var alpha = 2;
  var SR15 = (FSThin > 0 && t > 0 && P != null && D != null) ? (P * D) / (alpha * FSThin * t) : null;
  var srPick = m5_thinResolveSRp(SR14, SR15);
  var SRp = srPick.SRp;
  var confKey = c.confidence_level != null ? String(c.confidence_level).toLowerCase() : "medium";
  var pr = M5_THIN_PRIORS[confKey] || M5_THIN_PRIORS.medium;
  var nA = m5_nonNegInt(c.insp_a), nB = m5_nonNegInt(c.insp_b), nC = m5_nonNegInt(c.insp_c), nD = m5_nonNegInt(c.insp_d);
  var I1 = m5_thinCalcI(pr[0], M5_THIN_COND.p1, nD, nC, nB, nA);
  var I2 = m5_thinCalcI(pr[1], M5_THIN_COND.p2, nD, nC, nB, nA);
  var I3 = m5_thinCalcI(pr[2], M5_THIN_COND.p3, nD, nC, nB, nA);
  var sumI = I1 + I2 + I3;
  var PoP = sumI > 0 ? [I1 / sumI, I2 / sumI, I3 / sumI] : pr.slice();
  var covDt = 0.2, covSf = 0.2, covP = 0.05;
  var betas = [], pfs = [], j, wPf = 0;
  for (j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
    var b = (Art != null && SRp != null) ? m5_thinBetaThin(M5_THIN_DS[j], Art, SRp, covDt, covSf, covP) : null;
    betas.push(b);
    pfs.push(b != null ? m5_thinNormCDF(-b) : null);
  }
  for (j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (pfs[j] != null) wPf += PoP[j] * pfs[j];
  var DfB = wPf / M5_THIN_GFF_SCALE;
  var DfThin = Math.max(DfB, 0.1);
  var out = {
    Art: Art, ArtMod: ArtMod, Art212: Art212, DfB: DfB, DfThin: DfThin,
    SRp: SRp, SR14: SR14, SR15: SR15, FSThin: FSThin, PoP: PoP,
    age: age, tmin: tmin, missing: []
  };
  if (ArtMod == null) out.missing.push("t_min");
  if (YS == null || TS == null) out.missing.push("YS/TS");
  if (SRp == null) out.missing.push("SR_p");
  c.thin_reliability = out;
  c.df_calculated = DfThin;
  return out;
}
function m5_thinReliabilityDfForCalc(c) {
  var r = typeof m5_thinReliabilityCalc === "function" ? m5_thinReliabilityCalc(c) : null;
  return r && Number.isFinite(r.DfThin) ? r.DfThin : null;
}
function m5_isMinWallThinningCalc(c) {
  return c && (c.measured_thickness_mm != null || c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr != null) && c.cracking_type == null && c.mechanism_type == null;
}
function m5_htmlThinReliabilityResult(c, idx) {
  var r = typeof m5_thinReliabilityCalc === "function" ? m5_thinReliabilityCalc(c) : null;
  var art = r && r.Art != null ? m5_thinReliabilityFmt(r.Art, 4) : "\u2014";
  var dfb = r && r.DfB != null ? m5_thinReliabilityFmt(r.DfB, 2) : "\u2014";
  var dft = r && r.DfThin != null ? m5_thinReliabilityFmt(r.DfThin, 2) : "\u2014";
  var miss = r && r.missing && r.missing.length ? ('<div class="hint" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:11px">Need: ' + r.missing.join(", ") + "</div>") : "";
  return (
    '<div class="m5-df-result m5-thin-reliability-result">' +
    '<div class="hd">Thinning \u2014 API RP 581 modified reliability (calculated D<sub>f</sub>)</div>' +
    '<div class="row">' +
    '<div><div class="k">A<sub>rt</sub></div><div class="v m5_thinArtResult" data-idx="' + idx + '">' + art + "</div></div>" +
    '<div><div class="k">D<sub>fB</sub></div><div class="v m5_thinDfBResult" data-idx="' + idx + '">' + dfb + "</div></div>" +
    '<div><div class="k">D<sub>f,thin</sub></div><div class="v m5_thinDfThinResult" data-idx="' + idx + '">' + dft + "</div></div>" +
    "</div>" + miss.replace("</div>", "</div>") +
    "</div>"
  );
}
/** Plain data for thinning DF narrative (581 reliability + GFF × FMS × Df). */
function m5_thinDfNarrativeData(calc, m3) {
  var r = typeof m5_thinReliabilityCalc === "function" ? m5_thinReliabilityCalc(calc) : null;
  var m3u = m3 || (typeof m5_data !== "undefined" ? m5_data : null);
  var gffWork = null, fms = null, dfAdj = null;
  if (m3u && m3u.generic_failure_gff && typeof m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject === "function") {
    var holeSelN = typeof m5_gffHoleSelForCalc === "function" ? m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(calc, m3u) : m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m3u);
    var gSel = m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject(m3u.generic_failure_gff, holeSelN);
    if (Number.isFinite(gSel)) gffWork = gSel;
  }
  if (m3u && m3u.management_questionnaire && typeof m3u.management_questionnaire === "object") {
    var fv = Number(m3u.management_questionnaire.fms != null ? m3u.management_questionnaire.fms : m3u.management_questionnaire.FMS);
    if (Number.isFinite(fv)) fms = fv;
  }
  dfAdj = typeof m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc === "function" ? m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(calc) : null;
  if (dfAdj == null && r && Number.isFinite(r.DfThin)) dfAdj = r.DfThin;
  var prod = (gffWork != null && fms != null && dfAdj != null && Number.isFinite(dfAdj)) ? gffWork * fms * dfAdj : null;
  var holeLbl = typeof m5_gffHoleSizeLabel === "function" && typeof m5_gffHoleSelForCalc === "function" ? m5_gffHoleSizeLabel(m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(calc, m3u)) : null;
  return { r: r, gffWork: gffWork, fms: fms, dfAdj: dfAdj, prod: prod, holeLbl: holeLbl };
}
/** Read-only narrative: how D<sub>f,thin</sub> and PoF were derived (beside confidence / inspection inputs). */
function m5_htmlThinDfCalcNarrative(calc, idx, surface) {
  if (!calc) return "";
  surface = surface || "internal";
  var d = m5_thinDfNarrativeData(calc, typeof m5_data !== "undefined" ? m5_data : null);
  var r = d.r;
  var art = r && r.Art != null ? m5_thinReliabilityFmt(r.Art, 4) : null;
  var dfb = r && r.DfB != null ? m5_thinReliabilityFmt(r.DfB, 4) : null;
  var dft = r && r.DfThin != null ? m5_thinReliabilityFmt(r.DfThin, 4) : null;
  var confLbl = "\u2014";
  if (calc.confidence_level) {
    var ck = String(calc.confidence_level).toLowerCase();
    confLbl = ck === "low" ? "Low confidence" : ck === "high" ? "High confidence" : "Medium confidence";
  }
  var parts = [];
  parts.push(
    '<p class="m5-thin-df-narrative-lead">The damage factor has been calculated as follows. Thinning severity uses <strong>A<sub>rt</sub></strong> from inspection thickness, corrosion rate, and plan age; the prior is <strong>' +
      escHtml(confLbl) +
      "</strong> (API RP 581 Table 4.5); inspection counts A\u2013D update confidence (Table 4.6).</p>"
  );
  parts.push(
    '<ul class="m5-thin-df-narrative-vars"><li><strong>A<sub>rt</sub></strong> <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'thin_art_rt\')" title="What A<sub>rt</sub> is and how it is scored" aria-label="What Art is and how it is scored">&#8505;</button> = ' +
      escHtml(art != null ? art : "\u2014") +
      "</li><li><strong>D<sub>fB</sub></strong> = " +
      escHtml(dfb != null ? dfb : "\u2014") +
      "</li><li><strong>D<sub>f,thin</sub></strong> = " +
      escHtml(dft != null ? dft : "\u2014") +
      "</li></ul>"
  );
  parts.push('<p class="m5-thin-df-narrative-eq">The app then applies: <strong>PoF = GFF \u00d7 FMS \u00d7 D<sub>f,thin</sub></strong> (Industry screening, Part 1 Eq. 1.1).</p>');
  if (d.gffWork != null && d.fms != null && d.dfAdj != null && d.prod != null) {
    var gffS = typeof fmt === "function" ? fmt(d.gffWork, 8) : String(d.gffWork);
    var fmsS = typeof fmt === "function" ? fmt(d.fms, 3) : String(d.fms);
    var dfS = typeof fmt === "function" ? fmt(d.dfAdj, 4) : String(d.dfAdj);
    var prodS = Number(d.prod).toExponential(4);
    parts.push(
      '<p class="m5-thin-df-narrative-worked"><strong>Selected hole size:</strong> ' +
        escHtml(d.holeLbl || "\u2014") +
        ' &mdash; GFF ' +
        escHtml(gffS) +
        " /yr \u00d7 " +
        escHtml(fmsS) +
        " \u00d7 " +
        escHtml(dfS) +
        ' = <strong>' +
        escHtml(prodS) +
        " /yr</strong></p>"
    );
  } else {
    parts.push(
      '<p class="m5-thin-df-narrative-worked hint">Complete measured thickness, corrosion rate, GFF (M0 hole size), and FMS to show the worked PoF example.</p>'
    );
  }
  if (r && r.missing && r.missing.indexOf("t_min") >= 0) {
    parts.push(
      '<p class="m5-thin-df-narrative-warn"><strong>Note:</strong> <em>t</em><sub>min</sub> is still flagged as missing, so results should be treated as provisional until Joint Factor <em>E</em>, geometry, material, and design pressure yield FFS / <em>t</em><sub>min</sub>.</p>'
    );
  }
  return (
    '<div class="m5-thin-df-narrative m5_thinDfNarrative" data-idx="' +
    idx +
    '" role="region" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Thinning damage factor calculation summary">' +
    '<div class="m5-thin-df-narrative-hd">Calculation summary</div>' +
    parts.join("") +
    "</div>"
  );
}

}

  var pofEl = cont.querySelector('.m5_pofScoreResult[data-idx="' + idx + '"]:not([data-m5-aux])');
  if (pofEl && typeof m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText === "function") pofEl.textContent = m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText(c, m5_data, halfStr);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   API RP 581 Part 2 — SCC / cracking Df (Table 2.C.1.3 + age escalation Eq. 2.C.1)
   Replaces legacy 2^(score−1) for cracking calcs only.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
var M5_SCC581_SVI = [1, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 5000];
function m5_scc581Slice7(arr) {
  return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr.slice(1, 8) : [];
}
/** Table 2.C.1.3 — SCC DFs (2016 Table 6.3 / 2025 Table 2.C.1.3). Index = inspection count 0–6. */
var M5_SCC581_TABLE = (function () {
  var e0 = [0, 1, 10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 5000];
  var t1 = {
    D: [0, 1, 8, 40, 80, 400, 800, 4000],
    C: [0, 1, 3, 17, 33, 170, 330, 1670],
    B: [0, 1, 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 500],
    A: [0, 1, 1, 3, 5, 25, 50, 250]
  };
  var t2 = {
    D: [0, 1, 2, 10, 20, 100, 200, 1000],
    C: [0, 1, 1, 2, 4, 20, 40, 250],
    B: [0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 10, 20, 100],
    A: [0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 5, 10, 50]
  };
  var t3 = {
    D: [0, 1, 1, 2, 4, 20, 40, 250],
    C: [0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 5, 10, 50],
    B: [0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 5, 25],
    A: [0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 4]
  };
  function row(block) {
    return {
      E: m5_scc581Slice7(e0),
      D: m5_scc581Slice7(block.D),
      C: m5_scc581Slice7(block.C),
      B: m5_scc581Slice7(block.B),
      A: m5_scc581Slice7(block.A)
    };
  }
  var t3row = row(t3);
  return [row({ D: e0, C: e0, B: e0, A: e0 }), row(t1), row(t2), t3row, t3row, t3row, t3row];
})();

function m5_isCrackingCalc(c) {
  if (!c || typeof c !== "object") return false;
  if (typeof m5_isMinWallThinningCalc === "function" && m5_isMinWallThinningCalc(c)) return false;
  if (c.mechanism_type != null && String(c.mechanism_type).trim() !== "") return false;
  return c.cracking_type != null || c.susceptibility != null || (c.df_score != null && c.measured_thickness_mm == null && c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr == null);
}

/** Owner susceptibility score (1–5) → 581 severity index (Table 2.C.1.2 / SSC Table 9.5 style). */
function m5_crack581SviFromSusceptibility(score, crackingType) {
  var n = parseInt(score, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1) return null;
  var mech = String(crackingType || "").toLowerCase();
  if (n === 1) return 1;
  if (n === 2) return 10;
  if (n === 3) return mech.indexOf("amine") >= 0 || mech.indexOf("caustic") >= 0 ? 100 : 50;
  if (n === 4) return 100;
  return mech.indexOf("hic") >= 0 || mech.indexOf("sohic") >= 0 || mech.indexOf("ssc") >= 0 || mech.indexOf("h2s") >= 0 ? 100 : 1000;
}

function m5_crack581InspEffectiveness(inspA, inspB, inspC, inspD) {
  var a = m5_nonNegInt(inspA), b = m5_nonNegInt(inspB), c = m5_nonNegInt(inspC), d = m5_nonNegInt(inspD);
  if (a > 0) return { cat: "A", n: Math.min(6, a) };
  if (b > 0) return { cat: "B", n: Math.min(6, b) };
  if (c > 0) return { cat: "C", n: Math.min(6, c) };
  if (d > 0) return { cat: "D", n: Math.min(6, d) };
  return { cat: "E", n: 0 };
}

function m5_crack581BaseDfLookup(svi, inspCat, numInsp) {
  if (svi == null || !Number.isFinite(Number(svi)) || Number(svi) <= 0) return 0;
  var sviN = Number(svi);
  var idx = -1;
  for (var i = 0; i < M5_SCC581_SVI.length; i++) {
    if (M5_SCC581_SVI[i] === sviN) { idx = i; break; }
  }
  if (idx < 0) {
    for (var j = 0; j < M5_SCC581_SVI.length; j++) {
      if (M5_SCC581_SVI[j] >= sviN) { idx = j; break; }
    }
    if (idx < 0) idx = M5_SCC581_SVI.length - 1;
  }
  var tblIdx = Math.min(6, Math.max(0, m5_nonNegInt(numInsp)));
  var row = M5_SCC581_TABLE[tblIdx];
  if (!row) return null;
  var cat = inspCat === "A" || inspCat === "B" || inspCat === "C" || inspCat === "D" ? inspCat : "E";
  var col = row[cat];
  if (!col || idx >= col.length) return null;
  return col[idx];
}

/** Age (yr) since last credited cracking inspection; min 1.0 when A/B/C inspections recorded. */
function m5_crack581AgeYears(c) {
  if (!c) return 1;
  var lastInsp = c.last_inspection_date != null ? m5_normalizeDateString(c.last_inspection_date) : null;
  if (lastInsp) {
    var elapsed = m5_yearsElapsedSinceMeasurementDate(lastInsp);
    if (elapsed != null) return Math.max(elapsed, 1);
  }
  var insp = m5_crack581InspEffectiveness(c.insp_a, c.insp_b, c.insp_c, c.insp_d);
  if ((insp.cat === "A" || insp.cat === "B" || insp.cat === "C") && insp.n > 0) return 1;
  if (typeof m5_vesselAgeYears === "function") {
    var age = m5_vesselAgeYears();
    if (Number.isFinite(age) && age > 0) return Math.max(age, 1);
  }
  return 1;
}

/** Full 581 cracking Df: Table 2.C.1.3 base × max(age,1)^1.1 capped at 5000 (Eq. 2.C.1). */
function m5_crack581DfCalc(c) {
  if (!c || typeof c !== "object") return null;
  var sus = c.susceptibility != null ? c.susceptibility : c.df_score;
  var svi = m5_crack581SviFromSusceptibility(sus, c.cracking_type);
  if (svi == null || svi <= 0) {
    return { svi: 0, dfB: 0, age: m5_crack581AgeYears(c), df: 0, insp: m5_crack581InspEffectiveness(c.insp_a, c.insp_b, c.insp_c, c.insp_d), missing: ["susceptibility"] };
  }
  var insp = m5_crack581InspEffectiveness(c.insp_a, c.insp_b, c.insp_c, c.insp_d);
  var dfB = m5_crack581BaseDfLookup(svi, insp.cat, insp.n);
  if (dfB == null || !Number.isFinite(dfB)) {
    return { svi: svi, dfB: null, age: null, df: null, insp: insp, missing: ["table lookup"] };
  }
  var age = m5_crack581AgeYears(c);
  var df = Math.min(dfB * Math.pow(Math.max(age, 1), 1.1), 5000);
  c.crack_581 = { svi: svi, dfB: dfB, age: age, df: df, inspCat: insp.cat, inspN: insp.n };
  c.df_calculated = df;
  return c.crack_581;
}

function m5_crack581DfForCalc(c) {
  var r = typeof m5_crack581DfCalc === "function" ? m5_crack581DfCalc(c) : null;
  return r && Number.isFinite(r.df) ? r.df : null;
}

function m5_crack581DfText(c) {
  var r = typeof m5_crack581DfCalc === "function" ? m5_crack581DfCalc(c) : null;
  if (!r || r.df == null || !Number.isFinite(r.df)) return "\u2014";
  return String(Math.round(r.df * 1000) / 1000);
}

  if (!r) return "";
  var svi = r.svi != null ? escHtml(String(r.svi)) : "\u2014";

  var inspLbl = r.inspCat ? escHtml(r.inspCat + (r.inspN ? " \u00d7 " + r.inspN : "")) : "\u2014";
  return (
    '<div class="m5-df-result m5-crack-581-result">' +

    '<div><div class="k">Age (yr)</div><div class="v m5_crackAgeResult" data-idx="' + idx + '">' + age + "</div></div>" +

  );
}

}

/** Legacy screening ordinal DF (2^(score-1)) — other calcs only; min-wall uses thinning; cracking uses m5_crack581DfCalc. */
function m5_damageFactorFromDfScore(score){
  var n = Number(score);
  if(!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1) return null;
  // Simple derived factor from ordinal DF score: 1->1, 2->2, 3->4, 4->8, 5->16.
  return Math.pow(2, n - 1);
}
function m5_damageFactorText(score){
  var df = m5_damageFactorFromDfScore(score);
  return df == null ? "—" : String(df);
}
function m5_adjustedDamageFactor(score, confidence, inspA, inspB, inspC, inspD){
  var base = m5_damageFactorFromDfScore(score);
  if(base == null) return null;
  var confMultMap = { low: 1.15, medium: 1.0, high: 0.9 };
  var confKey = confidence == null ? "medium" : String(confidence).toLowerCase();
  var confMult = confMultMap[confKey] != null ? confMultMap[confKey] : 1.0;
  var a = m5_nonNegInt(inspA), b = m5_nonNegInt(inspB), c = m5_nonNegInt(inspC), d = m5_nonNegInt(inspD);
  // Higher effectiveness inspections reduce uncertainty penalty.
  var credit = (0.08 * a) + (0.05 * b) + (0.03 * c) + (0.01 * d);
  var inspMult = Math.max(0.6, 1 - credit);
  return base * confMult * inspMult;
}
function m5_adjustedDamageFactorText(score, confidence, inspA, inspB, inspC, inspD){
  var v = m5_adjustedDamageFactor(score, confidence, inspA, inspB, inspC, inspD);
  return v == null ? "—" : String(Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000);
}

  return opts.map(function(o){return '<option value="'+o.v+'"'+(s===o.v?' selected':'')+'>'+o.t+'</option>';}).join("");
}

  ];
  var s=(selected==null?"":String(selected));
