function m5_normalizeDateString(v){
  if(v==null) return null;
  var s=String(v).trim();
  if(!s) return null;
  if(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
  var dmy=s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{4})$/);
  if(dmy){
    var dd=String(parseInt(dmy[1],10)).padStart(2,"0");
    var mm=String(parseInt(dmy[2],10)).padStart(2,"0");
    var yy=String(parseInt(dmy[3],10));
    return yy+"-"+mm+"-"+dd;
  }
  var ymd=s.match(/^(\d{4})[\/](\d{1,2})[\/](\d{1,2})$/);
  if(ymd){
    var y=String(parseInt(ymd[1],10));
    var m=String(parseInt(ymd[2],10)).padStart(2,"0");
    var d=String(parseInt(ymd[3],10)).padStart(2,"0");
    return y+"-"+m+"-"+d;
  }
  return null;
}
function m5_datePaste(evt, el){
  if(!evt || !el) return;
  var t = "";
  try { t = evt.clipboardData ? evt.clipboardData.getData("text") : ""; } catch(_) { t = ""; }
  var norm = m5_normalizeDateString(t);
  if(norm){
    evt.preventDefault();
    el.value = norm;
    if(typeof el.dispatchEvent === "function"){
      try { el.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true })); } catch(_) {}
    }
  }
}
var m5_datePickerInput = null;
function m5_showDatePicker(inputEl){
  if(!inputEl || !inputEl.classList || !inputEl.classList.contains("m5-df-date-pick")) return;
  var pop = document.getElementById("m5_datePickerPopover");
  if(!pop) return;
  m5_datePickerInput = inputEl;
  var val = (inputEl.value || "").trim();
  var y = new Date().getFullYear(), m = new Date().getMonth();
  if(val && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(val)){
    var parts = val.split("-");
    y = parseInt(parts[0],10);
    m = parseInt(parts[1],10)-1;
  }
  pop.setAttribute("data-year", y);
  pop.setAttribute("data-month", m);
  m5_datePickerRefreshGrid(pop, y, m);
  pop.classList.add("is-open");
  pop.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
  var rect = inputEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  pop.style.left = rect.left + "px";
  pop.style.top = (rect.bottom + 4) + "px";
  setTimeout(function(){ document.addEventListener("click", m5_datePickerCloseOnClick); }, 0);
}
function m5_dpMonthYearSelectsHtml(year, month){
  var monthNames = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  var nowY = new Date().getFullYear();
  var yLo = Math.min(nowY - 60, year);
  var yHi = Math.max(nowY + 25, year);
  var html = '<select class="m5-dp-month" title="Month" aria-label="Month">';
  var i;
  for(i = 0; i < 12; i++){
    html += '<option value="'+i+'"'+(i === month ? ' selected' : '')+'>'+monthNames[i]+'</option>';
  }
  html += '</select><select class="m5-dp-year" title="Year" aria-label="Year">';
  for(i = yLo; i <= yHi; i++){
    html += '<option value="'+i+'"'+(i === year ? ' selected' : '')+'>'+i+'</option>';
  }
  html += '</select>';
  return html;
}
function m5_datePickerRefreshGrid(pop, y, m){
  if(!pop) return;
  pop.setAttribute("data-year", y);
  pop.setAttribute("data-month", m);
  var sel = m5_datePickerInput && m5_datePickerInput.value ? m5_datePickerInput.value.trim() : "";
  pop.innerHTML = m5_buildCalendarHTML(y, m, sel);
  m5_datePickerBindNav(pop);
}
function m5_datePickerBindNav(pop){
  if(!pop)return;
  var py=pop.querySelector(".m5-dp-prev-y"); if(py)py.onclick=function(){m5_datePickerYear(-1);};
  var pm=pop.querySelector(".m5-dp-prev"); if(pm)pm.onclick=function(){m5_datePickerMonth(-1);};
  var ny=pop.querySelector(".m5-dp-next-y"); if(ny)ny.onclick=function(){m5_datePickerYear(1);};
  var nm=pop.querySelector(".m5-dp-next"); if(nm)nm.onclick=function(){m5_datePickerMonth(1);};
  var clr=pop.querySelector(".m5-dp-clear button"); if(clr)clr.onclick=function(){m5_datePickerSelect("");};
  var mo=pop.querySelector(".m5-dp-month");
  if(mo) mo.onchange = function(){
    var yy = parseInt(pop.getAttribute("data-year"), 10);
    var mm = parseInt(mo.value, 10);
    if(!Number.isFinite(yy)) yy = new Date().getFullYear();
    if(!Number.isFinite(mm) || mm < 0 || mm > 11) mm = 0;
    m5_datePickerRefreshGrid(pop, yy, mm);
  };
  var yr=pop.querySelector(".m5-dp-year");
  if(yr) yr.onchange = function(){
    var yy = parseInt(yr.value, 10);
    var mm = parseInt(pop.getAttribute("data-month"), 10);
    if(!Number.isFinite(yy)) yy = new Date().getFullYear();
    if(!Number.isFinite(mm) || mm < 0 || mm > 11) mm = 0;
    m5_datePickerRefreshGrid(pop, yy, mm);
  };
  var dayCells=pop.querySelectorAll(".m5-dp-day[data-ymd]");
  for(var i=0;i<dayCells.length;i++){
    dayCells[i].onclick=(function(ymd){return function(){m5_datePickerSelect(ymd);};})(dayCells[i].getAttribute("data-ymd"));
  }
}
function m5_buildCalendarHTML(year, month, selectedYMD){
  var first = new Date(year, month, 1);
  var last = new Date(year, month + 1, 0);
  var startPad = first.getDay();
  var daysInMonth = last.getDate();
  var selectsHtml = m5_dpMonthYearSelectsHtml(year, month);
  var html = '<div class="m5-dp-nav"><span class="m5-dp-nav-btns"><button type="button" class="m5-dp-prev-y" aria-label="Previous year" title="Previous year">&laquo;</button><button type="button" class="m5-dp-prev" aria-label="Previous month" title="Previous month">&lsaquo;</button></span><span class="m5-dp-selects">'+selectsHtml+'</span><span class="m5-dp-nav-btns"><button type="button" class="m5-dp-next" aria-label="Next month" title="Next month">&rsaquo;</button><button type="button" class="m5-dp-next-y" aria-label="Next year" title="Next year">&raquo;</button></span></div>';
  html += '<table><thead><tr><th>Su</th><th>Mo</th><th>Tu</th><th>We</th><th>Th</th><th>Fr</th><th>Sa</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr>';
  var prevMonth = month - 1; var prevYear = year; if(prevMonth<0){ prevMonth=11; prevYear--; }
  var prevLast = new Date(prevYear, prevMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
  var cell = 0;
  for(var p = startPad - 1; p >= 0; p--){
    var d = prevLast - p;
    var ymd = prevYear+"-"+String(prevMonth+1).padStart(2,"0")+"-"+String(d).padStart(2,"0");
    html += '<td><span class="m5-dp-day other-month" data-ymd="'+ymd+'">'+d+'</span></td>';
    cell++;
  }
  for(var d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++){
    var ymd = year+"-"+String(month+1).padStart(2,"0")+"-"+String(d).padStart(2,"0");
    var cls = "m5-dp-day" + (ymd === selectedYMD ? " selected" : "");
    html += '<td><span class="'+cls+'" data-ymd="'+ymd+'">'+d+'</span></td>';
    cell++;
    if(cell % 7 === 0) html += '</tr><tr>';
  }
  var nextMonth = month + 1; var nextYear = year; if(nextMonth>11){ nextMonth=0; nextYear++; }
  var remain = 7 - (cell % 7); if(remain === 7) remain = 0;
  for(var n = 1; n <= remain; n++){
    var ymd = nextYear+"-"+String(nextMonth+1).padStart(2,"0")+"-"+String(n).padStart(2,"0");
    html += '<td><span class="m5-dp-day other-month" data-ymd="'+ymd+'">'+n+'</span></td>';
  }
  html += '</tr></tbody></table><div class="m5-dp-clear"><button type="button">Clear date</button></div>';
  return html;
}
function m5_datePickerMonth(delta){
  var pop = document.getElementById("m5_datePickerPopover");
  if(!pop || !pop.classList.contains("is-open")) return;
  var y = parseInt(pop.getAttribute("data-year"),10), m = parseInt(pop.getAttribute("data-month"),10);
  m += delta;
  if(m > 11){ m = 0; y++; } else if(m < 0){ m = 11; y--; }
  m5_datePickerRefreshGrid(pop, y, m);
}
function m5_datePickerYear(delta){
  var pop = document.getElementById("m5_datePickerPopover");
  if(!pop || !pop.classList.contains("is-open")) return;
  var y = parseInt(pop.getAttribute("data-year"),10), m = parseInt(pop.getAttribute("data-month"),10);
  y += delta;
  m5_datePickerRefreshGrid(pop, y, m);
}
function m5_datePickerSelect(ymd){
  if(m5_datePickerInput){
    m5_datePickerInput.value = ymd;
    if(typeof m5_datePickerInput.dispatchEvent === "function"){
      try { m5_datePickerInput.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true })); } catch(_) {}
      try { m5_datePickerInput.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); } catch(_) {}
    }
  }
  m5_datePickerClose();
}
function m5_datePickerClose(){
  var pop = document.getElementById("m5_datePickerPopover");
  if(pop){ pop.classList.remove("is-open"); pop.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); pop.innerHTML = ""; }
  m5_datePickerInput = null;
  document.removeEventListener("click", m5_datePickerCloseOnClick);
}
function m5_datePickerCloseOnClick(evt){
  var pop = document.getElementById("m5_datePickerPopover");
  if(!pop || !evt || !evt.target) return;
  if(pop.contains(evt.target) || (m5_datePickerInput && m5_datePickerInput.contains && m5_datePickerInput.contains(evt.target))) return;
  m5_datePickerClose();
}
function m5_nonNegInt(v){
  var n = parseInt(v, 10);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 0;
}

    {v:"low",t:"Low confidence"},
    {v:"medium",t:"Medium confidence"},
    {v:"high",t:"High confidence"}
  ];
  var s=(selected==null?"medium":String(selected));
  return opts.map(function(o){return '<option value="'+o.v+'"'+(s===o.v?' selected':'')+'>'+o.t+'</option>';}).join("");
}
function m5_fCat(m){return m.category||m.Category||"";}
function m5_isThinningCategory(cat){return String(cat||"").trim().toLowerCase()==="thinning";}
function m5_damageDescription(m){
  if(!m||typeof m!=="object") return "";
  var parts=[
    m5_fId(m), m5_fName(m), m5_fMode(m), m5_fCat(m),
    m5_fMat(m), m5_fTemp(m), m5_fProc(m)
  ].map(function(v){return v!=null?String(v).trim():"";}).filter(Boolean);
  return parts.join(" · ");
}
function m5_getThinningMechanisms(materialGroup){
  if(typeof m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded==="function") m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded();
  var mechs=typeof m5_getMechs==="function"?m5_getMechs():[];
  return mechs.filter(function(m){
    if(!m5_isThinningCategory(m5_fCat(m))) return false;
    if(materialGroup&&typeof m5_materialGroupsOverlap==="function"&&!m5_materialGroupsOverlap(m5_fMat(m), materialGroup)) return false;
    return true;
  });
}
function m5_thinningCategorySummary(materialGroup){
  var mechs=m5_getThinningMechanisms(materialGroup);
  if(!mechs.length){
    if(typeof m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded==="function"&&!m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded()){
      return "Thinning — load M0 damage library";
    }
    return "Thinning — no M0 mechanisms"+(materialGroup?" for "+materialGroup:"");
  }
  return "Thinning ("+mechs.length+" M0 mechanism"+(mechs.length===1?"":"s")+")";
}
function m5_thinningSubtypeMatchesSelection(m, selected){
  if(!selected||!m) return false;
  var sel=String(selected).trim();
  if(!sel) return false;
  var id=m5_fId(m);
  if(id&&sel===id) return true;
  var desc=m5_damageDescription(m);
  if(desc&&sel===desc) return true;
  var name=m5_fName(m);
  if(name&&sel===name) return true;
  return false;
}
function m5_findThinningMechanism(selected, materialGroup){
  if(!selected||!String(selected).trim()) return null;
  var mechs=m5_getThinningMechanisms(materialGroup);
  for(var i=0;i<mechs.length;i++){
    if(m5_thinningSubtypeMatchesSelection(mechs[i], selected)) return mechs[i];
  }
  mechs=m5_getThinningMechanisms("");
  for(var j=0;j<mechs.length;j++){
    if(m5_thinningSubtypeMatchesSelection(mechs[j], selected)) return mechs[j];
  }
  return null;
}
function m5_mechanismDetailText(m){
  if(!m||typeof m!=="object") return "";
  function fmtVal(v){
    if(v==null||v==="") return "";
    if(Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(function(x){return String(x);}).join("; ");
    if(typeof v==="object") return JSON.stringify(v);
    return String(v);
  }
  function addLine(lines, label, val){
    var t=fmtVal(val);
    if(t) lines.push(label+": "+t);
  }
  var lines=[];
  addLine(lines,"ID", m5_fId(m));
  addLine(lines,"Name", m5_fName(m));
  addLine(lines,"Mode", m5_fMode(m));
  addLine(lines,"Category", m5_fCat(m));
  addLine(lines,"Material group", m5_fMat(m));
  addLine(lines,"Temperature range", m5_fTemp(m));
  addLine(lines,"Process environment", m5_fProc(m));
  addLine(lines,"Loading", m5_fLoad(m));
  addLine(lines,"Description", m.description||m.Definition||m.definition);
  addLine(lines,"Susceptible materials", m.susceptible_materials);
  addLine(lines,"Critical factors", m.critical_factors);
  addLine(lines,"Inspection methods", m.inspection_methods||m.inspection);
  addLine(lines,"Mitigation", m.mitigation);
  var used={"id":1,"mechanism_id":1,"ID":1,"dm_id":1,"name":1,"mechanism_name":1,"Name":1,"Mechanism":1,"mode":1,"Mode":1,"failure_mode":1,"category":1,"Category":1,"material_group":1,"Material_Group":1,"material":1,"Material":1,"temperature_range":1,"Temperature_Range":1,"temp_range":1,"temperature":1,"process_environment":1,"Process_Environment":1,"process":1,"environment":1,"loading":1,"Loading":1,"stress":1,"load_type":1,"description":1,"Definition":1,"definition":1,"susceptible_materials":1,"critical_factors":1,"inspection_methods":1,"inspection":1,"mitigation":1};
  Object.keys(m).forEach(function(k){
    if(used[k]) return;
    addLine(lines, k.replace(/_/g," "), m[k]);
  });
  return lines.join("\n");
}
function m5_wildcardMatch(text, pattern){
  if(pattern==null||!String(pattern).trim()) return true;
  var hay=String(text||"").toLowerCase();
  var pat=String(pattern).trim().toLowerCase();
  if(pat.indexOf("*")<0&&pat.indexOf("?")<0) return hay.indexOf(pat)>=0;
  var reStr=pat.replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g,"\\$&").replace(/\*/g,".*").replace(/\?/g,".");
  try{ return new RegExp(reStr).test(hay); }catch(_){ return hay.indexOf(pat.replace(/\*/g,""))>=0; }
}
function m5_thinningMechanismSearchHaystack(m){
  if(!m) return "";
  return [
    m5_fId(m), m5_fName(m), m5_fMode(m), m5_fCat(m),
    m5_fMat(m), m5_fTemp(m), m5_fProc(m), m5_fLoad(m),
    m5_damageDescription(m),
    m.description||m.Definition||m.definition,
    m.susceptible_materials, m.critical_factors,
    m.inspection_methods||m.inspection, m.mitigation
  ].map(function(v){
    if(v==null||v==="") return "";
    if(Array.isArray(v)) return v.join(" ");
    return String(v);
  }).filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}
function m5_thinningSubtypeOptions(selected, materialGroup, searchQ){
  var mechs=m5_getThinningMechanisms(materialGroup);
  var q=(searchQ==null?"":String(searchQ)).trim();
  if(q) mechs=mechs.filter(function(m){ return m5_wildcardMatch(m5_thinningMechanismSearchHaystack(m), q); });
  var html='<option value="">— Select sub-type (M0) —</option>';
  mechs.forEach(function(m){
    var id=m5_fId(m)||"";
    var label=m5_damageDescription(m)||m5_fName(m)||id||"Mechanism";
    var escId=String(id).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");
    var escLabel=String(label).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");
    var sel=selected&&m5_thinningSubtypeMatchesSelection(m, selected);
    html+='<option value="'+escId+'"'+(sel?' selected':'')+'>'+escLabel+'</option>';
  });
  if(selected&&String(selected).trim()&&!mechs.some(function(m){return m5_thinningSubtypeMatchesSelection(m, selected);})){
    var escLegacy=String(selected).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;");
    html+='<option value="'+escLegacy+'" selected>'+escLegacy+'</option>';
  }
  return html;
}

function m5_syncCustomDatePicker(dfTimeEl, dfSourceEl, dfDateEl){
  if(!dfTimeEl || !dfDateEl) return;
  var t = dfTimeEl.value || "t0";
  var s = dfSourceEl && dfSourceEl.value ? dfSourceEl.value : "";
  if(s === "measured_condition" && t !== "custom_date"){
    dfTimeEl.value = "custom_date";
    t = "custom_date";
    if(typeof dfDateEl.showPicker === "function"){
      try { dfDateEl.showPicker(); } catch(_) {}
    } else if(dfDateEl.classList && dfDateEl.classList.contains("m5-df-date-pick")){
      m5_showDatePicker(dfDateEl);
    }
  }
  dfDateEl.disabled = false;
}
/** Bands for half-life (years) from Libraries / M0 Half remaining life (min, max, score, label). Same interval rule as PoF Mapping (min inclusive, max exclusive or open). */
function m5_getHalfRemainingLifeBands(){
  var rows = Array.isArray(REF.halfRemainingLife) && REF.halfRemainingLife.length ? REF.halfRemainingLife : null;
  if ((!rows || !rows.length) && typeof window.osrPeekM0HalfRemainingLife === "function") {
    var live = window.osrPeekM0HalfRemainingLife();
    if (Array.isArray(live) && live.length) rows = live;
  }
  return Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
}
/** Built-in half-life PoF tiers (years): shorter life → higher score. Matches M0 default band breakpoints. */
function m5_halfLifePoFScore(hYears) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(hYears)) return null;
  if (hYears > 16) return 1;
  if (hYears > 10) return 2;
  if (hYears >= 6) return 3;
  if (hYears >= 2) return 4;
  return 5;
}
function m5_halfLifePoFLabel(sc) {
  var map = { 1: "low", 2: "med low", 3: "medium", 4: "med high", 5: "high" };
  return map[sc] || "";
}
/** True when M0 half-life rows look like PoF rate fractions (max &lt; 1 yr), not years. */
function m5_halfLifeBandsLookLikePoF(bands) {
  if (!bands || !bands.length) return false;
  var i, mx, n;
  for (i = 0; i < bands.length; i++) {
    mx = bands[i].max;
    if (mx == null || mx === "") continue;
    n = Number(mx);
    if (Number.isFinite(n) && n < 1) return true;
  }
  return false;
}
/** Match one half-life band row (default rows use inclusive max on medium/med-low). */
function m5_halfLifeRowMatches(hYears, b) {
  var min = Number(b.min);
  var maxRaw = b.max;
  var max = (maxRaw == null || maxRaw === "") ? null : Number(maxRaw);
  var score = m5_normalizePofBandScore(b.score);
  if (!(score >= 1 && score <= 5)) return false;
  if (score === 3) {
    return (Number.isFinite(min) ? hYears >= min : true) && (Number.isFinite(max) ? hYears <= max : true);
  }
  if (score === 2) {
    return (Number.isFinite(min) ? hYears > min : true) && (Number.isFinite(max) ? hYears <= max : true);
  }
  if (score === 1) {
    return Number.isFinite(min) ? hYears > min : true;
  }
  var inMin = Number.isFinite(min) ? (hYears >= min) : true;
  var inMax = (max == null || !Number.isFinite(max)) ? true : (hYears < max);
  return inMin && inMax;
}
/** Map half-life in years to M0 / legacy band; returns { score, label } or null if no match or invalid. */
function m5_mapHalfLifeYearsToBand(hYears){
  if (!Number.isFinite(hYears)) return null;
  var bands = typeof m5_getHalfRemainingLifeBands === "function" ? m5_getHalfRemainingLifeBands() : [];
  var i, b, score, label;
  if (bands.length && !m5_halfLifeBandsLookLikePoF(bands)) {
    for (i = 0; i < bands.length; i++) {
      b = bands[i] || {};
      if (m5_halfLifeRowMatches(hYears, b)) {
        score = m5_normalizePofBandScore(b.score);
        if (!(score >= 1 && score <= 5)) return null;
        label = b.label != null ? String(b.label).trim() : "";
        return { score: score, label: label };
      }
    }
    var tierSc = m5_halfLifePoFScore(hYears);
    if (tierSc != null) {
      label = m5_halfLifePoFLabel(tierSc);
      for (i = 0; i < bands.length; i++) {
        b = bands[i] || {};
        if (m5_normalizePofBandScore(b.score) === tierSc && b.label != null && String(b.label).trim() !== "") {
          label = String(b.label).trim();
          break;
        }
      }
      return { score: tierSc, label: label };
    }
    return null;
  }
  var legacy = REF.riskConfig && REF.riskConfig.half_life_pof;
  if (legacy && Array.isArray(legacy) && legacy.length) {
    for (i = 0; i < legacy.length; i++) {
      b = legacy[i];
      var minY = b.min_yrs != null ? parseFloat(b.min_yrs) : null;
      var maxY = b.max_yrs != null ? parseFloat(b.max_yrs) : null;
      var match = false;
      if (maxY == null && minY != null) match = (hYears > minY);
      else if (minY == null && maxY != null) match = (hYears < maxY);
      else if (minY != null && maxY != null) match = (hYears >= minY && hYears < maxY);
      if (match) {
        score = m5_normalizePofBandScore(b.score);
        if (!(score >= 1 && score <= 5)) return null;
        label = b.label != null ? String(b.label).trim() : "";
        return { score: score, label: label };
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}
/** Display string: score + M0 label (or damage-rate wording for built-in tier fallback). */
function m5_halfLifeBandDisplay(halfLifeStr){
  var h = parseFloat(halfLifeStr);
  if (isNaN(h)) return "—";
  var m = typeof m5_mapHalfLifeYearsToBand === "function" ? m5_mapHalfLifeYearsToBand(h) : null;
  if (m && m.score != null) {
    var lb = (m.label && String(m.label).trim() !== "") ? String(m.label).trim() : (typeof m5_pofScoreLabel === "function" ? m5_pofScoreLabel(m.score) : String(m.score));
    return m.score + " " + lb;
  }
  var sc = typeof m5_pofScoreFromHalfLife === "function" ? m5_pofScoreFromHalfLife(halfLifeStr) : null;
  if (sc != null && typeof m5_pofScoreLabel === "function") return sc + " " + m5_pofScoreLabel(sc);
  return "—";
}
function m5_pofScoreFromHalfLife(halfLifeStr){
  var h=parseFloat(halfLifeStr);
  if(isNaN(h))return null;
  var mapped = typeof m5_mapHalfLifeYearsToBand === "function" ? m5_mapHalfLifeYearsToBand(h) : null;
  if(mapped && mapped.score != null) return mapped.score;
  if(typeof m5_getHalfRemainingLifeBands === "function") {
    var hlBands = m5_getHalfRemainingLifeBands();
    if(hlBands.length && !m5_halfLifeBandsLookLikePoF(hlBands)) return null;
  }
  if(REF.riskConfig && REF.riskConfig.half_life_pof && Array.isArray(REF.riskConfig.half_life_pof) && REF.riskConfig.half_life_pof.length) return null;
  return m5_halfLifePoFScore(h);
}
function m5_calcTminFor(idx,surface){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var arrKey=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
  var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
  m5_syncCalcFromUI(idx,surface);
  var c=m5_data&&m5_data[arrKey]?m5_data[arrKey][idx]:null;
  var P=parseFloat($("m5_desPres").value);
  var CA=parseFloat($("m5_corrAllow").value); if(isNaN(CA))CA=0;
  var cont=$(contId); if(!cont)return "—";
  var ffsEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_ffsResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var remEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_remWallResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var y2tEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_yearsToTminResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var halfEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_halfLifeResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var halfBandEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_halfLifeBandResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var pofEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_pofScoreResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var tMin=m5_calcTminValue(c,P,CA);
  var tMinNum=parseFloat(tMin);
  var ffs=(!isNaN(tMinNum)&&tMinNum<2.5)?2.5:(tMinNum);
  var ffsStr=(!isNaN(ffs)?ffs.toFixed(2):tMin);
  if(ffsEl)ffsEl.textContent=ffsStr;
  var tmm=c.measured_thickness_mm!=null?String(c.measured_thickness_mm):"";
  var cr=c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr!=null?String(c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr):"";
  var remWall=m5_calcRemainingWall(tmm,ffsStr);
  var y2t=m5_calcYearsToTminFromInspection(remWall,cr,c.measured_thickness_date);
  var halfLife=m5_calcHalfLife(y2t);
  if(remEl)remEl.textContent=remWall;
  if(y2tEl)y2tEl.textContent=y2t;
  if(halfEl)halfEl.textContent=halfLife;
  if(halfBandEl)halfBandEl.textContent=(typeof m5_halfLifeBandDisplay==="function"?m5_halfLifeBandDisplay(halfLife):"—");
  var screenEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_screeningPoFResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  if(screenEl&&typeof m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText==="function")screenEl.textContent=m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText(c,halfLife);
  if(pofEl)pofEl.textContent=(typeof m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText==="function"?m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText(c,m5_data,halfLife):"\u2014");
  return tMin;
}

}

function m5_save(){
  if(!activeAsset)return;
  if(!m5_data&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage){
    m5_data=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage));
  }
  if(!m5_data)return;
  var cont=$("m5_minWallCalcs");
  if(cont&&cont.querySelector('.m5-mw-tabs-root[data-m5-surface="internal"]')){
    var calcs=m5_data.min_wall_calcs||[];
    for(var i=0;i<calcs.length;i++)m5_syncCalcFromUI(i,"internal");
  }
  var extCont=$("m5_externalMinWallCalcs");
  if(extCont&&extCont.querySelector('.m5-mw-tabs-root[data-m5-surface="external"]')){
    var extCalcs=m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs||[];
    for(var j=0;j<extCalcs.length;j++)m5_syncCalcFromUI(j,"external");
  }
  var crackCont=$("m5_crackingCalcs");
  if(crackCont&&crackCont.querySelector('.m5_calcTitle[data-idx="0"]')){
    var crackCalcs=m5_data.cracking_calcs||[];
    for(var k=0;k<crackCalcs.length;k++)m5_syncCrackingFromUI(k);
  }
  var otherCont=$("m5_otherCalcs");
  if(otherCont&&otherCont.querySelector('.m5_calcTitle[data-idx="0"]')){
    var otherCalcs=m5_data.other_calcs||[];
    for(var k2=0;k2<otherCalcs.length;k2++)m5_syncOtherFromUI(k2);
  }
  if(Array.isArray(m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs)){
    m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs=m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_minWallCalcIsUsed==="function"&&m5_minWallCalcIsUsed(c); });
  }
  if(typeof m5_syncGenericFailureCalcTitle==="function")m5_syncGenericFailureCalcTitle();
  if(m5_data&&m5_data.gff_hole_selection&&typeof m5_data.gff_hole_selection==="object")
    m5_data.gff_hole_selection=m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m5_data);
  var m5SeaEl = $("m5_sea_notes"); m5_data.specialist_engineering_assessment = m5SeaEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m5_sea_notes") : "";
  var m5NotesEl = $("m5_notes"); m5_data.notes = m5NotesEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m5_notes") : "";
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m5_data));
  setModuleStatus(3,"complete"); auditLog(3,"saved");
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  $("m5_status").textContent="Saved — "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
}

/** Load PCC-3 damage screening library into REF when M0 hydrate / demo-rules did not (dropdowns stay "All" otherwise). */
function m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded(){
  if(REF.screenLib && m5_getMechs().length>0) return true;
  function applyDamagePayload(data, fname){
    if(!data||typeof refApply!=="function") return false;
    try{
      refApply("damage", data, fname);
      return !!(REF.screenLib && m5_getMechs().length>0);
    }catch(e){
      console.warn("m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded refApply", e);
      return false;
    }
  }
  var gdu=typeof $==="function"?$("gdu_damage"):null;
  if(gdu&&String(gdu.value||"").trim()){
    try{
      if(applyDamagePayload(JSON.parse(gdu.value), "M0 damage library (embedded)")) return true;
    }catch(eG){ console.warn("m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded gdu_damage", eG); }
  }
  if(typeof osrCallGetM0State==="function"){
    try{
      var st=osrCallGetM0State();
      if(st&&st.damage!=null&&st.damage!==""){
        var raw=st.damage;
        var dmg=typeof raw==="string"?(function(){try{return JSON.parse(raw);}catch(e){return null;}})():raw;
        if(dmg&&applyDamagePayload(dmg, "M0 RBI Data snapshot")) return true;
      }
    }catch(eSt){ console.warn("m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded M0 state", eSt); }
  }
  if(typeof m6_damageMechanismsFromDemoRules==="function"){
    var mechs=m6_damageMechanismsFromDemoRules();
    if(mechs.length){
      return applyDamagePayload({library:"PCC-3",mechanisms:mechs}, "Embedded demo rules (damage)");
    }
  }
  return false;
}
function m5_refreshDamageMechanismList(){
  m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded();
  if(typeof m5_populateFilters==="function") m5_populateFilters();
  if(typeof m5_syncDamageFilterFromActiveCalc==="function") m5_syncDamageFilterFromActiveCalc("internal");
  else if(typeof m5_applyFilter==="function") m5_applyFilter();
}

function m5_getMechs(){
  if(!REF.screenLib)return [];
  if(Array.isArray(REF.screenLib))return REF.screenLib;
  var known = REF.screenLib.mechanisms||REF.screenLib.data||REF.screenLib.items||
              REF.screenLib.rows||REF.screenLib.Table_B1||REF.screenLib.table_b1||
              REF.screenLib.damage_mechanisms||REF.screenLib.screening||null;
  if(Array.isArray(known)&&known.length)return known;
  var keys=Object.keys(REF.screenLib);
  for(var i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
    var v=REF.screenLib[keys[i]];
    if(Array.isArray(v)&&v.length>0)return v;
  }
  return [];
}

function m5_populateFilters(){
  if(typeof m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded==="function") m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded();
  var mechs=m5_getMechs();
  if(!mechs.length){
    var countEl0=$("m5_count");
    if(countEl0) countEl0.textContent="0 mechanisms — load screening library in M0";
    return;
  }
  if(!window.m5_filterOptionCache) window.m5_filterOptionCache={material:[],temperature:[],process:[],loading:[]};
  var sets={material:new Set(),temperature:new Set(),process:new Set(),loading:new Set()};
  mechs.forEach(function(m){
    var mat=m5_fMat(m), tmp=m5_fTemp(m), proc=m5_fProc(m), ld=m5_fLoad(m);
    if(mat)sets.material.add(mat);
    if(tmp)sets.temperature.add(tmp);
    if(proc)sets.process.add(proc);
    if(ld)sets.loading.add(ld);
  });
  ["material","temperature","process","loading"].forEach(function(key){
    window.m5_filterOptionCache[key]=Array.from(sets[key]).sort();
  });
  var countEl=$("m5_count"); if(countEl) countEl.textContent=mechs.length+" mechanisms total";
  m5_filterDropdown("m5_mat","m5_mat_search","material");
  m5_filterDropdown("m5_temp","m5_temp_search","temperature");
  m5_filterDropdown("m5_proc","m5_proc_search","process");
  m5_filterDropdown("m5_load","m5_load_search","loading");
}

function m5_filterDropdown(selectId, searchId, key){
  if(!window.m5_filterOptionCache) window.m5_filterOptionCache={material:[],temperature:[],process:[],loading:[]};
  var sel=$(selectId), search=$(searchId);
  if(!sel) return;
  var prev=sel.value||"";
  var q=(search&&search.value?search.value:"").trim().toLowerCase();
  var items=(window.m5_filterOptionCache[key]||[]).filter(function(v){
    return !q || String(v).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0;
  });
  sel.innerHTML='<option value="">All</option>';
  items.forEach(function(v){
    var o=document.createElement("option");o.value=v;o.textContent=v;sel.appendChild(o);
  });
  var hasPrev=Array.prototype.some.call(sel.options,function(o){return o.value===prev;});
  sel.value=hasPrev?prev:"";
}

function m5_getMulti(id){
  var sel=$(id); if(!sel) return [];
  var v=sel.value;
  return v?[v]:[];
}
function m5_columnSearchQ(searchId){
  var e=$(searchId);
  return (e&&e.value?e.value:"").trim().toLowerCase();
}
function m5_fieldMatchesFilter(value, exactVals, partialQ){
  if(exactVals.length){
    var v=value||"";
    return !v||exactVals.indexOf(v)>=0;
  }
  if(partialQ){
    return String(value||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(partialQ)>=0;
  }
  return true;
}

  m5_filterDropdown("m5_temp","m5_temp_search","temperature");
  m5_filterDropdown("m5_proc","m5_proc_search","process");
  m5_filterDropdown("m5_load","m5_load_search","loading");
  var se=$("m5_search");if(se)se.value="";
  m5_applyFilter();
}
