function m5_fMat(m){return m.material_group||m.Material_Group||m.material||m.Material||""}
function m5_fTemp(m){return m.temperature_range||m.Temperature_Range||m.temp_range||m.temperature||""}
function m5_fProc(m){return m.process_environment||m.Process_Environment||m.process||m.environment||""}
function m5_fLoad(m){return m.loading||m.Loading||m.stress||m.load_type||""}
function m5_fName(m){return m.name||m.mechanism_name||m.Name||m.Mechanism||m.description||""}
function m5_fId(m){return m.id||m.mechanism_id||m.ID||m.dm_id||""}
function m5_fMode(m){return m.mode||m.Mode||m.failure_mode||""}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION: ASME VIII-1 — Pressure design (UG-27, UG-32, UG-34, UG-36/37), component types
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function m5_getComponentTypeOptions(){
  return [{id:"shell_course",label:"Shell course (API 650)",ref:"§5.6.3",factor:"hydrostatic"},{id:"tankbottom",label:"Tank bottom",ref:"API 653",factor:"Part 5"},{id:"tankbotedge",label:"Bottom edge",ref:"API 653",factor:"Part 5"},{id:"roof",label:"Roof",ref:"API 650",factor:"—"},{id:"shell",label:"Shell (pressure vessel)",ref:"UG-27(c)",factor:"0.6"},{id:"elliptical",label:"2:1 Ellipsoidal head",ref:"UG-32(c)",factor:"0.2"},{id:"torispherical",label:"Torispherical head",ref:"UG-32(d)",factor:"0.2"},{id:"hemispherical",label:"Hemispherical head",ref:"UG-32(e)",factor:"0.2"},{id:"conical",label:"Conical head",ref:"UG-32(f)",factor:"0.2"},{id:"toriconical",label:"Toriconical head",ref:"UG-32(g)",factor:"0.2"},{id:"flathead",label:"Flat head / blind flange",ref:"UG-34",factor:"C"},{id:"nozzle",label:"Nozzle neck",ref:"UG-27(c)",factor:"0.6"},{id:"largeopening",label:"Large opening",ref:"UG-36/37",factor:"Special"}];
}
function m5_componentTypeFullLabel(id){
  if(!id)return "—";
  var opts=typeof m5_getComponentTypeOptions==="function"?m5_getComponentTypeOptions():[];
  for(var i=0;i<opts.length;i++){if(opts[i].id===id){
    var f=opts[i].factor;
    var suffix=f==="C"?" — C factor":f==="Special"?" — Special":" — factor "+f;
    return opts[i].label+" ("+opts[i].ref+")"+suffix;
  }}
  return id;
}

function m5_applyFilter(){
  if(typeof m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded==="function") m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded();
  var mechs=m5_getMechs();
  var countEl=$("m5_count");
  if(!mechs.length){if(countEl) countEl.textContent="0 mechanisms — load screening library in M0";return;}
  var fMat=m5_getMulti("m5_mat"), fTemp=m5_getMulti("m5_temp"), fProc=m5_getMulti("m5_proc"), fLoad=m5_getMulti("m5_load");
  var qMat=!fMat.length?m5_columnSearchQ("m5_mat_search"):"";
  var qTemp=!fTemp.length?m5_columnSearchQ("m5_temp_search"):"";
  var qProc=!fProc.length?m5_columnSearchQ("m5_proc_search"):"";
  var qLoad=!fLoad.length?m5_columnSearchQ("m5_load_search"):"";
  var searchEl=$("m5_search");
  var searchTxt=(searchEl&&searchEl.value?searchEl.value:"").trim().toLowerCase();
  var filtered=mechs.filter(function(m){
    var calcMatGrp=window.m5_activeCalcMaterialGroup||"";
    if(calcMatGrp&&!m5_materialGroupsOverlap(m5_fMat(m), calcMatGrp)) return false;
    if(!m5_fieldMatchesFilter(m5_fMat(m), fMat, qMat)) return false;
    if(!m5_fieldMatchesFilter(m5_fTemp(m), fTemp, qTemp)) return false;
    if(!m5_fieldMatchesFilter(m5_fProc(m), fProc, qProc)) return false;
    if(!m5_fieldMatchesFilter(m5_fLoad(m), fLoad, qLoad)) return false;
    if(searchTxt){
      var id=(m5_fId(m)||"").toLowerCase();
      var name=(m5_fName(m)||"").toLowerCase();
      var mode=(m5_fMode(m)||"").toLowerCase();
      var mat=(m5_fMat(m)||"").toLowerCase();
      var tmp=(m5_fTemp(m)||"").toLowerCase();
      var desc=(m.description||m.Definition||m.definition||"").toLowerCase();
      var proc=(m5_fProc(m)||"").toLowerCase();
      var load=(m5_fLoad(m)||"").toLowerCase();
      var match=id.indexOf(searchTxt)>=0||name.indexOf(searchTxt)>=0||mode.indexOf(searchTxt)>=0||
                mat.indexOf(searchTxt)>=0||tmp.indexOf(searchTxt)>=0||desc.indexOf(searchTxt)>=0||
                proc.indexOf(searchTxt)>=0||load.indexOf(searchTxt)>=0;
      if(!match)return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  if(countEl) countEl.textContent=filtered.length+" mechanisms match";
  m5_lastFiltered=filtered;
  m5_renderTable(filtered);
}

var m5_lastFiltered=[], m5_sortCol="id", m5_sortDir=1;

function m5_sortBy(col){
  if(m5_sortCol===col){m5_sortDir=-m5_sortDir;} else{m5_sortCol=col;m5_sortDir=1;}
  if(!m5_lastFiltered.length)return;
  var arr=m5_lastFiltered.slice();
  var sel=m5_data?m5_data.selected_mechanisms:[];
  if(col==="selected"){
    arr.sort(function(a,b){
      var sa=sel.indexOf(m5_fId(a))>=0?1:0, sb=sel.indexOf(m5_fId(b))>=0?1:0;
      return m5_sortDir*(sa-sb);
    });
  } else {
    var k=col==="id"?"_id":col==="mechanism"?"_name":col==="mode"?"_mode":col==="material"?"_mat":"_id";
    arr.sort(function(a,b){
      var va=(k==="_id"?m5_fId(a):k==="_name"?m5_fName(a):k==="_mode"?m5_fMode(a):m5_fMat(a))||"";
      var vb=(k==="_id"?m5_fId(b):k==="_name"?m5_fName(b):k==="_mode"?m5_fMode(b):m5_fMat(b))||"";
      var c=String(va).localeCompare(String(vb),"en",{numeric:true});
      return m5_sortDir*(c||0);
    });
  }
  m5_lastFiltered=arr;
  m5_renderTable(arr);
}

function m5_renderTable(mechs){
  var el=$("m5_table");
  if(!mechs||!mechs.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="hint">No mechanisms match filters</div>';return;}
  var hasDefs=Object.keys(m5_defsMap).length>0;
  var arrow=function(c){return m5_sortCol===c?(m5_sortDir>0?" \u25b2":" \u25bc"):"";};
  var trunc=function(s,n){if(!s)return"—";s=String(s);return s.length<=n?s:s.slice(0,n)+"\u2026";};
  var esc=function(s){return escHtml(s);};
  var h='<table class="m5-tbl"><thead><tr><th class="m5-sort" onclick="m5_sortBy(\'id\')">ID'+arrow("id")+'</th><th class="m5-sort" onclick="m5_sortBy(\'mechanism\')">Mechanism'+arrow("mechanism")+'</th><th class="m5-sort" onclick="m5_sortBy(\'mode\')">Mode'+arrow("mode")+'</th><th class="m5-sort" onclick="m5_sortBy(\'material\')">Material'+arrow("material")+'</th><th>Definition</th><th>Attributes</th><th>Inspection</th><th>References</th>'+(hasDefs?'<th style="width:30px">&#9432;</th>':'')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';
  mechs.forEach(function(m){
    var id=m5_fId(m);
    var mode=m5_fMode(m);
    var modeClass=mode==="Internal"?"chip-blue":mode==="External"?"chip-amber":"chip-green";
    var defAvail=m5_lookupDef(id,m5_fName(m));
    var src=defAvail||m;
    var desc=src?(src.description||src.Definition||src.definition||""):"";
    var defTxt=trunc(desc,100);
    var attrs=[];
    if(src){
      if(src.material_group) attrs.push("Material Group: "+src.material_group);
      if(src.process_environment) attrs.push("Process Environment: "+src.process_environment);
      if(src.temperature_range) attrs.push("Temperature Range: "+src.temperature_range);
      if(src.loading) attrs.push("Loading / Stress: "+src.loading);
    }
    var attrTxt=attrs.length?attrs.join(" | "):"—";
    var insp=src?(src.inspection_methods||src.inspection||[]):[];
    var inspTxt=Array.isArray(insp)&&insp.length?insp.join("; "):"—";
    var refTxt=src?(src.reference||""):"";
    if(refTxt)refTxt=trunc(refTxt,80);
    else refTxt="—";
    h+='<tr style="cursor:'+(defAvail?'pointer':'default')+'" onclick="m5_showDef(\''+String(id||"").replace(/\\/g,"\\\\").replace(/'/g,"\\'")+'\',\''+String(m5_fName(m)||"").replace(/\\/g,"\\\\").replace(/'/g,"\\'")+'\')">';
    h+='<td>'+esc(id)+'</td><td>'+esc(m5_fName(m))+'</td>';
    h+='<td>'+(mode?'<span class="chip '+modeClass+'">'+esc(mode)+'</span>':"")+'</td>';
    h+='<td style="font-size:10px">'+esc(m5_fMat(m))+'</td>';
    h+='<td style="font-size:10px;max-width:180px" title="'+esc(desc)+'">'+esc(defTxt)+'</td>';
    h+='<td style="font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap" title="'+esc(attrTxt)+'">'+esc(attrTxt)+'</td>';
    h+='<td style="font-size:10px;max-width:160px" title="'+esc(inspTxt)+'">'+esc(inspTxt)+'</td>';
    h+='<td style="font-size:10px;max-width:140px" title="'+esc(src?src.reference:"")+'">'+esc(refTxt)+'</td>';
    if(hasDefs) h+='<td style="text-align:center;color:'+(defAvail?'var(--accent)':'var(--border)')+'">&#9432;</td>';
    h+='</tr>';
  });
  h+='</tbody></table>'; el.innerHTML=h;
  // With tick-selection removed, treat visible mechanisms as selected for downstream modules.
  if(m5_data){
    m5_data.selected_mechanisms = mechs.map(function(mm){ return m5_fId(mm); }).filter(Boolean);
  }
  m5_updateSelCount();
}

function m5_lookupDef(id,name){
  if(m5_defsMap[id]) return m5_defsMap[id];
  if(name && m5_defsMap["_name_"+name.toLowerCase()]) return m5_defsMap["_name_"+name.toLowerCase()];
  return null;
}

function m5_showDef(id,name){
  var def=m5_lookupDef(id,name);
  if(!def){$("m5_defPanel").style.display="none";return;}
  $("m5_defPanel").style.display="block";
  $("m5_defTitle").textContent=(def.name||def.mechanism_name||def.Name||name);
  $("m5_defId").textContent=(def.id||def.dm_id||id)+" — "+(def.category||def.mode||"")+(def.reference?" — "+def.reference:"");
  $("m5_defDesc").textContent=def.description||def.Definition||def.definition||"No description available.";
  var mats=def.susceptible_materials||def.materials||[];
  $("m5_defMats").innerHTML=Array.isArray(mats)?mats.map(function(s){return '<span style="display:inline-block;background:var(--border);padding:2px 7px;border-radius:3px;margin:2px;font-size:11px">'+escHtml(s)+'</span>';}).join(""):"<em>—</em>";
  var facts=def.critical_factors||def.factors||[];
  $("m5_defFactors").innerHTML=Array.isArray(facts)?facts.map(function(s){return '<div style="padding:1px 0">• '+escHtml(s)+'</div>';}).join(""):"<em>—</em>";
  var insp=def.inspection_methods||def.inspection||[];
  $("m5_defInsp").innerHTML=Array.isArray(insp)?insp.map(function(s){return '<div style="padding:1px 0">• '+escHtml(s)+'</div>';}).join(""):"<em>—</em>";
  var mit=def.mitigation||def.prevention||[];
  $("m5_defMitig").innerHTML=Array.isArray(mit)?mit.map(function(s){return '<div style="padding:1px 0">• '+escHtml(s)+'</div>';}).join(""):"<em>—</em>";
  $("m5_defRef").textContent=def.reference||"";
  $("m5_defPanel").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"});
}

function m5_syncSelection(){
  if(!m5_data)return;
  var cbs=document.querySelectorAll(".m5-chk");
  m5_data.selected_mechanisms=[];
  cbs.forEach(function(cb){if(cb.checked)m5_data.selected_mechanisms.push(cb.dataset.id);});
  m5_updateSelCount();
}

function m5_updateSelCount(){
  var el=$("m5_selCount");
  if(el) el.textContent=(m5_data?m5_data.selected_mechanisms.length:0)+" selected";
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 6 — RISK SCORING & POSITION
   SECTION: PCC-3 §8–9 / Industry screening — CoF, PoF, risk matrix, driving consequence
   ═══════════════════════════════════════ */

var m6_data=null, m6_riskConfig=null;

function m6_normalizeOptions(opts){
  if(!Array.isArray(opts)) return [];
  return opts.map(function(o){
    if(o==null) return {value:"",label:""};
    if(typeof o!=="object") return {value:String(o),label:String(o)};
    var rawValue = (o.value!=null?o.value:(o.id!=null?o.id:(o.score!=null?o.score:o.label)));
    var rawLabel = (o.label!=null?o.label:(o.score!=null?o.score:(o.description!=null?o.description:rawValue)));
    var value = rawValue==null ? "" : String(rawValue);
    // If score text is used as value (e.g. "A Low" or "1 – Low"), take leading A–E or digit 1–5.
    var v0 = value.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    if((v0==="A"||v0==="B"||v0==="C"||v0==="D"||v0==="E") && value.length>1 && !/^\d+$/.test(value)) value = v0;
    else if(/^[1-5]$/.test(v0) && value.trim().length>1 && !/^\d{2,}$/.test(value.trim())) value = v0;
    var label = rawLabel==null ? value : String(rawLabel);
    var matrixScore = (o.id!=null ? String(o.id) : (value||"")).trim();
    if(!matrixScore){ var c=(value||"").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase(); if(c) matrixScore=c; }
    var scoreText = (o.score!=null ? String(o.score) : (o.label!=null ? String(o.label) : label));
    var descText = (o.description!=null ? String(o.description) : "");
    return {value:value,label:label,matrixScore:matrixScore,score:scoreText,description:descText};
  }).filter(function(x){return x.value!==""||x.label!=="";});
}

function m6_normalizeCoFDimensions(dims){
  if(!Array.isArray(dims)) return [];
  return dims.map(function(dim){
    var d = Object.assign({}, dim || {});
    var srcOpts = d.options;
    // Support risk schema where options live under factors[0].options.
    if((!Array.isArray(srcOpts) || !srcOpts.length) && Array.isArray(d.factors) && d.factors.length){
      var f0 = d.factors[0] || {};
      srcOpts = f0.options;
      if(!d.description && f0.description) d.description = f0.description;
    }
    d.options = m6_normalizeOptions(srcOpts);
    return d;
  }).filter(function(d){return d && d.id;});
}

function m6_parseMechanismsFromDamageData(data){
  if(!data) return [];
  if(Array.isArray(data)) return data;
  if(typeof data !== "object") return [];
  var arr = data.mechanisms || data.damage_mechanisms || data.data || data.items || data.rows;
  if(Array.isArray(arr)) return arr;
  var keys = Object.keys(data);
  for(var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++){
    var v = data[keys[i]];
    if(Array.isArray(v) && v.length) return v;
  }
  return [];
}
function m6_damageMechanismsFromDemoRules(){
  try {
    var rules = (typeof DEMO_RULES !== "undefined" && DEMO_RULES) ? DEMO_RULES : null;
    if(!rules){
      var el = document.getElementById("demo-rules-json");
      if(el && el.textContent) rules = JSON.parse(el.textContent);
    }
    if(!rules) return [];
    var dmg = rules.damage || rules.Damage;
    if(typeof dmg === "string" && dmg.trim()){
      try { dmg = JSON.parse(dmg); } catch (eParse) { return []; }
    }
    return m6_parseMechanismsFromDamageData(dmg);
  } catch (e) { return []; }
}
function m6_collectMechanismRecords(){
  var seen = {}, out = [];
  function add(m){
    if(!m || typeof m !== "object") return;
    var id = (typeof m5_fId === "function" ? m5_fId(m) : (m.id || m.mechanism_id || m.ID || m.dm_id || "")).trim();
    if(!id || seen[id]) return;
    seen[id] = 1;
    out.push(m);
  }
  (typeof m5_getMechs === "function" ? m5_getMechs() : []).forEach(add);
  if(typeof m5_defsMap === "object" && m5_defsMap){
    Object.keys(m5_defsMap).forEach(function(k){
      if(k.indexOf("_name_") === 0) return;
      add(m5_defsMap[k]);
    });
  }
  try {
    var gdu = typeof $ === "function" ? $("gdu_damage") : null;
    if(gdu && gdu.value) m6_parseMechanismsFromDamageData(JSON.parse(gdu.value)).forEach(add);
  } catch (eGdu) {}
  m6_damageMechanismsFromDemoRules().forEach(add);
  return out;
}
function m6_getDamageMechanismOptions(){
  var out = [], seen = {};
  function pushOpt(value, label){
    if(!value || seen[value]) return;
    seen[value] = 1;
    out.push({ value: value, label: label || value });
  }
  m6_collectMechanismRecords().forEach(function(m){
    var id = (typeof m5_fId === "function" ? m5_fId(m) : (m.id || m.dm_id || m.mechanism_id || m.ID || "")).trim();
    var name = (typeof m5_fName === "function" ? m5_fName(m) : (m.name || m.mechanism_name || m.Name || m.description || "")).trim();
    var val = id || name;
    if(!val) return;
    pushOpt(val, id && name ? (id + " — " + name) : val);
  });
  var saved = (m6_data && m6_data.damage_mechanism != null) ? String(m6_data.damage_mechanism).trim() : "";
  if(saved && !seen[saved]){
    pushOpt(saved, typeof m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc === "function" ? m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc(saved) : saved);
  }
  out.sort(function(a,b){ return a.label.localeCompare(b.label, "en", {numeric:true}); });
  return out;
}
function m6_updateDamageMechanismLabel(){
  var el = $("m6_damage_mechanism_label");
  if(!el) return;
  var sel = $("m6_damage_mechanism");
  var v = (sel && sel.value) ? String(sel.value).trim() : "";
  if(!v && m6_data && m6_data.damage_mechanism != null) v = String(m6_data.damage_mechanism).trim();
  if(v){
    el.textContent = typeof m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc === "function" ? m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc(v) : v;
    el.style.display = "";
  } else {
    el.textContent = "";
    el.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function m6_filterDamageMechanismOptions(){
  var sel = $("m6_damage_mechanism");
  if(!sel) return;
  var searchEl = $("m6_damage_mechanism_search");
  var q = (searchEl && searchEl.value ? searchEl.value : "").trim().toLowerCase();
  var prev = sel.value || "";
  var opts = m6_getDamageMechanismOptions();
  if(q){
    opts = opts.filter(function(o){
      return (o.label||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0 || (o.value||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>=0;
    });
  }
  sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Select mechanism —</option>';
  opts.forEach(function(o){
    var op = document.createElement("option");
    op.value = o.value;
    op.textContent = o.label;
    sel.appendChild(op);
  });
  var hasPrev = Array.prototype.some.call(sel.options, function(o){ return o.value===prev; });
  if(hasPrev) sel.value = prev;
  else if(prev){
    var opKeep = document.createElement("option");
    opKeep.value = prev;
    opKeep.textContent = typeof m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc==="function" ? m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc(prev) : prev;
    sel.appendChild(opKeep);
    sel.value = prev;
  }
  if(typeof m6_updateDamageMechanismLabel==="function") m6_updateDamageMechanismLabel();
}

/* CoF: from CoF dimensions / risk JSON -> consequence.dimensions. Options 1–5 (or legacy A–E). */
function m6_getCoFDimensions(){
  var raw = (m6_riskConfig&&m6_riskConfig.consequence&&m6_riskConfig.consequence.dimensions) || REF.consequenceDimensions || [];
  return m6_normalizeCoFDimensions(raw);
}
function m6_getDrivingDimensionOptions(){
  var dims = m6_getCoFDimensions().filter(function(dim){ return m6_dimHasOptions(dim); });
  var hasFlammable = dims.some(function(dim){ return dim.id==="flammable_release"; });
  if(!hasFlammable){
    dims.push({ id:"flammable_release", label:"Flammable release" });
  }
  return dims;
}
function m6_drivingDimensionLabel(id){
  if(!id) return "";
  var dims = m6_getDrivingDimensionOptions();
  for(var i=0;i<dims.length;i++){ if(dims[i].id===id) return dims[i].label || id; }
  return id;
}
function m6_dimHasOptions(dim){ return dim.options&&dim.options.length>0; }
/** Pick option.value for &lt;select&gt; when saved CoF may be 1–5 or A–E vs library using the other form. */
function m6_findCofOptionMatch(dim, savedRaw){
  if(!dim||!dim.options||!dim.options.length) return "";
  var s=String(savedRaw==null?"":savedRaw).trim();
  var i, o;
  if(s){
    for(i=0;i<dim.options.length;i++){
      o=dim.options[i];
      if(o&&String(o.value)===s) return String(o.value);
    }
    var rank=m6_cofLetterToNum(s);
    if(rank>=1&&rank<=5){
      for(i=0;i<dim.options.length;i++){
        o=dim.options[i];
        if(!o) continue;
        if(m6_cofLetterToNum(o.value)===rank) return String(o.value);
      }
    }
  }
  return String(dim.options[0].value!=null&&dim.options[0].value!==""?dim.options[0].value:"1");
}
/** Driving-consequence &lt;select&gt; only allows 1–5; map saved A–E or digits to that. */
function m6_drivingLetterToSelectValue(raw){
  var n=m6_cofLetterToNum(raw!=null&&raw!==""?raw:"1");
  return n>=1&&n<=5?String(n):"1";
}
/** CoF value → rank 1–5 (display: A, low … E, high). Accepts digits 1–5 or legacy A–E. */
function m6_cofLetterToNum(v){
  var s=String(v||"").trim();
  if(!s) return 0;
  if(/^[1-5]$/.test(s)) return parseInt(s,10);
  var u=s.toUpperCase();
  var c=u.charAt(0);
  if(c==="A")return 1; if(c==="B")return 2; if(c==="C")return 3; if(c==="D")return 4; if(c==="E")return 5;
  var n=parseInt(s,10);
  return Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=1&&n<=5?n:0;
}
function m6_cofRankLabel(n){
  var letters=["","A","B","C","D","E"];
  var names=["","low","med low","med","med high","high"];
  return n>=1&&n<=5?letters[n]+", "+names[n]:"";
}
/** Live planning: merge Libraries + M0 (M0 overwrites same key string). If only one source, use it. */
function m6_getPlanningCellsFromRefOrM0(){
  var pl=typeof REF!=="undefined"&&REF&&REF.planningLib?REF.planningLib:null;
  var refCells=pl&&pl.cells&&typeof pl.cells==="object"&&!Array.isArray(pl.cells)?pl.cells:null;
  var refN=refCells?Object.keys(refCells).length:0;
  var m0cells=null;
  try{
    if(typeof window.osrPeekM0Planning==="function"){
      var o=window.osrPeekM0Planning();
      if(o&&o.cells&&typeof o.cells==="object"&&!Array.isArray(o.cells)&&Object.keys(o.cells).length) m0cells=o.cells;
    }
  }catch(e1){}
  var m0n=m0cells?Object.keys(m0cells).length:0;
  if(refN>0&&m0n>0){
    var merged={}, k;
    for(k in refCells){ if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(refCells,k)) merged[k]=refCells[k]; }
    for(k in m0cells){ if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m0cells,k)) merged[k]=m0cells[k]; }
    return merged;
  }
  if(refN>0) return refCells;
  if(m0cells) return m0cells;
  return refCells;
}
/**
 * Planning cell lookup. On-screen risk label uses m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof (**PoF digit + CoF letter**, e.g. **5E**).
 * M0 / CSV rows often use **E5** (CoF letter + PoF digit) or **55** (numeric). All variants are tried; case/space tolerant.
 */
function m6_planningCellEntry(cells,cofNum,pofNum){
  if(!cells) return null;
  var cn=parseInt(cofNum,10), pn=parseInt(pofNum,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(cn)||!Number.isFinite(pn)||cn<1||cn>5||pn<1||pn>5) return null;
  var candidates=[];
  var cofLeg="ABCDE".charAt(cn-1);
  var pofLeg="ABCDE".charAt(5-pn);
  if(pofLeg){
    candidates.push(pofLeg+String(cn));
    candidates.push((pofLeg+String(cn)).toLowerCase());
  }
  if(cofLeg){
    candidates.push(cofLeg+String(pn));
    candidates.push((cofLeg+String(pn)).toLowerCase());
    /* Match UI label 5E ↔ table row E5 */
    candidates.push(String(pn)+cofLeg);
    candidates.push((String(pn)+cofLeg).toLowerCase());
  }
  candidates.push(String(cn)+String(pn));
  var i,k;
  for(i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){
    k=candidates[i];
    if(cells[k]!=null) return cells[k];
  }
  var norm=function(s){return String(s||"").toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,"");};
  var lowMap={};
  try{
    Object.keys(cells).forEach(function(kk){ lowMap[norm(kk)]=kk; });
  }catch(e2){}
  for(i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){
    var nk=norm(candidates[i]);
    if(lowMap[nk]!=null) return cells[lowMap[nk]];
  }
  return null;
}
/** Manual planning lookup: pick row by exact key from M0 / Libraries merged cells (case-insensitive fallback). */
function m6_planningEntryForChosenKey(cells, chosenRaw) {
  if (!cells || chosenRaw == null || String(chosenRaw).trim() === "") return null;
  var chosen = String(chosenRaw).trim();
  if (cells[chosen] != null) return cells[chosen];
  var low = chosen.toLowerCase();
  var k;
  for (k in cells) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cells, k) && String(k).toLowerCase() === low) return cells[k];
  }
  return null;
}
function m6_sortedPlanningCellKeys(cells) {
  if (!cells || typeof cells !== "object") return [];
  var keys = Object.keys(cells);
  keys.sort(function(a, b) {
    var na = /^[1-5]{2}$/.test(a), nb = /^[1-5]{2}$/.test(b);
    if (na && !nb) return -1;
    if (!na && nb) return 1;
    if (na && nb) return parseInt(a, 10) - parseInt(b, 10);
    return String(a).localeCompare(String(b), undefined, { numeric: true });
  });
  return keys;
}
/** Risk cell string for UI/report: always CoF digit + PoF digit (e.g. 23); legacy B3 → 23. */
function m6_riskCellToNumericDisplay(rc){
  if(rc==null||rc==="") return "—";
  var s=String(rc).trim();
  if(s==="—") return "—";
  if(/^[1-5][1-5]$/.test(s)) return s;
  if(/^[A-E][1-5]$/i.test(s)){
    var cn=m6_cofLetterToNum(s.charAt(0)), pn=parseInt(s.charAt(1),10);
    if(cn>=1&&cn<=5&&pn>=1&&pn<=5) return String(cn)+String(pn);
  }
  return s;
}
/** Risk cell for on-screen labels: PoF band + CoF letter for that CoF rank (same as matrix columns A…E), e.g. key **23** → **3B** (rank 2 = B, PoF 3). */
function m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof(cofNum, pofNum){
  var cn=parseInt(cofNum,10), pn=parseInt(pofNum,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(cn)||!Number.isFinite(pn)||cn<1||cn>5||pn<1||pn>5) return "—";
  return String(pn)+"ABCDE".charAt(cn-1);
}
function m6_riskCellToDisplayLabel(rc){
  var norm=typeof m6_riskCellToNumericDisplay==="function"?m6_riskCellToNumericDisplay(rc):String(rc||"");
  if(norm==="—"||!/^[1-5][1-5]$/.test(norm)) return norm==="—"?"—":String(rc).trim();
  return m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof(norm.charAt(0), norm.charAt(1));
}
/** When loaded rules use numeric CoF options (1–5), map saved A–E values and driving letter. */
function m6_migrateCofScoresToNumericScale(data){
  if(!data||typeof data.cof!=="object") return;
  var dims=m6_getCoFDimensions().filter(function(d){ return m6_dimHasOptions(d); });
  if(!dims.length) return;
  var norm0=m6_normalizeOptions(dims[0].options||[]);
  var v0=norm0[0]&&norm0[0].value;
  var libNumeric=/^[1-5]$/.test(String(v0||""));
  var libLetter=/^[A-E]$/i.test(String(v0||""));
  if(libNumeric){
    dims.forEach(function(dim){
      var dd=data.cof[dim.id];
      if(!dd||dd._==null||dd._==="") return;
      var n=m6_cofLetterToNum(dd._);
      if(n>=1&&n<=5) dd._=String(n);
    });
  } else if(libLetter){
    dims.forEach(function(dim){
      var dd=data.cof[dim.id];
      if(!dd||dd._==null||dd._==="") return;
      var sv=String(dd._).trim();
      if(/^[1-5]$/.test(sv)){
        var leg="ABCDE".charAt(parseInt(sv,10)-1);
        if(leg) dd._=leg;
      }
    });
  }
  var d=data.drivingConsequence;
  if(d&&d.letter!=null&&String(d.letter).trim()!==""){
    var ln=m6_cofLetterToNum(d.letter);
    if(ln>=1&&ln<=5){
      if(libNumeric) d.letter=String(ln);
      else if(libLetter) d.letter="ABCDE".charAt(ln-1);
    }
  }
}

/** Map pre-4D CoF (Safety / Financial / Repair / Fines / Public image) into Personal / Asset / Reputation. */
function m6_migrateLegacyCofData(data){
  if(!data||typeof data.cof!=="object") return;
  var c=data.cof;
  var have={};
  m6_getCoFDimensions().forEach(function(di){ if(di&&di.id) have[di.id]=true; });
  function letterFromKeys(keys){
    var n=0;
    for(var i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
      var v=c[keys[i]]&&c[keys[i]]._;
      var x=m6_cofLetterToNum(v);
      if(x>n) n=x;
    }
    return n?String(n):"";
  }
  if(have.personal){
    if(!c.personal) c.personal={};
    if(!c.personal._&&c.safety&&c.safety._) c.personal._=c.safety._;
  }
  if(have.asset){
    if(!c.asset) c.asset={};
    var mergedAsset=letterFromKeys(["financial","repair_costs","fines_legal"]);
    if(mergedAsset&&(!c.asset._||!String(c.asset._).trim())) c.asset._=mergedAsset;
    else if(!c.asset._&&c.financial&&c.financial._) c.asset._=c.financial._;
  }
  if(have.reputation){
    if(!c.reputation) c.reputation={};
    if(!c.reputation._&&c.public_image&&c.public_image._) c.reputation._=c.public_image._;
  }
  var d=data.drivingConsequence;
  if(d&&d.dimensionId){
    if(d.dimensionId==="safety"&&have.personal) d.dimensionId="personal";
    else if((d.dimensionId==="financial"||d.dimensionId==="repair_costs"||d.dimensionId==="fines_legal")&&have.asset) d.dimensionId="asset";
    else if(d.dimensionId==="public_image"&&have.reputation) d.dimensionId="reputation";
  }
  [["safety","personal"],["financial","asset"],["repair_costs","asset"],["fines_legal","asset"],["public_image","reputation"]].forEach(function(pair){
    if(c[pair[0]]&&!have[pair[0]]&&have[pair[1]]) delete c[pair[0]];
  });
}

function m6_blank(){
  var d={cof:{},pof:{},pof_overall:"",damage_mechanism:"",planning_lookup_key:"",scores:{cof_total:0,cof_category:0,pof_total:0,pof_category:0,risk_product:0,risk_level:"NOT SCORED"},drivingConsequence:{letter:"1",dimensionId:""},comments:"",specialist_engineering_assessment:"",notes:""};
  var dims=m6_getCoFDimensions();
  dims.forEach(function(dim){
    if(!m6_dimHasOptions(dim)) return;
    d.cof[dim.id]={};
    var ov=(dim.options[0]&&dim.options[0].value);
    d.cof[dim.id]["_"]=(ov!=null&&ov!=="")?String(ov):"1";
  });
  var cfg=m6_riskConfig;
  if(cfg&&cfg.probability&&cfg.probability.factors){
    cfg.probability.factors.forEach(function(f){d.pof[f.id]=(f.options&&f.options[0]?f.options[0].value:"0");});
  }
  return d;
}

function m6_renderCoF(){
  var el=$("m6_cofContainer");
  var dims=m6_getCoFDimensions().filter(function(dim){ return m6_dimHasOptions(dim); });
  if(!dims.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="hint">Load <strong>CoF dimensions</strong> via Libraries (or bundled Rules CSV) with <strong>consequence.dimensions</strong> containing options (1–5 or A–E).</div>';return;}
  var h='<div class="hint" style="margin-bottom:10px">One rating per dimension (<strong>1</strong> = Low through <strong>5</strong> = High).</div>';
  h+='<div class="m6-cof-stack" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box">';
  for(var i=0;i<dims.length;i++){
    var dim=dims[i];
    h+='<div style="border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:10px;width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box">';
    h+='<div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px">'+(dim.icon||"")+" "+escHtml(dim.label)+'</div>';
    if(dim.description){h+='<div class="hint" style="font-size:11px;margin-bottom:6px">'+escHtml(dim.description)+'</div>';}
    h+='<div class="score-grid" style="max-width:100%">';
    var eid="m6_cof_"+dim.id;
    h+='<div class="score-field" style="max-width:100%"><label>'+escHtml(dim.label)+' <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'m6_cof_dimension\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></label>';
    h+='<select id="'+eid+'" onchange="m6_calc()" style="width:100%;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box">';
    dim.options.forEach(function(o){
      var txt;
      if(o && (o.matrixScore || o.score || o.description)){
        txt = (o.matrixScore||"") + " | " + (o.score||o.label||"") + " | " + (o.description||"");
      } else {
        txt = o.label;
      }
      h+='<option value="'+escHtml(o.value)+'">'+escHtml(txt)+'</option>';
    });
    h+='</select></div>';
    h+='</div></div>';
  }
  h+='</div>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
  m6_renderDrivingDropdown();
}

function m6_renderDrivingDropdown(){
  var sel=$("m6_drivingDimension");
  if(!sel) return;
  var dims=m6_getDrivingDimensionOptions();
  sel.innerHTML='<option value="">— select —</option>';
  dims.forEach(function(dim){
    var o=document.createElement("option");
    o.value=dim.id;
    o.textContent=dim.label;
    sel.appendChild(o);
  });
  var dc=m6_data&&m6_data.drivingConsequence?m6_data.drivingConsequence:null;
  if(dc&&dc.dimensionId){ var opt=sel.querySelector('option[value="'+dc.dimensionId+'"]'); if(opt) sel.value=dc.dimensionId; }
}

function m5_getMinWallConScores(){
  var m3=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage:null;
  var calcs=m3&&m3.min_wall_calcs?m3.min_wall_calcs:[];
  var extCalcs=m3&&m3.external_min_wall_calcs?m3.external_min_wall_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_minWallCalcIsUsed==="function"&&m5_minWallCalcIsUsed(c); }):[];
  var dc = {};
  if (typeof osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating === "function") dc = osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating().design_conditions || {};
  else {
    var m1=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset:null;
    dc=m1&&m1.design_conditions?m1.design_conditions:{};
  }
  var P=dc.design_pressure_mpa!=null?parseFloat(dc.design_pressure_mpa):null;
  if(!P||(!calcs.length&&!extCalcs.length))return [];
  var out=[];
  function pushScores(arr,prefix){
    for(var i=0;i<arr.length;i++){
      var c=arr[i];
      var tMin=m5_calcTminValue(c,P,0);
      var tMinNum=parseFloat(tMin);
      var ffs=(!isNaN(tMinNum)&&tMinNum<2.5)?2.5:(tMinNum);
      var ffsStr=(!isNaN(ffs)?ffs.toFixed(2):tMin);
      var tmm=c.measured_thickness_mm!=null?String(c.measured_thickness_mm):"";
      var cr=c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr!=null?String(c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr):"";
      var remWall=m5_calcRemainingWall(tmm,ffsStr);
      var y2t=m5_calcYearsToTminFromInspection(remWall,cr,c.measured_thickness_date);
      var halfLife=m5_calcHalfLife(y2t);
      var pof=m5_pofScoreFromHalfLife(halfLife);
      var tit=(prefix?prefix+" — ":"")+(c.calculation_title||("Calc "+(i+1)));
      var pofDisp=(typeof m5_halfLifeBandDisplay==="function"?m5_halfLifeBandDisplay(halfLife):(pof!=null?pof+" "+m5_pofScoreLabel(pof):"—"));
      out.push({title:tit,pofScore:pofDisp,score:pof});
    }
  }
  pushScores(calcs,"");
  pushScores(extCalcs,"External");
  return out;
}

function m5_getCrackingConScores(){
  var m3=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage:null;
  var calcs=m3&&m3.cracking_calcs?m3.cracking_calcs:[];
  var out=[];
  for(var i=0;i<calcs.length;i++){
    var c=calcs[i];
    var tit=c.calculation_title||(c.cracking_type||("Cracking "+(i+1)));
    var gr=c.pof_score!=null?parseInt(c.pof_score,10):NaN;
    var pofDisp="—";
    var score=null;
    if(Number.isFinite(gr)&&gr>=1&&gr<=5){
      pofDisp=gr+" "+m5_pofScoreLabel(gr);
      score=gr;
    } else {
      var susRaw=c.susceptibility!=null?c.susceptibility:c.df_score;
      var sn=susRaw!=null?parseInt(susRaw,10):NaN;
      if(Number.isFinite(sn)&&sn>=1&&sn<=5)pofDisp=sn+" "+m5_susceptibilityBandLabel(sn);
    }
    out.push({title:tit,pofScore:pofDisp,score:score});
  }
  return out;
}
function m5_getOtherConScores(){
  var m3=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage:null;
  var calcs=m3&&m3.other_calcs?m3.other_calcs:[];
  var out=[];
  for(var i=0;i<calcs.length;i++){
    var c=calcs[i];
    var pof=c.pof_score;
    var tit=c.calculation_title||(c.mechanism_type||("Other "+(i+1)));
    var pofDisp=pof!=null?pof+" "+m5_pofScoreLabel(pof):"—";
    out.push({title:tit,pofScore:pofDisp,score:pof});
  }
  return out;
}

function m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(c){
  if(!c || typeof c!=="object") return null;
  if(typeof m5_isMinWallThinningCalc==="function" && m5_isMinWallThinningCalc(c)){
    var dfThin=typeof m5_thinReliabilityDfForCalc==="function"?m5_thinReliabilityDfForCalc(c):null;
    if(Number.isFinite(dfThin)) return dfThin;
    return null;
  }
  if(typeof m5_isCrackingCalc==="function" && m5_isCrackingCalc(c)){
    var dfCr=typeof m5_crack581DfForCalc==="function"?m5_crack581DfForCalc(c):null;
    if(Number.isFinite(dfCr)) return dfCr;
    return null;
  }
  return m5_adjustedDamageFactor(c.df_score, c.confidence_level, c.insp_a, c.insp_b, c.insp_c, c.insp_d);
}

function m6_matchMechanism(calc, needle){
  if(!calc || !needle) return false;
  var n = String(needle).trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!n) return false;
  var hay = [
    calc.calculation_title,
    calc.cracking_type,
    calc.mechanism_type,
    calc.component_type,
    calc.external_damage_mechanism
  ].filter(Boolean).map(function(x){ return String(x).toLowerCase(); }).join(" | ");
  return hay.indexOf(n) >= 0;
}

/** Pool of M3 calcs considered for governing DF (with calc kind for UI labelling). */
function m6_workingPofCalcEntries(m3){
  if(!m3) return [];
  var out = [];
  function push(arr, kind){
    if(!Array.isArray(arr)) return;
    arr.forEach(function(c, idx){
      if(!c || typeof c!=="object") return;
      if(kind==="external_min_wall" && typeof m5_minWallCalcIsUsed==="function" && !m5_minWallCalcIsUsed(c)) return;
      out.push({ calc:c, kind:kind, idx:idx });
    });
  }
  push(m3.min_wall_calcs, "internal_min_wall");
  push(m3.external_min_wall_calcs, "external_min_wall");
  push(m3.cracking_calcs, "cracking");
  push(m3.other_calcs, "other");
  return out;
}

function m6_workingPofCalcKindLabel(kind){
  var map = {
    internal_min_wall: "Internal min-wall",
    external_min_wall: "External min-wall",
    cracking: "Cracking",
    other: "Other"
  };
  return map[kind] || String(kind || "Calc");
}

/** Human caption for the calc that governs summary DF, e.g. "Cracking — SCC shell". */
function m6_governingDfCalcCaption(entry){
  if(!entry || !entry.calc) return "";
  var kindLbl = m6_workingPofCalcKindLabel(entry.kind);
  var c = entry.calc;
  var detail = "";
  if(entry.kind==="cracking") detail = c.calculation_title || c.cracking_type || "";
  else if(entry.kind==="other") detail = c.calculation_title || c.mechanism_type || "";
  else if(entry.kind==="external_min_wall") detail = c.calculation_title || c.external_damage_mechanism || "";
  else detail = c.calculation_title || "";
  if(!String(detail).trim() && c.component_type){
    detail = typeof m5_componentTypeFullLabel==="function" ? m5_componentTypeFullLabel(c.component_type) : c.component_type;
  }
  detail = String(detail || "").trim();
  if(!detail) detail = kindLbl + " #" + (entry.idx + 1);
  if(detail.toLowerCase() === kindLbl.toLowerCase()) return kindLbl;
  return kindLbl + " \u2014 " + detail;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION: Industry screening — Probability of failure (PoF = GFF × FMS × DF), PoF mapping
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/** Working PoF (probability of failure) per Industry screening: PoF = GFF × FMS × DF.
 *  GFF = failure frequency (failures/yr, from GFF library or M3 GFF);
 *  FMS = management systems factor (from Management questionnaire);
 *  DF = damage factor (adjusted, from min wall / cracking / other calcs). */
/** Live M3 Damage (m5_data while editing) else last saved module3_damage. */
function m6_effectiveM3Data(){
  if(typeof m5_data!=="undefined"&&m5_data&&typeof m5_data==="object") return m5_data;
  var s=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi:null;
  return s&&s.module3_damage?s.module3_damage:null;
}

function m6_getWorkingPofInputs(){
  var m3=typeof m6_effectiveM3Data==="function"?m6_effectiveM3Data():null;
  if(!m3) return { gff:null, fms:null, dfAdjusted:null, workingPof:null, dfGoverning:null, dfFilterApplied:false };

  var gff = null;
  if(m3.generic_failure_gff && typeof m3.generic_failure_gff==="object"){
    var gv = m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject(m3.generic_failure_gff, m3);
    if(Number.isFinite(gv)) gff = gv;
  }

  var fms = null;
  if(m3.management_questionnaire && typeof m3.management_questionnaire==="object"){
    var fv = Number(m3.management_questionnaire.fms);
    if(Number.isFinite(fv)) fms = fv;
  }

  var dmSel = (m6_data && m6_data.damage_mechanism) ? String(m6_data.damage_mechanism).trim() : "";
  var allEntries = m6_workingPofCalcEntries(m3);
  var matched = dmSel ? allEntries.filter(function(e){ return m6_matchMechanism(e.calc, dmSel); }) : [];
  var dfAdjusted = null;
  var dfGoverning = null;
  var dfFilterApplied = !!(dmSel && matched.length);
  if(dfFilterApplied){
    matched.forEach(function(entry){
      var v = m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(entry.calc);
      if(Number.isFinite(v) && (dfAdjusted==null || v > dfAdjusted)){
        dfAdjusted = v;
        dfGoverning = entry;
      }
    });
  }
  if(dfGoverning){
    dfGoverning = {
      kind: dfGoverning.kind,
      idx: dfGoverning.idx,
      caption: m6_governingDfCalcCaption(dfGoverning)
    };
  }

  /* Industry screening: working PoF = GFF × FMS × DF (numeric); then mapped to 1–5 via PoF Mapping bands */
  var workingPof = (Number.isFinite(gff) && Number.isFinite(fms) && Number.isFinite(dfAdjusted)) ? (gff * fms * dfAdjusted) : null;
  return {
    gff:gff,
    fms:fms,
    dfAdjusted:dfAdjusted,
    workingPof:workingPof,
    dfGoverning:dfGoverning,
    dfFilterApplied:dfFilterApplied
  };
}

/** Cracking PoF band = M3 susceptibility score (1–5). M6 matches M3; no GFF×FMS×DF override for cracking band. */
function m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc(calc){
  if(!calc||typeof m5_isCrackingCalc!=="function"||!m5_isCrackingCalc(calc)) return null;
  var txt=typeof m5_crackingPofBandUiText==="function"?m5_crackingPofBandUiText(calc):null;
  if(!txt||txt==="\u2014") return null;
  var sus=calc.susceptibility!=null?calc.susceptibility:(calc.pof_score!=null?calc.pof_score:calc.df_score);
  var n=parseInt(sus,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<1||n>5) return null;
  return { score:n, label:txt, susceptibilityText:txt, source:"m3_susceptibility" };
}

/** Summary PoF band for M6. Uses M3 calc matching Damage mechanism (filter) only — not auto max-DF. */
function m6_effectiveSummaryPofBand(m3, wp){
  wp=wp||(typeof m6_getWorkingPofInputs==="function"?m6_getWorkingPofInputs():{});
  m3=m3||(typeof m6_effectiveM3Data==="function"?m6_effectiveM3Data():null);
  if(!wp.dfFilterApplied||!wp.dfGoverning) return null;
  if(wp.dfGoverning.kind==="cracking"&&m3&&Array.isArray(m3.cracking_calcs)){
    var c=m3.cracking_calcs[wp.dfGoverning.idx];
    var b=typeof m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc==="function"?m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc(c):null;
    if(b) return b;
    return null;
  }
  if(wp.dfGoverning.kind==="cracking") return null;
  if(wp.workingPof!=null&&Number.isFinite(wp.workingPof)&&typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand==="function"){
    var m=m6_mapWorkingPofBand(wp.workingPof);
    if(m&&m.score>=1&&m.score<=5){
      return { score:m.score, label:typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi==="function"?m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(m.score):String(m.score), source:"gff_fms_df" };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** GFF×FMS×DF(adj) for one M3 calc → numeric PoF + PoF band (cracking: M3 susceptibility). */
function m6_screeningPofUiForCalc(calc, m3){
  if(!calc || !m3) return { prod:null, bandLabel:"\u2014", prodText:"\u2014", uiText:"\u2014" };
  var gff = null, fms = null;
  if(m3.generic_failure_gff && typeof m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject==="function"){
    var holeSel = typeof m5_isMinWallThinningCalc==="function" && m5_isMinWallThinningCalc(calc) && typeof m5_gffHoleSelForCalc==="function"
      ? m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(calc, m3) : m3;
    var gv = m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject(m3.generic_failure_gff, holeSel);
    if(Number.isFinite(gv)) gff = gv;
  }
  if(m3.management_questionnaire && typeof m3.management_questionnaire==="object"){
    var fv = Number(m3.management_questionnaire.fms);
    if(Number.isFinite(fv)) fms = fv;
  }
  var dfAdj = typeof m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc==="function" ? m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(calc) : null;
  var prod = (Number.isFinite(gff) && Number.isFinite(fms) && Number.isFinite(dfAdj)) ? (gff * fms * dfAdj) : null;
  var bandLabel = "\u2014";
  var uiText = "\u2014";
  if(typeof m5_isCrackingCalc==="function"&&m5_isCrackingCalc(calc)){
    var m3b=typeof m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc==="function"?m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc(calc):null;
    if(m3b){
      bandLabel=m3b.label;
      uiText=m3b.susceptibilityText||m3b.label;
      var prodText = prod != null && Number.isFinite(prod) ? Number(prod).toExponential(3) + " failures/yr" : "\u2014";
      return { prod:prod, bandLabel:bandLabel, prodText:prodText, uiText:uiText, bandScore:m3b.score, bandSource:"m3_susceptibility" };
    }
  }
  if(prod != null && typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand==="function"){
    var mapped = m6_mapWorkingPofBand(prod);
    if(mapped && mapped.score >= 1 && mapped.score <= 5 && typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi==="function")
      bandLabel = m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(mapped.score);
  }
  var prodText = prod != null && Number.isFinite(prod) ? Number(prod).toExponential(3) + " failures/yr" : "\u2014";
  uiText = (prodText !== "\u2014" && bandLabel !== "\u2014")
    ? (prodText + " \u2192 " + bandLabel)
    : "\u2014";
  return { prod:prod, bandLabel:bandLabel, prodText:prodText, uiText:uiText };
}

function m5_crackCalcIsUsed(c){
  if(!c || typeof c!=="object") return false;
  if(String(c.cracking_type||"").trim()) return true;
  if(String(c.calculation_title||"").trim()) return true;
  if(c.susceptibility!=null || c.df_score!=null) return true;
  return false;
}

function m5_otherCalcIsUsed(c){
  if(!c || typeof c!=="object") return false;
  if(String(c.mechanism_type||"").trim()) return true;
  if(String(c.calculation_title||"").trim()) return true;
  if(c.df_score!=null || c.pof_score!=null) return true;
  return false;
}

function m6_getPofMappingBands(){
  var rows = Array.isArray(REF.pofMapping) && REF.pofMapping.length ? REF.pofMapping : null;
  if(!rows){
    var cfg = m6_riskConfig;
    if(cfg && cfg.probability && Array.isArray(cfg.probability.numeric_bands) && cfg.probability.numeric_bands.length){
      rows = cfg.probability.numeric_bands;
    }
  }
  if((!rows || !rows.length) && typeof window.osrPeekM0PofMapping==="function"){
    var live = window.osrPeekM0PofMapping();
    if(Array.isArray(live) && live.length) rows = live;
  }
  return Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
}

/** Legacy letter for numeric PoF band (5→A … 1→E) — kept for planning CSV / old cell keys only; UI uses digits 1–5. */
function m6_pofBandLetterFromNumeric(n){
  var ni = parseInt(n, 10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(ni) || ni < 1 || ni > 5) return "";
  var letters = { 5: "A", 4: "B", 3: "C", 2: "D", 1: "E" };
  return letters[ni] || "";
}

/**
 * Band wording from PoF Mapping: matches internal band n (1–5) to table row by score (digit or A–E), uses label column.
 * full: **n / label** for single-field UI (e.g. m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi).
 * short: **label only** — callers that prefix the band digit use `n + " " + m5_pofScoreLabel(n)`; short must not repeat n or "n /" or you get `2 2 / med low`.
 */
function m6_grPofOptionMetaFromPofMapping(score){
  var n = parseInt(score, 10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 5) return null;
  var bands = m6_getPofMappingBands();
  var row = null;
  for(var i = 0; i < bands.length; i++){
    var b = bands[i];
    if(!b) continue;
    var ns = m5_normalizePofBandScore(b.score);
    if(ns !== n) continue;
    row = b;
    break;
  }
  if(!row) return null;
  var lbl = row.label != null ? String(row.label).trim() : "";
  if(!lbl) return null;
  var fullText = (String(n) + " / " + lbl).trim();
  return { full: fullText, short: lbl };
}

/** Same visible text as Driving Probability for PoF band n (1–5): PoF Mapping → M0 option label → m5_pofScoreLabel (PoF = numeric frequency 1 low … 5 high). */
function m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(n){
  var oi = parseInt(n, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(oi) || oi < 1 || oi > 5) return "\u2014";
  var mapMeta = typeof m6_grPofOptionMetaFromPofMapping === "function" ? m6_grPofOptionMetaFromPofMapping(oi) : null;
  if (mapMeta && mapMeta.full) return mapMeta.full;
  var grMeta = typeof m6_grPofOptionMetaFromM0 === "function" ? m6_grPofOptionMetaFromM0(oi) : null;
  if (grMeta && grMeta.full) return grMeta.full;
  return typeof m5_pofScoreLabel === "function" ? m5_pofScoreLabel(oi) : String(oi);
}

function m6_mapWorkingPofBand(workingPof){
  if(!Number.isFinite(workingPof)) return null;
  var bands = m6_getPofMappingBands();
  for(var i=0;i<bands.length;i++){
    var b = bands[i] || {};
    var min = Number(b.min);
    var maxRaw = b.max;
    var max = (maxRaw==null || maxRaw==="") ? null : Number(maxRaw);
    var inMin = Number.isFinite(min) ? (workingPof >= min) : true;
    var inMax = (max==null || !Number.isFinite(max)) ? true : (workingPof < max);
    if(inMin && inMax){
      var score = m5_normalizePofBandScore(b.score);
      return {
        score: (score>=1 && score<=5) ? score : null,
        label: b.label!=null ? String(b.label) : "",
        min: Number.isFinite(min) ? min : null,
        max: (max==null || !Number.isFinite(max)) ? null : max
      };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Industry screening working PoF band (1–5) for min-wall calcs: GFF×FMS×DF(adj) mapped via PoF bands; null if inputs missing. */
function m5_pofFromScreeningWorkingMinWall(calc,m3){
  if(!calc||!m3)return null;
  var gff=null,fms=null;
  if(m3.generic_failure_gff&&typeof m3.generic_failure_gff==="object"){
    var holeSel=typeof m5_gffHoleSelForCalc==="function"?m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(calc,m3):m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m3);
    var gv=m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject(m3.generic_failure_gff,holeSel);
    if(Number.isFinite(gv))gff=gv;
  }
  if(m3.management_questionnaire&&typeof m3.management_questionnaire==="object"){
    var fv=Number(m3.management_questionnaire.fms!=null?m3.management_questionnaire.fms:m3.management_questionnaire.FMS);
    if(Number.isFinite(fv))fms=fv;
  }
  var dfAdj=typeof m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc==="function"?m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(calc):null;
  var wp=(Number.isFinite(gff)&&Number.isFinite(fms)&&Number.isFinite(dfAdj))?(gff*fms*dfAdj):null;
  var mapped=typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand==="function"?m6_mapWorkingPofBand(wp):null;
  if(mapped&&mapped.score>=1&&mapped.score<=5)return mapped.score;
  return null;
}

/** M3 min-wall PoF score readout: GFF×FMS×DF(adj) → PoF Mapping (same label as hole size PoF) when available; else half-life band. Keeps PoF row in sync when GFF line is refreshed without full card re-render. */

function m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText(calc, halfLifeStr) {
  if (!calc) return "\u2014";
  var hs = halfLifeStr != null ? String(halfLifeStr).trim() : "";
  if (hs && hs !== "\u2014" && typeof m5_halfLifeBandDisplay === "function") {
    var hb = m5_halfLifeBandDisplay(halfLifeStr);
    if (hb && hb !== "\u2014") return hb;
  }
  var pofHalf = typeof m5_pofScoreFromHalfLife === "function" ? m5_pofScoreFromHalfLife(halfLifeStr) : null;
  if (pofHalf != null && typeof m5_pofScoreLabel === "function") return pofHalf + " " + m5_pofScoreLabel(pofHalf);
  return "\u2014";
}
function m5_minWallGoverningPoFUiText(calc, m3) {
  if (!calc) return "\u2014";
  var m3u = m3 || (typeof m5_data !== "undefined" ? m5_data : null);
  var pofApi = (m3u && typeof m5_pofFromScreeningWorkingMinWall === "function") ? m5_pofFromScreeningWorkingMinWall(calc, m3u) : null;
  if (pofApi != null && pofApi >= 1 && pofApi <= 5) {
    if (typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi === "function") {
      var t = m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(pofApi);
      if (t && t !== "\u2014") return t;
    }
    if (typeof m5_pofScoreLabel === "function") return pofApi + " " + m5_pofScoreLabel(pofApi);
    return String(pofApi);
  }
  return "\u2014";
}
/** Min-wall PoF readout: screening half-life band (M0). */
function m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText(calc,m3,halfLifeStr){
  if(!calc)return"\u2014";
  return typeof m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText==="function"?m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText(calc,halfLifeStr):"\u2014";
}

/** HTML: Small/Medium/Large/Rupture + Total (failures/yr); optional checkboxes drive working GFF. Internal/external COMP tabs use per-row gff_hole_selection; cracking/other use module-level. When embedInIo, omit top border and shorten hint for use inside GFF two-column row. */
function m5_htmlGffPerHoleSizeBreakdown(gffObj,m3,showSelectors,embedInIo,calcIdx,surface){
  embedInIo=!!embedInIo;
  if(!gffObj||typeof gffObj!=="object")return"";
  function fmtCell(v){
    if(v==null||!Number.isFinite(Number(v)))return"\u2014";
    var x=Number(v);
    var t=(typeof fmt==="function")?fmt(x,8):String(x);
    return escHtml(t);
  }
  var holes=[["Small","small","6 mm"],["Medium","medium","25 mm"],["Large","large","100 mm"],["Rupture","rupture","whole vessel"]];
  var perComp=false,ci=null;
  if(calcIdx!=null&&calcIdx!==""&&(surface==="internal"||surface==="external")){
    ci=parseInt(calcIdx,10);
    if(!isNaN(ci))perComp=true;
  }
  var sel=null;
  if(showSelectors&&m3){
    if(perComp){
      var arrKey=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
      var calc=(typeof m5_data!=="undefined"&&m5_data&&m5_data[arrKey])?m5_data[arrKey][ci]:null;
      sel=typeof m5_gffHoleSelForCalc==="function"?m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(calc,m3):m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m3);
    }else sel=m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m3);
  }
  var chgExtra=perComp?(","+ci+",'"+surface+"'"):"";
  var hdr="", cells="", has=false;
  holes.forEach(function(H){
    var title=H[0],key=H[1],sub=H[2];
    var thInner;
    if(sel){
      var on=!!sel[key];
      thInner='<label class="m5_gffHoleLbl"><input type="checkbox" class="m5_gffHoleChk" data-hole="'+escHtml(key)+'"'+(on?" checked":"")+' onchange="m5_gffHoleCheckboxChange(\''+key+'\',this.checked'+chgExtra+')" aria-label="'+escHtml(title+" "+sub)+'"/> <span class="m5_gffHoleTitle">'+escHtml(title)+'</span></label><div class="hint m5_gffHoleSub">'+escHtml(sub)+"</div>";
    }else{
      thInner='<span class="m5_gffHoleTitle">'+escHtml(title)+'</span><div class="hint m5_gffHoleSub">'+escHtml(sub)+"</div>";
    }
    hdr+="<th>"+thInner+"</th>";
    var n=Number(gffObj[key]);
    var c=fmtCell(n);
    if(c!=="\u2014")has=true;
    cells+='<td style="text-align:right">'+c+"</td>";
  });
  hdr+="<th><span class=\"m5_gffHoleTitle\">"+escHtml("Total")+'</span><div class="hint m5_gffHoleSub">consolidated (all sizes)</div></th>';
  var tot=m5_gffTotalHzFromObject(gffObj);
  var totC=fmtCell(tot);
  if(totC!=="\u2014")has=true;
  cells+='<td style="text-align:right;font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);color:var(--accent)">'+totC+"</td>";
  if(!has)return"";
  var hint='GFF by release hole size (failures/yr). Select <strong>one</strong> size for <strong>working GFF</strong> (above). <strong>Total</strong> = consolidated GFF: table <strong>Total (failures/yr)</strong> when set; otherwise <strong>\u03a3</strong> Small\u2026Rupture (Eq.\u00a03.2).';
  if(sel){
    var wHz=m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject(gffObj,sel);
    var wTxt=(wHz!=null&&Number.isFinite(wHz))?fmtCell(wHz):"\u2014";
    hint+=" <strong>Selected GFF (working):</strong> "+wTxt+" /yr.";
  }
  var embedHint=perComp?"Select <strong>one</strong> hole size for <strong>working GFF</strong> on this COMP tab (failures/yr). <strong>Total</strong> = table total when set, else \u03a3 Small\u2026Rupture.":"Select <strong>one</strong> hole size for <strong>working GFF</strong> (failures/yr). <strong>Total</strong> = table total when set, else \u03a3 Small\u2026Rupture.";
  var hintHtml='<div class="hint m5_gffHoleSizeHint">'+(embedInIo?embedHint:hint)+"</div>";
  var wrapCls="m5_gffHoleSizeWrap"+(embedInIo?" m5_gffHoleSizeWrap--embedded":"");
  return'<div class="'+wrapCls+'">'+hintHtml+'<table class="rtbl m5_gffHoleSizeTbl"><thead><tr>'+hdr+'</tr></thead><tbody><tr>'+cells+"</tr></tbody></table></div>";
}

/** M3 GFF Method (min-wall, external, cracking, other): two-column io-pair — left: release hole sizes + table; right: readout rows using the same label/value grid as Years to Tmin (minmax + auto, value justify-self:end). Optional consolidated-GFF tail; optional data-m5-aux for Cracking/Other. */
function m5_htmlGffMethodWorkingFactorsLine(calc,m3,resCol,calcIdx,surface,auxDom){
  if(!calc)return"";
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var auxAttr="";
  if(auxDom!=null&&String(auxDom)!==""){
    var auxEsc=String(auxDom).replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/"/g,"&quot;").replace(/</g,"&lt;");
    if(auxEsc)auxAttr=' data-m5-aux="'+auxEsc+'"';
  }
  var m3u=m3||(typeof m5_data!=="undefined"?m5_data:null);
  var perCompHole=(surface==="internal"||surface==="external");
  var holeSel=perCompHole&&typeof m5_gffHoleSelForCalc==="function"?m5_gffHoleSelForCalc(calc,m3u):m5_gffHoleSelectionNormalized(m3u||{});
  var gffFull=null,gffWork=null,fms=null;
  if(m3u&&m3u.generic_failure_gff&&typeof m3u.generic_failure_gff==="object"){
    var gTot=m5_gffTotalHzFromObject(m3u.generic_failure_gff);
    var gSel=m5_gffWorkingHzFromObject(m3u.generic_failure_gff,holeSel);
    if(Number.isFinite(gTot))gffFull=gTot;
    if(Number.isFinite(gSel))gffWork=gSel;
  }
  if(m3u&&m3u.management_questionnaire&&typeof m3u.management_questionnaire==="object"){
    var fv=Number(m3u.management_questionnaire.fms!=null?m3u.management_questionnaire.fms:m3u.management_questionnaire.FMS);
    if(Number.isFinite(fv))fms=fv;
  }
  var dfAdj=typeof m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc==="function"?m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(calc):null;
  /* Min-wall: D<sub>f,thin</sub> from API RP 581 modified reliability; PoF = GFF × FMS × D<sub>f,thin</sub>. */
  var gffLabel="GFF (selected hole size)";
  var prod=(gffWork!=null&&fms!=null&&dfAdj!=null&&Number.isFinite(dfAdj))?(gffWork*fms*dfAdj):null;
  var bandTxt="\u2014";
  var pofBandLabelHint="PoF Mapping";
  var showPofBandRow=(surface!=="crack"&&surface!=="cracking");
  if(showPofBandRow&&prod!=null&&typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand==="function"){
    var mapped=m6_mapWorkingPofBand(prod);
    if(mapped&&mapped.score>=1&&mapped.score<=5&&typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi==="function")bandTxt=m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(mapped.score);
  }
  var showCons=gffFull!=null&&gffWork!=null&&Number.isFinite(gffFull)&&Number.isFinite(gffWork)&&Math.abs(gffFull-gffWork)>1e-24*Math.max(1,Math.abs(gffFull));
  var prodCons=(showCons&&fms!=null&&dfAdj!=null&&Number.isFinite(dfAdj))?(gffFull*fms*dfAdj):null;
  var mappedCons=(!showPofBandRow||surface==="crack"||surface==="cracking")?null:(prodCons!=null&&typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand==="function"?m6_mapWorkingPofBand(prodCons):null);
  var bandConsTxt="\u2014";
  if(mappedCons&&mappedCons.score>=1&&mappedCons.score<=5&&typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi==="function")bandConsTxt=m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(mappedCons.score);
  var gffTxt=gffWork!=null&&Number.isFinite(gffWork)?fmt(gffWork,8)+" /yr":"\u2014";
  var fmsTxt=fms!=null&&Number.isFinite(fms)?fmt(fms,3):"\u2014";
  var dfTxt=dfAdj!=null&&Number.isFinite(dfAdj)?fmt(dfAdj,4):"\u2014";
  var prodTxt=prod!=null&&Number.isFinite(prod)?Number(prod).toExponential(4)+" /yr":"\u2014";
  var gffConsTxt=gffFull!=null&&Number.isFinite(gffFull)?fmt(gffFull,8)+" /yr":"\u2014";
  var prodConsTxt=prodCons!=null&&Number.isFinite(prodCons)?Number(prodCons).toExponential(4)+" /yr":"\u2014";
  var col=resCol||"var(--accent)";
  var di=calcIdx!=null?String(parseInt(calcIdx,10)):"";
  var showHoleChk=(surface==="internal"||surface==="external"||surface==="crack"||surface==="other");
  var showSelInBreakdown=showHoleChk&&!perCompHole;
  var holeBreak=(typeof m5_htmlGffPerHoleSizeBreakdown==="function"&&m3u&&m3u.generic_failure_gff)?m5_htmlGffPerHoleSizeBreakdown(m3u.generic_failure_gff,m3u,showSelInBreakdown,true,perCompHole?calcIdx:null,perCompHole?surface:null):"";
  var holeRefBtn='<button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'m3_scenario_name\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button>';
  var gffRefBtn='<button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'m5_generic_failure_select\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button>';
  var fmsRefBtn='<button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'pof_score\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button>';
  var dfRefBtn='<button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'df_score_at_t\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button>';
  var pofRefBtn='<button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'pof_score\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button>';
  var consBlock="";
  if(showCons){
    consBlock='<div class="hint m5_gffConsolidatedLine" style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px dashed var(--border);line-height:1.45;font-size:12px;color:var(--text)"><span style="color:var(--muted)">Upper range (same DF &amp; FMS; consolidated GFF over all release sizes)</span> <strong style="color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(gffConsTxt)+'</strong> <span style="color:var(--muted)">\u00b7</span> <span style="color:var(--muted)">FMS</span> <strong style="color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(fmsTxt)+'</strong> <span style="color:var(--muted)">\u00b7</span> <span style="color:var(--muted)">DF</span> <strong style="color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(dfTxt)+'</strong> <span style="color:var(--muted)">\u00b7</span> <span style="color:var(--muted)">GFF\u00d7FMS\u00d7DF</span> <strong style="color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(prodConsTxt)+'</strong></div>';
  }
  var consMappedBlock="";
  if(showCons&&showPofBandRow){
    consMappedBlock='<div class="hint m5_gffConsolidatedMapped" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top:8px;line-height:1.4;font-size:12px"><span style="color:var(--muted)">GFF over all release sizes</span> <strong style="color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(bandConsTxt)+'</strong></div>';
  }
  var pofBandRowHtml=showPofBandRow?('<div class="field m5-gff-readout-row" role="status" aria-live="polite"><label>PoF band <span class="ref-std">('+escHtml(pofBandLabelHint)+')</span> '+pofRefBtn+'</label><strong class="m5_ffsResult" style="font-size:14px;color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(bandTxt)+'</strong></div>'):'';
  var gffConsolidatedTail=(consBlock||consMappedBlock)?('<div class="m5-gff-consolidated-tail">'+consBlock+consMappedBlock+'</div>'):"";
  return'<div class="m5_gffWorkingFactorsLine m5-gff-working-wrap" data-idx="'+di+'"'+auxAttr+'">'+
  '<div class="g2 m5-g2-io-pair m5-gff-method-io" style="margin:0 0 10px">'+
  '<div class="m5-g2-input-stack"><div class="field"><label>'+(perCompHole?'GFF by release hole size':'Release hole sizes')+' <span class="ref-std">(Industry screening)</span> '+holeRefBtn+'</label>'+
  (perCompHole?'<div class="hint" style="font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted)">Values from the <strong>M3 GFF table</strong> (Table 3.1) for the <strong>Damage</strong> hole size selected above.</div>':
  '<div class="hint" style="font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted)">Choose <strong>one</strong> hole-size GFF column (failures/yr) for <strong style="color:var(--text)">working GFF</strong> (module-level for cracking/other). Values follow the <strong>M3 GFF table</strong> (Table 3.1).</div>')+
  holeBreak+
  "</div></div>"+
  '<div class="m5-g2-input-stack m5-gff-right-readouts">'+
  '<div class="field m5-gff-readout-row"><label>'+escHtml(gffLabel)+' <span class="ref-std">(Industry screening)</span> '+gffRefBtn+'</label><strong class="m5_ffsResult" style="font-size:14px;color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(gffTxt)+'</strong></div>'+
  '<div class="field m5-gff-readout-row"><label>FMS <span class="ref-std">(Industry screening)</span> '+fmsRefBtn+'</label><strong class="m5_ffsResult" style="font-size:14px;color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(fmsTxt)+'</strong></div>'+
  '<div class="field m5-gff-readout-row"><label>D<sub>f,thin</sub> (calc) <span class="ref-std">(API RP 581 §4.5.7)</span> '+dfRefBtn+'</label><strong class="m5_ffsResult" style="font-size:14px;color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(dfTxt)+'</strong></div>'+
  '<div class="field m5-gff-readout-row"><label>GFF \u00d7 FMS \u00d7 DF <span class="ref-std">(Industry screening, Part 1 Eq. 1.1)</span> '+pofRefBtn+'</label><strong class="m5_ffsResult" style="font-size:14px;color:'+col+'">'+escHtml(prodTxt)+'</strong></div>'+
  pofBandRowHtml+
  "</div></div>"+
  gffConsolidatedTail+
  "</div>";
}

function m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine(idx,surface){
  surface=surface||"internal";
  var arrKey=surface==="external"?"external_min_wall_calcs":"min_wall_calcs";
  var contId=surface==="external"?"m5_externalMinWallCalcs":"m5_minWallCalcs";
  var cont=$(contId);if(!cont||!m5_data||!m5_data[arrKey]||!m5_data[arrKey][idx])return;
  var el=cont.querySelector('.m5_gffWorkingFactorsLine[data-idx="'+idx+'"]:not([data-m5-aux])');
  if(!el||typeof m5_htmlGffMethodWorkingFactorsLine!=="function")return;
  var c=m5_data[arrKey][idx];
  var resCol=surface==="external"?"var(--blue)":"var(--accent)";
  var h=m5_htmlGffMethodWorkingFactorsLine(c,m5_data,resCol,idx,surface);
  if(h)el.outerHTML=h;
  if(typeof m5_refreshThinDfCalcNarrative==="function")m5_refreshThinDfCalcNarrative(idx,surface);
  var halfEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_halfLifeResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]');
  var halfStr=halfEl&&halfEl.textContent!=null?String(halfEl.textContent).trim():"";
  var screenEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_screeningPoFResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]:not([data-m5-aux])');
  if(screenEl&&typeof m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText==="function")screenEl.textContent=m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText(c,halfStr);
  var pofEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_pofScoreResult[data-idx="'+idx+'"]:not([data-m5-aux])');
  if(pofEl&&typeof m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText==="function")pofEl.textContent=m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText(c,m5_data,halfStr);
}

function m5_refreshAllGffMethodFactorLines(){
  if(!m5_data||typeof m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine!=="function")return;
  var i,arr=m5_data.min_wall_calcs||[];
  for(i=0;i<arr.length;i++)m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine(i,"internal");
  arr=m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs||[];
  for(i=0;i<arr.length;i++)m5_updateGffMethodFactorsLine(i,"external");
  if(typeof m5_refreshM3AuxGffLines==="function")m5_refreshM3AuxGffLines();
}

/** Refresh Industry screening GFF×FMS×DF lines on M3 Cracking / Other cards (same HTML as min-wall). */
function m5_refreshM3AuxGffLines(){
  if(!m5_data||typeof m5_htmlGffMethodWorkingFactorsLine!=="function")return;
  function one(contId,arrKey,aux,surf){
    var cont=$(contId);if(!cont)return;
    var arr=m5_data[arrKey]||[],i,c,el,h,pofEl;
    for(i=0;i<arr.length;i++){
      c=arr[i];if(!c)continue;
      el=cont.querySelector('.m5_gffWorkingFactorsLine[data-m5-aux="'+aux+'"][data-idx="'+i+'"]');
      if(!el)continue;
      h=m5_htmlGffMethodWorkingFactorsLine(c,m5_data,"var(--accent)",i,surf,aux);
      if(h)el.outerHTML=h;
      pofEl=cont.querySelector('.m5_pofScoreResult[data-m5-aux="'+aux+'"][data-idx="'+i+'"]');
      if(pofEl&&typeof m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText==="function")pofEl.textContent=m5_minWallPoFScoreUiText(c,m5_data,"\u2014");
    }
  }
  one("m5_crackingCalcs","cracking_calcs","crack","crack");
  one("m5_otherCalcs","other_calcs","other","other");
}

function m6_getCalcPofCalculatedText(calc, m3){
  if(!calc || !m3) return "—";
  var isCracking = (calc.cracking_type != null && String(calc.cracking_type).trim() !== "");
  var isOther = (calc.mechanism_type != null && String(calc.mechanism_type).trim() !== "");
  if(isCracking){
    var bandTxt = typeof m5_crackingPofBandUiText === "function" ? m5_crackingPofBandUiText(calc) : "\u2014";
    return bandTxt !== "\u2014" ? bandTxt : "\u2014";
  }
  if(isOther){
    var bandO = typeof m5_pofFromScreeningWorkingMinWall==="function" ? m5_pofFromScreeningWorkingMinWall(calc, m3) : null;
    if(bandO != null && bandO >= 1 && bandO <= 5) return String(bandO) + " " + m5_pofScoreLabel(bandO);
    var pMan = calc.pof_score != null ? parseInt(calc.pof_score, 10) : NaN;
    if(Number.isFinite(pMan) && pMan >= 1 && pMan <= 5) return String(pMan) + " " + m5_pofScoreLabel(pMan);
    return "—";
  }
  var bandThin = typeof m5_pofFromScreeningWorkingMinWall==="function" ? m5_pofFromScreeningWorkingMinWall(calc, m3) : null;
  if(bandThin != null && bandThin >= 1 && bandThin <= 5) return String(bandThin) + " " + m5_pofScoreLabel(bandThin);
  var rowPof = calc.pof_score != null ? parseInt(calc.pof_score, 10) : NaN;
  if(Number.isFinite(rowPof) && rowPof >= 1 && rowPof <= 5) return String(rowPof) + " " + m5_pofScoreLabel(rowPof);
  return "—";
}

function m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc(code){
  if(!code || String(code).trim()==="") return "—";
  var c = String(code).trim();
  if(typeof m5_lookupDef==="function"){
    var def = m5_lookupDef(c, "");
    if(def){
      var id = typeof m5_fId==="function" ? m5_fId(def) : (def.id||def.mechanism_id||c);
      var name = typeof m5_fName==="function" ? m5_fName(def) : (def.name||def.description||def.mechanism_name||"");
      name = name && String(name).trim() ? String(name).trim() : "";
      if(name && name !== id) return id + " — " + name;
      return id || name || c;
    }
  }
  var mechs = typeof m6_collectMechanismRecords==="function" ? m6_collectMechanismRecords() : (typeof m5_getMechs==="function" ? m5_getMechs() : []);
  for(var i=0;i<mechs.length;i++){
    var m = mechs[i];
    var id = typeof m5_fId==="function" ? m5_fId(m) : (m.id||m.mechanism_id||"");
    if(String(id)===c){
      var name = typeof m5_fName==="function" ? m5_fName(m) : (m.name||m.description||m.mechanism_name||"");
      name = name && String(name).trim() ? String(name).trim() : "";
      if(name && name !== id) return id + " — " + name;
      return id;
    }
  }
  return c;
}
