/** Side-by-side table: Shell min-wall vs Cracking — all values from M3 calcs. */
function m6_htmlM3ShellVsCrackingCompareTable(m3, gffV, fmsV){
  if(!m3) return "";
  var minW=Array.isArray(m3.min_wall_calcs)?m3.min_wall_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_minWallCalcIsUsed!=="function"||m5_minWallCalcIsUsed(c); }):[];
  var crackW=Array.isArray(m3.cracking_calcs)?m3.cracking_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_crackCalcIsUsed==="function"&&m5_crackCalcIsUsed(c); }):[];
  if(!minW.length&&!crackW.length) return "";
  var rep=minW.length?minW[0]:null;
  for(var ri=0;rep&&ri<minW.length;ri++){
    var rt=String(minW[ri].calculation_title||"").toLowerCase();
    if(rt.indexOf("shell")>=0&&rt.indexOf("external")<0){ rep=minW[ri]; break; }
  }
  var crackRep=crackW.length?crackW[0]:null;
  if(!rep&&!crackRep) return "";
  var mwTit=rep?(rep.calculation_title||"Shell"):"\u2014";
  var crTit=crackRep?(crackRep.calculation_title||crackRep.cracking_type||"Cracking"):"\u2014";
  function cell(v){
    var s=(v==null||v==="")?"\u2014":String(v);
    return '<td style="text-align:right">'+escHtml(s)+"</td>";
  }
  function sec(lbl){ return '<tr><td colspan="3" style="font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);font-size:11px;background:var(--input);padding:7px 8px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)">'+escHtml(lbl)+"</td></tr>"; }
  function row(lbl, mw, cr){
    return "<tr><td style=\"padding-left:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:12px\">"+lbl+"</td>"+cell(mw)+cell(cr)+"</tr>";
  }
  var mwR=rep&&typeof m5_thinReliabilityCalc==="function"?m5_thinReliabilityCalc(rep):null;
  var crR=crackRep&&typeof m5_crack581DfCalc==="function"?m5_crack581DfCalc(crackRep):null;
  var crSus=crackRep?(crackRep.susceptibility!=null?crackRep.susceptibility:crackRep.df_score):null;
  var crSusTxt="\u2014";
  if(crSus!=null&&Number.isFinite(Number(crSus))&&typeof m5_susceptibilityBandLabel==="function")
    crSusTxt=String(crSus)+" | "+m5_susceptibilityBandLabel(crSus);
  var mwDf=rep&&typeof m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc==="function"?m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(rep):null;
  var crDf=crackRep&&typeof m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc==="function"?m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(crackRep):null;
  function pof(df){ return (gffV!=null&&fmsV!=null&&df!=null&&Number.isFinite(df))?(gffV*fmsV*df):null; }
  function band(prod){
    if(prod==null||!Number.isFinite(prod)||typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand!=="function") return "\u2014";
    var m=m6_mapWorkingPofBand(prod);
    if(m&&m.score>=1&&m.score<=5&&typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi==="function") return m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(m.score);
    return "\u2014";
  }
  function crackBand(c){
    if(!c) return "\u2014";
    var b=typeof m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc==="function"?m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc(c):null;
    return b?b.label:"\u2014";
  }
  function thinBand(c){
    var df=c&&typeof m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc==="function"?m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(c):null;
    return band(pof(df));
  }
  var gffS=gffV!=null?fmt(gffV,8)+" failures/yr":"\u2014";
  var fmsS=fmsV!=null?fmt(fmsV,3):"\u2014";
  var h='<div class="m6-m3-compare-wrap" style="margin:14px 0 12px">';
  h+='<div style="font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px">M3 calc comparison <span class="ref-std" style="font-weight:600">(values from Module 3 Damage calcs)</span></div>';
  h+='<table class="rtbl m6-m3-compare-pof" style="font-size:12px;margin-bottom:0">';
  h+="<thead><tr><th style=\"width:34%\">Item</th><th style=\"text-align:right;width:33%\">Min-wall ("+escHtml(mwTit)+") \u2014 M3 calc</th><th style=\"text-align:right;width:33%\">Cracking ("+escHtml(crTit)+") \u2014 M3 calc</th></tr></thead><tbody>";
  h+=sec("DF Result (M3 Damage)");
  h+=row("Susceptibility (at t)", "\u2014", crSusTxt);
  h+=row("Base D<sub>f</sub> (Table 2.C.1.3)", "\u2014", crR&&crR.dfB!=null?String(crR.dfB):"\u2014");
  h+=row("D<sub>f</sub> (581, age adjusted)", "\u2014", crackRep&&typeof m5_crack581DfText==="function"?m5_crack581DfText(crackRep):"\u2014");
  h+=row("A<sub>rt</sub> (thinning)", mwR&&mwR.Art!=null&&typeof m5_thinReliabilityFmt==="function"?m5_thinReliabilityFmt(mwR.Art,4):"\u2014", "\u2014");
  h+=row("D<sub>fB</sub> (thinning)", mwR&&mwR.DfB!=null&&typeof m5_thinReliabilityFmt==="function"?m5_thinReliabilityFmt(mwR.DfB,2):"\u2014", "\u2014");
  h+=row("D<sub>f,thin</sub> (581)", mwR&&mwR.DfThin!=null&&typeof m5_thinReliabilityFmt==="function"?m5_thinReliabilityFmt(mwR.DfThin,2):"\u2014", "\u2014");
  h+=sec("Cracking \u2014 API RP 581 Part 2 (Table 2.C.1.3 + age escalation)");
  h+=row("Severity index (SVI)", "\u2014", crR&&crR.svi!=null?String(crR.svi):"\u2014");
  h+=row("Base D<sub>f</sub> (Table 2.C.1.3)", "\u2014", crR&&crR.dfB!=null&&typeof m5_thinReliabilityFmt==="function"?m5_thinReliabilityFmt(crR.dfB,2):"\u2014");
  h+=row("Age (yr)", "\u2014", crR&&crR.age!=null&&typeof m5_thinReliabilityFmt==="function"?m5_thinReliabilityFmt(crR.age,1):"\u2014");
  h+=row("Inspection (581)", "\u2014", crR&&crR.inspCat?(crR.inspCat+(crR.inspN?" \u00d7 "+crR.inspN:"")):"\u2014");
  h+=row("D<sub>f</sub> (581)", "\u2014", crR&&crR.df!=null&&typeof m5_thinReliabilityFmt==="function"?m5_thinReliabilityFmt(crR.df,3):"\u2014");
  h+=sec("PoF = GFF \u00d7 FMS \u00d7 DF (581 Part 1 Eq. 1.1)");
  h+=row("GFF (M3)", gffS, gffS);
  h+=row("FMS (M3 questionnaire)", fmsS, fmsS);
  h+=row("DF adjusted (M3)", mwDf!=null&&Number.isFinite(mwDf)?fmt(mwDf,4):"\u2014", crDf!=null&&Number.isFinite(crDf)?fmt(crDf,4):"\u2014");
  var mwP=pof(mwDf), crP=pof(crDf);
  h+=row("PoF (failures/yr)", mwP!=null?Number(mwP).toExponential(4):"\u2014", crP!=null?Number(crP).toExponential(4):"\u2014");
  h+=sec("PoF band (M6 matches M3)");
  h+=row("PoF band", thinBand(rep), crackBand(crackRep));
  h+="</tbody></table>";
  h+='<div class="hint" style="font-size:10px;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.45">Reference calcs only. Use <strong>Damage mechanism (filter)</strong> above to choose which M3 calc drives the summary row.</div>';
  h+="</div>";
  return h;
}

/** Compact M3→M6 list: GFF, FMS, DF (from M3) and resulting PoF + band. */
function m6_htmlPofFactorListBlock(title, gffV, fmsV, dfAdj, opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  var prod=(gffV!=null&&fmsV!=null&&dfAdj!=null&&Number.isFinite(dfAdj))?(gffV*fmsV*dfAdj):null;
  var bandTxt="\u2014";
  if(opts.kind==="cracking"&&opts.calc&&typeof m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc==="function"){
    var cb=m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc(opts.calc);
    if(cb) bandTxt=cb.label;
  } else if(prod!=null&&typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand==="function"){
    var mapped=m6_mapWorkingPofBand(prod);
    if(mapped&&mapped.score>=1&&mapped.score<=5&&typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi==="function")
      bandTxt=m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(mapped.score);
  }
  var govTag="";
  var h='<div class="m6-pof-factor-list" style="padding:10px 12px;background:var(--card);border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)">';
  h+='<div style="font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px">'+escHtml(title)+govTag+"</div>";
  if(opts.kind==="cracking"&&opts.calc&&typeof m6_htmlM3CrackingDfResultList==="function")
    h+=m6_htmlM3CrackingDfResultList(opts.calc);
  else if(opts.kind==="min_wall"&&opts.calc&&typeof m6_htmlM3ThinningDfResultList==="function")
    h+=m6_htmlM3ThinningDfResultList(opts.calc);
  h+='<div style="font-weight:600;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--muted)">PoF from M3 factors</div>';
  h+='<ul style="list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65">';
  h+="<li><strong>GFF</strong> <span class=\"ref-std\" style=\"font-weight:500\">(M3)</span>: "+(gffV!=null?escHtml(fmt(gffV,8))+" failures/yr":"\u2014")+"</li>";
  h+="<li><strong>FMS</strong> <span class=\"ref-std\" style=\"font-weight:500\">(M3 questionnaire)</span>: "+(fmsV!=null?escHtml(fmt(fmsV,3)):"\u2014")+"</li>";
  h+="<li><strong>DF</strong> <span class=\"ref-std\" style=\"font-weight:500\">(M3 adjusted)</span>: "+(dfAdj!=null&&Number.isFinite(dfAdj)?escHtml(fmt(dfAdj,4)):"\u2014")+"</li>";
  h+='<li style="margin-top:6px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)"><strong>PoF</strong> <span class="ref-std" style="font-weight:500">(GFF \u00d7 FMS \u00d7 DF)</span>: <strong>'+(prod!=null?escHtml(Number(prod).toExponential(4))+" failures/yr":"\u2014")+"</strong></li>";
  h+='<li><strong>Mapped PoF band</strong>: <strong style="color:var(--accent)">'+escHtml(bandTxt)+"</strong></li>";
  h+="</ul></div>";
  return h;
}

/** M6 PoF tab: boxed breakdown for Industry screening working PoF = GFF × FMS × DF, plus per min-wall row (DF varies per component). */
function m6_htmlPoFGffBreakdownSection(m3){
  if(!m3) return "";
  var wp = typeof m6_getWorkingPofInputs === "function" ? m6_getWorkingPofInputs() : { gff:null, fms:null, dfAdjusted:null, workingPof:null };
  var gffV = Number.isFinite(wp.gff) ? wp.gff : null;
  var fmsV = Number.isFinite(wp.fms) ? wp.fms : null;
  var summaryBand=typeof m6_effectiveSummaryPofBand==="function"?m6_effectiveSummaryPofBand(m3, wp):null;
  var mappedOverall = null;
  if(summaryBand&&summaryBand.label) mappedOverall={ score:summaryBand.score, label:summaryBand.label, source:summaryBand.source };
  else if(!(wp.dfGoverning&&wp.dfGoverning.kind==="cracking")&&wp.workingPof != null && Number.isFinite(wp.workingPof) && typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand === "function") mappedOverall = m6_mapWorkingPofBand(wp.workingPof);
  var bandOverall = "\u2014";
  if(summaryBand && summaryBand.label) bandOverall = summaryBand.label;
  else if(mappedOverall && mappedOverall.score >= 1 && mappedOverall.score <= 5 && typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi === "function")
    bandOverall = m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(mappedOverall.score);
  var bandSourceHint=(summaryBand&&summaryBand.source==="m3_susceptibility")?"from M3 cracking susceptibility":"from PoF Mapping (GFF\u00d7FMS\u00d7DF)";
  var minW = Array.isArray(m3.min_wall_calcs) ? m3.min_wall_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_minWallCalcIsUsed!=="function"||m5_minWallCalcIsUsed(c); }) : [];
  var extW = Array.isArray(m3.external_min_wall_calcs) ? m3.external_min_wall_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_minWallCalcIsUsed==="function"&&m5_minWallCalcIsUsed(c); }) : [];
  var crackW = Array.isArray(m3.cracking_calcs) ? m3.cracking_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_crackCalcIsUsed==="function"&&m5_crackCalcIsUsed(c); }) : [];
  var otherW = Array.isArray(m3.other_calcs) ? m3.other_calcs.filter(function(c){ return typeof m5_otherCalcIsUsed==="function"&&m5_otherCalcIsUsed(c); }) : [];
  var hasDetailRows = minW.length > 0 || extW.length > 0 || crackW.length > 0 || otherW.length > 0;
  var rowLine = function(c, surf){
    var dfAdj = typeof m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc === "function" ? m6_calcAdjustedDfForCalc(c) : null;
    var prod = (gffV != null && fmsV != null && dfAdj != null && Number.isFinite(dfAdj)) ? (gffV * fmsV * dfAdj) : null;
    var mapped = prod != null && typeof m6_mapWorkingPofBand === "function" ? m6_mapWorkingPofBand(prod) : null;
    var bandTxt = "\u2014";
    if(surf==="Cracking"&&typeof m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc==="function"){
      var cb=m6_pofBandFromM3CrackingCalc(c);
      if(cb) bandTxt=cb.label;
    } else if(mapped && mapped.score >= 1 && mapped.score <= 5 && typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi === "function") bandTxt = m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(mapped.score);
    var tit = c.calculation_title || "";
    if(!tit && surf==="Cracking") tit = c.cracking_type || "\u2014";
    if(!tit && surf==="Other") tit = c.mechanism_type || "\u2014";
    if(!tit) tit = "\u2014";
    return "<tr><td>"+escHtml(surf)+"</td><td>"+escHtml(tit)+'</td><td style="text-align:right">'+(gffV!=null?escHtml(fmt(gffV,8)):"\u2014")+'</td><td style="text-align:right">'+(fmsV!=null?escHtml(fmt(fmsV,3)):"\u2014")+'</td><td style="text-align:right">'+(dfAdj != null && Number.isFinite(dfAdj) ? escHtml(fmt(dfAdj, 4)) : "\u2014")+'</td><td style="text-align:right">'+(prod != null && Number.isFinite(prod) ? escHtml(Number(prod).toExponential(3)) : "\u2014")+'</td><td>'+escHtml(bandTxt)+"</td></tr>";
  };
  var rows = "";
  minW.forEach(function(c){ rows += rowLine(c, "Internal"); });
  extW.forEach(function(c){ rows += rowLine(c, "External"); });
  crackW.forEach(function(c){ rows += rowLine(c, "Cracking"); });
  otherW.forEach(function(c){ rows += rowLine(c, "Other"); });
  var gffCell = gffV != null ? escHtml(fmt(gffV, 8))+" <span style=\"font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)\">failures/yr</span>" : "\u2014";
  var fmsCell = fmsV != null ? escHtml(fmt(fmsV, 3)) : "\u2014";
  var dfNum = wp.dfAdjusted != null && Number.isFinite(wp.dfAdjusted) ? escHtml(fmt(wp.dfAdjusted, 4)) : "\u2014";
  var dfSelCaption = wp.dfGoverning && wp.dfGoverning.caption ? String(wp.dfGoverning.caption).trim() : "";
  var dfScopeHint = wp.dfFilterApplied
    ? "from M3 calc matching <strong>Damage mechanism (filter)</strong>"
    : "Select <strong>Damage mechanism (filter)</strong> above — summary DF and PoF band follow your selection";
  var dfCell = dfNum;
  if(dfNum !== "\u2014" && dfSelCaption && wp.dfFilterApplied){
    dfCell = '<div style="font-weight:600">'+dfNum+'</div>'
      +'<div class="m6-df-selected" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.35">'+escHtml(dfSelCaption)+'</div>';
  } else if(dfNum === "\u2014" && !wp.dfFilterApplied){
    dfCell = '<span style="color:var(--muted)">\u2014</span>';
  }
  var prodCell = wp.workingPof != null && Number.isFinite(wp.workingPof) ? escHtml(Number(wp.workingPof).toExponential(4)) : "\u2014";
  var bandCell = bandOverall !== "\u2014" ? '<span style="font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);color:var(--accent)">'+escHtml(bandOverall)+"</span>" : '<span style="color:var(--muted)">\u2014</span>';
  var h = '<div class="m6-pof-review-title m6-pof-h1" style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:8px">PoF Review</div>';
  h += '<div class="m6-pof-gff-breakdown m6_allCons" style="margin-bottom:14px;padding:12px;background:var(--input);border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border)">';
  h += '<div style="font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:10px">Industry screening working PoF <span class="ref-std" style="font-weight:600">(GFF \u00d7 FMS \u00d7 DF)</span></div>';
  h += '<table class="rtbl m6-pof-working-summary" style="margin-bottom:0;font-size:13px">';
  h += '<thead><tr><th style="width:52%">Factor</th><th style="text-align:right">Value</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  h += "<tr><td><strong>GFF</strong> \u2014 failure frequency (failures/yr)</td><td style=\"text-align:right;font-weight:600\">"+gffCell+"</td></tr>";
  h += "<tr><td><strong>FMS</strong> \u2014 management systems factor (questionnaire)</td><td style=\"text-align:right;font-weight:600\">"+fmsCell+"</td></tr>";
  h += "<tr><td><strong>DF</strong> adjusted \u2014 "+dfScopeHint+'</td><td style="text-align:right;font-weight:600">'+dfCell+"</td></tr>";
  h += '<tr style="border-top:2px solid var(--border)"><td><strong>Working PoF</strong> (numeric, failures/yr)</td><td style="text-align:right;font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);font-size:14px">'+prodCell+(prodCell!=="\u2014"?' <span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)">= GFF\u00d7FMS\u00d7DF</span>':"")+"</td></tr>";
  h += "<tr><td><strong>PoF band</strong> (M6) \u2014 "+bandSourceHint+"</td><td style=\"text-align:right\">"+bandCell+"</td></tr>";
  if(wp.dfFilterApplied&&wp.dfGoverning&&wp.dfGoverning.kind==="cracking"){
    h += "<tr><td colspan=\"2\" class=\"hint\" style=\"font-size:10px;line-height:1.45;padding-top:6px\">Selected mechanism is cracking: PoF band = M3 susceptibility. Numeric working PoF is informational only.</td></tr>";
  }
  h += "</tbody></table>";
  var compareTbl=typeof m6_htmlM3ShellVsCrackingCompareTable==="function"?m6_htmlM3ShellVsCrackingCompareTable(m3, gffV, fmsV):"";
  if(compareTbl) h+=compareTbl;
  h += '<div class="m6-pof-screening-explainer hint" style="font-size:10px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);letter-spacing:0.01em">';
  h += "<strong style=\"color:var(--text);font-weight:600\">Calculation.</strong> ";
  h += "Industry screening working probability of failure is <strong>GFF \u00d7 FMS \u00d7 DF</strong> (units: failures per year). ";
  h += "<strong>GFF</strong> comes from the GFF library (M3 Damage). ";
  h += "<strong>FMS</strong> is derived from the management systems questionnaire. ";
  h += "<strong>DF</strong> is the adjusted damage factor from the M3 calc that matches your <strong>Damage mechanism (filter)</strong> selection. ";
  h += "When the selected mechanism is cracking, PoF band = <strong>M3 susceptibility</strong> (581 Part 2). PoF Mapping is not used for cracking.";
  h += "</div>";
  if(hasDetailRows){
    h += '<div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px">All M3 calcs (reference). Summary row uses your <strong>Damage mechanism (filter)</strong> selection only.</div>';
    h += '<table class="rtbl"><thead><tr><th>Calc type</th><th>Calculation</th><th style="text-align:right">GFF</th><th style="text-align:right">FMS</th><th style="text-align:right">DF (adj.)</th><th style="text-align:right">PoF</th><th>PoF band</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+rows+"</tbody></table>";
  }
  h += "</div>";
  return h;
}

      crackCalcs.forEach(function(c, i){

  h+='<div id="m6_pofComputedInline" class="m6_allCons" style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px;background:var(--input);border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)"></div>';
