function m6_readForm(){
  if(!m6_data)return;
  var dims=m6_getCoFDimensions();
  dims.forEach(function(dim){
    if(!m6_dimHasOptions(dim)) return;
    if(!m6_data.cof[dim.id]) m6_data.cof[dim.id]={};
    var el=$("m6_cof_"+dim.id);
    m6_data.cof[dim.id]["_"]=el?el.value:(dim.options[0]&&dim.options[0].value?dim.options[0].value:"1");
  });
  var drLetter=$("m6_drivingLetter"), drDim=$("m6_drivingDimension"), comm=$("m6_comments");
  if(!m6_data.drivingConsequence) m6_data.drivingConsequence={letter:"1",dimensionId:""};
  m6_data.drivingConsequence.letter=drLetter?drLetter.value:"1";
  m6_data.drivingConsequence.dimensionId=drDim?drDim.value:"";
  m6_data.comments=comm?comm.value.trim():"";
  var cfg=m6_riskConfig;
  if(cfg&&cfg.probability&&cfg.probability.factors){
    cfg.probability.factors.forEach(function(f){
      var el=$("m6_pof_"+f.id);
      m6_data.pof[f.id]=el?el.value:(f.options&&f.options[0]?f.options[0].value:"0");
    });
  }
  var overallSel = $("m6_pof_overall");
  var dmgSel = $("m6_damage_mechanism");
  m6_data.pof_overall = overallSel ? overallSel.value : "";
  m6_data.damage_mechanism = dmgSel ? dmgSel.value : "";
}

function m6_populateForm(){
  if(!m6_data)return;
  var dims=m6_getCoFDimensions();
  dims.forEach(function(dim){
    if(!m6_dimHasOptions(dim)) return;
    var dd=m6_data.cof[dim.id]||{};
    var el=$("m6_cof_"+dim.id);
    if(el){
      var resolved=typeof m6_findCofOptionMatch==="function"?m6_findCofOptionMatch(dim,dd["_"]):(dd["_"]||(dim.options[0]&&dim.options[0].value?dim.options[0].value:"1"));
      el.value=resolved;
    }
  });
  var dc=m6_data.drivingConsequence||{letter:"1",dimensionId:""};
  var drLetter=$("m6_drivingLetter"), drDim=$("m6_drivingDimension"), comm=$("m6_comments");
  if(drLetter) drLetter.value=typeof m6_drivingLetterToSelectValue==="function"?m6_drivingLetterToSelectValue(dc.letter):(dc.letter||"1");
  if(drDim&&dc.dimensionId){ var opt=drDim.querySelector('option[value="'+dc.dimensionId+'"]'); if(opt) drDim.value=dc.dimensionId; }
  if(comm) comm.value=m6_data.comments||"";
  var cfg=m6_riskConfig;
  if(cfg&&cfg.probability&&cfg.probability.factors){
    cfg.probability.factors.forEach(function(f){
      var el=$("m6_pof_"+f.id);
      if(el){var v=(m6_data.pof||{})[f.id]||(f.options&&f.options[0]?f.options[0].value:"0"); var hasOpt=Array.prototype.some.call(el.options,function(o){return o.value===v;}); el.value=hasOpt?v:(f.options&&f.options[0]?f.options[0].value:"0");}
    });
  }
  var overallSel = $("m6_pof_overall");
  if(overallSel){
    var ov = (m6_data&&m6_data.pof_overall!=null) ? String(m6_data.pof_overall) : "";
    var hasOv = Array.prototype.some.call(overallSel.options,function(o){return o.value===ov;});
    overallSel.value = hasOv ? ov : "";
  }
  var dmgSel = $("m6_damage_mechanism");
  if(dmgSel){
    var dv = (m6_data&&m6_data.damage_mechanism!=null) ? String(m6_data.damage_mechanism) : "";
    var hasDv = Array.prototype.some.call(dmgSel.options,function(o){return o.value===dv;});
    dmgSel.value = hasDv ? dv : "";
    if(!hasDv && dv){
      var op = document.createElement("option");
      op.value = dv;
      op.textContent = typeof m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc==="function" ? m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc(dv) : dv;
      dmgSel.appendChild(op);
      dmgSel.value = dv;
    }
  }
  if(typeof m6_updateDamageMechanismLabel==="function") m6_updateDamageMechanismLabel();
}

function m6_calc(){
  if(!m6_riskConfig)return;
  if(!m6_data) m6_data=m6_blank();
  m6_readForm();
  var cfg=m6_riskConfig;
  var dimScores={}, cofTotal=0;

  var cofDims=m6_getCoFDimensions();
  cofDims.forEach(function(dim){
    if(!m6_dimHasOptions(dim)) return;
    var dd=m6_data.cof[dim.id]||{};
    var v=dd["_"];
    dimScores[dim.id]=m6_cofLetterToNum(v);
  });

  var areaAffectedScore=0, areaAffectedBand=null;
  var m5=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module5_consequence:null;
  var outputs=m5&&m5.outputs?m5.outputs:(m4_data&&m4_data.outputs?m4_data.outputs:[]);
  var m3=activeAsset?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release:null;
  var selHole=m3?m3.selected_hole_for_damage:null;
  if(selHole){outputs=outputs.filter(function(o){var hn=o.hole_name||(o.hole?String(o.hole).split(/\s+/)[0]:""); return hn===selHole;});}
  if(outputs.length&&REF.consequenceAreas&&REF.consequenceAreas.bands){
    var summary={};
    outputs.forEach(function(o){var a=o.area_m2!=null?o.area_m2:o.consequence_area_m2; if(!summary[o.type]||a>summary[o.type].area_m2)summary[o.type]={area_m2:a};});
    for(var t in summary){
      var b=m4_consequenceAreaBand(summary[t].area_m2);
      if(b){var sc=areaBandScoreToNum(b);if(sc>areaAffectedScore){areaAffectedScore=sc;areaAffectedBand=b;}}
    }
  }
  dimScores.area_affected=areaAffectedScore;

  var cofCat=0;
  var driving=m6_data.drivingConsequence;
  if(driving&&driving.letter){
    cofCat=m6_cofLetterToNum(driving.letter);
  } else {
    for(var k in dimScores){if(dimScores[k]>cofCat)cofCat=dimScores[k];}
  }
  var cofTotal=cofCat;

  var pofTotal=0;
  var overallFromForm = parseInt((m6_data&&m6_data.pof_overall!=null)?m6_data.pof_overall:"",10);
  var wp = m6_getWorkingPofInputs();
  var m3eff=typeof m6_effectiveM3Data==="function"?m6_effectiveM3Data():null;
  var mappedFromWorking = typeof m6_effectiveSummaryPofBand==="function"?m6_effectiveSummaryPofBand(m3eff, wp):null;
  if(Number.isFinite(overallFromForm) && overallFromForm>=1 && overallFromForm<=5){
    pofTotal = overallFromForm;
  } else if(mappedFromWorking && mappedFromWorking.score){
    pofTotal = mappedFromWorking.score;
  } else if(cfg.probability&&cfg.probability.factors&&cfg.probability.factors.length){
    var dmFactor=cfg.probability.factors[0];
    for(var fi=0;fi<cfg.probability.factors.length;fi++){
      var f=cfg.probability.factors[fi];
      if(f.id==="damage_rate"||f.id==="damage_mechanism"){dmFactor=f;break;}
    }
    pofTotal=parseInt((m6_data.pof||{})[dmFactor.id])||0;
  }

  var pofCat=0, pofColor="var(--muted)";
  if(cfg.probability&&cfg.probability.bands){
    for(var pi=0;pi<cfg.probability.bands.length;pi++){
      var pb=cfg.probability.bands[pi];
      if(pofTotal>=pb.min&&pofTotal<pb.max){pofCat=pb.score;pofColor=pb.color;break;}
    }
  }

  var riskProduct=pofCat*cofCat;

  var riskLabel="NOT SCORED",riskColor="var(--muted)",riskBg="var(--border)",riskAction="";
  if(cfg.risk_matrix&&cfg.risk_matrix.risk_levels){
    for(var ri=0;ri<cfg.risk_matrix.risk_levels.length;ri++){
      var rl=cfg.risk_matrix.risk_levels[ri];
      if(riskProduct>=rl.min&&riskProduct<rl.max){
        riskLabel=rl.label;riskColor=rl.color;riskBg=rl.bg;riskAction=rl.action||"";break;
      }
    }
  }

  var pofNumForCell=parseInt(pofTotal,10)||0;
  m6_data.scores={
    dim_scores:dimScores,cof_total:cofTotal,cof_category:cofCat,
    pof_total:pofTotal,pof_category:pofCat,
    risk_product:riskProduct,risk_level:riskLabel,
    risk_cell:(cofCat>=1&&cofCat<=5&&pofNumForCell>=1&&pofNumForCell<=5)?String(cofCat)+String(pofNumForCell):""
  };
  var cofH="";
  if(cofCat>0){
    var drivingLabel=m6_cofRankLabel(cofCat)||String(cofCat);
    var drivingDimLabel = driving&&driving.dimensionId ? m6_drivingDimensionLabel(driving.dimensionId) : "";
    cofH='<div class="row"><div class="l" style="font-weight:600">Driving consequence</div><div class="pill" style="font-weight:600">'+escHtml(drivingLabel)+(drivingDimLabel?' – '+escHtml(drivingDimLabel):'')+'</div></div>';
  } else {
    cofH='<div class="row"><div class="l" style="font-weight:600">Driving consequence</div><div class="pill">—</div></div>';
  }
  $("m6_cofScores").innerHTML=cofH;

  var pofNOverall=parseInt(pofTotal,10);
  var pofBandDisplay="\u2014";
  if(pofNOverall>=1&&pofNOverall<=5){
    if(mappedFromWorking&&mappedFromWorking.source==="m3_susceptibility"&&mappedFromWorking.label)
      pofBandDisplay=mappedFromWorking.label;
    else
      pofBandDisplay=typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi==="function"?m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(pofNOverall):(String(pofNOverall)+" \u2013 "+m5_pofScoreLabel(pofNOverall));
  }
  var pofH="";
  pofH+='<div class="row"><div class="l" style="font-weight:600">PoF band</div><div class="pill" style="font-weight:600">'+escHtml(pofBandDisplay)+'</div></div>';
  pofH+='<div class="row"><div class="l" style="font-weight:600">Damage mechanism (filter)</div><div class="pill" style="font-weight:600">'+escHtml((m6_data&&m6_data.damage_mechanism)?(typeof m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc==="function"?m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc(m6_data.damage_mechanism):m6_data.damage_mechanism):"—")+'</div></div>';
  if(cfg.probability&&cfg.probability.factors){
    var fmtNum = function(x, d){ return Number.isFinite(x) ? Number(x).toFixed(d) : "—"; };
    pofH+='<div class="row"><div class="l" style="font-weight:600">PoF numeric (working)</div><div class="pill" style="font-weight:600">'+(Number.isFinite(wp.workingPof)?Number(wp.workingPof).toExponential(3):"—")+'</div></div>';
    var mappedTxt = "—";
    if(mappedFromWorking && mappedFromWorking.score){
      if(mappedFromWorking.source==="m3_susceptibility")
        mappedTxt = mappedFromWorking.label || (String(mappedFromWorking.score)+" (M3 susceptibility)");
      else {
        var bandTxt = (mappedFromWorking.min!=null ? mappedFromWorking.min.toExponential(2) : "0") + " to " + (mappedFromWorking.max!=null ? mappedFromWorking.max.toExponential(2) : "and above");
        mappedTxt = String(mappedFromWorking.score) + (mappedFromWorking.label ? " ("+mappedFromWorking.label+")" : "") + " ["+bandTxt+"]";
      }
    }
    pofH+='<div class="row"><div class="l" style="font-weight:600">PoF band source</div><div class="pill" style="font-weight:600">'+escHtml(mappedFromWorking&&mappedFromWorking.source==="m3_susceptibility"?(mappedFromWorking.label||"M3 susceptibility"):mappedTxt)+'</div></div>';
    pofH+='<div class="row"><div class="l" style="font-weight:600">Inputs used</div><div class="pill" style="font-weight:600">GFF='+fmtNum(wp.gff,6)+', FMS='+fmtNum(wp.fms,3)+', DF adj='+fmtNum(wp.dfAdjusted,3)+'</div></div>';
  } else {
    pofH+='<div class="hint" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:6px;color:var(--muted)">PoF trace lines (GFF\u00d7FMS\u00d7DF) need a <strong>probability.factors</strong> block in the loaded risk JSON. The PoF band above still applies from Driving Probability / mapping.</div>';
  }
  $("m6_pofScores").innerHTML=pofH;
  var pofInline = $("m6_pofComputedInline");
  if(pofInline) pofInline.innerHTML = pofH || '<div class="hint">PoF calculation details will appear here.</div>';

  m6_renderRiskMatrix();
  try {
    if (typeof currentTab === "number" && currentTab === 7 && typeof m7_refreshPlanningRiskHeader === "function") m7_refreshPlanningRiskHeader();
  } catch (eM7Hdr) { /* ignore */ }
}

/** M0 risk matrix cell color: named palette (readable contrast) or legacy #hex / CSS color. */
function m6_riskMatrixCellBackgroundStyle(color) {
  if (color == null || String(color).trim() === '') return '';
  var low = String(color).trim().toLowerCase();
  var semantic = { red: ['#c62828', '#fff'], orange: ['#ef6c00', '#fff'], yellow: ['#f9a825', '#111'], blue: ['#1565c0', '#fff'], green: ['#2e7d32', '#fff'] };
  if (semantic[low]) {
    var pair = semantic[low];
    return 'background:' + pair[0] + ' !important;color:' + pair[1] + ' !important;border-color:' + pair[0] + ' !important';
  }
  var s = String(color).trim();
  return 'background:' + s + ' !important;color:#fff !important;border-color:' + s + ' !important';
}

/** One matrix cell label: PoF digit + column CoF letter (c=0 … 4 → A, low … E, high; e.g. PoF 5 + column E → **5E**). */
function m6_riskMatrixCellPofCofDisplay(pofRowNum, colIndex) {
  var pn = parseInt(pofRowNum, 10), c = parseInt(colIndex, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(pn) || !Number.isFinite(c) || pn < 1 || pn > 5 || c < 0 || c > 4) return '\u2014';
  return String(pn) + 'ABCDE'.charAt(c);
}

/** Same visible label as the M6 risk matrix cell for this CoF rank × PoF band (matches CSV cell.label e.g. A1, not only PoF+letter). */
function m6_riskMatrixResolvedCellLabel(cofCat, pofTotalNum) {
  var cofCatN = parseInt(cofCat, 10), pn = parseInt(pofTotalNum, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(cofCatN) || !Number.isFinite(pn) || cofCatN < 1 || cofCatN > 5 || pn < 1 || pn > 5) return "\u2014";
  var cfg = REF.riskMatrix || {};
  var cofLabels = (cfg.cof_labels || ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"]).slice(0, 5);
  var pofLabels = (cfg.pof_labels && cfg.pof_labels.length === 5) ? cfg.pof_labels.map(function(x) { return String(x); }) : ["5", "4", "3", "2", "1"];
  var cells = cfg.cells || {};
  var c = cofCatN - 1;
  var pofRowNum = pn;
  var r = 5 - pofRowNum;
  var resolveCell = (typeof riskMatrixCellDataForUi === "function") ? riskMatrixCellDataForUi : null;
  var label;
  if (resolveCell) {
    var ent = resolveCell(cells, cofLabels[c], r, pofLabels, pofLabels[r], c);
    label = ent && ent.label != null ? ent.label : (cofLabels[c] + String(pofRowNum));
  } else {
    var cellRank = c + 1;
    var cellId = String(cellRank) + String(pofRowNum);
    var cellData = cells[cellId] || {};
    if ((cellData.label == null || cellData.label === "") && !cellData.color) {
      var leg = ("ABCDE").charAt(c);
      if (leg) { var altId = leg + String(pofRowNum); if (cells[altId]) cellData = cells[altId]; }
    }
    if ((cellData.label == null || cellData.label === "") && !cellData.color) {
      var longId = (cofLabels[c] != null ? String(cofLabels[c]) : "") + String(pofRowNum);
      if (longId && cells[longId]) cellData = cells[longId];
    }
    label = cellData.label != null ? cellData.label : cellId;
  }
  var labStr = String(label != null ? label : "").trim();
  if (labStr === "" || /^[1-5][1-5]$/.test(labStr)) {
    label = (typeof m6_riskMatrixCellPofCofDisplay === "function") ? m6_riskMatrixCellPofCofDisplay(pofRowNum, c) : labStr;
  }
  var out = String(label != null ? label : "").trim();
  if (out) return out;
  return (typeof m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof === "function") ? m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof(cofCatN, pn) : String(cofCatN) + String(pn);
}

function m6_renderRiskMatrix(){
  var el=$("m6_riskMatrix"); if(!el)return;
  var cfg=REF.riskMatrix||{};
  var cofLabels=(cfg.cof_labels||["1","2","3","4","5"]).slice(0,5);
  /* Same PoF axis as M0 (renderRiskMatrixSection): explicit pof_labels or default 5→1 (= bands A…E). */
  var pofLabels=(cfg.pof_labels&&cfg.pof_labels.length===5)?cfg.pof_labels.map(function(x){return String(x);}):["5","4","3","2","1"];
  var cells=cfg.cells||{};
  var cofCat=(m6_data&&m6_data.scores)?m6_data.scores.cof_category:0;
  var pofForMatrix=(m6_data&&m6_data.scores)?m6_data.scores.pof_total:0;
  var pofForMatrixNum=parseInt(pofForMatrix)||0;
  var resolveCell=(typeof riskMatrixCellDataForUi==="function")?riskMatrixCellDataForUi:null;
  var h='<table class="rm-table"><thead><tr><th class="rm-corner"></th><th colspan="'+cofLabels.length+'" class="rm-cof-header">CoF (A = low \u2026 E = high) \u2192</th></tr><tr><th class="rm-corner rm-pof-label">PoF (1 = low freq \u2026 5 = high) \u2193</th>';
  for(var cHd=0;cHd<cofLabels.length;cHd++){
    var cofRank=cHd+1;
    var headTxt=(typeof m6_cofRankLabel==="function"&&m6_cofRankLabel(cofRank))?m6_cofRankLabel(cofRank):String(cofLabels[cHd]||cofRank);
    h+='<th class="rm-cof">'+escHtml(headTxt)+'</th>';
  }
  h+='</tr></thead><tbody>';
  for(var r=0;r<5;r++){
    var pofRowNum=5-r;
    var rowHead=(typeof m6_pofMatrixRowHeader==="function")?m6_pofMatrixRowHeader(pofRowNum):((pofLabels[r]!=null&&String(pofLabels[r])!=="")?String(pofLabels[r]):((typeof m6_pofMatrixRowLabel==="function")?m6_pofMatrixRowLabel(pofRowNum):String(pofRowNum)));
    h+='<tr><th class="rm-pof">'+escHtml(rowHead)+'</th>';
    for(var c=0;c<cofLabels.length;c++){
      var label, cellColor;
      if(resolveCell){
        var ent=resolveCell(cells,cofLabels[c],r,pofLabels,pofLabels[r],c);
        label=ent&&ent.label!=null?ent.label:(cofLabels[c]+String(pofRowNum));
        cellColor=ent&&ent.color!=null?ent.color:"";
      } else {
        var cellRank=c+1;
        var cellId=String(cellRank)+String(pofRowNum);
        var cellData=cells[cellId]||{};
        if((cellData.label==null||cellData.label==="")&&!cellData.color){
          var leg=("ABCDE").charAt(c);
          if(leg){ var altId=leg+String(pofRowNum); if(cells[altId]) cellData=cells[altId]; }
        }
        if((cellData.label==null||cellData.label==="")&&!cellData.color){
          var longId=(cofLabels[c]!=null?String(cofLabels[c]):"")+String(pofRowNum);
          if(longId&&cells[longId]) cellData=cells[longId];
        }
        label=cellData.label!=null?cellData.label:cellId;
        cellColor=cellData.color||"";
      }
      var labStr=String(label!=null?label:"").trim();
      if(labStr===""||/^[1-5][1-5]$/.test(labStr)){
        label=(typeof m6_riskMatrixCellPofCofDisplay==="function")?m6_riskMatrixCellPofCofDisplay(pofRowNum,c):labStr;
      }
      var isCurrent=(cofCat===c+1&&pofForMatrixNum===pofRowNum);
      var cls="rm-cell"+(isCurrent?" rm-current":"");
      var style = cellColor ? m6_riskMatrixCellBackgroundStyle(cellColor) : '';
      h+='<td class="'+cls+'"'+(style?' style="'+style+'"':'')+'>'+escHtml(label)+'</td>';
    }
    h+='</tr>';
  }
  h+='</tbody></table>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
  if(typeof m6_updateDamageMechanismLabel==="function") m6_updateDamageMechanismLabel();
  m6_renderPlanningSummary();
}

function m6_formatPlanningIntervalYears(years){
  if(years==null||years==="") return null;
  if(typeof years==="number"&&Number.isFinite(years)) return years+" years";
  var s=String(years).trim();
  if(s==="") return null;
  if(/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(s)) return s+" years";
  return s;
}
function m6_renderPlanningSummary(){
  var riskCellEl=$("m6_planningRiskCell"), intervalEl=$("m6_planningInterval"), hintEl=$("m6_planningHint");
  var drivingLetterEl=$("m6_planningDrivingLetter"), drivingDimEl=$("m6_planningDrivingDim");
  var pofEl=$("m6_planningPof"), dmgEl=$("m6_planningDamageMech");
  var lookupSel=$("m6_planningLookupSelect");
  if(!riskCellEl||!intervalEl) return;
  riskCellEl.textContent="\u2014";
  intervalEl.textContent="\u2014";
  if(hintEl) hintEl.textContent="";
  if(pofEl){ pofEl.textContent="\u2014"; }
  if(dmgEl){ dmgEl.textContent="\u2014"; }
  if(drivingLetterEl){
    var letterSel=$("m6_drivingLetter");
    drivingLetterEl.textContent=letterSel&&letterSel.selectedIndex>=0?letterSel.options[letterSel.selectedIndex].textContent:"\u2014";
  }
  if(drivingDimEl){
    var dimSel=$("m6_drivingDimension");
    drivingDimEl.textContent=dimSel&&dimSel.selectedIndex>=0&&dimSel.value?dimSel.options[dimSel.selectedIndex].textContent:"\u2014";
  }
  var cells=m6_getPlanningCellsFromRefOrM0();
  var sortedKeys=(typeof m6_sortedPlanningCellKeys==="function")?m6_sortedPlanningCellKeys(cells):[];
  var cofCat=(m6_data&&m6_data.scores)?m6_data.scores.cof_category:0;
  var pofTotal=(m6_data&&m6_data.scores)?m6_data.scores.pof_total:0;
  var cofNum=parseInt(cofCat,10)||0;
  var pofNum=parseInt(pofTotal,10)||0;
  if(pofEl&&pofNum>=1&&pofNum<=5){
    pofEl.textContent=typeof m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi==="function"?m6_pofBandDisplayLabelForUi(pofNum):(String(pofNum)+" \u2013 "+(typeof m5_pofScoreLabel==="function"?m5_pofScoreLabel(pofNum):String(pofNum)));
  }
  if(dmgEl){
    var dmRaw=(m6_data&&m6_data.damage_mechanism!=null)?String(m6_data.damage_mechanism).trim():"";
    if(dmRaw){
      dmgEl.textContent=(typeof m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc==="function")?m6_mechanismCodeAndDesc(dmRaw):dmRaw;
    } else {
      dmgEl.textContent="\u2014 (choose under PoF \u2192 Damage mechanism filter)";
    }
  }
  var riskDisp="";
  if(cofNum&&pofNum){
    riskDisp=(typeof m6_riskMatrixResolvedCellLabel==="function")?m6_riskMatrixResolvedCellLabel(cofNum,pofNum):(typeof m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof==="function"?m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof(cofNum,pofNum):(String(cofNum)+String(pofNum)));
    riskCellEl.textContent=riskDisp;
  } else {
    riskCellEl.textContent="\u2014";
  }

  var pick="";
  if(lookupSel&&lookupSel.value) pick=String(lookupSel.value).trim();
  else if(m6_data&&m6_data.planning_lookup_key!=null&&String(m6_data.planning_lookup_key).trim()!=="") pick=String(m6_data.planning_lookup_key).trim();

  if(lookupSel){
    lookupSel.innerHTML="";
    var o0=document.createElement("option");
    o0.value="";
    o0.textContent="\u2014 Select planning cell (M0 Planning table) \u2014";
    lookupSel.appendChild(o0);
    var i, ky, op;
    for(i=0;i<sortedKeys.length;i++){
      ky=sortedKeys[i];
      op=document.createElement("option");
      op.value=ky;
      op.textContent=ky;
      lookupSel.appendChild(op);
    }
    if(pick){
      if(sortedKeys.indexOf(pick)>=0) lookupSel.value=pick;
      else {
        var found=false;
        for(i=0;i<sortedKeys.length;i++){
          if(String(sortedKeys[i]).toLowerCase()===pick.toLowerCase()){ lookupSel.value=sortedKeys[i]; found=true; break; }
        }
        if(!found) pick="";
      }
    }
    if(!lookupSel.value) pick="";
    if(m6_data){
      if(!m6_data.planning_lookup_key) m6_data.planning_lookup_key="";
      m6_data.planning_lookup_key=lookupSel.value||"";
    }
  }

  var chosen=(m6_data&&m6_data.planning_lookup_key!=null)?String(m6_data.planning_lookup_key).trim():"";
  var entry=(chosen&&cells&&typeof m6_planningEntryForChosenKey==="function")?m6_planningEntryForChosenKey(cells,chosen):null;
  if(entry){
    var years=entry.frequency_years!=null?entry.frequency_years:(entry.years!=null?entry.years:null);
    var intervalTxt=typeof m6_formatPlanningIntervalYears==="function"?m6_formatPlanningIntervalYears(years):null;
    intervalEl.textContent=intervalTxt!=null?intervalTxt:"\u2014";
    if(hintEl) hintEl.textContent=intervalTxt!=null?("Recommended inspection interval from M0 Planning cell "+chosen+" (risk score "+(riskDisp||"\u2014")+")."):"Planning cell \""+chosen+"\" has no frequency value.";
  } else {
    intervalEl.textContent="\u2014";
    if(hintEl){
      if(!chosen) hintEl.textContent=sortedKeys.length?"Select a planning cell for the recommended interval (keys from M0 Planning and Libraries).":"No planning cells available \u2014 edit M0 Planning or load Planning in Libraries.";
      else hintEl.textContent="No interval row for key \""+chosen+"\". Check M0 \u2192 Planning.";
    }
  }
}

function m6_renderConsequenceAreas(){
  var el=$("m6_consequenceAreas"); if(!el)return;
  var m5=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module5_consequence:null;
  var allRows=[];
  if(m5){
    if(Array.isArray(m5.models)&&m5.models.length) allRows=m5.models;
    else if(Array.isArray(m5.outputs)&&m5.outputs.length) allRows=m5.outputs;
  }
  if(!allRows.length&&typeof m4_data!=="undefined"&&m4_data){
    if(Array.isArray(m4_data.models)&&m4_data.models.length) allRows=m4_data.models;
    else if(Array.isArray(m4_data.outputs)&&m4_data.outputs.length) allRows=m4_data.outputs;
  }
  if(!allRows.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="hint">Open Module 5, choose consequence type(s), click <strong>Build Consequence Models</strong>, then <strong>Save M5</strong>. If you already built models, click <strong>Save M5</strong> so consequence areas are stored.</div>';return;}
  var m3=activeAsset?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module4_release:null;
  var m5damage=activeAsset&&activeAsset.sentinel_rbi?activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module3_damage:null;
  var gff=m5damage&&m5damage.generic_failure_gff?m5damage.generic_failure_gff:null;
  var lev1=m4_level1WeightedFlammableCA(allRows,gff);
  var sel=m3?m3.selected_hole_for_damage:null;
  var h='<div style="font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap">Maximum Consequence Areas <button type="button" class="m5_stdRefIcon" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,\'m6_max_consequence_areas\')" title="Purpose of this field and standard references" aria-label="Purpose of this field and standard references">&#8505;</button></div>';
  /* Level 1 (Eq 1.4) weighted only; selected-hole detail is in the table below */
  h+='<div style="margin-bottom:10px">';
  h+='<div class="hint" style="padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow-x:auto">';
  h+='<strong>Level 1 (Industry screening Eq 1.4)</strong> Probability-weighted flammable: ';
  if(lev1&&Number.isFinite(lev1.weightedArea_m2)){
    h+='C<sub>f</sub><sup>flam</sup> = '+fmt(lev1.weightedArea_m2)+' m²';
    if(lev1.band){var letter=areaBandScoreLetter(lev1.band); h+=' &nbsp; <span class="consequence-score-badge band-accent" style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:600;font-size:11px">'+escHtml(lev1.band.label)+(letter?' ('+escHtml(letter)+')':'')+'</span>';}
    h+=' <span style="color:var(--muted)">(screening intermediate; map to <strong>owner CoF</strong>.)</span>';
  } else {
    h+='<span style="color:var(--muted)">Enter GFF by hole size in M3 Damage (GFF) and build consequence models with a flammable type to see C<sub>f</sub><sup>flam</sup>.</span>';
  }
  h+='</div></div>';
  var rows=allRows.filter(function(r){var hn=r.hole_name||(r.hole?String(r.hole).split(/\s+/)[0]:""); return hn===sel;});
  h+='<div class="hint" style="margin-bottom:8px"><strong>Area Affected (CSV)</strong> bands support screening; <strong>Owner</strong> CoF ratings follow owner Libraries. Rows for the selected hole <strong>Small → Medium → Large → Rupture</strong>. In M5, double-click a row in Maximum Consequence Areas to select hole size for damage scenario.</div>';
  if(!REF.consequenceAreas||!REF.consequenceAreas.bands.length){h+='<div class="hint" style="margin-bottom:8px">Load Area Affected CSV for screening bands (map into owner CoF)</div>';}
  if(!sel){h+='<div class="hint">Select a hole: open M5, build models, then double-click a row in Maximum Consequence Areas.</div>';el.innerHTML=h;return;}
  if(!rows.length){h+='<div class="hint">No data for selected hole</div>';el.innerHTML=h;return;}
  rows=m4_sortModelsByHoleSizeAsc(rows);
  var hasBands=REF.consequenceAreas&&REF.consequenceAreas.bands&&REF.consequenceAreas.bands.length;
  var dispMethod=osrDispersionMethodFromSource();
  var showScreeningCol=(dispMethod==="screening_default"||dispMethod==="both"||dispMethod==="pcc3");
  var header='<tr><th>Type</th><th>Hole</th><th>Rate (kg/s)</th><th>Area (m²)</th><th>Distance (m)</th>';
  if(showScreeningCol)header+='<th>Industry screening</th>';
  if(hasBands)header+='<th title="From Area Affected CSV reference">Area band</th>';
  h+='<table class="rtbl"><thead>'+header+'</tr></thead><tbody>';
  rows.forEach(function(r){
    var hole=r.hole||r.hole_label||"";
    var hn=r.hole_name||(hole?String(hole).split(/\s+/)[0]:"");
    var rate=r.rate_kg_s!=null?r.rate_kg_s:(r.release_rate_kg_s!=null?r.release_rate_kg_s:0);
    var area=r.consequence_area_m2!=null?r.consequence_area_m2:r.area_m2;
    var dist=r.consequence_distance_m!=null?r.consequence_distance_m:r.distance_m;
    var screening_default=r.dispersion_screen||"—";
    var band=hasBands?m4_consequenceAreaBand(area):null;
    var letter=band?areaBandScoreLetter(band):"";
    var bandColor=band&&band.color?band.color:'var(--border)';
    var bandCell=hasBands&&band?'<td><span class="consequence-score-badge band-accent" style="display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;border-left-color:'+bandColor+'">'+escHtml(band.label)+' ('+escHtml(letter)+')</span></td>':(hasBands?'<td>—</td>':'');
    var safeHn=String(hn||"").replace(/\\/g,"\\\\").replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    var row='<td>'+escHtml(r.type)+'</td><td>'+escHtml(hole)+'</td><td>'+fmt(rate,4)+'</td><td>'+fmt(area)+'</td><td>'+fmt(dist)+'</td>';
    if(showScreeningCol)row+='<td>'+escHtml(screening_default)+'</td>';
    row+=bandCell;
    h+='<tr data-hole-name="'+escHtml(hn)+'" ondblclick="m4_selectHoleForDamage(\''+safeHn+'\')" title="Double-click to select for damage scenario">'+row+'</tr>';
  });
  h+='</tbody></table>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function m6_load(){
  if(!activeAsset)return;
  try { if(typeof m4_load==="function") m4_load(); } catch(eM4) { console.warn("m6_load m4_load", eM4); }
  m6_renderConsequenceAreas();
  m6_renderRiskMatrix();
  m6_data=activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module6_risk?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module6_risk)):m6_blank();
  if(m6_data.planning_lookup_key===undefined) m6_data.planning_lookup_key="";
  m6_migrateLegacyCofData(m6_data);
  m6_migrateCofScoresToNumericScale(m6_data);
  if($("m6_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m6_notes", m6_data.notes || "");
  if($("m6_sea_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m6_sea_notes", m6_data.specialist_engineering_assessment || "");
  if(!m6_riskConfig){
    var st0=$("m6_status");
    if(st0) st0.textContent="Load CoF dimensions via Libraries";
  }
  m6_renderCoF(); m6_renderPoF();
  if(!m6_riskConfig) return;
  m6_populateForm();
  m6_calc();
  m6_renderRiskMatrix();
  var st=$("m6_status");
  if(st) st.textContent="Loaded";
}

function m6_save(){
  if(!activeAsset||!m6_data)return;
  m6_readForm(); m6_calc();
  var m6NotesEl = $("m6_notes"); m6_data.notes = m6NotesEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m6_notes") : "";
  var m6SeaEl = $("m6_sea_notes"); m6_data.specialist_engineering_assessment = m6SeaEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m6_sea_notes") : "";
  var save=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m6_data));
  if(save.cof){for(var k in save.cof){if(save.cof[k]._dollar_total!==undefined) delete save.cof[k]._dollar_total;}}
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module6_risk=save;
  setModuleStatus(6,"complete"); auditLog(6,"saved");
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  $("m6_status").textContent="Saved \u2014 "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   MODULE 7 — PLANNING (inspection frequency from risk score)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════ */

/** Risk score + recommended interval in M7 header (same logic as first part of m7_load); call after M0→REF sync when on tab 7. */
function m7_refreshPlanningRiskHeader() {
  var riskCellEl = $("m7_riskCell"), freqEl = $("m7_frequency"), hintEl = $("m7_hint");
  if (!riskCellEl || !freqEl) return;
  riskCellEl.textContent = "—";
  freqEl.textContent = "—";
  if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = "";
  var s = activeAsset && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi ? activeAsset.sentinel_rbi : null;
  if (!m6_data && s && s.module6_risk) {
    m6_data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.module6_risk));
    if (m6_riskConfig && typeof m6_calc === "function") m6_calc();
  }
  var cells = typeof m6_getPlanningCellsFromRefOrM0 === "function" ? m6_getPlanningCellsFromRefOrM0() : (REF.planningLib && REF.planningLib.cells ? REF.planningLib.cells : null);
  var cofCat = (m6_data && m6_data.scores) ? m6_data.scores.cof_category : 0;
  var pofTotal = (m6_data && m6_data.scores) ? m6_data.scores.pof_total : 0;
  var cofNum = parseInt(cofCat) || 0;
  var pofNum = parseInt(pofTotal) || 0;
  if (!cofNum || !pofNum) {
    riskCellEl.textContent = "—";
    freqEl.textContent = "—";
    if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = "Complete M6 Risk to get a risk score (CoF + PoF).";
    return;
  }
  var riskDisp = (typeof m6_riskMatrixResolvedCellLabel === "function") ? m6_riskMatrixResolvedCellLabel(cofNum, pofNum) : (typeof m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof === "function" ? m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof(cofNum, pofNum) : String(cofNum) + String(pofNum));
  riskCellEl.textContent = riskDisp;
  var chosen = (m6_data && m6_data.planning_lookup_key != null) ? String(m6_data.planning_lookup_key).trim() : "";
  if (!chosen) {
    freqEl.textContent = "—";
    if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = "In M6, choose Planning interval lookup (M0 Planning table) for the recommended interval.";
    return;
  }
  var entry = cells && typeof m6_planningEntryForChosenKey === "function" ? m6_planningEntryForChosenKey(cells, chosen) : null;
  if (entry) {
    var years = entry.frequency_years != null ? entry.frequency_years : (entry.years != null ? entry.years : null);
    var intervalTxt = typeof m6_formatPlanningIntervalYears === "function" ? m6_formatPlanningIntervalYears(years) : (years != null ? years + " years" : null);
    freqEl.textContent = intervalTxt != null ? intervalTxt : "—";
    if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = intervalTxt != null ? ("Recommended inspection interval from M0 Planning cell " + chosen + ".") : ("Planning cell \"" + chosen + "\" has no frequency.");
  } else {
    freqEl.textContent = "—";
    if (hintEl) hintEl.textContent = "No interval row for planning key \"" + chosen + "\".";
  }
}

function osrM7InspectionPlanEsc(s) {
  return String(s || "").replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
}

function osrFormatIsoSlashDate(v) {
  if (v == null || String(v).trim() === "") return "—";
  var norm = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? m5_normalizeDateString(v) : null;
  if (!norm) return "—";
  return norm.replace(/-/g, "/");
}

function osrM7ComputeNextInspectionDate(lastRaw, nextRaw, freqYrs) {
  var normLast = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? m5_normalizeDateString(lastRaw) : null;
  var freq = parseFloat(freqYrs);
  if (normLast && !isNaN(freq) && freq > 0) {
    var p = normLast.split("-");
    var d = new Date(parseInt(p[0], 10), parseInt(p[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(p[2], 10));
    if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      var wholeY = Math.floor(freq);
      var fracY = freq - wholeY;
      d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() + wholeY);
      if (fracY > 0) d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + Math.round(fracY * 12));
      var y = d.getFullYear();
      var m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
      var day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
      return y + "/" + m + "/" + day;
    }
  }
  var normNext = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? m5_normalizeDateString(nextRaw) : null;
  if (normNext) return osrFormatIsoSlashDate(normNext);
  return "—";
}

function osrM7StableRowKey(r, idx) {
  if (r && r.rowKey != null) return String(r.rowKey);
  return String(r.source || "") + "|" + String(r.componentType || "") + "|" + String(idx);
}

function osrM7TitleStableRowKey(r, idx) {
  if (r && r.rowKey != null) return String(r.rowKey);
  return String(r.source || "") + "|" + String(r.title || "") + "|" + String(r.componentType || "") + "|" + String(idx);
}

function osrM7LegacyRowKey(r, idx) {
  if (r && r.rowKey != null) return String(r.rowKey);
  return String(r.source || "") + "|" + String(r.title || "") + "|" + String(r.type || "") + "|" + String(r.componentType || "") + "|" + String(idx);
}

function osrM7RowKeyLookupOrder(r, idx) {
  if (r && r.rowKey != null) return [String(r.rowKey)];
  var stable = osrM7StableRowKey(r, idx);
  var titleStable = osrM7TitleStableRowKey(r, idx);
  var legacy = osrM7LegacyRowKey(r, idx);
  var out = [];
  [stable, titleStable, legacy].forEach(function(k) {
    if (k && out.indexOf(k) < 0) out.push(k);
  });
  return out;
}

function osrM7MigrateSavedRowKeys(s, rowObjs) {
  if (!s || !rowObjs || !rowObjs.length) return;
  var props = ["module7_calc_inspection_selections", "module7_calc_freq_yrs", "module7_calc_comment", "module7_calc_inspection_type"];
  rowObjs.forEach(function(o) {
    var r = o.r;
    var idx = o.idx;
    var keys = osrM7RowKeyLookupOrder(r, idx);
    var stable = keys[0];
    props.forEach(function(prop) {
      var bag = s[prop];
      if (!bag || typeof bag !== "object") return;
      if (bag[stable] != null && String(bag[stable]).trim() !== "") return;
      for (var ki = 1; ki < keys.length; ki++) {
        var alt = keys[ki];
        if (bag[alt] != null && String(bag[alt]).trim() !== "") {
          bag[stable] = bag[alt];
          break;
        }
      }
    });
  });
}

function osrM7SavedRowValue(saved, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) {
  if (!saved || typeof saved !== "object") return null;
  var keys = [rowKey, titleKey, legacyKey];
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var k = keys[i];
    if (k && saved[k] != null && String(saved[k]).trim() !== "") return saved[k];
  }
  return null;
}

/** Material label for M7/M10 inspection plan rows — M1 composite label when possible. */
function osrM7CalcMaterialDisplay(c) {
  if (!c) return "—";
  var spec = c.material_spec != null ? String(c.material_spec).trim() : "";
  if (spec && typeof m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel === "function") {
    var resolved = m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel(spec);
    if (resolved) return resolved;
  }
  if (c.calculation_title && typeof m5_findM1ComponentByName === "function") {
    var m1row = m5_findM1ComponentByName(c.calculation_title);
    if (m1row && m1row.material_spec != null && String(m1row.material_spec).trim() !== "") {
      var fromM1 = typeof m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel === "function"
        ? m1_resolveMaterialSpecLabel(m1row.material_spec)
        : String(m1row.material_spec).trim();
      if (fromM1) return fromM1;
    }
  }
  return spec || "—";
}

function osrM7EffectiveDesignPressureMpa(s) {
  if (typeof m5_effectiveDesignPressureMpaDisplay === "function") {
    var live = m5_effectiveDesignPressureMpaDisplay();
    if (live !== "" && live != null) {
      var n = parseFloat(live);
      if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;
    }
  }
  var dc = typeof osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating === "function"
    ? osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating().design_conditions || {}
    : ((s && s.module1_asset) ? s.module1_asset.design_conditions || {} : {});
  var v = parseFloat(dc.design_pressure_mpa);
  return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : NaN;
}

function osrM7MinWallPoFText(c, P, CA) {
  if (!c || typeof m5_calcTminValue !== "function") return "—";
  var p = parseFloat(P);
  if (!Number.isFinite(p) || p <= 0) return "—";
  var ca = parseFloat(CA);
  if (!Number.isFinite(ca)) ca = 0;
  var tMin = m5_calcTminValue(c, p, ca);
  var tMinNum = parseFloat(tMin);
  var ffs = (!isNaN(tMinNum) && tMinNum < 2.5) ? 2.5 : tMinNum;
  var ffsStr = !isNaN(ffs) ? ffs.toFixed(2) : String(tMin);
  var tmm = c.measured_thickness_mm != null ? String(c.measured_thickness_mm) : "";
  var cr = c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr != null ? String(c.corrosion_rate_mm_per_yr) : "";
  var remWall = typeof m5_calcRemainingWall === "function" ? m5_calcRemainingWall(tmm, ffsStr) : "—";
  var y2t = typeof m5_calcYearsToTminFromInspection === "function"
    ? m5_calcYearsToTminFromInspection(remWall, cr, c.measured_thickness_date)
    : (typeof m5_calcYearsToTmin === "function" ? m5_calcYearsToTmin(remWall, cr) : "—");
  var halfLife = typeof m5_calcHalfLife === "function" ? m5_calcHalfLife(y2t) : "—";
  if (typeof m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText === "function") return m5_minWallScreeningPoFUiText(c, halfLife);
  if (typeof m5_halfLifeBandDisplay === "function") return m5_halfLifeBandDisplay(halfLife);
  return "—";
}

function osrM7InternalThinningMech(c) {
  if (!c) return null;
  var sub = c.thinning_subtype != null ? String(c.thinning_subtype).trim() : "";
  if (!sub) return null;
  if (typeof m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded === "function") m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded();
  var matGrp = "";
  if (c.material_spec && typeof m5_materialGroupDisplay === "function") {
    matGrp = m5_materialGroupDisplay(c.material_spec) || "";
  }
  return typeof m5_findThinningMechanism === "function" ? m5_findThinningMechanism(sub, matGrp) : null;
}

function osrM7ThinningDamageLabel(c, mech) {
  if (mech && typeof m5_damageDescription === "function") {
    var d = m5_damageDescription(mech);
    if (d) return d;
  }
  if (mech && typeof m5_fName === "function") {
    var n = m5_fName(mech);
    if (n) return n;
  }
  if (c && c.thinning_subtype_custom && String(c.thinning_subtype_custom).trim()) {
    return String(c.thinning_subtype_custom).trim();
  }
  if (c && c.thinning_subtype && String(c.thinning_subtype).trim()) {
    return String(c.thinning_subtype).trim();
  }
  return "Internal thinning";
}

/** Prefer live M3 editor state (m5_data) over last-saved module3_damage for M7 auto-calc columns. */
function osrM7LiveM3Data(s) {
  if (typeof m5_data !== "undefined" && m5_data && (
    (m5_data.min_wall_calcs && m5_data.min_wall_calcs.length) ||
    (m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs && m5_data.external_min_wall_calcs.length) ||
    (m5_data.cracking_calcs && m5_data.cracking_calcs.length) ||
    (m5_data.other_calcs && m5_data.other_calcs.length)
  )) {
    return m5_data;
  }
  return (s && s.module3_damage) ? s.module3_damage : null;
}

function osrM7CollectInspectionPlanRows(s) {
  if (!s) return null;
  if (typeof m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded === "function") m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded();
  var m3 = osrM7LiveM3Data(s);
  var esc = osrM7InspectionPlanEsc;
  var pofLabel = typeof m5_pofScoreLabel === "function" ? m5_pofScoreLabel : function(v) { return v == null ? "—" : String(v); };
  var mechs = typeof m5_getMechs === "function" ? m5_getMechs() : [];
  var mechName = function(id) {
    if (!id) return "—";
    var idStr = String(id);
    for (var i = 0; i < mechs.length; i++) { if (String(m5_fId(mechs[i]) || "") === idStr) return m5_fName(mechs[i]) || idStr; }
    return idStr;
  };
  var mechInspectionArray = function(id, name) {
    var def = typeof m5_lookupDef === "function" ? m5_lookupDef(id, name) : null;
    if (!def) return [];
    var insp = def.inspection_methods || def.inspection || [];
    return Array.isArray(insp) ? insp : [];
  };
  var mechMode = function(id, name) {
    var def = typeof m5_lookupDef === "function" ? m5_lookupDef(id, name) : null;
    if (!def) return "—";
    var mode = def.mode || def.Mode || def.failure_mode || "";
    return String(mode).trim() || "—";
  };
  var dc = typeof osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating === "function" ? osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating().design_conditions || {} : ((s.module1_asset || {}).design_conditions || {});
  var P = osrM7EffectiveDesignPressureMpa(s);
  var CA = parseFloat(dc.corrosion_allowance_mm); if (isNaN(CA)) CA = 0;
  var rows = [];
  if (m3) {
  (m3.min_wall_calcs || []).forEach(function(c) {
    var tit = c.calculation_title || "—";
    var mech = osrM7InternalThinningMech(c);
    var typeTxt = osrM7ThinningDamageLabel(c, mech);
    var mechId = mech && typeof m5_fId === "function" ? m5_fId(mech) : (c.thinning_subtype || "");
    var modeTxt = mech && typeof m5_fMode === "function" ? m5_fMode(mech) : mechMode(mechId, typeTxt);
    if (!modeTxt || modeTxt === "—") modeTxt = "Internal";
    var pofTxt = osrM7MinWallPoFText(c, P, CA);
    rows.push({ id: rows.length + 1, source: "Min wall", title: tit, type: typeTxt, pof: pofTxt, material: osrM7CalcMaterialDisplay(c), componentType: typeof m5_componentTypeFullLabel === "function" ? m5_componentTypeFullLabel(c.component_type) : (c.component_type || "—"), inspectionCodes: mechInspectionArray(mechId, typeTxt), mode: modeTxt, lastInspectedRaw: c.measured_thickness_date, nextInspectionRaw: null });
  });
  (m3.external_min_wall_calcs || []).forEach(function(c) {
    var tit = c.calculation_title || "—";
    var typeTxt = "External thinning";
    var pofTxt = osrM7MinWallPoFText(c, P, CA);
    var modeTxt = (c.external_damage_mechanism && String(c.external_damage_mechanism).trim()) ? String(c.external_damage_mechanism).trim() : "External";
    rows.push({ id: rows.length + 1, source: "Ext min wall", title: tit, type: typeTxt, pof: pofTxt, material: osrM7CalcMaterialDisplay(c), componentType: typeof m5_componentTypeFullLabel === "function" ? m5_componentTypeFullLabel(c.component_type) : (c.component_type || "—"), inspectionCodes: mechInspectionArray("", typeTxt), mode: modeTxt, lastInspectedRaw: c.measured_thickness_date, nextInspectionRaw: null });
  });
  (m3.cracking_calcs || []).forEach(function(c) {
    var tit = c.calculation_title || "—";
    var typeTxt = mechName(c.cracking_type) || "—";
    var pofTxt = typeof m5_crackingPofOrSusceptibilityDisplay === "function" ? m5_crackingPofOrSusceptibilityDisplay(c, pofLabel) : "—";
    rows.push({ id: rows.length + 1, source: "Cracking", title: tit, type: typeTxt, pof: pofTxt, material: osrM7CalcMaterialDisplay(c), componentType: typeof m5_componentTypeFullLabel === "function" ? m5_componentTypeFullLabel(c.component_type) : (c.component_type || "—"), inspectionCodes: mechInspectionArray(c.cracking_type, typeTxt), mode: mechMode(c.cracking_type, typeTxt), lastInspectedRaw: c.last_inspection_date, nextInspectionRaw: null });
  });
  (m3.other_calcs || []).forEach(function(c) {
    var tit = c.calculation_title || "—";
    var typeTxt = mechName(c.mechanism_type) || "—";
    var pofTxt = typeof m5_otherGrPofDisplay === "function" ? m5_otherGrPofDisplay(c, m3, pofLabel) : (c.pof_score != null ? c.pof_score + " " + pofLabel(c.pof_score) : "—");
    rows.push({ id: rows.length + 1, source: "Other", title: tit, type: typeTxt, pof: pofTxt, material: osrM7CalcMaterialDisplay(c), componentType: typeof m5_componentTypeFullLabel === "function" ? m5_componentTypeFullLabel(c.component_type) : (c.component_type || "—"), inspectionCodes: mechInspectionArray(c.mechanism_type, typeTxt), mode: mechMode(c.mechanism_type, typeTxt), lastInspectedRaw: c.last_inspection_date, nextInspectionRaw: null });
  });
  }
  var customRows = s.module7_custom_inspection_rows || [];
  customRows.forEach(function(cr) {
    rows.push({
      id: cr.id,
      rowKey: "custom|" + cr.id,
      custom: true,
      source: cr.source != null && String(cr.source).trim() !== "" ? String(cr.source).trim() : "Manual",
      title: cr.title || "",
      componentType: cr.componentType || "",
      type: cr.type || "",
      mode: cr.mode || "",
      pof: cr.pof || "",
      material: cr.material || "",
      inspectionCodes: [],
      lastInspectedRaw: cr.lastInspected || null,
      nextInspectionRaw: cr.nextInspection || null
    });
  });
  var replCalcs = s.module7_replicated_calcs || [];
  replCalcs.forEach(function(repl) {
    rows.push({ id: repl.id, rowKey: "repl|" + repl.id, source: repl.source || "—", title: repl.title || "—", type: repl.type || "—", pof: repl.pof || "—", material: repl.material || "—", componentType: repl.componentType || "—", mode: repl.mode || "—", inspectionCodes: [], lastInspectedRaw: repl.lastInspectedRaw || null, nextInspectionRaw: repl.nextInspectionRaw || null, lastInspectedDisp: repl.lastInspected || null, nextInspectionDisp: repl.nextInspection || null });
  });
  var rowObjs = rows.map(function(r, idx) { return { r: r, idx: idx }; });
  osrM7MigrateSavedRowKeys(s, rowObjs);
  var excludedRaw = s.module7_calc_row_excluded || [];
  var excludedSet = {};
  excludedRaw.forEach(function(k) { if (k) excludedSet[String(k)] = true; });
  var filteredRowObjs = rowObjs.filter(function(o) {
    var rk = osrM7StableRowKey(o.r, o.idx);
    if (!excludedSet[String(rk)]) return true;
    var legacy = osrM7LegacyRowKey(o.r, o.idx);
    return legacy !== rk && !excludedSet[String(legacy)];
  });
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  return {
    esc: esc,
    rows: rows,
    filteredRowObjs: filteredRowObjs,
    savedSelections: s.module7_calc_inspection_selections || {},
    savedFreq: s.module7_calc_freq_yrs || {},
    savedComment: s.module7_calc_comment || {},
    savedInspectionType: s.module7_calc_inspection_type || {},
    libMethods: (typeof REF !== "undefined" && REF.inspectionMethods && REF.inspectionMethods.inspection_methods) ? REF.inspectionMethods.inspection_methods : [],
    M7_TYPE_OPTIONS: ["Internal", "External", "Non Intrusive", "NDT"]
  };
}

function osrM7RenderInspectionPlanTable(calcsBody, s, opts) {
  if (!calcsBody) return;
  opts = opts || {};
  var compact = !!opts.compact;
  var colspan = compact ? 11 : 16;
  var ctx = osrM7CollectInspectionPlanRows(s);
  if (!ctx) {
    calcsBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="' + colspan + '" class="hint" style="padding:12px">No inspection plan rows yet. Complete M3 Damage or click <strong>Add row</strong> above.</td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  var esc = ctx.esc;
  var savedSelections = ctx.savedSelections;
  var savedFreq = ctx.savedFreq;
  var savedComment = ctx.savedComment;
  var savedInspectionType = ctx.savedInspectionType;
  var libMethods = ctx.libMethods;
  var M7_TYPE_OPTIONS = ctx.M7_TYPE_OPTIONS;
  var findCodeToSelect = function(recommendedCodes) {
    if (!Array.isArray(recommendedCodes) || !recommendedCodes.length || !libMethods.length) return null;
    var first = String(recommendedCodes[0] || "").trim();
    if (!first) return null;
    for (var i = 0; i < libMethods.length; i++) {
      var m = libMethods[i];
      var code = m.code || "";
      var desc = (m.code_description || m.description || "").trim();
      if (code === first || desc === first) return code;
      if (desc && first.toLowerCase() === desc.toLowerCase()) return code;
    }
    return null;
  };
  var buildActionButtons = function(rowKey, r) {
    return "<span class=\"m7-calc-actions-wrap\"><button type=\"button\" class=\"m7-calc-icon-btn m7-calc-replicate-btn\" onclick=\"m7_replicateCalcInspection(this)\" title=\"Duplicate this row (e.g. 1a, 1b)\">&#128190;</button></span>";
  };
  var buildDeleteCell = function(rowKey) {
    return "<button type=\"button\" class=\"m7-calc-icon-btn m7-calc-delete-btn\" onclick=\"m7_deleteCalcRow(this)\" title=\"Remove this row from the inspection plan\">&#128465;</button>";
  };
  var buildInspectionCell = function(r, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) {
    var codeToSelect = osrM7SavedRowValue(savedSelections, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) || findCodeToSelect(r.inspectionCodes);
    var optsHtml = "<option value=\"\">—</option>";
    if (!libMethods.length) return "<span class=\"m7-calc-inspection-wrap\"><select class=\"m7-calc-inspection-select\" disabled title=\"Load inspection method CSV via References\" data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\"><option value=\"\">—</option></select></span>";
    for (var i = 0; i < libMethods.length; i++) {
      var m = libMethods[i];
      var code = m.code || "—";
      var label = (m.code_description || m.description || "") ? (code + " — " + (m.code_description || m.description)) : code;
      var sel = (codeToSelect && code === codeToSelect) ? " selected" : "";
      optsHtml += "<option value=\"" + esc(code) + "\"" + sel + ">" + esc(label) + "</option>";
    }
    return "<span class=\"m7-calc-inspection-wrap\"><select class=\"m7-calc-inspection-select\" data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\" onchange=\"m7_saveCalcInspectionSelection(this)\">" + optsHtml + "</select></span>";
  };
  var buildFreqCell = function(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) {
    var raw = osrM7SavedRowValue(savedFreq, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
    var val = raw != null ? esc(String(raw)) : "";
    return "<input type=\"number\" class=\"m7-calc-freq\" data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\" value=\"" + val + "\" min=\"0\" step=\"0.5\" placeholder=\"years\" title=\"Inspection frequency in years (not days)\" oninput=\"m7_onCalcFreqInput(this)\" onchange=\"m7_saveCalcFreqComment(this)\"/>";
  };
  var buildCommentCell = function(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) {
    var raw = osrM7SavedRowValue(savedComment, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
    var val = raw != null ? String(raw).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;") : "";
    return "<input type=\"text\" class=\"m7-calc-comment\" data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\" value=\"" + val + "\" placeholder=\"—\" oninput=\"m7_saveCalcFreqComment(this)\" onchange=\"m7_saveCalcFreqComment(this)\"/>";
  };
  var buildTypeCell = function(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) {
    var val = osrM7SavedRowValue(savedInspectionType, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
    val = val != null ? String(val) : "";
    var optsHtml = "<option value=\"\">—</option>";
    for (var i = 0; i < M7_TYPE_OPTIONS.length; i++) {
      var o = M7_TYPE_OPTIONS[i];
      var sel = (val === o) ? " selected" : "";
      optsHtml += "<option value=\"" + esc(o) + "\"" + sel + ">" + esc(o) + "</option>";
    }
    return "<select class=\"m7-calc-type-select\" data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\" onchange=\"m7_saveCalcInspectionType(this)\">" + optsHtml + "</select>";
  };
  var buildDateCells = function(r, rowKey, legacyKey, freqVal, titleKey) {
    if (r.custom) {
      var lastNorm = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? m5_normalizeDateString(r.lastInspectedRaw) : null;
      var nextNorm = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? m5_normalizeDateString(r.nextInspectionRaw) : null;
      var lastVal = lastNorm ? esc(lastNorm) : "";
      var nextVal = nextNorm ? esc(nextNorm) : "";
      return "<td><input type=\"text\" class=\"m7-calc-last-insp m5-df-date-pick\" data-custom-id=\"" + esc(String(r.id)) + "\" value=\"" + lastVal + "\" placeholder=\"yyyy/mm/dd\" onpaste=\"m5_datePaste(event,this)\" onchange=\"m7_saveCustomRowField(this)\" onfocus=\"m5_showDatePicker(this)\" onclick=\"m5_showDatePicker(this)\"/></td><td><input type=\"text\" class=\"m7-calc-next-insp m5-df-date-pick\" data-custom-id=\"" + esc(String(r.id)) + "\" value=\"" + nextVal + "\" placeholder=\"yyyy/mm/dd\" onpaste=\"m5_datePaste(event,this)\" onchange=\"m7_saveCustomRowField(this)\" onfocus=\"m5_showDatePicker(this)\" onclick=\"m5_showDatePicker(this)\"/></td>";
    }
    var lastDisp = r.lastInspectedDisp != null && String(r.lastInspectedDisp).trim() !== "" ? String(r.lastInspectedDisp).trim() : osrFormatIsoSlashDate(r.lastInspectedRaw);
    var freqForNext = freqVal != null && String(freqVal).trim() !== "" ? freqVal : osrM7SavedRowValue(savedFreq, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
    var nextDisp = r.nextInspectionDisp != null && String(r.nextInspectionDisp).trim() !== "" ? String(r.nextInspectionDisp).trim() : osrM7ComputeNextInspectionDate(r.lastInspectedRaw, r.nextInspectionRaw, freqForNext);
    return "<td class=\"m7-calc-date-cell m7-calc-last-insp-ro\">" + esc(lastDisp) + "</td><td class=\"m7-calc-date-cell m7-calc-next-insp-ro\" data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\">" + esc(nextDisp) + "</td>";
  };
  var buildCustomTextCell = function(rowId, field, val) {
    var raw = val != null ? String(val) : "";
    var v = raw.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
    return "<input type=\"text\" class=\"m7-calc-custom-field\" data-custom-id=\"" + esc(String(rowId)) + "\" data-custom-field=\"" + esc(field) + "\" value=\"" + v + "\" placeholder=\"" + (field === "mode" ? "Internal / External" : "—") + "\" title=\"" + (field === "mode" ? "Failure mode — where damage applies" : "") + "\" onchange=\"m7_saveCustomRowField(this)\"/>";
  };
  if (!ctx.rows.length) {
    calcsBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="' + colspan + '" class="hint" style="padding:12px">No inspection plan rows yet. Complete M3 Damage or click <strong>Add row</strong> above.</td></tr>';
  } else if (!ctx.filteredRowObjs.length) {
    calcsBody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="' + colspan + '" class="hint" style="padding:12px">No inspection plan rows to show — add calculations in M3 Damage, click <strong>Add row</strong>, or clear <code>module7_calc_row_excluded</code> in saved data if rows were removed.</td></tr>';
  } else {
    calcsBody.innerHTML = ctx.filteredRowObjs.map(function(o) {
      var r = o.r, idx = o.idx;
      var rowKey = osrM7StableRowKey(r, idx);
      var legacyKey = osrM7LegacyRowKey(r, idx);
      var titleKey = osrM7TitleStableRowKey(r, idx);
      var freqVal = osrM7SavedRowValue(savedFreq, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
      if (compact) {
        var lastDispC = r.lastInspectedDisp != null && String(r.lastInspectedDisp).trim() !== "" ? String(r.lastInspectedDisp).trim() : osrFormatIsoSlashDate(r.lastInspectedRaw);
        var nextDispC = r.nextInspectionDisp != null && String(r.nextInspectionDisp).trim() !== "" ? String(r.nextInspectionDisp).trim() : osrM7ComputeNextInspectionDate(r.lastInspectedRaw, r.nextInspectionRaw, freqVal);
        return "<tr data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\" data-row-id=\"" + esc(String(r.id)) + "\"><td>" + esc(r.componentType || "—") + "</td><td>" + esc(r.type || "—") + "</td><td>" + esc(r.mode || "—") + "</td><td>" + esc(r.pof || "—") + "</td><td>" + esc(r.material || "—") + "</td><td class=\"m7-calc-date-cell m7-calc-last-insp-ro\">" + esc(lastDispC) + "</td><td class=\"m7-calc-date-cell m7-calc-next-insp-ro\" data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\">" + esc(nextDispC) + "</td><td>" + buildFreqCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildCommentCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildTypeCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildInspectionCell(r, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td></tr>";
      }
      if (r.custom) {
        return "<tr data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\" data-row-id=\"" + esc(String(r.id)) + "\" data-custom-row=\"1\"><td class=\"m7-calc-actions-cell\">" + buildActionButtons(rowKey, r) + "</td><td>" + esc(String(r.id)) + "</td><td>" + buildCustomTextCell(r.id, "source", r.source) + "</td><td>" + buildCustomTextCell(r.id, "title", r.title) + "</td><td>" + buildCustomTextCell(r.id, "componentType", r.componentType) + "</td><td>" + buildCustomTextCell(r.id, "type", r.type) + "</td><td>" + buildCustomTextCell(r.id, "mode", r.mode) + "</td><td>" + buildCustomTextCell(r.id, "pof", r.pof) + "</td><td>" + buildCustomTextCell(r.id, "material", r.material) + "</td>" + buildDateCells(r, rowKey, legacyKey, freqVal, titleKey) + "<td>" + buildFreqCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildCommentCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildTypeCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildInspectionCell(r, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td class=\"m7-calc-delete-cell\">" + buildDeleteCell(rowKey) + "</td></tr>";
      }
      return "<tr data-row-key=\"" + esc(rowKey) + "\" data-row-id=\"" + esc(String(r.id)) + "\"><td class=\"m7-calc-actions-cell\">" + buildActionButtons(rowKey, r) + "</td><td>" + esc(String(r.id)) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.source) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.title) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.componentType) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.type) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.mode) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.pof) + "</td><td>" + esc(r.material) + "</td>" + buildDateCells(r, rowKey, legacyKey, freqVal, titleKey) + "<td>" + buildFreqCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildCommentCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildTypeCell(rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td>" + buildInspectionCell(r, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey) + "</td><td class=\"m7-calc-delete-cell\">" + buildDeleteCell(rowKey) + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("");
  }
  if (!compact && typeof m7_initCalcsColResize === "function") m7_initCalcsColResize();
}

var M7_CALCS_COL_COUNT = 16;
var M7_CALCS_COL_WIDTHS_KEY = "osr_m7_calcs_col_widths";

function m7_defaultCalcsColWidths() {
  return [36, 44, 72, 160, 100, 130, 80, 44, 90, 100, 100, 72, 140, 90, 180, 36];
}

function m7_loadCalcsColWidths() {
  try {
    var raw = localStorage.getItem(M7_CALCS_COL_WIDTHS_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      var w = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(w) && w.length === M7_CALCS_COL_COUNT) return w.map(function(n) { return Math.max(28, Math.round(Number(n) || 28)); });
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return m7_defaultCalcsColWidths();
}

function m7_saveCalcsColWidths(widths) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(M7_CALCS_COL_WIDTHS_KEY, JSON.stringify(widths)); } catch (e) {}
}

function m7_applyCalcsColWidths(widths) {
  var table = document.getElementById("m7_calcsTable");
  if (!table) return;
  widths = widths || m7_loadCalcsColWidths();
  var ths = table.querySelectorAll("thead tr:first-child th");
  for (var i = 0; i < ths.length && i < widths.length; i++) {
    var px = widths[i] + "px";
    ths[i].style.width = px;
    ths[i].style.minWidth = px;
    ths[i].style.maxWidth = px;
  }
}

function m7_initCalcsColResize() {
  var table = document.getElementById("m7_calcsTable");
  if (!table) return;
  var widths = m7_loadCalcsColWidths();
  m7_applyCalcsColWidths(widths);
  var ths = table.querySelectorAll("thead tr:first-child th");
  ths.forEach(function(th, colIdx) {
    if (th.querySelector(".m7-col-resizer")) return;
    var grip = document.createElement("span");
    grip.className = "m7-col-resizer";
    grip.title = "Drag to resize column";
    grip.addEventListener("mousedown", function(ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      ev.stopPropagation();
      m7_startCalcsColResize(ev, colIdx);
    });
    grip.addEventListener("click", function(ev) { ev.stopPropagation(); });
    th.appendChild(grip);
  });
}

function m7_startCalcsColResize(ev, colIdx) {
  var table = document.getElementById("m7_calcsTable");
  if (!table) return;
  var ths = table.querySelectorAll("thead tr:first-child th");
  var th = ths[colIdx];
  if (!th) return;
  var startX = ev.clientX;
  var startW = th.getBoundingClientRect().width;
  var widths = m7_loadCalcsColWidths();
  function onMove(e) {
    var nw = Math.max(28, Math.round(startW + (e.clientX - startX)));
    widths[colIdx] = nw;
    var px = nw + "px";
    th.style.width = px;
    th.style.minWidth = px;
    th.style.maxWidth = px;
  }
  function onUp() {
    document.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMove);
    document.removeEventListener("mouseup", onUp);
    document.body.classList.remove("m7-col-resizing");
    m7_saveCalcsColWidths(widths);
  }
  document.body.classList.add("m7-col-resizing");
  document.addEventListener("mousemove", onMove);
  document.addEventListener("mouseup", onUp);
}

function osrM7SnapshotPlan(s) {
  if (!s) return null;
  function cloneBag(b) {
    if (!b || typeof b !== "object") return {};
    try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(b)); } catch (e) { return {}; }
  }
  return {
    module7_calc_inspection_selections: cloneBag(s.module7_calc_inspection_selections),
    module7_calc_freq_yrs: cloneBag(s.module7_calc_freq_yrs),
    module7_calc_comment: cloneBag(s.module7_calc_comment),
    module7_calc_inspection_type: cloneBag(s.module7_calc_inspection_type)
  };
}

/** Restore M7 plan fields cleared by a stale DOM flush during export (never overwrites non-empty values). */
function osrM7MergePlanSnapshotIfEmptied(s, snap) {
  if (!s || !snap) return;
  var props = ["module7_calc_inspection_selections", "module7_calc_freq_yrs", "module7_calc_comment", "module7_calc_inspection_type"];
  props.forEach(function(prop) {
    var old = snap[prop];
    if (!old || typeof old !== "object") return;
    if (!s[prop] || typeof s[prop] !== "object") s[prop] = {};
    Object.keys(old).forEach(function(k) {
      var ov = old[k];
      if (ov == null || String(ov).trim() === "") return;
      var cur = s[prop][k];
      if (cur == null || String(cur).trim() === "") s[prop][k] = ov;
    });
  });
}

function osrM7MigrateAllPlanKeysInMemory(s) {
  if (!s || typeof osrM7CollectInspectionPlanRows !== "function" || typeof osrM7MigrateSavedRowKeys !== "function") return;
  var ctx = osrM7CollectInspectionPlanRows(s);
  if (!ctx || !ctx.filteredRowObjs || !ctx.filteredRowObjs.length) return;
  osrM7MigrateSavedRowKeys(s, ctx.filteredRowObjs);
}

function osrM7FlushCalcsBodyFromDom(calcsBody) {
  if (!calcsBody || !activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var s = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
  if (!s.module7_calc_inspection_selections) s.module7_calc_inspection_selections = {};
  calcsBody.querySelectorAll(".m7-calc-inspection-select").forEach(function(sel) {
    var key = sel.getAttribute("data-row-key");
    if (key) s.module7_calc_inspection_selections[key] = sel.value || "";
  });
  if (!s.module7_calc_freq_yrs) s.module7_calc_freq_yrs = {};
  calcsBody.querySelectorAll("input.m7-calc-freq").forEach(function(inp) {
    var key = inp.getAttribute("data-row-key");
    if (key) s.module7_calc_freq_yrs[key] = (inp.value || "").trim();
  });
  if (!s.module7_calc_comment) s.module7_calc_comment = {};
  calcsBody.querySelectorAll("input.m7-calc-comment").forEach(function(inp) {
    var key = inp.getAttribute("data-row-key");
    if (key) s.module7_calc_comment[key] = (inp.value || "").trim();
  });
  if (!s.module7_calc_inspection_type) s.module7_calc_inspection_type = {};
  calcsBody.querySelectorAll("select.m7-calc-type-select").forEach(function(sel) {
    var key = sel.getAttribute("data-row-key");
    if (key) s.module7_calc_inspection_type[key] = (sel.value || "").trim();
  });
  osrM7FlushCustomRowsFromDom(calcsBody);
}

/** Flush M7 plan edits from the M7 inspection plan table only. */
function osrM7FlushInspectionPlanFromDom() {
  if (!activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var m7Body = $("m7_calcsBody");
  if (m7Body && m7Body.querySelector("tr[data-row-key]")) {
    osrM7FlushCalcsBodyFromDom(m7Body);
  }
}

function osrM7FlushM7NotesAndSelections() {
  if (!activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var m7NotesEl = $("m7_notes");
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_notes = m7NotesEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m7_notes") : (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_notes || "");
  var m7SeaEl = $("m7_sea_notes");
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_specialist_engineering_assessment = m7SeaEl ? osrModNotes_getStored("m7_sea_notes") : (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_specialist_engineering_assessment || "");
}

function osrM7FlushCustomRowsFromDom(calcsBody) {
  if (!calcsBody || !activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var stored = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows;
  if (!Array.isArray(stored)) return;
  calcsBody.querySelectorAll("tr[data-custom-row]").forEach(function(tr) {
    var id = tr.getAttribute("data-row-id");
    if (!id) return;
    var row = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < stored.length; i++) {
      if (String(stored[i].id) === String(id)) { row = stored[i]; break; }
    }
    if (!row) return;
    tr.querySelectorAll(".m7-calc-custom-field[data-custom-field]").forEach(function(inp) {
      var f = inp.getAttribute("data-custom-field");
      if (f) row[f] = (inp.value || "").trim();
    });
    var lastInp = tr.querySelector(".m7-calc-last-insp");
    var nextInp = tr.querySelector(".m7-calc-next-insp");
    if (lastInp && typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function") row.lastInspected = m5_normalizeDateString(lastInp.value) || "";
    if (nextInp && typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function") row.nextInspection = m5_normalizeDateString(nextInp.value) || "";
  });
}

function m7_load() {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  var s = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi || {};
  try {
    if (s.module6_risk) m6_data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s.module6_risk));
  } catch (eM7m6) { /* ignore */ }
  var m1 = s.module1_asset || {};
  var dc = typeof osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating === "function" ? osrEffectiveM1DesignOperating().design_conditions || {} : (m1.design_conditions || {});

  /* Basic Info */
  $("m7_tag").textContent = m1.tag || s.tag_number || "—";
  $("m7_name").textContent = m1.name || "—";
  $("m7_desc").textContent = m1.description || "—";
  if ($("m7_insulation")) $("m7_insulation").textContent = (m1.vessel_insulation != null && String(m1.vessel_insulation).trim() !== "") ? String(m1.vessel_insulation).trim() : "—";
  if ($("m7_heat_treated")) $("m7_heat_treated").textContent = (m1.vessel_heat_treated != null && String(m1.vessel_heat_treated).trim() !== "") ? String(m1.vessel_heat_treated).trim() : "—";
  $("m7_eqType").textContent = m1.equipment_type || "—";

  /* Design Conditions */
  $("m7_tempC").textContent = dc.design_temperature_c != null ? dc.design_temperature_c : "—";
  $("m7_presMPa").textContent = dc.design_pressure_mpa != null ? dc.design_pressure_mpa : "—";
  $("m7_nomThk").textContent = dc.nominal_thickness_mm != null ? dc.nominal_thickness_mm : "—";
  $("m7_corrAllow").textContent = dc.corrosion_allowance_mm != null ? dc.corrosion_allowance_mm : "—";

  /* Risk & Inspection Frequency */
  m7_refreshPlanningRiskHeader();
  if ($("m7_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m7_notes", s.module7_notes || "");
  if (!String(s.module7_notes || "").trim() && s.module10_freeform && String(s.module10_freeform).trim() && $("m7_notes")) {
    osrModNotes_setFromStored("m7_notes", s.module10_freeform);
  }
  if ($("m7_sea_notes")) osrModNotes_setFromStored("m7_sea_notes", s.module7_specialist_engineering_assessment || "");
  if ($("m7_status")) $("m7_status").textContent = "Loaded";

  /* M3 Calculations table — Min wall, Cracking, Other (from saved module3_damage or m5_data) */
  var calcsBody = $("m7_calcsBody");
  if (calcsBody) osrM7RenderInspectionPlanTable(calcsBody, s, { compact: false });

}

function m7_refreshNextInspectionDates(calcsBody) {
  if (!calcsBody || typeof osrM7ComputeNextInspectionDate !== "function") return;
  calcsBody.querySelectorAll("tr[data-row-key]").forEach(function(tr) {
    var freqInp = tr.querySelector("input.m7-calc-freq");
    var nextTd = tr.querySelector(".m7-calc-next-insp-ro");
    var lastTd = tr.querySelector(".m7-calc-last-insp-ro");
    if (!freqInp || !nextTd || !lastTd) return;
    var lastTxt = String(lastTd.textContent || "").trim();
    if (lastTxt === "—") lastTxt = "";
    nextTd.textContent = osrM7ComputeNextInspectionDate(lastTxt.replace(/\//g, "-"), null, freqInp.value);
  });
}

function m7_save() {
  if (!activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  osrM7FlushM7NotesAndSelections();
  var calcsBody = $("m7_calcsBody");
  osrM7FlushInspectionPlanFromDom();
  setModuleStatus(7, "complete");
  auditLog(7, "saved");
  if (typeof osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed === "function") osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  m7_refreshNextInspectionDates(calcsBody);
  if ($("m7_status")) $("m7_status").textContent = "Saved";
}

function m7_onCalcFreqInput(el) {
  if (!el) return;
  m7_saveCalcFreqComment(el);
  var tr = el.closest("tr");
  if (!tr) return;
  var nextTd = tr.querySelector(".m7-calc-next-insp-ro");
  if (!nextTd) return;
  var lastTd = tr.querySelector(".m7-calc-last-insp-ro");
  var lastTxt = lastTd ? String(lastTd.textContent || "").trim() : "";
  if (lastTxt === "—") lastTxt = "";
  var nextDisp = typeof osrM7ComputeNextInspectionDate === "function"
    ? osrM7ComputeNextInspectionDate(lastTxt.replace(/\//g, "-"), null, el.value)
    : "—";
  nextTd.textContent = nextDisp;
}

/** Finalize M7 inspection plan for export — never re-renders the table (m7_load was wiping the UI and stale DOM was clearing memory). */
function osrFlushM7ForExport(planSnap) {
  if (!activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var s = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
  osrM7FlushM7NotesAndSelections();
  osrM7FlushInspectionPlanFromDom();
  osrM7MigrateAllPlanKeysInMemory(s);
  if (planSnap) osrM7MergePlanSnapshotIfEmptied(s, planSnap);
  osrM7MigrateAllPlanKeysInMemory(s);
  var m7Body = $("m7_calcsBody");
  if (m7Body && m7Body.querySelector("tr[data-row-key]")) m7_refreshNextInspectionDates(m7Body);
}

var m7_calcsSortCol = -1;
var m7_calcsSortDir = 1;

function m7_sortCalcsTable(colIndex) {
  var calcsBody = $("m7_calcsBody");
  if (!calcsBody) return;
  var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(calcsBody.querySelectorAll("tr[data-row-key]"));
  if (!rows.length) return;
  if (m7_calcsSortCol === colIndex) m7_calcsSortDir = -m7_calcsSortDir;
  else { m7_calcsSortCol = colIndex; m7_calcsSortDir = 1; }
  var getCellText = function(tr, col) {
    var td = tr.cells[col];
    if (!td) return "";
    var sel = td.querySelector("select.m7-calc-inspection-select");
    if (sel && col === 14) return (sel.options[sel.selectedIndex] && sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].text) ? sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].text.trim() : (sel.value || "");
    var typeSel = td.querySelector("select.m7-calc-type-select");
    if (typeSel && col === 13) return (typeSel.options[typeSel.selectedIndex] && typeSel.options[typeSel.selectedIndex].text) ? typeSel.options[typeSel.selectedIndex].text.trim() : (typeSel.value || "");
    var inp = td.querySelector("input.m7-calc-freq, input.m7-calc-comment");
    if (inp) return (inp.value || "").trim();
    return (td.textContent || "").trim();
  };
  rows.sort(function(a, b) {
    var va = getCellText(a, colIndex);
    var vb = getCellText(b, colIndex);
    if (colIndex === 1) {
      var na = parseInt(va.replace(/[a-z]/gi, ""), 10);
      var nb = parseInt(vb.replace(/[a-z]/gi, ""), 10);
      if (na !== nb) return m7_calcsSortDir * (na - nb);
      return m7_calcsSortDir * (va.localeCompare(vb, undefined, { numeric: true }));
    }
    if (colIndex === 9 || colIndex === 10) {
      var da = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? m5_normalizeDateString(va.replace(/\//g, "-")) : va;
      var db = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? m5_normalizeDateString(vb.replace(/\//g, "-")) : vb;
      if (da && db) return m7_calcsSortDir * da.localeCompare(db);
      if (da && !db) return -m7_calcsSortDir;
      if (!da && db) return m7_calcsSortDir;
    }
    if (colIndex === 11) {
      var nfa = parseFloat(va), nfb = parseFloat(vb);
      if (!isNaN(nfa) && !isNaN(nfb) && nfa !== nfb) return m7_calcsSortDir * (nfa - nfb);
    }
    return m7_calcsSortDir * (va.localeCompare(vb, undefined, { sensitivity: "base", numeric: true }));
  });
  rows.forEach(function(tr){ calcsBody.appendChild(tr); });
  var thead = calcsBody.closest("table") && calcsBody.closest("table").querySelector("thead");
  if (thead) {
    thead.querySelectorAll(".m7-calcs-sort-th").forEach(function(th){
      var i = parseInt(th.getAttribute("data-col"), 10);
      th.classList.remove("m7-sort-asc", "m7-sort-desc");
      var icon = th.querySelector(".m7-sort-icon");
      if (icon) icon.textContent = "⇅";
      if (i === m7_calcsSortCol) {
        th.classList.add(m7_calcsSortDir === 1 ? "m7-sort-asc" : "m7-sort-desc");
        if (icon) icon.textContent = m7_calcsSortDir === 1 ? "\u2191" : "\u2193";
      }
    });
  }
}

function m7_saveCalcInspectionSelection(selectEl) {
  if (!selectEl || !activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var rowKey = selectEl.getAttribute("data-row-key");
  if (!rowKey) return;
