  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections[rowKey] = selectEl.value || "";
}

function m7_addInspectionPlanRow() {
  if (!activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows = [];
  var rows = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows;
  var maxN = 0;
  rows.forEach(function(r) {
    var m = String(r.id || "").match(/^C(\d+)$/i);
    if (m) maxN = Math.max(maxN, parseInt(m[1], 10));
  });
  var newId = "C" + (maxN + 1);
  rows.push({ id: newId, source: "Manual", title: "", componentType: "", type: "", mode: "", pof: "", material: "", lastInspected: "", nextInspection: "" });
  if (typeof osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed === "function") osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  m7_load();
}

function m7_saveCustomRowField(el) {
  if (!el || !activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var id = el.getAttribute("data-custom-id");
  if (!id) return;
  var rows = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows;
  if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return;
  var row = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if (String(rows[i].id) === String(id)) { row = rows[i]; break; }
  }
  if (!row) return;
  if (el.classList.contains("m7-calc-last-insp")) {
    row.lastInspected = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? (m5_normalizeDateString(el.value) || "") : (el.value || "").trim();
  } else if (el.classList.contains("m7-calc-next-insp")) {
    row.nextInspection = typeof m5_normalizeDateString === "function" ? (m5_normalizeDateString(el.value) || "") : (el.value || "").trim();
  } else {
    var field = el.getAttribute("data-custom-field");
    if (field) row[field] = (el.value || "").trim();
  }
  if (typeof osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed === "function") osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
}

function m7_replicateCalcInspection(btnEl) {
  var row = btnEl && btnEl.closest("tr");
  if (!row || !activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  if (row.getAttribute("data-custom-row") === "1") {
    m7_replicateCustomInspectionRow(row, btnEl);
    return;
  }
  var tds = row.cells;
  if (tds.length < 16) return;
  var idText = (row.getAttribute("data-row-id") || (tds[1] && tds[1].textContent) || "").trim();
  var parentId = parseInt(String(idText).replace(/[a-z]/gi, ""), 10) || 1;
  var replCalcs = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_replicated_calcs;
  if (!replCalcs) { activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_replicated_calcs = []; replCalcs = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_replicated_calcs; }
  var forParent = replCalcs.filter(function(r){ var p = parseInt(String(r.id).replace(/[a-z]/gi, ""), 10); return p === parentId; });
  var nextLetter = String.fromCharCode(97 + forParent.length);
  var newId = parentId + nextLetter;
  var getText = function(i){ return (tds[i] && tds[i].textContent || "").trim(); };
  var repl = {
    parentId: parentId,
    id: newId,
    source: getText(2),
    title: getText(3),
    componentType: getText(4),
    type: getText(5),
    mode: getText(6),
    pof: getText(7),
    material: getText(8),
    lastInspected: getText(9),
    nextInspection: getText(10)
  };
  replCalcs.push(repl);
  var sel = row.querySelector(".m7-calc-inspection-select");
  var freqInp = row.cells[11] && row.cells[11].querySelector("input.m7-calc-freq");
  var commentInp = row.cells[12] && row.cells[12].querySelector("input.m7-calc-comment");
  var typeSel = row.cells[13] && row.cells[13].querySelector("select.m7-calc-type-select");
  var rowKeyNew = "repl|" + newId;
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections = {};
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections[rowKeyNew] = (sel && !sel.disabled) ? (sel.value || "") : "";
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs = {};
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment = {};
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type = {};
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs[rowKeyNew] = freqInp ? (freqInp.value || "").trim() : "";
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment[rowKeyNew] = commentInp ? (commentInp.value || "").trim() : "";
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type[rowKeyNew] = typeSel ? (typeSel.value || "").trim() : "";
  m7_load();
  var orig = btnEl.textContent;
  btnEl.textContent = "\u2713";
  setTimeout(function(){ btnEl.textContent = orig; }, 600);
}

function m7_replicateCustomInspectionRow(row, btnEl) {
  if (!row || !activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var calcsBody = $("m7_calcsBody");
  if (calcsBody) {
    osrM7FlushCustomRowsFromDom(calcsBody);
    osrM7FlushCalcsBodyFromDom(calcsBody);
  }
  var idText = (row.getAttribute("data-row-id") || "").trim();
  if (!idText) return;
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows = [];
  var stored = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows;
  var sourceRow = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < stored.length; i++) {
    if (String(stored[i].id) === String(idText)) { sourceRow = stored[i]; break; }
  }
  if (!sourceRow) return;
  var baseMatch = String(idText).match(/^(C\d+)/i);
  var baseId = baseMatch ? baseMatch[1] : String(idText);
  var baseEsc = baseId.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  var forParent = stored.filter(function(r) {
    return new RegExp("^" + baseEsc + "[a-z]+$", "i").test(String(r.id || ""));
  });
  var nextLetter = String.fromCharCode(97 + forParent.length);
  var newId = baseId + nextLetter;
  stored.push({
    id: newId,
    source: sourceRow.source != null && String(sourceRow.source).trim() !== "" ? String(sourceRow.source).trim() : "Manual",
    title: sourceRow.title || "",
    componentType: sourceRow.componentType || "",
    type: sourceRow.type || "",
    mode: sourceRow.mode || "",
    pof: sourceRow.pof || "",
    material: sourceRow.material || "",
    lastInspected: sourceRow.lastInspected || "",
    nextInspection: sourceRow.nextInspection || ""
  });
  var rowKeyNew = "custom|" + newId;
  var rowKeyOld = row.getAttribute("data-row-key") || ("custom|" + idText);
  var sel = row.querySelector(".m7-calc-inspection-select");
  var freqInp = row.cells[11] && row.cells[11].querySelector("input.m7-calc-freq");
  var commentInp = row.cells[12] && row.cells[12].querySelector("input.m7-calc-comment");
  var typeSel = row.cells[13] && row.cells[13].querySelector("select.m7-calc-type-select");
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections = {};
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs = {};
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment = {};
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type = {};
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections[rowKeyNew] = (sel && !sel.disabled) ? (sel.value || "") : (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections[rowKeyOld] || "");
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs[rowKeyNew] = freqInp ? (freqInp.value || "").trim() : (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs[rowKeyOld] || "");
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment[rowKeyNew] = commentInp ? (commentInp.value || "").trim() : (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment[rowKeyOld] || "");
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type[rowKeyNew] = typeSel ? (typeSel.value || "").trim() : (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type[rowKeyOld] || "");
  if (typeof osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed === "function") osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  m7_load();
  if (btnEl) {
    var orig = btnEl.textContent;
    btnEl.textContent = "\u2713";
    setTimeout(function(){ btnEl.textContent = orig; }, 600);
  }
}

function m7_deleteCalcRow(btnEl) {
  var row = btnEl && btnEl.closest("tr");
  if (!row || !activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var rowKey = row.getAttribute("data-row-key");
  if (!rowKey) return;
  if (String(rowKey).indexOf("repl|") === 0) {
    var rowId = row.getAttribute("data-row-id") || (row.cells[1] && row.cells[1].textContent) || "";
    var replCalcs = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_replicated_calcs;
    if (replCalcs) {
      activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_replicated_calcs = replCalcs.filter(function(r){ return String(r.id) !== String(rowId); });
    }
  } else if (String(rowKey).indexOf("custom|") === 0) {
    var customId = String(rowKey).slice(7);
    var customRows = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows;
    if (customRows) {
      activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_custom_inspection_rows = customRows.filter(function(r){ return String(r.id) !== String(customId); });
    }
  } else {
    if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_row_excluded) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_row_excluded = [];
    var ex = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_row_excluded;
    if (ex.indexOf(rowKey) < 0) ex.push(rowKey);
  }
  if (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections) delete activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_selections[rowKey];
  if (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs) delete activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_freq_yrs[rowKey];
  if (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment) delete activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_comment[rowKey];
  if (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type) delete activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module7_calc_inspection_type[rowKey];
  if (typeof osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed === "function") osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  m7_load();
}

function m9_infoBtn(key) {
  return " <button type=\"button\" class=\"m5_stdRefIcon m9-sec-info\" onclick=\"event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();m5_showStdRef(event,'" + key + "')\" aria-label=\"Industry RBI screening RP — section meaning (click)\">&#8505;</button>";
}

function m9_nodeIsEmptyReportEl(node) {
  if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return true;
  var tag = (node.tagName || "").toLowerCase();
  if (tag === "img" || tag === "picture" || tag === "iframe" || tag === "video" || tag === "svg") return true;
  if (node.classList && node.classList.contains("osr-img-wrap")) return true;
  var inner = String(node.innerHTML || "")
    .replace(/&nbsp;|\u00a0|\u200b/gi, "")
    .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "")
    .replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, "")
    .trim();
  if (!inner) return true;
  var text = String(node.textContent || "").replace(/\u00a0|\u200b/g, "").trim();
  if (!text && !node.querySelector("table, ul, ol, li, a[href]")) return true;
  return false;
}

function m9_pruneEmptyReportElements(root) {
  if (!root) return;
  var changed = true;
  var pass = 0;
  while (changed && pass < 24) {
    changed = false;
    pass++;
    var list = root.querySelectorAll("p, div, span, h1, h2, h3, h4, li");
    for (var i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var node = list[i];
      if (!node.parentNode || node === root) continue;
      if (m9_nodeIsEmptyReportEl(node)) {
        node.parentNode.removeChild(node);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
  }
}

function m9_stripReportLayoutStyles(root) {
  if (!root) return;
  root.querySelectorAll("[style]").forEach(function(el) {
    var st = el.getAttribute("style");
    if (!st) return;
    st = st
      .replace(/\b(?:min-)?height\s*:\s*[^;]+;?/gi, "")
      .replace(/\bwidth\s*:\s*[^;]+;?/gi, "")
      .replace(/\bfloat\s*:\s*[^;]+;?/gi, "")
      .replace(/\bclear\s*:\s*[^;]+;?/gi, "")
      .replace(/\bposition\s*:\s*(?:absolute|fixed|relative)\s*;?/gi, "")
      .replace(/\btop\s*:\s*[^;]+;?/gi, "")
      .replace(/\bleft\s*:\s*[^;]+;?/gi, "")
      .replace(/\bz-index\s*:\s*[^;]+;?/gi, "")
      .replace(/^\s*;\s*|\s*;\s*;/g, ";")
      .replace(/^;+|;+$/g, "")
      .trim();
    if (st) el.setAttribute("style", st);
    else el.removeAttribute("style");
  });
  root.querySelectorAll("img, picture, .osr-img-wrap, [contenteditable='false']").forEach(function(node) {
    if (node.parentNode) node.parentNode.removeChild(node);
  });
}

function m9_stripImagesFromHtml(html) {
  var raw = html != null ? String(html) : "";
  if (!raw.trim()) return "";
  try {
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.innerHTML = raw;
    m9_stripReportLayoutStyles(wrap);
    m9_pruneEmptyReportElements(wrap);
    return wrap.innerHTML;
  } catch (eStrip) {
    return raw
      .replace(/<img\b[^>]*>/gi, "")
      .replace(/<picture\b[\s\S]*?<\/picture>/gi, "")
      .replace(/<span[^>]*class="[^"]*osr-img-wrap[^"]*"[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/span>/gi, "");
  }
}

function m9_richHtmlFromEditorOrStored(editorId, storedHtml) {
  var el = typeof $ === "function" ? $(editorId) : document.getElementById(editorId);
  if (el && el.innerHTML != null) {
    var live = String(el.innerHTML || "").trim();
    if (live && live !== "<p></p>" && live !== "<p><br></p>" && live !== "<p><br/></p>" && live !== "<br>" && live !== "<br/>") return m9_stripImagesFromHtml(live);
  }
  return m9_stripImagesFromHtml(storedHtml != null ? String(storedHtml).trim() : "");
}

function m9_isEmptyRichHtml(html) {
  var raw = html != null ? String(html).trim() : "";
  return !raw || raw === "<p></p>" || raw === "<p><br></p>" || raw === "<p><br/></p>" || raw === "<br>" || raw === "<br/>";
}

function m9_appendRichNotesBlock(h, title, html) {
  html = m9_stripImagesFromHtml(html);
  if (m9_isEmptyRichHtml(html)) return h;
  return h + "<h3 class=\"m9-sub\">" + title + "</h3><div class=\"m9-ref-html m9-sea-body\">" + html + "</div>";
}

function m9_appendPlainNotesBlock(h, title, text) {
  var t = text != null ? String(text).trim() : "";
  if (!t) return h;
  return h + "<h3 class=\"m9-sub\">" + title + "</h3><div class=\"m9-ref-html\">" + escHtml(t).replace(/\r\n|\r|\n/g, "<br>") + "</div>";
}

/** Append report HTML in section chunks so one bad rich-text block cannot hide later sections (e.g. M8). */
function m9_setReportHtml(el, h) {
  if (!el) return;
  el.innerHTML = "";
  var parts = String(h || "").split(/(?=<h[12] class="m9-(?:report-title|sec-title))/);
  parts.forEach(function(part) {
    if (!String(part || "").trim()) return;
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    try {
      wrap.innerHTML = part;
      while (wrap.firstChild) el.appendChild(wrap.firstChild);
    } catch (ePart) {
      console.warn("m9_setReportHtml chunk", ePart);
      var pre = document.createElement("pre");
      pre.className = "hint";
      pre.textContent = "Could not render part of the report.";
      el.appendChild(pre);
    }
  });
}

function m9_buildModule8Html(s) {
  var out = "";
  out += "<h2 class=\"m9-sec-title\" id=\"m9-module-8\">Module 8 — History" + m9_infoBtn("m9_sub_m8_history") + "</h2>";
  var m8Html = m9_richHtmlFromEditorOrStored("m8_editor", s.module8_references);
  if (m9_isEmptyRichHtml(m8Html)) {
    out += "<p class=\"hint\">No history document recorded. Open <strong>M8 History</strong>, add content, save, then produce the report again.</p>";
  } else {
    out = m9_appendRichNotesBlock(out, "History document", m8Html);
  }
  var m8PlainEl = typeof $ === "function" ? $("m8_notes") : document.getElementById("m8_notes");
  var m8Plain = m8PlainEl ? String(m8PlainEl.value || "").trim() : (s.module8_notes != null ? String(s.module8_notes).trim() : "");
  if (m8Plain) out = m9_appendPlainNotesBlock(out, "Module 8 notes", m8Plain);
  return out;
}

/** Mount Module 8 after M1–M7 so rich HTML in earlier modules cannot hide history. */
function m9_mountModule8(el, s) {
  if (!el || !s) return;
  var prev = el.querySelector("#m9-module-8-wrap");
  if (prev && prev.parentNode) prev.parentNode.removeChild(prev);
  var block = document.createElement("div");
  block.id = "m9-module-8-wrap";
  block.className = "m9-module-block";
  block.setAttribute("data-m9-module", "8");
  block.innerHTML = m9_buildModule8Html(s);
  el.appendChild(block);
}

  var area = loc.area || "";
  var system = loc.system || "";

  var reportTitle = "Risk Based Inspection Report for \"" + escHtml(tag) + " " + escHtml(name) + "\" — Location (as per location CSV reference): " + escHtml(site || "—") + " / " + escHtml(area || "—") + " / " + escHtml(system || "—");
  var m6Early = s.module6_risk;

  var rawRiskCellEarly = (m6Early && m6Early.scores && m6Early.scores.risk_cell) ? String(m6Early.scores.risk_cell).trim() : "";

  var finalRiskCellDisp = typeof m6_riskCellToDisplayLabel === "function" ? m6_riskCellToDisplayLabel(finalRiskCell) : finalRiskCell;
  var h = "";
  h += "<h1 class=\"m9-report-title\">" + reportTitle + m9_infoBtn("m9_report_title") + "</h1>";
  h += "<p class=\"m9-final-risk\"><strong>Final risk:</strong> " + escHtml(finalRiskCellDisp) + m9_infoBtn("m9_report_final_risk") + "</p>";

  /* Module 1 — Asset register */
  h += "<h2 class=\"m9-sec-title\" id=\"m9-module-1\">Module 1 — Asset register" + m9_infoBtn("m9_sub_m1_asset") + "</h2>";
  h += "<p>The equipment is identified as <strong>" + escHtml(tag) + "</strong>";
  if (name) h += " — " + escHtml(name);

    h += "<div class=\"m9-sea-body\">" + m9_stripImagesFromHtml(m3.specialist_engineering_assessment) + "</div>";
  }

  /* Module 4 — Release */
  h += "<h2 class=\"m9-sec-title\" id=\"m9-module-4\">Module 4 — Release" + m9_infoBtn("m9_sub_m4_release") + "</h2>";
  var m4Phase = m4 && m4.phase ? m4.phase : null;
  var m4Scen = m4 && m4.scenario_name ? m4.scenario_name : null;
  if (m4) {
    h += "<p>";

    h += "Phase at release: " + escHtml(m4Phase || "—") + ". ";

    if (m4.storage_pressure_mpa != null) {
      h += "Storage/operating pressure " + escHtml(m4.storage_pressure_mpa) + " MPa gauge. ";
      var psAbs=m4.storage_pressure_abs_mpa;
      if(psAbs==null&&m4.storage_pressure_mpa!=null&&Number.isFinite(parseFloat(m4.storage_pressure_mpa)))psAbs=parseFloat(m4.storage_pressure_mpa)+M3_PATM_REF_MPA;
      if(psAbs!=null&&Number.isFinite(psAbs)) h += "P<sub>s</sub> (abs, §4.3) " + escHtml(fmt(psAbs,6)) + " MPa. ";
    }

    if (m4.back_pressure_mpa != null) h += "Back pressure P<sub>atm</sub> " + escHtml(m4.back_pressure_mpa) + " MPa absolute. ";
    if (m4.discharge_coefficient != null) h += "Discharge coefficient C<sub>d</sub> " + escHtml(m4.discharge_coefficient) + ". ";
    if (m4.vessel_volume_l != null) h += "Vessel volume " + escHtml(m4.vessel_volume_l) + " L. ";
    h += "</p>";
    if (m4Holes.length) {
      h += "<p><strong>Release rates by hole size:</strong></p><ul class=\"m9-list\">";

/** Clone a module panel for printing: expand all details, strip buttons/file inputs, flatten form controls to text so the full module body prints (not headings only). */
function osrClonePanelForFullPrint(panelEl) {
  var clone = panelEl.cloneNode(true);
  clone.querySelectorAll("details").forEach(function(d) {
    d.setAttribute("open", "");
  });
  clone.querySelectorAll('input[type="file"]').forEach(function(n) {
    if (n.parentNode) n.parentNode.removeChild(n);
  });
  clone.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(function(b) {
    if (b.parentNode) b.parentNode.removeChild(b);
  });
  clone.querySelectorAll("textarea").forEach(function(ta) {
    var pre = document.createElement("pre");
    pre.className = "osr-print-static";
    pre.style.cssText = "white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font:inherit;margin:0";
    pre.textContent = ta.value || "";
    ta.parentNode.replaceChild(pre, ta);
  });
  clone.querySelectorAll("select").forEach(function(sel) {
    var opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
    var txt = opt ? String(opt.textContent || opt.value || "") : "";
    var div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "osr-print-static";
    div.textContent = txt;
    sel.parentNode.replaceChild(div, sel);
  });
  clone.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(function(inp) {
    var t = (inp.type || "text").toLowerCase();
    var div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "osr-print-static";
    if (t === "checkbox" || t === "radio") div.textContent = inp.checked ? (inp.value || "Yes") : "";
    else div.textContent = inp.value != null ? String(inp.value) : "";
    inp.parentNode.replaceChild(div, inp);
  });
  clone.querySelectorAll("[contenteditable]").forEach(function(ed) {
    var div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "osr-print-editable";
    div.innerHTML = ed.innerHTML;
    ed.parentNode.replaceChild(div, ed);
  });
  return clone;
}

/** Print one module (M0–M9): loads module data, flattens DOM, opens print window with full content. */
function osrPrintModule(num) {
  num = parseInt(num, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num < 0 || num > 9) return;
  try {
    switch (num) {
      case 0:
        break;
      case 1:
        if (typeof m1_load === "function") m1_load();
        break;
      case 2:
        if (typeof m2_load === "function") m2_load();
        break;
      case 3:
        if (typeof m5_load === "function") m5_load();
        break;
      case 4:
        if (typeof m3_load === "function") m3_load();
        break;
      case 5:
        if (typeof m4_load === "function") m4_load();
        break;
      case 6:
        if (typeof m6_load === "function") m6_load();
        break;
      case 7:
        if (typeof m7_load === "function") m7_load();
        break;
      case 8:
        if (typeof m8_load === "function") m8_load();
        break;
      case 9:
        if (typeof m9_load === "function") m9_load();
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  } catch (ePre) {
    console.warn("osrPrintModule preload", ePre);
  }
  var panel = document.getElementById("panel" + num);
  if (!panel) return;
  var title = "Module " + num;
  var h2 = panel.querySelector(".osr-module-summary h2, .module-title-row h2, h2");
  if (h2 && h2.textContent) title = String(h2.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() || title;
  var flat = osrClonePanelForFullPrint(panel);
  var win = window.open("", "_blank");
  var printStyles =
    "body{font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:900px;margin:16px auto;padding:16px;line-height:1.5;color:#1a1a1a;background:#fff}";
  printStyles +=
    "h1,h2,h3,h4{margin:0.75em 0 0.35em;font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy)}";
  printStyles +=
    ".data-table,.m9-tbl{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:11px;margin:8px 0}";
  printStyles += ".data-table th,.data-table td,.m9-tbl th,.m9-tbl td{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:4px 6px;vertical-align:top}";
  printStyles +=
    ".card,.osr-m0-reference-section{border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px}";
  printStyles += ".hint{color:#444;font-size:12px}";
  printStyles +=
    ".osr-print-static,.osr-print-editable{margin:2px 0;padding:2px 0;min-height:1.2em}";
  printStyles += "img{max-width:100%;height:auto}";
  printStyles += "pre.osr-print-static{font-size:10px;background:#f8f8f8;padding:8px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:6px}";
  printStyles += ".sbar{display:block!important}";
  printStyles +=
    ".osr-module-asset-line{font-size:11px;color:#444;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 14px;padding:0 0 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e5e5}";
  win.document.write(
    '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>' +
      escHtml(title) +
      '</title><style>' +
      printStyles +
      '</style></head><body>'
  );
  win.document.write("<h1 style=\"font-size:1.35em;margin:0 0 12px\">" + escHtml(title) + "</h1>");
  win.document.write(flat.innerHTML);
  win.document.write("</body></html>");
  win.document.close();
  win.focus();
  setTimeout(function() {
    win.print();
    win.close();
  }, 250);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   M7 — INSPECTION TEST PLAN PRINT (was separate Module 9 tab)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════ */

function m7_inspMethodLabel(code) {
  if (!code) return "—";
  var libMethods = (typeof REF !== "undefined" && REF.inspectionMethods && REF.inspectionMethods.inspection_methods) ? REF.inspectionMethods.inspection_methods : [];
  for (var im = 0; im < libMethods.length; im++) {
    if (libMethods[im].code === code) {
      var m = libMethods[im];
      var desc = m.code_description || m.description || "";
      return desc ? (code + " — " + desc) : code;
    }
  }
  return code;
}

function m7_planNotesHtmlForPrint(s) {
  if (!s) return "";
  var fromM7 = m9_richHtmlFromEditorOrStored("m7_notes", s.module7_notes);
  if (fromM7 && String(fromM7).trim()) return fromM7;
  if (s.module10_freeform && String(s.module10_freeform).trim()) return s.module10_freeform;
  return "";
}

function m7_buildInspectionPlanPrintSummaryHtml(s) {
  if (!s) return "";
  var m1 = s.module1_asset || {};
  var m6 = s.module6_risk;
  var tag = m1.tag || s.tag_number || "—";
  var name = m1.name || "";
  var h = "<h1 class=\"m9-report-title\">Inspection test plan — " + escHtml(tag) + (name ? " " + escHtml(name) : "") + "</h1>";
  h += "<p>This document summarises the inspection planning (Module 7) for this asset. The recommended inspection interval follows the planning row selected in Module 6 (M0 Planning lookup). The table below gives each damage-mechanism calculation with its planned frequency, comment, type and inspection method.</p>";
  var m7RiskCell = "";
  var m7Freq = "";
  if (m6 && m6.scores) {
    var m7Cof = m6.scores.cof_category;
    var m7Pof = m6.scores.pof_total;
    var m7PofN = parseInt(m7Pof, 10);
    m7RiskCell = (m7Cof >= 1 && m7Cof <= 5 && m7PofN >= 1 && m7PofN <= 5) ? ((typeof m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof === "function") ? m6_formatRiskCellLetterPof(m7Cof, m7PofN) : String(m7Cof) + String(m7PofN)) : "";
    var cells = typeof m6_getPlanningCellsFromRefOrM0 === "function" ? m6_getPlanningCellsFromRefOrM0() : (typeof REF !== "undefined" && REF.planningLib && REF.planningLib.cells ? REF.planningLib.cells : null);
    var chosen = (m6 && m6.planning_lookup_key != null) ? String(m6.planning_lookup_key).trim() : "";
    var ent = chosen && cells && typeof m6_planningEntryForChosenKey === "function" ? m6_planningEntryForChosenKey(cells, chosen) : null;
    if (ent && (ent.frequency_years != null || ent.years != null)) {
      var yy2 = ent.frequency_years != null ? ent.frequency_years : ent.years;
      m7Freq = typeof m6_formatPlanningIntervalYears === "function" ? (m6_formatPlanningIntervalYears(yy2) || String(yy2) + " years") : String(yy2) + " years";
    } else m7Freq = "—";
  }
  h += "<p><strong>Risk score (cell):</strong> " + escHtml(m7RiskCell || "—") + ". <strong>Recommended inspection interval:</strong> " + escHtml(m7Freq || "—") + (m6 && m6.planning_lookup_key ? " <span style=\"color:#666\">(planning key " + escHtml(String(m6.planning_lookup_key)) + ")</span>" : "") + ".</p>";
  return h;
}

function m7_buildInspectionPlanTableHtml(s) {
  if (!s) return "";
  var ctx = osrM7CollectInspectionPlanRows(s);
  if (!ctx || !ctx.filteredRowObjs.length) {
    return "<p class=\"hint\">No inspection plan rows. Complete M3 Damage and M7 Planning to populate.</p>";
  }
  var h = "<table class=\"m5-tbl rtbl m9-tbl m9-insp-plan-report\"><thead><tr>";
  h += "<th>Component type</th><th>Damage Mechanism</th><th>Mode</th><th>PoF</th><th>Material</th><th>last inspected</th><th>next inspected</th><th>freq (years)</th><th>comment</th><th>Type</th><th>Inspection</th>";
  h += "</tr></thead><tbody>";
  ctx.filteredRowObjs.forEach(function(o) {
    var r = o.r, idx = o.idx;
    var rowKey = osrM7StableRowKey(r, idx);
    var legacyKey = osrM7LegacyRowKey(r, idx);
    var titleKey = osrM7TitleStableRowKey(r, idx);
    var freq = osrM7SavedRowValue(ctx.savedFreq, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
    var comment = osrM7SavedRowValue(ctx.savedComment, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
    var inspType = osrM7SavedRowValue(ctx.savedInspectionType, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
    var inspection = osrM7SavedRowValue(ctx.savedSelections, rowKey, legacyKey, titleKey);
    var lastDisp = osrFormatIsoSlashDate(r.lastInspectedRaw);
    var nextDisp = osrM7ComputeNextInspectionDate(r.lastInspectedRaw, r.nextInspectionRaw, freq);
    h += "<tr><td>" + escHtml(r.componentType) + "</td><td>" + escHtml(r.type) + "</td><td>" + escHtml(r.mode) + "</td><td>" + escHtml(r.pof) + "</td><td>" + escHtml(r.material) + "</td>";
    h += "<td>" + escHtml(lastDisp) + "</td><td>" + escHtml(nextDisp) + "</td>";
    h += "<td>" + escHtml(freq != null && String(freq) !== "" ? freq + " yr" : "—") + "</td>";
    h += "<td>" + escHtml(comment != null && String(comment) !== "" ? comment : "—") + "</td>";
    h += "<td>" + escHtml(inspType != null && String(inspType) !== "" ? inspType : "—") + "</td>";
    h += "<td>" + escHtml(m7_inspMethodLabel(inspection)) + "</td></tr>";
  });
  h += "</tbody></table>";
  return h;
}

function m7_buildInspectionPlanPrintHtml(s) {
  if (!s) return "";
  var h = m7_buildInspectionPlanPrintSummaryHtml(s);
  h += "<h2 class=\"m9-sec-title\">Inspection plan</h2>";
  h += m7_buildInspectionPlanTableHtml(s);
  var notesHtml = m7_planNotesHtmlForPrint(s);
  if (notesHtml && String(notesHtml).trim()) {
    h = m9_appendRichNotesBlock(h, "Additional notes (M7)", notesHtml);
  }
  return h;
}

function m7_printInspectionPlan() {
  if (typeof m7_save === "function") m7_save();
  if (!activeAsset || !activeAsset.sentinel_rbi) return;
  var s = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi;
  var tag = s.tag_number || "Asset";
  var bodyHtml = m7_buildInspectionPlanPrintHtml(s);
  var win = window.open("", "_blank");
  var printStyles = "body{font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:900px;margin:24px auto;padding:20px;line-height:1.6;color:#1a1a1a}";
  printStyles += "h1,h2,h3{margin:1em 0 0.4em}";
  printStyles += ".m9-report-title{font-size:1.5em;font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);margin:0 0 0.75em;color:#1a1a1a}";
  printStyles += ".m9-sec-title{font-size:1.15em;margin:1em 0 0.5em;padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc}";
  printStyles += ".m9-tbl th,.m9-tbl td{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:4px 8px}";
  printStyles += ".m9-sub{font-size:1em;margin:1em 0 0.4em;color:#444}";
  printStyles += osrEditorPrintImageCss() + "a{color:#2563eb}";
  win.document.write("<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset=\"UTF-8\"><title>Inspection test plan - " + tag + "</title><style>" + printStyles + "</style></head><body>");
  win.document.write(bodyHtml);
  win.document.write("</body></html>");
  win.document.close();
  win.focus();
  setTimeout(function() { win.print(); win.close(); }, 250);
}

var m8_dirty = false;

  var ed = $("m8_editor");

  osrEditorExecCommand(ed, cmd, arg);
  m8_dirty = true;
}

  osrEditorInsertLink($("m8_editor"), function() { m8_dirty = true; });
}

function m8_insertImage() {
  osrEditorInsertImage($("m8_editor"), function() { m8_dirty = true; });
}

  osrEditorImageDblClick(ev, function() { m8_dirty = true; });

function m8_print() {
  var ed = $("m8_editor");
  if (!ed) return;
  var tag = activeAsset && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi ? (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.tag_number || "Asset") : "Asset";
  var name = activeAsset && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi && activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset ? (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module1_asset.name || "") : "";
  var win = window.open("", "_blank");
  win.document.write("<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset=\"UTF-8\"><title>History - " + tag + "</title><style>body{font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:800px;margin:24px auto;padding:20px;line-height:1.6;color:#1a1a1a}h1,h2,h3{margin:1em 0 0.4em}" + osrEditorPrintImageCss() + "a{color:#2563eb}</style></head><body>");
  win.document.write("<h1>History</h1><p><strong>" + tag + "</strong>" + (name ? " &mdash; " + name : "") + "</p><hr>");
  win.document.write(ed.innerHTML);
  win.document.write("</body></html>");
  win.document.close();
  win.focus();
  setTimeout(function() { win.print(); win.close(); }, 250);
}

function m8_load() {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  var ed = $("m8_editor");
  if (!ed) return;
  var html = (activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module8_references || "").trim();
  ed.innerHTML = html ? (typeof osrModNotes_htmlFromStored === "function" ? osrModNotes_htmlFromStored(html) : html) : "";
  osrEditorPrepareBlocks(ed);
  if (html) osrEditorWrapLooseEditorContent(ed);
  osrEditorNormalizeImages(ed);
  if ($("m8_notes")) $("m8_notes").value = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module8_notes || "";
  m8_dirty = false;
  if ($("m8_status")) $("m8_status").textContent = "Loaded";
}

function m8_save() {
  if (!activeAsset) return;
  var ed = $("m8_editor");
  if (!ed) return;
  if (!activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module8_references) activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module8_references = "";
  var live = ed.innerHTML.trim() || "";
  var editorEmpty = !live || live === "<p></p>" || live === "<p><br></p>" || live === "<p><br/></p>";
  if (m8_dirty || (typeof currentTab === "number" && currentTab === 8) || !editorEmpty) {
    activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module8_references = live;
  }
  var m8NotesEl = $("m8_notes");
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module8_notes = m8NotesEl ? String(m8NotesEl.value || "") : "";
  activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module_status["module8"] = activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module8_references ? "complete" : null;
  setModuleStatus(8, activeAsset.sentinel_rbi.module8_references ? "complete" : null);
  auditLog(8, "saved");
  osrPersistSentinelBackupIfAllowed();
  if ($("m8_status")) $("m8_status").textContent = "Saved — " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
  m8_dirty = false;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   INIT — load demo asset at startup
   ═══════════════════════════════════════ */

function applyReadOnlyMode() {
  if (!READONLY_MODE) return;
  document.body.classList.add("readonly-view");
  var i, el, list;
  list = document.querySelectorAll("input, textarea");
  for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    el = list[i];
    if (el && el.closest && el.closest("#gduRoot")) continue;
    el.readOnly = true;
    el.setAttribute("readonly", "readonly");
  }
  list = document.querySelectorAll("select");
  for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    el = list[i];
    if (el && el.closest && el.closest("#gduRoot")) continue;
    el.disabled = true;
  }
  el = document.getElementById("m8_editor");
  if (el) { el.contentEditable = "false"; el.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false"); }
  ["m1_notes", "m2_notes", "m2_sea_notes", "m3_notes", "m3_sea_notes", "m4_notes", "m4_sea_notes", "m5_notes", "m5_sea_notes", "m6_notes", "m6_sea_notes", "m7_notes", "m7_sea_notes"].forEach(function(nid) {
    el = document.getElementById(nid);
    if (el) { el.contentEditable = "false"; el.setAttribute("contenteditable", "false"); }
  });
}

      if (typeof osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData === "function") osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData();
      if (typeof m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded === "function") m5_ensureScreenLibLoaded();
    } else {
      if (typeof applyDemoRules === "function") applyDemoRules(true);
      if (typeof window.renderAllSections === "function") window.renderAllSections();
    }
    var revEl=document.getElementById("revDateTime");
    if(revEl){var d=new Date(); revEl.textContent=d.toLocaleDateString("en-GB",{day:"2-digit",month:"short",year:"numeric"})+" "+d.toLocaleTimeString("en-GB",{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",hour12:false});}
    var buildEl=document.getElementById("osrBuildStamp");
    if(buildEl){buildEl.textContent="build "+new Date().toISOString();}
    if(typeof updateThemeIcon==="function") updateThemeIcon();
    if (typeof syncOsrHeaderTitleFromMetadata === "function") syncOsrHeaderTitleFromMetadata();
    if (!(typeof OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED !== "undefined" && OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED) && typeof applyDemoRules === "function") applyDemoRules(true);
    if (typeof tryConsumeOpenstandardBundle === "function" && tryConsumeOpenstandardBundle()) {
      if (typeof hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp === "function" && hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp() && typeof osrOnM0StateApplied === "function") {
        try { var stB = osrCallGetM0State(); if (stB != null) osrOnM0StateApplied(stB); } catch (eM0) { console.warn("initApp M0→REF after bundle", eM0); }
      }
      if(typeof onAssetLoaded==="function") onAssetLoaded();
      if (typeof switchTab === "function") switchTab(1);
      if (READONLY_MODE) applyReadOnlyMode();
      if (typeof initM3SectionCollapsibles === "function") initM3SectionCollapsibles();
      return;
    }
    activeAsset = null;
    if(typeof onAssetLoaded==="function") onAssetLoaded();
    if (typeof loadDemoVessel==="function") loadDemoVessel();
    if (typeof hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp === "function" && hasEmbeddedRbiDataApp() && typeof osrOnM0StateApplied === "function") {
      try { var stN = osrCallGetM0State(); if (stN != null) osrOnM0StateApplied(stN); } catch (eM1) { console.warn("initApp M0→REF no bundle", eM1); }
    }
    if (READONLY_MODE) applyReadOnlyMode();
    if (typeof initM3SectionCollapsibles === "function") initM3SectionCollapsibles();
  } catch(e) {
    activeAsset = null;
    if(typeof onAssetLoaded==="function"){ try{ onAssetLoaded(); }catch(e2){} }
    if (READONLY_MODE) applyReadOnlyMode();
    if (typeof initM3SectionCollapsibles === "function") initM3SectionCollapsibles();
  }
}

/** Enable Continue when disclaimer checkbox is ticked (inline onchange + gate init). */
function openrbiSyncDisclaimerContinueBtn() {
  var cb = document.getElementById("openrbiDisclaimerAccept");
  var btn = document.getElementById("openrbiDisclaimerContinue");
  if (btn) btn.disabled = !(cb && cb.checked);
}

/** Same role as pipe `openrbiTryDisclaimerThenInit`: do not run `initApp` until disclaimer checkbox + Continue (blocks asset load, tabs, libraries). */
function openrbiTryDisclaimerThenInit() {
  try {
    var gate = document.getElementById("openrbiDisclaimerGate");
    var ws = document.getElementById("openrbiM0Workspace");
    var cb = document.getElementById("openrbiDisclaimerAccept");
    var btn = document.getElementById("openrbiDisclaimerContinue");
    if (!gate || !ws || !cb || !btn) {
      initApp();
      return;
    }
    if (!ws.classList.contains("openrbi-m0-workspace--locked")) {
      initApp();
      return;
    }
    document.body.classList.add("openrbi-awaiting-disclaimer");
    function syncBtn() { openrbiSyncDisclaimerContinueBtn(); }
    cb.addEventListener("change", syncBtn);
    cb.addEventListener("input", syncBtn);
    cb.addEventListener("click", syncBtn);
    syncBtn();
    setTimeout(syncBtn, 0);
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (!cb || !cb.checked) return;
      if (window.__openrbiDisclaimerInitDone) return;
      window.__openrbiDisclaimerInitDone = true;
      document.body.classList.remove("openrbi-awaiting-disclaimer");
      ws.classList.remove("openrbi-m0-workspace--locked");
      ws.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      try {
        if (typeof osrScrollMainToTop === "function") osrScrollMainToTop();
        else if (typeof osrResetViewportScroll === "function") osrResetViewportScroll();
      } catch (eScrollTop) {}
      try {
        var m0 = document.getElementById("osrMod0");
        if (m0 && m0.tagName === "DETAILS") m0.setAttribute("open", "");
      } catch (e0) {}
      initApp();
      try {
        if (typeof m1_syncLocationLibFromM0 === "function") m1_syncLocationLibFromM0();
        if (typeof m1_popLocationSelects === "function") m1_popLocationSelects(!!activeAsset);
        if (typeof m1_renderComponentDesignTable === "function") m1_renderComponentDesignTable();
      } catch (eLocInit) { console.warn("initApp M1 location refresh", eLocInit); }
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("openrbiTryDisclaimerThenInit", e);
    initApp();
  }
}

(function bootstrap(){
  try {
    if(document.readyState==="loading"){ document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",openrbiTryDisclaimerThenInit); }
    else { openrbiTryDisclaimerThenInit(); }
  } catch(e) { setTimeout(openrbiTryDisclaimerThenInit,100); }
})();

    /** Default PoF-style numeric bands (min, max, score, label) for PoF Mapping when JSON is missing — working PoF fractions, not years. */
    const DEFAULT_POF_LIKE_BAND_ROWS = [

    /** Half remaining life bands in years (M3 min-wall 1/2 life). Shorter half-life → higher score — matches m5_halfLifePoFScore built-in tiers. */

    /** PoF-mapping fractions were mistakenly stored in Half remaining life — treat max &lt; 1 yr as invalid. */
    function gduHalfLifeBandsLookLikePoF(arr) {
      if (!arr || !arr.length) return false;
      for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
        const mx = arr[i].max;
        if (mx == null || mx === '') continue;
        const n = Number(mx);
        if (Number.isFinite(n) && n < 1) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    function todayStr() {
      const d = new Date();
      return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    }

    function parseSectionJson(raw) {
      if (raw == null || (raw = String(raw).trim()) === '') return null;
      try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { return null; }
    }

    function getArrayOfObjects(data) {
      if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0 && typeof data[0] === 'object' && data[0] !== null) return { arr: data, wrapperKey: null };
      if (typeof data === 'object' && data !== null) {
        for (const k of Object.keys(data)) {
          const v = data[k];
          if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length > 0 && typeof v[0] === 'object' && v[0] !== null) return { arr: v, wrapperKey: k };
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    function getAllKeys(arr) {
      const set = new Set();
      arr.forEach(obj => { if (obj && typeof obj === 'object') Object.keys(obj).forEach(k => set.add(k)); });
      return Array.from(set);
    }

    /** One matrix-score row under a consequence dimension (Risk consequences). */
    function appendRiskCoFRow(stBody, optKeys, optRow) {
      const str = document.createElement('tr');
      optKeys.forEach(q => {
        const std = document.createElement('td');
        const v = optRow && optRow[q] !== undefined ? optRow[q] : '';
        const inp = document.createElement('input');
        inp.type = 'text';
        inp.className = 'cell-input options-cell';
        inp.setAttribute('data-opt-key', q);
        inp.value = v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v);
        std.appendChild(inp);
        str.appendChild(std);
      });
      const optDelTd = document.createElement('td');
      optDelTd.className = 'opt-del-cell';
      const optDelBtn = document.createElement('button');
      optDelBtn.type = 'button';
      optDelBtn.className = 'row-del';
      optDelBtn.title = 'Delete row';
      optDelBtn.innerHTML = ROW_DEL_ICON;
      optDelBtn.onclick = () => { str.remove(); };
      optDelTd.appendChild(optDelBtn);
      str.appendChild(optDelTd);
      stBody.appendChild(str);
    }

    /** Subtable + “Add matrix row” for matrix rows; full CoF sections use “Add new CoF Section” / per-section “Delete CoF Section”. */
    function createRiskOptionsWrap(val, fallbackOptKeys) {
      const fk = fallbackOptKeys || ['id', 'score', 'description'];
      const optKeys = (Array.isArray(val) && val.length > 0 && val[0] && typeof val[0] === 'object')
        ? Object.keys(val[0])
        : fk;
      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className = 'options-table-wrap';
      const st = document.createElement('table');
      st.className = 'options-subtable';
      const stHead = document.createElement('thead');
      stHead.innerHTML = '<tr>' + optKeys.map(q => '<th>' + (q === 'id' ? 'matrix score' : q) + '</th>').join('') + '<th></th></tr>';
      st.appendChild(stHead);
      const stBody = document.createElement('tbody');
      if (Array.isArray(val) && val.length) {
        val.forEach(optRow => appendRiskCoFRow(stBody, optKeys, optRow));
      }
      st.appendChild(stBody);
      wrap.appendChild(st);
      const addMatrixBtn = document.createElement('button');
      addMatrixBtn.type = 'button';
      addMatrixBtn.className = 'hBtn add-matrix-row-btn';
      addMatrixBtn.textContent = 'Add matrix row';
      addMatrixBtn.title = 'Add a matrix score row in this dimension';
      addMatrixBtn.onclick = () => { appendRiskCoFRow(stBody, optKeys, {}); };
      wrap.appendChild(addMatrixBtn);
      return wrap;
    }

    /** Delete control for one full CoF section row (not matrix rows). */
    function wireRiskCofSectionDelete(header, labelField, tr) {
      const btnDel = document.createElement('button');
      btnDel.type = 'button';
      btnDel.className = 'hBtn del-cof-section-btn danger';
      btnDel.textContent = 'Delete CoF Section';
      btnDel.title = 'Remove this entire CoF section (title, description, and matrix)';
      btnDel.onclick = () => {
        const title = (labelField.value || '').trim();
        const msg = title ? ('Remove “' + title + '” (full CoF section)?') : 'Remove this CoF section?';
        if (!confirm(msg)) return;
        tr.remove();
      };
      header.appendChild(btnDel);
    }

    function riskMatrixCellKey(cofLab, pofLab) {
      return String(cofLab || '') + String(pofLab || '');
    }

    /** Five PoF rows: top = band 5 (A / highest), bottom = band 1 (E / lowest) — matches M6 pofRowNum. */
    function riskMatrixPofBandForRow(rowIndex, pofLen) {
      if (pofLen === 5) return String(5 - rowIndex);
      return null;
    }

    /** CoF column rank 1–5 from header text or column index (aligns M0 saves with M6 lookup). */
    function riskMatrixCofRankFromLabel(cofLab, colIndex) {
      const s = String(cofLab || '').trim();
      if (/^[1-5]$/.test(s)) return parseInt(s, 10);
      const m = s.match(/^([A-E])/i);
      if (m && typeof m6_cofLetterToNum === 'function') {
        const n = m6_cofLetterToNum(m[1]);
        if (n >= 1 && n <= 5) return n;
      }
      const ci = parseInt(colIndex, 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(ci) && ci >= 0 && ci <= 4) return ci + 1;
      return 1;
    }

    function riskMatrixCofAliases(cofLab, colIndex) {
      const s = String(cofLab || '').trim();
      const out = [s];
      if (/^[1-5]$/.test(s)) {
        const leg = 'ABCDE'.charAt(parseInt(s, 10) - 1);
        if (leg) out.push(leg);
      } else if (/^[A-E]$/i.test(s) && typeof m6_cofLetterToNum === 'function') {
        const n = m6_cofLetterToNum(s);
        if (n >= 1 && n <= 5) out.push(String(n));
      } else if (s.length > 1 && typeof m6_cofLetterToNum === 'function') {
        const m = s.match(/^([A-E])/i);
        if (m) {
          const n = m6_cofLetterToNum(m[1]);
          if (n >= 1 && n <= 5) {
            out.push(String(n));
            out.push(m[1].toUpperCase());
          }
        }
      }
      const ci = parseInt(colIndex, 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(ci) && ci >= 0 && ci <= 4) {
        const rks = String(ci + 1);
        const lg = 'ABCDE'.charAt(ci);
        if (out.indexOf(rks) < 0) out.push(rks);
        if (lg && out.indexOf(lg) < 0) out.push(lg);
      }
      return [...new Set(out)];
    }

    function riskMatrixPofKeyCandidates(rowIndex, pofLen, pofDisplay) {
      const cand = [];
      const pd = String(pofDisplay || '').trim();
      if (pd) cand.push(pd);
      const band = riskMatrixPofBandForRow(rowIndex, pofLen);
      if (band && cand.indexOf(band) < 0) cand.push(band);
      if (typeof m5_normalizePofBandScore === 'function') {
        const n = m5_normalizePofBandScore(pd);
        if (n != null) {
          const sn = String(n);
          if (cand.indexOf(sn) < 0) cand.push(sn);
        }
      }
      return cand;
    }

    function riskMatrixCellDataForUi(cells, cofLab, rowIndex, pofArr, pofDisplay, cofColIndex) {
      const defLabel = riskMatrixCellKey(cofLab, pofDisplay);
      const band = riskMatrixPofBandForRow(rowIndex, pofArr.length);
      const rank = riskMatrixCofRankFromLabel(cofLab, cofColIndex);
      const rankStr = String(rank);
      const letter = rank >= 1 && rank <= 5 ? 'ABCDE'.charAt(rank - 1) : '';
      const cofCands = riskMatrixCofAliases(cofLab, cofColIndex);
      const tryOrder = [];
      function pushKey(cf, pf) {
        const k = riskMatrixCellKey(cf, pf);
        if (k && tryOrder.indexOf(k) < 0) tryOrder.push(k);
      }
      /* Prefer stable keys (digit+digit, letter+digit) so M0 colours match M6 even when headers are “A, low …”. */
      if (band) {
        pushKey(rankStr, band);
        if (letter) pushKey(letter, band);
      }
      if (band) cofCands.forEach(cf => pushKey(cf, band));
      const pofCands = riskMatrixPofKeyCandidates(rowIndex, pofArr.length, pofDisplay);
      cofCands.forEach(cf => pofCands.forEach(pf => pushKey(cf, pf)));
      for (let ti = 0; ti < tryOrder.length; ti++) {
        const k = tryOrder[ti];
        if (cells[k] != null) return riskMatrixCellEntry(cells, k, defLabel);
      }
      return { label: defLabel, color: '' };
    }

    /** Default or legacy numeric cell label (CoF rank + PoF) → matrix display PoF + column letter (e.g. 15 → 5A; 35 → 5C). */
    function riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel(label, rowIndex, cofColIndex, pofArr) {
      const s = String(label != null ? label : '').trim();
      if (s !== '' && !/^[1-5][1-5]$/.test(s)) return label;
      const band = riskMatrixPofBandForRow(rowIndex, pofArr.length);
      const pn = band ? parseInt(band, 10) : NaN;
      const cj = parseInt(cofColIndex, 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(pn) && Number.isFinite(cj) && cj >= 0 && cj <= 4 && typeof m6_riskMatrixCellPofCofDisplay === 'function')
        return m6_riskMatrixCellPofCofDisplay(pn, cj);
      return s;
    }

    function riskMatrixCanonicalCellKeyFromRow(cofLab, rowIndex, pofLen, pofDisplay, cofColIndex) {
      const rank = riskMatrixCofRankFromLabel(cofLab, cofColIndex);
      const rankStr = String(rank);
      const band = riskMatrixPofBandForRow(rowIndex, pofLen);
      if (band) return riskMatrixCellKey(rankStr, band);
      const n = typeof m5_normalizePofBandScore === 'function' ? m5_normalizePofBandScore(pofDisplay) : null;
      if (n != null) return riskMatrixCellKey(rankStr, String(n));
      return riskMatrixCellKey(rankStr, String(pofDisplay || '').trim());
    }

    function riskMatrixCellEntry(cells, key, defLab) {
      const raw = cells[key];
      if (raw == null) return { label: defLab, color: '' };
      if (typeof raw === 'string') return { label: raw, color: '' };
      if (typeof raw === 'object') {
        return {
          label: raw.label != null ? String(raw.label) : defLab,
          color: raw.color != null ? String(raw.color) : ''
        };
      }
      return { label: defLab, color: '' };
    }

    const RISK_MATRIX_PALETTE = ['red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'blue', 'green'];
    const RISK_MATRIX_SWATCH_BG = {
      red: '#c62828',
      orange: '#ef6c00',
      yellow: '#f9a825',
      blue: '#1565c0',
      green: '#2e7d32'
    };

    function createRiskMatrixColorSwatches(ent, pofIdx, cofIdx) {
      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className = 'risk-matrix-cell-color risk-matrix-color-swatches';
      wrap.setAttribute('data-pof-idx', String(pofIdx));
      wrap.setAttribute('data-cof-idx', String(cofIdx));
      wrap.setAttribute('role', 'group');
      wrap.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Cell highlight color');
      const raw = ent.color != null ? String(ent.color).trim() : '';
      const lower = raw.toLowerCase();
      const paletteSet = new Set(RISK_MATRIX_PALETTE);
      const normalized = !raw ? '' : (paletteSet.has(lower) ? lower : raw);

      function setSelected(value) {
        wrap.setAttribute('data-selected-color', value);
        wrap.querySelectorAll('.risk-matrix-swatch').forEach(btn => {
          const v = btn.getAttribute('data-value') || '';
          btn.classList.toggle('risk-matrix-swatch-selected', v === value);
        });
      }

      function addSwatch(value, title, bgCss) {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.type = 'button';
        btn.className = 'risk-matrix-swatch' + (value === '' ? ' risk-matrix-swatch-none' : '');
        btn.setAttribute('data-value', value);
        btn.title = title;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-label', title);
        if (bgCss) btn.style.backgroundColor = bgCss;
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => { setSelected(value); });
        wrap.appendChild(btn);
      }

      addSwatch('', 'No highlight', null);
      RISK_MATRIX_PALETTE.forEach(name => {
        addSwatch(name, name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1), RISK_MATRIX_SWATCH_BG[name]);
      });
      if (normalized !== '' && !paletteSet.has(normalized.toLowerCase())) {
        addSwatch(normalized, 'Custom color (' + normalized + ')', normalized);
      }
      setSelected(normalized);
      return wrap;
    }

    function renderRiskMatrixSection(wrap, data, key) {
      const cof = Array.isArray(data.cof_labels) && data.cof_labels.length ? data.cof_labels.map(x => String(x)) : ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5'];
      const pof = Array.isArray(data.pof_labels) && data.pof_labels.length ? data.pof_labels.map(x => String(x)) : ['5', '4', '3', '2', '1'];

      const cells = (data.cells && typeof data.cells === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data.cells)) ? data.cells : {};

        th.appendChild(inp);
        htr.appendChild(th);
      });
      thead.appendChild(htr);
      table.appendChild(thead);

      const tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
      pof.forEach((pLabel, i) => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        const pth = document.createElement('th');
        pth.className = 'risk-matrix-pof-th';
        const pInp = document.createElement('input');
        pInp.type = 'text';
        pInp.className = 'cell-input risk-matrix-axis-header';
        pInp.setAttribute('data-risk-axis', 'pof');
        pInp.setAttribute('data-idx', String(i));
        pInp.value = pLabel;
        pInp.title = 'PoF band label (numeric 1 = lowest frequency … 5 = highest; row order 5→1 top to bottom)';
        pth.appendChild(pInp);
        tr.appendChild(pth);

        cof.forEach((cLabel, j) => {
          const ent = riskMatrixCellDataForUi(cells, cLabel, i, pof, pLabel, j);
          const td = document.createElement('td');
          td.className = 'risk-matrix-cell-td';
          const labInp = document.createElement('input');
          labInp.type = 'text';
          labInp.className = 'cell-input risk-matrix-cell-label';
          labInp.setAttribute('data-pof-idx', String(i));
          labInp.setAttribute('data-cof-idx', String(j));
          labInp.value = typeof riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel === 'function' ? riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel(ent.label, i, j, pof) : ent.label;
          labInp.title = 'Cell label (risk band / text)';
          const colSw = createRiskMatrixColorSwatches(ent, i, j);
          td.appendChild(labInp);
          td.appendChild(colSw);
          tr.appendChild(td);
        });
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });
      table.appendChild(tbody);
      wrap.appendChild(table);

      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'table-actions risk-matrix-actions';
      addCsvButtons(actions, key);
      const hint = document.createElement('span');
      hint.className = 'hint';
      hint.textContent = 'CoF ranks 1–5 across top (M6 shows A, low … E, high). PoF rows 5→1 (5 high … 1 low). Default cell labels match M6: PoF + column letter (e.g. 5A … 5E). Colors: click the squares.';
      actions.appendChild(hint);
      wrap.appendChild(actions);
    }

    const MQ_DEFAULT_SCORE_OPTS = [
      { value: 0, label: '0 | Not in place' },
      { value: 25, label: '25 | Initial' },
      { value: 50, label: '50 | Defined' },
      { value: 75, label: '75 | Controlled' },
      { value: 100, label: '100 | Optimized' }
    ];

    function mqCollectScoreOptionsFromTable(wrap) {
      const tbody = wrap.querySelector('.mq-opts-subtable tbody');
      if (!tbody) return [];
      const opts = [];
      tbody.querySelectorAll('tr').forEach(tr => {
        const vInp = tr.querySelector('.mq-opt-value');
        const lInp = tr.querySelector('.mq-opt-label');
        const v = Number((vInp && vInp.value.trim()) || '');
        if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return;
        opts.push({ value: v, label: String((lInp && lInp.value.trim()) || String(v)) });
      });
      return opts;
    }

    function mqRecalcFromDom(wrap) {
      const mqTable = wrap.querySelector('table[data-management-questionnaire="1"]');
      if (!mqTable) return;
      function rowWeightAndScore(rr) {
        const wRaw = Number((rr.querySelector('.mq-weight') && rr.querySelector('.mq-weight').value) || 0);
        const w = Number.isFinite(wRaw) && wRaw > 0 ? wRaw : 0;
        const sEl = rr.querySelector('.mq-answer');
        const s = sEl ? Number(sEl.value) : NaN;
        return { w, s };
      }
      let globalWeighted = 0, globalTotalW = 0, globalAnswered = 0;
      mqTable.querySelectorAll('tbody.mq-section-tbody').forEach(stb => {
        let weighted = 0, totalW = 0, answered = 0;
        stb.querySelectorAll('tr.mq-question-row').forEach(rr => {
          const { w, s } = rowWeightAndScore(rr);
          totalW += w;
          globalTotalW += w;
          if (Number.isFinite(s)) {
            weighted += s * w;
            answered++;
            globalWeighted += s * w;
            globalAnswered++;
          }
        });
        const secScore = (answered > 0 && totalW > 0) ? (weighted / totalW) : null;
        const secFs = stb.querySelector('.mq-section-final-score');
        const secFms = stb.querySelector('.mq-section-fms');
        if (secFs) secFs.value = secScore == null ? '' : secScore.toFixed(3);
        if (secFms) secFms.value = secScore == null ? '' : (2.38 * Math.exp(-0.012 * secScore)).toFixed(3);
      });
      const gScore = (globalAnswered > 0 && globalTotalW > 0) ? (globalWeighted / globalTotalW) : null;
      const fsOut = wrap.querySelector('.mq-final-score');
      const fmsOut = wrap.querySelector('.mq-fms');
      if (fsOut) fsOut.value = gScore == null ? '' : gScore.toFixed(3);
      if (fmsOut) fmsOut.value = gScore == null ? '' : (2.38 * Math.exp(-0.012 * gScore)).toFixed(3);
    }

    function mqRefreshAnswerSelects(wrap) {
      let opts = mqCollectScoreOptionsFromTable(wrap);
      if (!opts.length) opts = MQ_DEFAULT_SCORE_OPTS.slice();
      wrap.querySelectorAll('.mq-answer').forEach(sel => {
        const cur = sel.value;
        sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">— select —</option>' + opts.map(o => '<option value="' + escapeAttr(String(o.value)) + '">' + escapeAttr(o.label) + '</option>').join('');
        if (opts.some(o => String(o.value) === cur)) sel.value = cur;
      });
    }

    function mqRenumberOrdinals(wrap) {
      const mqTable = wrap.querySelector('table[data-management-questionnaire="1"]');
      if (!mqTable) return;
      let n = 0;
      mqTable.querySelectorAll('tbody.mq-section-tbody tr.mq-question-row').forEach(tr => {
        n++;
        const ord = tr.querySelector('.mq-ordinal');
        if (ord) ord.value = String(n);
      });
    }

    /** Array-of-objects table cell: textarea wraps text; single-line inputs clip in narrow columns and PDF. */
    function gduCreateArrayCellTextarea(keyName, str) {
      const el = document.createElement('textarea');
      el.className = 'cell-input';

      el.value = str == null ? '' : String(str);
      el.rows = 1;

    }

    function gduPlanningCompareRows(trA, trB, colKey) {
      const cellVal = (tr, k) => {
        const inp = tr.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="' + k + '"]');
        return inp ? String(inp.value || '').trim() : '';
      };
      if (colKey === 'frequency_years') {
        const va = cellVal(trA, colKey);
        const vb = cellVal(trB, colKey);
        const na = parseFloat(va);
        const nb = parseFloat(vb);
        const fa = va !== '' && Number.isFinite(na);
        const fb = vb !== '' && Number.isFinite(nb);
        if (fa && fb) return na - nb;
        if (fa && !fb) return -1;
        if (!fa && fb) return 1;
        return va.localeCompare(vb, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
      }
      if (colKey === 'description') {
        return cellVal(trA, colKey).localeCompare(cellVal(trB, colKey), undefined, { sensitivity: 'base' });
      }
      const a = cellVal(trA, 'risk_score');
      const b = cellVal(trB, 'risk_score');
      if (/^\d+$/.test(a) && /^\d+$/.test(b)) return parseInt(a, 10) - parseInt(b, 10);
      const ltr = (x) => (x && x.charAt(0)) || '';
      const tailNum = (x) => parseInt(String(x).slice(1), 10) || 0;
      const lc = ltr(a).localeCompare(ltr(b));
      if (lc !== 0) return lc;
      return tailNum(a) - tailNum(b) || a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true });
    }

    function gduPlanningTableSort(table, colKey) {
      if (!table || table.getAttribute('data-planning-cells') !== '1') return;
      const prevKey = table.getAttribute('data-planning-sort-col') || '';
      const prevDir = table.getAttribute('data-planning-sort-dir') || 'asc';
      let dir = 'asc';
      if (prevKey === colKey && prevDir === 'asc') dir = 'desc';
      table.setAttribute('data-planning-sort-col', colKey);
      table.setAttribute('data-planning-sort-dir', dir);
      const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
      if (!tbody) return;
      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll('tr'));
      rows.sort((trA, trB) => {
        const c = gduPlanningCompareRows(trA, trB, colKey);
        return dir === 'desc' ? -c : c;
      });
      rows.forEach((tr) => tbody.appendChild(tr));
      table.querySelectorAll('.planning-col-sort').forEach((btn) => {
        const k = btn.getAttribute('data-sort-col');
        const active = k === colKey;
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        btn.textContent = active ? (dir === 'asc' ? '\u2191' : '\u2193') : '\u21c5';
      });
      table.querySelectorAll('thead th[data-key]').forEach((th) => {
        const k = th.getAttribute('data-key');
        if (!k) return;
        th.setAttribute('aria-sort', k === colKey ? (dir === 'asc' ? 'ascending' : 'descending') : 'none');
      });
    }

    function osrCanonicalSectionJson(key) {
      if (!window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED || !window.__osrLockedM0Canonical) return null;
      const c = window.__osrLockedM0Canonical;
      if (c[key] == null || c[key] === '') return null;
      return typeof c[key] === 'string' ? c[key] : JSON.stringify(c[key], null, 2);
    }
    window.osrCanonicalSectionJson = osrCanonicalSectionJson;

    }

      return '';
    }

    var GDU_M0_COL_WIDTHS_PREFIX = 'osr_m0_col_widths_';

    function gdu_m0ColWidthsKey(sectionKey, tableIdx) {
      return GDU_M0_COL_WIDTHS_PREFIX + sectionKey + '_' + tableIdx;
    }

    function gdu_loadM0ColWidths(sectionKey, tableIdx, colCount) {
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem(gdu_m0ColWidthsKey(sectionKey, tableIdx));
        if (raw) {
          var w = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(w) && w.length === colCount) {
            return w.map(function(n) { return Math.max(28, Math.round(Number(n) || 28)); });
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return null;
    }

    function gdu_saveM0ColWidths(sectionKey, tableIdx, widths) {
      try { localStorage.setItem(gdu_m0ColWidthsKey(sectionKey, tableIdx), JSON.stringify(widths)); } catch (e) {}
    }

    function gdu_applyM0ColWidths(table, widths) {
      var ths = table.querySelectorAll('thead tr:first-child th');
      for (var i = 0; i < ths.length && i < widths.length; i++) {
        var px = widths[i] + 'px';
        ths[i].style.width = px;
        ths[i].style.minWidth = px;
        ths[i].style.maxWidth = px;
      }
    }

    function gdu_startM0ColResize(ev, table, sectionKey, tableIdx, colIdx) {
      var ths = table.querySelectorAll('thead tr:first-child th');
      var th = ths[colIdx];
      if (!th) return;
      var startX = ev.clientX;
      var startW = th.getBoundingClientRect().width;
      var widths = gdu_loadM0ColWidths(sectionKey, tableIdx, ths.length);
      if (!widths) {
        widths = Array.from(ths).map(function(t) { return Math.max(28, Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().width)); });
      }
      function onMove(e) {
        var nw = Math.max(28, Math.round(startW + (e.clientX - startX)));
        widths[colIdx] = nw;
        var px = nw + 'px';
        th.style.width = px;
        th.style.minWidth = px;
        th.style.maxWidth = px;
      }
      function onUp() {
        document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
        document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
        document.body.classList.remove('gdu-col-resizing');
        gdu_saveM0ColWidths(sectionKey, tableIdx, widths);
      }
      document.body.classList.add('gdu-col-resizing');
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    }

    function gdu_initM0TableColResize(table, sectionKey, tableIdx) {
      if (!table) return;
      var ths = table.querySelectorAll('thead tr:first-child th');
      if (!ths.length) return;
      table.classList.add('gdu-col-resize-enabled');
      table.setAttribute('data-gdu-col-resize', '1');
      var colCount = ths.length;
      var widths = gdu_loadM0ColWidths(sectionKey, tableIdx, colCount);
      if (!widths) {
        widths = Array.from(ths).map(function(th) { return Math.max(28, Math.round(th.getBoundingClientRect().width)); });
      }
      gdu_applyM0ColWidths(table, widths);
      ths.forEach(function(th, colIdx) {
        if (th.querySelector('.gdu-col-resizer')) return;
        var grip = document.createElement('span');
        grip.className = 'gdu-col-resizer';
        grip.title = 'Drag to resize column';
        grip.addEventListener('mousedown', function(ev) {
          ev.preventDefault();
          ev.stopPropagation();
          gdu_startM0ColResize(ev, table, sectionKey, tableIdx, colIdx);
        });
        grip.addEventListener('click', function(ev) { ev.stopPropagation(); });
        th.appendChild(grip);
      });
    }

    function gdu_initSectionColResize(sectionKey, wrap) {
      if (!wrap) return;
      var tables = wrap.querySelectorAll('table.data-table, table.options-subtable, table.mq-opts-subtable');
      tables.forEach(function(table, tableIdx) {
        gdu_initM0TableColResize(table, sectionKey, tableIdx);
      });
    }

    function renderSection(key) {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('gdu_' + key + 'Table');
      const ta = document.getElementById('gdu_' + key);
      if (!wrap || !ta) return;
      try {
      const lockedJson = (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof osrCanonicalSectionJson === 'function') ? osrCanonicalSectionJson(key) : null;
      if (lockedJson != null) {
        ta.readOnly = true;
        ta.setAttribute('aria-readonly', 'true');
        ta.value = lockedJson;
      } else if (key === 'location' && window.OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED && typeof window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString === 'function') {
        ta.readOnly = true;
        ta.setAttribute('aria-readonly', 'true');
        ta.value = window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString();
      }
      const raw = (ta.value || '').trim();
      let data = parseSectionJson(raw);
      if (key === 'risk' && data && data.consequence && Array.isArray(data.consequence.dimensions)) data = { dimensions: data.consequence.dimensions };
      if (key === 'location' && data && data.sites && Array.isArray(data.sites) && data.sites.length > 0 && data.sites[0].areas) {
        const flat = [];
        data.sites.forEach(site => {
          const siteName = site.name || site['Site / Facility'] || '';
          (site.areas || []).forEach(area => {
            const areaName = area.name || area['Unit / Area'] || '';
            const systems = area.systems || [];
            if (systems.length) systems.forEach(sys => flat.push({ 'Site / Facility': siteName, 'Unit / Area': areaName, 'System': typeof sys === 'string' ? sys : (sys.name || '') }));
            else flat.push({ 'Site / Facility': siteName, 'Unit / Area': areaName, 'System': '' });
          });
        });
        data = { sites: flat };
      }
      if (key === 'pofMapping' || key === 'halfRemainingLife') {
        const bad = (data == null || !Array.isArray(data) || !data.length || typeof data[0] !== 'object' || data[0] === null);
        const pofLike = key === 'halfRemainingLife' && !bad && gduHalfLifeBandsLookLikePoF(data);
        if (bad || pofLike) {
          data = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(key === 'halfRemainingLife' ? DEFAULT_HALF_REMAINING_LIFE_BAND_ROWS : DEFAULT_POF_LIKE_BAND_ROWS));
          ta.value = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
        }
      }
      wrap.innerHTML = '';
      if (key === 'riskMatrix') {
        const rmData = (data && typeof data === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data)) ? data : {};
        renderRiskMatrixSection(wrap, rmData, key);
        return;
      }
      if (key === 'planning' && data && typeof data === 'object' && data.cells && typeof data.cells === 'object') {
        const desc = (data.description != null && data.description !== '') ? String(data.description) : '';
        const cellIds = Object.keys(data.cells).sort((a, b) => {
          const ltr = (x) => x.charAt(0), num = (x) => parseInt(x.slice(1), 10) || 0;
          if (ltr(a) !== ltr(b)) return ltr(a).localeCompare(ltr(b));
          return num(a) - num(b);
        });
        const table = document.createElement('table');
        table.className = 'data-table';
        table.setAttribute('data-table-type', 'array');
        table.setAttribute('data-planning-cells', '1');
        table.removeAttribute('data-planning-sort-col');
        table.removeAttribute('data-planning-sort-dir');
        const thead = document.createElement('thead');
        const trHead = document.createElement('tr');
        const planningCols = [
          { label: 'Risk score', key: 'risk_score' },
          { label: 'Frequency (yrs)', key: 'frequency_years' },
          { label: 'Description', key: 'description' }
        ];
        planningCols.forEach((c) => {
          const th = document.createElement('th');
          th.setAttribute('data-key', c.key);
          th.setAttribute('aria-sort', 'none');
          th.appendChild(document.createTextNode(c.label + ' '));
          const sortBtn = document.createElement('button');
          sortBtn.type = 'button';
          sortBtn.className = 'hBtn planning-col-sort';
          sortBtn.setAttribute('data-sort-col', c.key);
          sortBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Sort by ' + c.label);
          sortBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
          sortBtn.textContent = '\u21c5';
          sortBtn.title = 'Sort ascending / descending';
          sortBtn.onclick = (ev) => {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            gduPlanningTableSort(table, c.key);
          };
          th.appendChild(sortBtn);
          trHead.appendChild(th);
        });
        const thDel = document.createElement('th');
        trHead.appendChild(thDel);
        thead.appendChild(trHead);
        table.appendChild(thead);
        const tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
        const descInp = document.createElement('input');
        descInp.type = 'hidden';
        descInp.className = 'planning-description';
        descInp.value = desc;
        wrap.appendChild(descInp);
        cellIds.forEach(cellId => {
          const cell = data.cells[cellId];
          const freq = (cell && (cell.frequency_years != null || cell.frequency_years === 0)) ? String(cell.frequency_years) : '';
          const cellDesc = (cell && cell.description != null) ? String(cell.description) : '';
          const tr = document.createElement('tr');
          tr.innerHTML = '<td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="risk_score" value="' + escapeAttr(cellId) + '"></td><td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="frequency_years" value="' + escapeAttr(freq) + '"></td><td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="description" value="' + escapeAttr(cellDesc) + '"></td><td><button type="button" class="row-del" title="Delete row">' + ROW_DEL_ICON + '</button></td>';
          tr.querySelector('.row-del').onclick = () => tr.remove();
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
        table.appendChild(tbody);
        wrap.appendChild(table);
        const actions = document.createElement('div');
        actions.className = 'table-actions';
        addCsvButtons(actions, key);
        const btnAdd = document.createElement('button');
        btnAdd.type = 'button';
        btnAdd.className = 'hBtn';
        btnAdd.textContent = 'Add row';
        btnAdd.onclick = () => {
          const tr = document.createElement('tr');
          tr.innerHTML = '<td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="risk_score" value=""></td><td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="frequency_years" value=""></td><td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="description" value=""></td><td><button type="button" class="row-del" title="Delete row">' + ROW_DEL_ICON + '</button></td>';
          tr.querySelector('.row-del').onclick = () => tr.remove();
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        };
        actions.appendChild(btnAdd);
        wrap.appendChild(actions);
        return;
      }
      if (key === 'managementQuestionnaire' && data && typeof data === 'object') {
        const title = data.title != null ? String(data.title) : 'Management systems questionnaire';
        const opts = Array.isArray(data.score_options) && data.score_options.length
          ? data.score_options.map(o => ({ value: Number(o.value), label: String(o.label != null ? o.label : o.value) })).filter(o => Number.isFinite(o.value))
          : MQ_DEFAULT_SCORE_OPTS.slice();
        const defaultQuestions = [
          { id: 'leadership_accountability', text: 'Leadership and Accountability - Are RBI roles, ownership, and decision authority formally assigned and active?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'data_quality_control', text: 'Data Quality Control - Are thickness, corrosion, and condition data validated before use?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'damage_mechanism_identification', text: 'Damage Mechanism Identification - Is there a structured, multidisciplinary review to confirm credible mechanisms?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'inspection_effectiveness_control', text: 'Inspection Effectiveness Control - Are inspection methods selected and graded against mechanism-specific effectiveness?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'reassessment_discipline', text: 'Reassessment Discipline - Are risk assessments updated after inspections, process changes, or anomalies?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'moc_integration', text: 'Management of Change (MOC) Integration - Do process/material/operating changes automatically trigger RBI reassessment?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'ffs_integration', text: 'Fitness-for-Service Integration - Are FFS assessments used where required and linked back to planning decisions?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'competency_training', text: 'Competency and Training - Are RBI team members qualified and periodically assessed for competence?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'corrective_action_closure', text: 'Corrective Action Closure - Are high-risk findings tracked to closure with deadlines and verification?', weight_pct: 10 },
          { id: 'audit_continuous_improvement', text: 'Audit and Continuous Improvement - Is the RBI process periodically audited and improved using findings/trends?', weight_pct: 10 }
        ];
        const answers = (data.answers && typeof data.answers === 'object') ? data.answers : {};
        let sectionsData;
        if (Array.isArray(data.sections) && data.sections.length > 0) {
          sectionsData = data.sections.map(s => ({
            title: s.title != null ? String(s.title) : '',
            questions: Array.isArray(s.questions) ? s.questions : []
          }));
        } else {
          const flatQ = Array.isArray(data.questions) && data.questions.length ? data.questions : defaultQuestions;
          sectionsData = [{ title: '', questions: flatQ }];
        }
        const allQs = sectionsData.flatMap(s => s.questions);
        const calcScore = (() => {
          let weighted = 0, totalW = 0, answered = 0;
          allQs.forEach(q => {
            const wRaw = Number(q.weight_pct);
            const w = Number.isFinite(wRaw) && wRaw > 0 ? wRaw : 0;
            totalW += w;
            const s = Number(answers[q.id]);
            if (Number.isFinite(s)) { weighted += s * w; answered++; }
          });
          if (answered > 0 && totalW > 0) return weighted / totalW;
          const fs = Number(data.final_score);
          return Number.isFinite(fs) ? fs : null;
        })();
        const finalScore = calcScore == null ? '' : calcScore.toFixed(3);
        const fms = calcScore == null ? '' : (2.38 * Math.exp(-0.012 * calcScore)).toFixed(3);

          sel.addEventListener('change', () => mqRecalcFromDom(wrap));
          return sel;
        }
