        function appendMqQuestionRow(targetTbody, q) {
          const qid = (q.id != null && String(q.id).trim() !== '') ? String(q.id).trim() : ('mq_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7));
          const tr = document.createElement('tr');
          tr.className = 'mq-question-row';
          const tdO = document.createElement('td');
          const hid = document.createElement('input');
          hid.type = 'hidden';
          hid.className = 'mq-qid';
          hid.value = qid;
          const ord = document.createElement('input');
          ord.type = 'text';
          ord.className = 'cell-input mq-ordinal';
          ord.title = 'Row number (display)';
          ord.value = '1';
          tdO.appendChild(hid);
          tdO.appendChild(ord);
          const tdQ = document.createElement('td');
          const inQ = document.createElement('textarea');
          inQ.className = 'cell-input mq-question';
          inQ.rows = 3;
          inQ.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Question text');
          inQ.value = q.text || '';
          tdQ.appendChild(inQ);
          const tdW = document.createElement('td');
          const inW = document.createElement('input');
          inW.type = 'text';
          inW.className = 'cell-input mq-weight';
          inW.value = String(q.weight_pct != null ? q.weight_pct : 0);
          inW.addEventListener('input', () => mqRecalcFromDom(wrap));
          tdW.appendChild(inW);
          const tdA = document.createElement('td');
          tdA.appendChild(buildMqAnswerSelect(qid, answers[qid]));
          const tdDel = document.createElement('td');
          const btnDel = document.createElement('button');
          btnDel.type = 'button';
          btnDel.className = 'row-del';
          btnDel.title = 'Delete question';
          btnDel.innerHTML = ROW_DEL_ICON;
          btnDel.onclick = () => { tr.remove(); mqRenumberOrdinals(wrap); mqRecalcFromDom(wrap); };
          tdDel.appendChild(btnDel);
          tr.appendChild(tdO);
          tr.appendChild(tdQ);
          tr.appendChild(tdW);
          tr.appendChild(tdA);
          tr.appendChild(tdDel);
          const sumRow = targetTbody.querySelector('.mq-section-summary-row');
          if (sumRow) targetTbody.insertBefore(tr, sumRow);
          else targetTbody.appendChild(tr);
        }

            descField.className = 'consequence-dimension-desc';
            descField.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Consequence dimension description');
            descField.placeholder = 'Description (e.g. Safety consequence Low to High)';
            descField.value = '';
            labelBlock.appendChild(labelField);
            labelBlock.appendChild(descField);
            header.appendChild(labelBlock);
            wireRiskCofSectionDelete(header, labelField, tr);
            td.appendChild(header);
            td.appendChild(createRiskOptionsWrap([], ['id', 'score', 'description']));
            tr.appendChild(td);
          } else {
            keys.forEach(k => {
              const td = document.createElement('td');
              if (key === 'materials' && k === 'material_description') {
                td.appendChild(gduCreateMaterialSummaryInput({}));
              } else if (key === 'damage' && k === 'damage_description') {
                td.appendChild(gduCreateDamageSummaryInput({}));
              } else if (key === 'risk' && k === 'score') {
                const select = document.createElement('select');
                select.className = 'cell-input';
                select.setAttribute('data-key', k);
                ['', 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E'].forEach((v, i) => {
                  const o = document.createElement('option');
                  o.value = v;
                  o.textContent = v === '' ? '—' : (v + ' – ' + ['Low', 'Med low', 'Medium', 'Med high', 'High'][i - 1]);
                  select.appendChild(o);
                });
                td.appendChild(select);
              } else {
                td.appendChild(gduCreateArrayCellTextarea(k, ''));
              }
              tr.appendChild(td);
            });
          }
          if (key === 'materials') {
            const mgHid = document.createElement('input');
            mgHid.type = 'hidden';
            mgHid.className = 'cell-input';
            mgHid.setAttribute('data-key', 'material_group');
            mgHid.value = '';
            tr.appendChild(mgHid);
            gduWireMaterialSummaryRow(tr);
          }
          if (key === 'damage') gduWireDamageSummaryRow(tr);
          if (key !== 'risk') {
            const tdDel = document.createElement('td');
            const btnDel = document.createElement('button');
            btnDel.type = 'button';
            btnDel.className = 'row-del';
            btnDel.title = 'Delete row';
            btnDel.innerHTML = ROW_DEL_ICON;
            btnDel.onclick = () => tr.remove();
            tdDel.appendChild(btnDel);
            tr.appendChild(tdDel);
          }
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        }
        if (key === 'risk') {
          const btnAddCof = document.createElement('button');
          btnAddCof.type = 'button';
          btnAddCof.className = 'hBtn add-cof-btn';
          btnAddCof.textContent = 'Add new CoF Section';
          btnAddCof.title = 'Add a new full CoF section (title, description, and matrix)';
          btnAddCof.onclick = () => { appendRiskDimensionRow(); };
          const btnDelCof = document.createElement('button');
          btnDelCof.type = 'button';
          btnDelCof.className = 'hBtn del-cof-btn danger';
          btnDelCof.textContent = 'Delete CoF Section';
          btnDelCof.title = 'Remove the last CoF section (use the button inside a section to remove that one)';
          btnDelCof.onclick = () => {
            /* Only top-level tbody rows — not <tr> inside nested .options-subtable matrices */
            const rows = Array.from(tbody.children).filter(el => el.tagName === 'TR');
            if (!rows.length) return;
            if (!confirm('Remove the last CoF section?')) return;
            rows[rows.length - 1].remove();
          };
          actions.appendChild(btnAddCof);
          actions.appendChild(btnDelCof);
        } else if (!m0SectionReadOnly) {
          const btnAdd = document.createElement('button');
          btnAdd.type = 'button';
          btnAdd.className = 'hBtn';
          btnAdd.textContent = 'Add row';
          btnAdd.onclick = () => { appendRiskDimensionRow(); };
          actions.appendChild(btnAdd);
        }
        wrap.appendChild(actions);
      } else {
        const obj = data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {};
        const table = document.createElement('table');
        table.className = 'data-table';
        table.setAttribute('data-table-type', 'object');
        const thead = document.createElement('thead');
        thead.innerHTML = '<tr><th>Key</th><th>Value</th><th></th></tr>';
        table.appendChild(thead);
        const tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
        Object.keys(obj).forEach(k => {
          const tr = document.createElement('tr');
          const val = obj[k];
          const str = val === null || val === undefined ? '' : (typeof val === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(val) : String(val));
          tr.innerHTML = '<td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="key" value="' + escapeAttr(k) + '"></td><td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="value" value="' + escapeAttr(str) + '"></td><td><button type="button" class="row-del" title="Delete row">' + ROW_DEL_ICON + '</button></td>';
          tr.querySelector('.row-del').onclick = () => tr.remove();
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
        table.appendChild(tbody);
        wrap.appendChild(table);
        const actions = document.createElement('div');
        actions.className = 'table-actions';
        addCsvButtons(actions, key);
        const btnAdd = document.createElement('button');
        btnAdd.type = 'button';
        btnAdd.className = 'hBtn';
        btnAdd.textContent = 'Add row';
        btnAdd.onclick = () => {
          const tr = document.createElement('tr');
          tr.innerHTML = '<td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="key" value=""></td><td><input type="text" class="cell-input" data-key="value" value=""></td><td><button type="button" class="row-del" title="Delete row">' + ROW_DEL_ICON + '</button></td>';
          tr.querySelector('.row-del').onclick = () => tr.remove();
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        };
        actions.appendChild(btnAdd);
        wrap.appendChild(actions);
      }
      } finally {
        gdu_initSectionColResize(key, wrap);
      }
    }

    function escapeAttr(s) {
      return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
    }

    function csvEscape(v) {
      const s = v === null || v === undefined ? '' : (typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v));
      if (/[",\r\n]/.test(s)) return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
      return s;
    }
    function sectionDataToCsv(key, jsonStr) {
      if (!jsonStr || !jsonStr.trim()) return ' ';
      let data;
      try { data = JSON.parse(jsonStr); } catch (_) { return ' '; }
      if (key === 'planning' && data.cells && typeof data.cells === 'object') {
        const rows = [['Risk score', 'Frequency (yrs)', 'Description']];
        Object.keys(data.cells).sort((a, b) => (a.charAt(0) !== b.charAt(0) ? a.localeCompare(b) : (parseInt(a.slice(1), 10) || 0) - (parseInt(b.slice(1), 10) || 0))).forEach(cellId => {
          const c = data.cells[cellId];
          rows.push([cellId, (c && c.frequency_years != null) ? String(c.frequency_years) : '', (c && c.description != null) ? String(c.description) : '']);
        });
        return rows.map(r => r.map(csvEscape).join(',')).join('\r\n');
      }
      if (key === 'riskMatrix') {
        let d;
        try { d = JSON.parse(jsonStr); } catch (_) { return ' '; }
        if (!d || typeof d !== 'object') return ' ';
        const cof = Array.isArray(d.cof_labels) ? d.cof_labels.map(String) : [];
        const pof = Array.isArray(d.pof_labels) ? d.pof_labels.map(String) : [];
        if (!cof.length || !pof.length) return ' ';
        const cells = (d.cells && typeof d.cells === 'object') ? d.cells : {};
        const lines = [['pof', 'cof', 'cell_key', 'label', 'color']];
        pof.forEach((pi, ri) => {
          const band = riskMatrixPofBandForRow(ri, pof.length);
          cof.forEach((cj, ci) => {
            const cellKey = band ? riskMatrixCellKey(cj, band) : riskMatrixCellKey(cj, pi);
            const ent = riskMatrixCellDataForUi(cells, cj, ri, pof, pi, ci);
            const labOut = typeof riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel === 'function' ? riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel(ent.label, ri, ci, pof) : ent.label;
            lines.push([pi, cj, cellKey, labOut, ent.color]);
          });
        });
        return lines.map(r => r.map(csvEscape).join(',')).join('\r\n');
      }
      if (key === 'damage' && data && Array.isArray(data.mechanisms) && data.mechanisms.length) {
        let keys = Object.keys(data.mechanisms[0] || {});
        keys = keys.filter(k => k !== 'damage_description');
        keys = ['damage_description'].concat(keys);
        const header = keys.join(',');
        const body = data.mechanisms.map(row => keys.map(k => {
          if (k === 'damage_description') return csvEscape(gduDamageSummaryFromRow(row));
          const v = row[k];
          return csvEscape(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : (typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : v));
        }).join(',')).join('\r\n');
        return header + '\r\n' + body;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        if (data.length === 0) return ' ';
        let keys = Object.keys(data[0] || {});
        if (key === 'materials') {
          keys = keys.filter(k => k !== 'material_description');
          keys = ['material_description'].concat(keys);
        }
        const header = keys.join(',');
        const body = data.map(row => keys.map(k => csvEscape(k === 'material_description' ? gduMaterialSummaryFromRow(row) : row[k])).join(',')).join('\r\n');
        return header + '\r\n' + body;
      }
      if (data.consequence && Array.isArray(data.consequence.dimensions)) {
        const dims = data.consequence.dimensions;
        const keys = ['id', 'label', 'description', 'score', 'options'];
        const header = keys.join(',');
        const body = dims.map(d => keys.map(k => csvEscape(k === 'options' ? (d[k] ? JSON.stringify(d[k]) : '') : d[k])).join(',')).join('\r\n');
        return header + '\r\n' + body;
      }
      const wrapperKey = data && typeof data === 'object' && Object.keys(data).length === 1 ? Object.keys(data)[0] : null;
      const arr = wrapperKey && Array.isArray(data[wrapperKey]) ? data[wrapperKey] : null;
      if (arr && arr.length > 0) {
        let keys = Object.keys(arr[0] || {});
        if (key === 'damage') {
          keys = keys.filter(k => k !== 'damage_description');
          keys = ['damage_description'].concat(keys);
        }
        const header = keys.join(',');
        const body = arr.map(row => keys.map(k => {
          if (key === 'damage' && k === 'damage_description') return csvEscape(gduDamageSummaryFromRow(row));
          const v = row[k];
          return csvEscape(v === null || v === undefined ? '' : (typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : v));
        }).join(',')).join('\r\n');
        return header + '\r\n' + body;
      }
      if (data && typeof data === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data)) {
        return 'Key,Value\r\n' + Object.keys(data).map(k => csvEscape(k) + ',' + csvEscape(data[k])).join('\r\n');
      }
      return ' ';
    }
    function parseCsv(text) {
      const rows = [];
      let row = [], cell = '', inQuotes = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        const ch = text[i];
        if (inQuotes) {
          if (ch === '"') {
            if (text[i + 1] === '"') { cell += '"'; i++; }
            else inQuotes = false;
          } else cell += ch;
        } else {
          if (ch === '"') inQuotes = true;
          else if (ch === ',' || ch === '\n' || (ch === '\r' && text[i + 1] === '\n')) {
            row.push(cell);
            cell = '';
            if (ch === '\n' || (ch === '\r' && text[i + 1] === '\n')) { if (ch === '\r') i++; rows.push(row); row = []; }
          } else if (ch !== '\r') cell += ch;
        }
      }
      row.push(cell);
      if (row.some(c => c)) rows.push(row);
      return rows;
    }
    function csvToSectionData(key, csvText) {
      const rows = parseCsv(csvText);
      if (rows.length === 0) return key === 'planning' ? JSON.stringify({ description: '', cells: {} }, null, 2) : '{}';
      if (key === 'planning') {
        const header = rows[0].map(c => (c || '').trim().toLowerCase());
        const riskIdx = header.findIndex(h => /risk|score/.test(h));
        const freqIdx = header.findIndex(h => /freq|year/.test(h));
        const descIdx = header.findIndex(h => /desc/.test(h));
        const ri = riskIdx >= 0 ? riskIdx : 0;
        const fi = freqIdx >= 0 ? freqIdx : 1;
        const di = descIdx >= 0 ? descIdx : 2;
        const cells = {};
        for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
          const cellId = (rows[i][ri] || '').trim();
          if (!cellId) continue;
          const freq = (rows[i][fi] || '').trim();
          const cellDesc = (rows[i][di] || '').trim();
          cells[cellId] = { frequency_years: freq === '' ? null : (isNaN(Number(freq)) ? freq : Number(freq)), description: cellDesc };
        }
        return JSON.stringify({ description: '', cells }, null, 2);
      }
      if (key === 'riskMatrix' && rows.length > 1) {
        const h = rows[0].map(c => (c || '').trim().toLowerCase());
        const pofI = h.indexOf('pof');
        const cofI = h.indexOf('cof');
        if (pofI >= 0 && cofI >= 0) {
          const keyI = h.indexOf('cell_key');
          const altKeyI = h.indexOf('key');
          const kIdx = keyI >= 0 ? keyI : altKeyI;
          const labI = h.indexOf('label');
          const colI = h.indexOf('color');
          const pofOrder = [];
          const cofOrder = [];
          const seenP = new Set();
          const seenC = new Set();
          const cellMap = {};
          for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
            const pv = (rows[i][pofI] || '').trim();
            const cv = (rows[i][cofI] || '').trim();
            if (!pv || !cv) continue;
            if (!seenP.has(pv)) { seenP.add(pv); pofOrder.push(pv); }
            if (!seenC.has(cv)) { seenC.add(cv); cofOrder.push(cv); }
            let cellKey = (kIdx >= 0 && (rows[i][kIdx] || '').trim()) ? (rows[i][kIdx] || '').trim() : '';
            if (!cellKey) {
              let pf = pv;
              if (typeof m5_normalizePofBandScore === 'function') {
                const nPv = m5_normalizePofBandScore(pv);
                if (nPv != null) pf = String(nPv);
              }
              cellKey = riskMatrixCellKey(cv, pf);
            }
            const lab = labI >= 0 ? (rows[i][labI] || '').trim() : '';
            const col = colI >= 0 ? (rows[i][colI] || '').trim() : '';
            if (!cellKey) continue;
            const o = {};
            if (lab && lab !== cellKey) o.label = lab;
            if (col) o.color = col;
            if (Object.keys(o).length) cellMap[cellKey] = o;
          }
          const out = { cof_labels: cofOrder, pof_labels: pofOrder, description: '' };
          if (Object.keys(cellMap).length) out.cells = cellMap;
          return JSON.stringify(out, null, 2);
        }
      }
      const headers = rows[0].map(c => (c || '').trim());
      if (headers.length === 2 && headers[0].toLowerCase() === 'key' && headers[1].toLowerCase() === 'value') {
        const obj = {};
        for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
          const k = (rows[i][0] || '').trim();
          if (!k) continue;
          let v = (rows[i][1] || '').trim();
          if (v.startsWith('{') || v.startsWith('[')) try { v = JSON.parse(v); } catch (_) { }
          obj[k] = v;
        }
        return JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2);
      }
      const arr = [];
      for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
        const obj = {};
        headers.forEach((h, j) => {
          let val = (rows[i][j] || '').trim();
          if (val.startsWith('{') || val.startsWith('[')) try { val = JSON.parse(val); } catch (_) { }
          obj[h] = val;
        });
        arr.push(obj);
      }
      if (key === 'risk') return JSON.stringify({ consequence: { dimensions: arr } }, null, 2);
      const wrapperKeys = { location: 'sites', chemical: null, toxic: 'fluid_properties_library', acid: 'acid_properties_library', materials: null, tankComponents: null, damage: 'mechanisms', riskMatrix: null, areaAffected: 'bands', gff: null, pofMapping: null, halfRemainingLife: null, susceptibility: null, managementQuestionnaire: null, inspectionMethod: 'inspection_methods' };
      const wk = wrapperKeys[key];
      if (wk) return JSON.stringify({ [wk]: arr }, null, 2);
      return JSON.stringify(arr, null, 2);
    }
    let csvImportKey = null;
    function addCsvButtons(actionsDiv, key) {
      const m0Locked = !!window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED;
      const locLocked = key === 'location' && window.OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED;
      const sectionLocked = m0Locked || locLocked;
      const exportBtn = document.createElement('button');
      exportBtn.type = 'button';
      exportBtn.className = 'hBtn' + (sectionLocked ? ' osr-m0-export-only osr-loc-export-only' : '');
      exportBtn.textContent = 'Export CSV';
      exportBtn.onclick = () => {
        const json = getSectionDataFromTable(key);
        const csv = sectionDataToCsv(key, json);
        const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = (key || 'data') + '.csv';
        a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
      };
      const importBtn = document.createElement('button');
      importBtn.type = 'button';
      importBtn.className = 'hBtn';
      importBtn.textContent = 'Import CSV';
      importBtn.onclick = () => {
        csvImportKey = key;
        document.getElementById('gdu_csvImportInput').click();
      };
      const resetBtn = document.createElement('button');
      resetBtn.type = 'button';
      resetBtn.className = 'hBtn danger';
      resetBtn.textContent = 'Reset';
      resetBtn.title = 'Reset this table to default';
      resetBtn.onclick = () => {
        if (sectionLocked) {
          alert(typeof window.osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage === 'function' ? window.osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage() : 'This section is fixed in the approved M0 reference.');
          return;
        }
        const def = DEFAULT_SECTION_VALUES[key];
        if (def !== undefined) {
          const ta = document.getElementById('gdu_' + key);
          if (ta) { ta.value = def; renderSection(key); }
        }
      };
      actionsDiv.appendChild(exportBtn);
      if (!sectionLocked) {
        actionsDiv.appendChild(importBtn);
        actionsDiv.appendChild(resetBtn);
      }
    }

    function getSectionDataFromTable(key) {
      if (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof osrCanonicalSectionJson === 'function') {
        const cj = osrCanonicalSectionJson(key);
        if (cj != null) return cj;
      }
      if (key === 'location' && window.OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED && typeof window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString === 'function') {
        return window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString();
      }
      const wrap = document.getElementById('gdu_' + key + 'Table');
      if (!wrap) return '';
      if (key === 'riskMatrix') {
        const rmTable = wrap.querySelector('table[data-risk-matrix="1"]');
        if (!rmTable) return '';
        const descInp = wrap.querySelector('.risk-matrix-description');
        const description = descInp ? (descInp.value || '').trim() : '';
        const cofInps = Array.from(rmTable.querySelectorAll('thead .risk-matrix-axis-header[data-risk-axis="cof"]'));
        const cof_labels = cofInps.map((inp, idx) => {
          const v = (inp.value || '').trim();
          return v || String.fromCharCode(65 + idx);
        });
        const bodyRows = rmTable.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
        const pof_labels = Array.from(bodyRows).map((tr, idx) => {
          const pInp = tr.querySelector('.risk-matrix-axis-header[data-risk-axis="pof"]');
          const v = pInp ? (pInp.value || '').trim() : '';
          return v || String(idx + 1);
        });
        const cells = {};
        bodyRows.forEach((tr, i) => {
          const pofLab = pof_labels[i];
          const tds = tr.querySelectorAll('td.risk-matrix-cell-td');
          tds.forEach((td, j) => {
            const cofLab = cof_labels[j];
            if (cofLab === undefined) return;
            const canonicalK = riskMatrixCanonicalCellKeyFromRow(cofLab, i, pof_labels.length, pofLab, j);
            const defaultLabelKey = riskMatrixCellKey(cofLab, pofLab);
            const labInp = td.querySelector('.risk-matrix-cell-label');
            const colEl = td.querySelector('.risk-matrix-cell-color');
            const lab = labInp ? (labInp.value || '').trim() : '';
            const col = colEl ? (colEl.getAttribute('data-selected-color') || '').trim() : '';
            const labDisp = typeof riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel === 'function'
              ? riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel(lab, i, j, pof_labels)
              : lab;
            const defaultDisp = typeof riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel === 'function'
              ? riskMatrixNumericCellToUiLabel('', i, j, pof_labels)
              : defaultLabelKey;
            if (labDisp !== defaultDisp || col) {
              cells[canonicalK] = {};
              if (labDisp !== defaultDisp) cells[canonicalK].label = lab;
              if (col) cells[canonicalK].color = col;
            }
          });
        });
        const out = { cof_labels, pof_labels, description };
        if (Object.keys(cells).length) out.cells = cells;
        return JSON.stringify(out, null, 2);
      }
      if (key === 'managementQuestionnaire') {
        const mqTable = wrap.querySelector('table[data-management-questionnaire="1"]');
        if (!mqTable) return '';
        const titleInp = wrap.querySelector('.mq-title');
        const title = titleInp ? (titleInp.value || '').trim() : 'Management systems questionnaire';
        let scoreOptions = mqCollectScoreOptionsFromTable(wrap);
        if (!scoreOptions.length) scoreOptions = MQ_DEFAULT_SCORE_OPTS.slice();
        const sections = [];
        const answers = {};
        mqTable.querySelectorAll('tbody.mq-section-tbody').forEach(stb => {
          const secTitleEl = stb.querySelector('.mq-section-title');
          const secTitle = secTitleEl ? (secTitleEl.value || '').trim() : '';
          const secQuestions = [];
          stb.querySelectorAll('tr.mq-question-row').forEach(tr => {
            const qidInp = tr.querySelector('.mq-qid');
            const id = qidInp ? (qidInp.value || '').trim() : '';
            if (!id) return;
            const textEl = tr.querySelector('.mq-question');
            const text = textEl ? (textEl.value || '').trim() : '';
            const wEl = tr.querySelector('.mq-weight');
            const wRaw = wEl ? (wEl.value || '').trim() : '0';
            const weight_pct = isNaN(Number(wRaw)) ? 0 : Number(wRaw);
            secQuestions.push({ id, text, weight_pct });
            const sel = tr.querySelector('.mq-answer');
            const v = sel ? (sel.value || '').trim() : '';
            answers[id] = v === '' ? null : (isNaN(Number(v)) ? v : Number(v));
          });
          sections.push({ title: secTitle, questions: secQuestions });
        });
        const questions = sections.flatMap(s => s.questions);
        const scoreInp = wrap.querySelector('.mq-final-score');
        const rawScore = scoreInp ? (scoreInp.value || '').trim() : '';
        const finalScore = rawScore === '' ? null : (isNaN(Number(rawScore)) ? rawScore : Number(rawScore));
        const fms = (typeof finalScore === 'number' && Number.isFinite(finalScore)) ? Number((2.38 * Math.exp(-0.012 * finalScore)).toFixed(6)) : null;
        return JSON.stringify({ title, score_options: scoreOptions, sections, questions, answers, final_score: finalScore, fms }, null, 2);
      }
      const table = wrap.querySelector('.data-table');
      if (!table) return '';
      if (key === 'planning' && table.getAttribute('data-planning-cells') === '1') {
        const descInp = wrap.querySelector('.planning-description');
        const description = descInp ? (descInp.value || '').trim() : '';
        const rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
        const cells = {};
        rows.forEach(tr => {
          const riskScoreInp = tr.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="risk_score"]');
          const freqInp = tr.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="frequency_years"]');
          const descCellInp = tr.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="description"]');
          const cellId = riskScoreInp ? (riskScoreInp.value || '').trim() : '';
          if (!cellId) return;
          const freqVal = freqInp ? (freqInp.value || '').trim() : '';
          const num = freqVal === '' ? null : (isNaN(Number(freqVal)) ? freqVal : Number(freqVal));
          const cellDesc = descCellInp ? (descCellInp.value || '').trim() : '';
          cells[cellId] = { frequency_years: num, description: cellDesc };
        });
        return JSON.stringify({ description, cells }, null, 2);
      }
      const type = table.getAttribute('data-table-type');
      if (type === 'array') {
        const keys = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('thead th[data-key]'))
          .filter(th => th.getAttribute('data-computed') !== '1')
          .map(th => th.getAttribute('data-key'));
        const rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
        const arr = [];
      const consequencesOnlyOptions = table.getAttribute('data-consequences-only-options') === '1';
        rows.forEach(tr => {
          const obj = {};
          if (consequencesOnlyOptions) {
            const td = tr.querySelector('td.consequence-options-cell');
            if (!td) return;
            ['id'].forEach(f => {
              const inp = td.querySelector('.consequence-meta[data-meta-key="' + f + '"]');
              obj[f] = inp ? (inp.value || '').trim() : '';
            });
            const labelVis = td.querySelector('.consequence-dimension-label');
            const descVis = td.querySelector('.consequence-dimension-desc');
            if (labelVis) obj.label = (labelVis.value || '').trim();
            else {
              const inp = td.querySelector('.consequence-meta[data-meta-key="label"]');
              obj.label = inp ? (inp.value || '').trim() : '';
            }
            if (descVis) obj.description = (descVis.value || '').trim();
            else {
              const inp = td.querySelector('.consequence-meta[data-meta-key="description"]');
              obj.description = inp ? (inp.value || '').trim() : '';
            }
            const scoreInp = td.querySelector('.consequence-meta[data-meta-key="score"]');
            obj.score = scoreInp ? (scoreInp.value || '').trim() : '';
            const optWrap = td.querySelector('.options-table-wrap');
            if (optWrap) {
              const subRows = optWrap.querySelectorAll('.options-subtable tbody tr');
              const optArr = [];
              subRows.forEach(sr => {
                const inps = sr.querySelectorAll('.options-cell');
                const rowObj = {};
                inps.forEach(inp => {
                  const q = inp.getAttribute('data-opt-key');
                  const val = (inp.value || '').trim();
                  rowObj[q] = val === '' ? (q === 'id' || q === 'value' ? null : '') : (q === 'id' || q === 'value' ? (isNaN(Number(val)) ? val : Number(val)) : val);
                });
                optArr.push(rowObj);
              });
              obj.options = optArr;
            } else {
              const cell = td.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="options"]');
              const v = cell ? (cell.value || '').trim() : '';
              try { obj.options = v && (v.startsWith('[') || v.startsWith('{')) ? JSON.parse(v) : []; } catch (_) { obj.options = []; }
            }
            arr.push(obj);
            return;
          }
          const tds = tr.querySelectorAll('td');
          keys.forEach((k, colIdx) => {
            const td = tds[colIdx];
            const optWrap = td && td.querySelector('.options-table-wrap');
            if (optWrap) {
              const subRows = optWrap.querySelectorAll('.options-subtable tbody tr');
              const optArr = [];
              subRows.forEach(sr => {
                const inps = sr.querySelectorAll('.options-cell');
                const rowObj = {};
                inps.forEach(inp => {
                  const q = inp.getAttribute('data-opt-key');
                  const val = (inp.value || '').trim();
                  rowObj[q] = val === '' ? (q === 'id' || q === 'value' ? null : '') : (q === 'id' || q === 'value' ? (isNaN(Number(val)) ? val : Number(val)) : val);
                });
                optArr.push(rowObj);
              });
              obj[k] = optArr;
            } else {
              const cell = tr.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="' + k + '"]');
              const v = cell ? (cell.value || '').trim() : '';
              if (v === '') obj[k] = (k === 'score' ? '' : null);
              else if (k !== 'score' && (v.startsWith('[') || v.startsWith('{'))) { try { obj[k] = JSON.parse(v); } catch (_) { obj[k] = v; } }
              else obj[k] = v;
            }
          });
          if (key === 'materials') {
            const mgInp = tr.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="material_group"]');
            if (mgInp) {
              const mgv = (mgInp.value || '').trim();
              obj.material_group = mgv === '' ? null : mgv;
            }
          }
          arr.push(obj);
        });
        if (table.getAttribute('data-consequences-only-options') === '1') return JSON.stringify({ consequence: { dimensions: arr } }, null, 2);
        const wrapperKey = table.getAttribute('data-wrapper-key');
        if (wrapperKey) return JSON.stringify({ [wrapperKey]: arr }, null, 2);
        return JSON.stringify(arr, null, 2);
      }
      const rows = table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
      const obj = {};
      rows.forEach(tr => {
        const keyInput = tr.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="key"]');
        const valInput = tr.querySelector('.cell-input[data-key="value"]');
        const k = keyInput ? keyInput.value.trim() : '';
        if (!k) return;
        const v = valInput ? valInput.value.trim() : '';
        if (v === '') obj[k] = null;
        else if (v.startsWith('[') || v.startsWith('{')) { try { obj[k] = JSON.parse(v); } catch (_) { obj[k] = v; } }
        else obj[k] = v;
      });
      return JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2);
    }

    function renderAllSections() {
      SECTION_KEYS.forEach(k => renderSection(k));
    }
    window.renderAllSections = renderAllSections;
    window.renderSection = renderSection;

    /** Persist rich-table edits into hidden JSON textareas before snapshot (Management Questionnaire answers live in the DOM, not always in #gdu_managementQuestionnaire). */
    function syncM0RichSectionTextareas() {
      try {
        const mqW = document.getElementById('gdu_managementQuestionnaireTable');
        if (mqW && mqW.querySelector('table[data-management-questionnaire="1"]')) {
          const json = getSectionDataFromTable('managementQuestionnaire');
          const taMq = document.getElementById('gdu_managementQuestionnaire');
          if (taMq && json && String(json).trim()) taMq.value = json;
        }
      } catch (e) { console.warn('syncM0RichSectionTextareas', e); }
    }

    function getState() {
      if (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && window.__osrLockedM0Canonical) {
        try {
          return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__osrLockedM0Canonical));
        } catch (eCanon) { /* fall through */ }
      }
      syncM0RichSectionTextareas();
      const state = {
        title: (document.getElementById('gdu_docTitle').value || '').trim(),
        date: (document.getElementById('gdu_docDate').value || todayStr()).trim()
      };
      SECTION_KEYS.forEach(k => {
        const wrap = document.getElementById('gdu_' + k + 'Table');
        const ta = document.getElementById('gdu_' + k);
        let val = '';
        if (wrap && wrap.querySelector('.data-table')) {
          val = getSectionDataFromTable(k);
        }
        if ((!val || !String(val).trim()) && ta) {
          val = ta.value || '';
        }
        state[k] = val;
      });
      return state;
    }

    function setState(state) {
      if (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && window.__osrLockedM0Canonical) {
        try { state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__osrLockedM0Canonical)); } catch (eSet) { /* use incoming */ }
      }
      document.getElementById('gdu_docTitle').value = state.title || '';
      document.getElementById('gdu_docDate').value = state.date || todayStr();
      SECTION_KEYS.forEach(k => {
        const el = document.getElementById('gdu_' + k);
        if (!el) return;
        if (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof osrCanonicalSectionJson === 'function') {
          const lj = osrCanonicalSectionJson(k);
          if (lj != null) {
            el.value = lj;
            el.readOnly = true;
            el.setAttribute('aria-readonly', 'true');
            return;
          }
        }
        if (k === 'location' && window.OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED && typeof window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString === 'function') {
          el.value = window.osrLockedM0LocationJsonString();
          el.readOnly = true;
          el.setAttribute('aria-readonly', 'true');
          return;
        }
        const v = state[k];
        if (v === undefined || v === null) {
          el.value = '';
          return;
        }
        el.value = (typeof v === 'object') ? JSON.stringify(v, null, 2) : String(v);
      });
      renderAllSections();
    }

    function initSectionCollapsibles() {
      document.querySelectorAll('#gduRoot .section').forEach(section => {
        const summary = section.querySelector('summary');
        if (!summary) return;
        // Start fully collapsed on initial app load.
        if (!summary.dataset.collapseBound) section.classList.add('collapsed');
        summary.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        summary.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        summary.setAttribute('aria-expanded', section.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'false' : 'true');
        if (summary.dataset.collapseBound === '1') return;
        summary.dataset.collapseBound = '1';
        summary.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          section.classList.toggle('collapsed');
          summary.setAttribute('aria-expanded', section.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'false' : 'true');
        });
        summary.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ') return;
          e.preventDefault();
          section.classList.toggle('collapsed');
          summary.setAttribute('aria-expanded', section.classList.contains('collapsed') ? 'false' : 'true');
        });
      });
    }

    function setTheme(themeName) {
      const allowed = ['dark', 'half-light', 'light'];
      const next = allowed.includes(themeName) ? themeName : 'dark';
      const _gduShell = document.getElementById('gduRoot'); if (_gduShell) _gduShell.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    }

    function collapseAllSections() {
      document.querySelectorAll('#gduRoot .section').forEach(section => {
        section.classList.add('collapsed');
        const summary = section.querySelector('summary');
        if (summary) summary.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    }

    function expandAllSections() {
      document.querySelectorAll('#gduRoot .section').forEach(section => {
        section.classList.remove('collapsed');
        const summary = section.querySelector('summary');
        if (summary) summary.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      });
    }
    window.osrCollapseAllM0Sections = collapseAllSections;
    window.osrExpandAllM0Sections = expandAllSections;

    function save() {
      const state = getState();
      const payload = {
        title: state.title || 'M0 RBI Data',
        date: state.date || todayStr()
      };
      SECTION_KEYS.forEach(k => {
        let raw = state[k] || '';
        if (raw) {
          try { payload[k] = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { payload[k] = raw; }
        } else {
          payload[k] = null;
        }
      });
      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
      const name = (state.title || 'M0-RBI-Data').replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_') + '_' + (state.date || todayStr()).replace(/-/g, '') + '.json';
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = name;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    }

    function openFile() {
      if (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED) {
        alert(typeof window.osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage === 'function' ? window.osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage() : 'M0 JSON import is disabled.');
        return;
      }
      const input = document.getElementById('gdu_fileInput');
      input.value = '';
      input.onchange = function() {
        const file = input.files && input.files[0];
        if (!file) return;
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function() {
          try {
            const data = JSON.parse(reader.result);
            const state = {
              title: data.title != null ? String(data.title) : '',
              date: data.date != null ? String(data.date) : todayStr()
            };
            SECTION_KEYS.forEach(k => {
              const incoming = (k === 'risk' && data[k] == null && data.consequences != null) ? data.consequences : data[k];
              state[k] = incoming != null ? (typeof incoming === 'string' ? incoming : JSON.stringify(incoming, null, 2)) : '';
            });
            setState(state);
            try {
              if (typeof window.osrOnM0StateApplied === 'function') window.osrOnM0StateApplied(state);
            } catch (syncE) { console.warn('M0 openFile REF sync', syncE); }
          } catch (e) {
            alert('Could not open file: ' + (e.message || e));
          }
        };
        reader.readAsText(file, 'UTF-8');
      };
      input.click();
    }

    function exportDocumentAsCsv() {
      const state = getState();
      const rows = [['path', 'value']];
      rows.push(['title', state.title || '']);
      rows.push(['date', state.date || todayStr()]);
      SECTION_KEYS.forEach(k => {
        const raw = state[k] || '';
        rows.push([k, raw]);
      });
      const csv = '\uFEFF' + rows.map(r => r.map(cell => csvEscape(cell)).join(',')).join('\r\n');
      const name = ((state.title || 'M0-RBI-Data').replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_') + '_' + (state.date || todayStr()).replace(/-/g, '') + '.csv').trim() || 'M0_RBI_User_Data.csv';
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = name;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    }

    function exportChemicalAsCsv() {
      const json = getSectionDataFromTable('chemical');
      const csv = sectionDataToCsv('chemical', json);
      const title = (document.getElementById('gdu_docTitle') && document.getElementById('gdu_docTitle').value) || 'M0 RBI Data';
      const date = (document.getElementById('gdu_docDate') && document.getElementById('gdu_docDate').value) || todayStr();
      const name = ((title.replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '_') || 'M0_RBI_Data') + '_Representative_Fluids_' + date.replace(/-/g, '') + '.csv');
      const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = name;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    }

    function importDocumentFromCsv() {
      if (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED) {
        alert(typeof window.osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage === 'function' ? window.osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage() : 'M0 CSV import is disabled.');
        return;
      }
      const input = document.getElementById('gdu_documentCsvInput');
      input.value = '';
      input.onchange = function() {
        const file = input.files && input.files[0];
        this.value = '';
        if (!file) return;
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function() {
          try {
            const rows = parseCsv(reader.result || '');
            if (rows.length < 2) {
              alert('CSV has no data rows. Use a CSV exported from this document.');
              return;
            }
            const header = (rows[0] || []).map(c => (c || '').trim().toLowerCase());
            const pathIdx = header.indexOf('path') >= 0 ? header.indexOf('path') : 0;
            const valueIdx = header.indexOf('value') >= 0 ? header.indexOf('value') : 1;
            const state = { title: '', date: todayStr() };
            SECTION_KEYS.forEach(k => { state[k] = ''; });
            for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
              const path = (rows[i][pathIdx] != null ? String(rows[i][pathIdx]) : '').trim();
              const value = rows[i][valueIdx] != null ? String(rows[i][valueIdx]) : '';
              if (path === 'title') state.title = value;
              else if (path === 'date') state.date = value || todayStr();
              else if (SECTION_KEYS.indexOf(path) >= 0) state[path] = value;
            }
            setState(state);
            try {
              if (typeof window.osrOnM0StateApplied === 'function') window.osrOnM0StateApplied(state);
            } catch (syncE) { console.warn('M0 importDocumentFromCsv REF sync', syncE); }
            alert('CSV imported successfully.');
          } catch (e) {
            alert('Could not import CSV: ' + (e.message || e));
          }
        };
        reader.readAsText(file, 'UTF-8');
      };
      input.click();
    }

    /** Called from shell when runtime opens a vessel-only CSV so RBI Data matches file (no embedded RBI). */
    function clearRbiDataStateForRuntime() {
      if (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED && typeof window.osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData === 'function') {
        window.osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData();
        return;
      }
      const state = { title: '', date: todayStr() };
      SECTION_KEYS.forEach(k => { state[k] = ''; });
      setState(state);
    }

    function gduMakeStaticPdfCell(text) {
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'gdu-pdf-static-cell';
      d.textContent = text == null ? '' : String(text);
      return d;
    }

    /** Clone M0 main and replace form controls with plain text so html2canvas can rasterize (avoids blank multi-page PDFs). */
    function gduFlattenDomForPdfCapture(mainEl) {
      const root = mainEl.cloneNode(true);
      root.querySelectorAll('textarea.raw-json').forEach(function(n) { n.remove(); });
      root.querySelectorAll('.table-actions').forEach(function(n) { n.remove(); });
      root.querySelectorAll('input[type="file"]').forEach(function(n) { n.remove(); });
      root.querySelectorAll('td.opt-del-cell').forEach(function(td) { td.remove(); });
      root.querySelectorAll('th, td').forEach(function(cell) {
        const kids = cell.children;
        if (kids.length === 1 && kids[0].classList && kids[0].classList.contains('row-del')) cell.remove();
      });
      var rmSemanticPdf = { red: '#c62828', orange: '#ef6c00', yellow: '#f9a825', blue: '#1565c0', green: '#2e7d32' };
      root.querySelectorAll('.risk-matrix-color-swatches').forEach(function(w) {
        var v = (w.getAttribute('data-selected-color') || '').trim();
        var box = document.createElement('div');
        box.className = 'gdu-pdf-static-cell';
        box.style.minHeight = '22px';
        box.style.display = 'flex';
        box.style.alignItems = 'center';
        if (!v) {
          box.textContent = '\u2014';
        } else {
          var sw = document.createElement('span');
          sw.style.display = 'inline-block';
          sw.style.width = '20px';
          sw.style.height = '20px';
          sw.style.borderRadius = '4px';
          sw.style.border = '1px solid #333';
          var low = v.toLowerCase();
          sw.style.backgroundColor = rmSemanticPdf[low] || v;
          box.appendChild(sw);
        }
        w.parentNode.replaceChild(box, w);
      });
      root.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b) { b.remove(); });
      root.querySelectorAll('input[type="hidden"]').forEach(function(n) { n.remove(); });
      root.querySelectorAll('textarea').forEach(function(ta) {
        ta.parentNode.replaceChild(gduMakeStaticPdfCell(ta.value), ta);
      });
      root.querySelectorAll('select').forEach(function(sel) {
        const opt = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex];
        const txt = opt ? String(opt.textContent || opt.value || '') : '';
        sel.parentNode.replaceChild(gduMakeStaticPdfCell(txt), sel);
      });
      root.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(function(inp) {
        const t = (inp.type || 'text').toLowerCase();
        if (t === 'checkbox' || t === 'radio') {
          inp.parentNode.replaceChild(gduMakeStaticPdfCell(inp.checked ? (inp.value || 'Yes') : ''), inp);
          return;
        }
        inp.parentNode.replaceChild(gduMakeStaticPdfCell(inp.value), inp);
      });
      root.querySelectorAll('.section').forEach(function(sec) {
        sec.classList.remove('collapsed');
      });
      root.querySelectorAll('.section .content').forEach(function(c) {
        c.style.display = 'block';
      });
      return root;
    }

    function saveAsPdf() {
      if (typeof html2pdf === 'undefined') {
        alert('PDF library not loaded. Check your connection and try again.');
        return;
      }
      expandAllSections();
      const title = (document.getElementById('gdu_docTitle') && document.getElementById('gdu_docTitle').value) || 'M0 RBI Data';
      const date = (document.getElementById('gdu_docDate') && document.getElementById('gdu_docDate').value) || todayStr();
      const filename = (title.replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || 'M0 RBI Data') + ' ' + date + '.pdf';
      const main = document.getElementById('gdu_main');
      if (!main) {
        alert('Report content is not available.');
        return;
      }
      const panel0 = document.getElementById('panel0');
      try {
        window.scrollTo(0, 0);
        if (panel0) panel0.scrollTop = 0;
        main.scrollTop = 0;
      } catch (eScroll) {}

      const reportHeader = document.createElement('div');
      reportHeader.id = 'gdu_pdfReportHeader';
      reportHeader.style.background = '#fff';
      reportHeader.style.color = '#000';
      reportHeader.style.padding = '10px 0 14px 0';
      reportHeader.style.borderBottom = '1px solid #000';
      reportHeader.style.marginBottom = '12px';
      reportHeader.innerHTML =
        '<h1 style="margin:0 0 6px 0;font-size:22px;font-weight:var(--osr-fw-heavy);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#000;background:#fff;">' + escapeAttr(title) + '</h1>' +
        '<div style="font-size:12px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#000;background:#fff;">Date: ' + escapeAttr(date) + '</div>';
      main.insertBefore(reportHeader, main.firstChild);

      function cleanupLiveHeader() {
        if (reportHeader && reportHeader.parentNode) reportHeader.parentNode.removeChild(reportHeader);
      }

      function runPdf() {
        let host = null;
        let flat = null;
        let innerWrap = null;
        const marginMm = [8, 8, 10, 8];
        const MM_TO_PX = 96 / 25.4;
        const pageWmm = 297;
        const pageHmm = 210;
        const usableWpx = (pageWmm - marginMm[1] - marginMm[3]) * MM_TO_PX;
        const usableHpx = (pageHmm - marginMm[0] - marginMm[2]) * MM_TO_PX;
        try {
          flat = gduFlattenDomForPdfCapture(main);
          host = document.createElement('div');
          host.id = 'gdu_pdf_capture_host';
          host.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          innerWrap = document.createElement('div');
          innerWrap.className = 'gdu-pdf-inner';
          const uw = Math.round(usableWpx);
          innerWrap.style.cssText = 'width:' + uw + 'px;max-width:100%;background:#fff;color:#000;overflow:visible;';
          host.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:-16000px;top:0;width:' + uw + 'px;max-width:100%;background:#fff;color:#000;overflow:visible;';
          flat.style.width = '100%';
          flat.style.maxWidth = '100%';
          flat.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
          flat.style.background = '#fff';
          flat.style.color = '#000';
          innerWrap.appendChild(flat);
          host.appendChild(innerWrap);
          document.body.appendChild(host);
        } catch (e0) {
          cleanupLiveHeader();
          alert('Could not prepare PDF: ' + (e0 && e0.message ? e0.message : String(e0)));
          return;
        }

        const opt = {
          margin: marginMm,
          filename: filename,
          image: { type: 'jpeg', quality: 0.92 },
          html2canvas: {
            scale: 1.15,
            useCORS: true,
            logging: false,
            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            scrollX: 0,
            scrollY: 0
          },
          jsPDF: { unit: 'mm', format: 'a4', orientation: 'landscape' },
          pagebreak: { mode: ['legacy'] }
        };

        function measureAndCapture() {
          try {
            var cw = Math.max(flat.scrollWidth, flat.offsetWidth, 1);
            var ch = Math.max(flat.scrollHeight, flat.offsetHeight, 1);
            var s = Math.min(usableWpx / cw, usableHpx / ch, 1);
            var SCALE_MIN = 0.14;
            flat.style.transform = '';
            flat.style.transformOrigin = '';
            innerWrap.style.height = '';
            innerWrap.style.overflow = 'visible';
            /* Shrink to fit one A4 landscape printable area (width and/or height); else multipage */
            if (s < 1 && s >= SCALE_MIN) {
              flat.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
              flat.style.transform = 'scale(' + s + ')';
              innerWrap.style.height = Math.min(Math.ceil(ch * s), Math.ceil(usableHpx)) + 'px';
              innerWrap.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }
          } catch (eM) { console.warn('gdu pdf measure', eM); }
          html2pdf().set(opt).from(innerWrap).save().then(function() {
            try {
              if (host && host.parentNode) host.parentNode.removeChild(host);
            } catch (e1) {}
            cleanupLiveHeader();
          }).catch(function() {
            try {
              if (host && host.parentNode) host.parentNode.removeChild(host);
            } catch (e2) {}
            cleanupLiveHeader();
            alert('Could not generate PDF report.');
          });
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
          requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            setTimeout(measureAndCapture, 50);
          });
        });
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
          setTimeout(runPdf, 40);
        });
      });
    }

    function elByLocal(id) {
      return document.getElementById(id) || document.getElementById('gdu_' + id);
    }
    function bindIfPresent(id, evt, handler) {
      const el = elByLocal(id);
      if (el) el.addEventListener(evt, handler);
    }
    /* Bind controls before heavy render so a throw there cannot skip listeners (e.g. M0 theme button). */
    window.osrSyncGduRootThemeFromShell = function(shellTheme) {
      const map = { dark: 'dark', grey: 'half-light', light: 'light' };
      const t = map[shellTheme] || 'dark';
      setTheme(t);
    };

    window.osrCaptureLockedM0Canonical = function() {
      if (!window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED) return;
      try {
        const prevCanon = window.__osrLockedM0Canonical;
        window.__osrLockedM0Canonical = null;

        if (!window.__osrLockedM0Canonical && prevCanon) window.__osrLockedM0Canonical = prevCanon;
      } catch (eCap) {

      }
    };

      window.osrCaptureLockedM0Canonical();
    }
    if (typeof window.osrEnforceLockedM0RbiData === 'function') {

    const csvImportEl = elByLocal('csvImportInput');
    if (csvImportEl) csvImportEl.addEventListener('change', function() {
      const key = csvImportKey;
      csvImportKey = null;
      const file = this.files && this.files[0];
      this.value = '';
      if (!key || !file) return;
      if (window.OSR_M0_RBI_DATA_LOCKED) {
        alert(typeof window.osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage === 'function' ? window.osrM0RbiDataLockedMessage() : 'M0 section import is disabled.');
        return;
      }
      if (key === 'location' && window.OSR_M0_LOCATION_LOCKED) {
        alert('Location is locked. Contact OpenRBI to change the approved site register.');
        return;
      }
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function() {
        const json = csvToSectionData(key, reader.result || '');
        const ta = document.getElementById('gdu_' + key);
        if (ta) { ta.value = json; renderSection(key); }
        try {
          if (typeof window.osrOnM0StateApplied === 'function') window.osrOnM0StateApplied(getState());
        } catch (syncE) { console.warn('M0 per-section CSV REF sync', syncE); }
      };
      reader.readAsText(file, 'UTF-8');
    });

    window.osrPeekM0Planning = function() {
      try {
        function planningCellCount(o) {
          return o && o.cells && typeof o.cells === 'object' && !Array.isArray(o.cells)
            ? Object.keys(o.cells).length
            : 0;
        }
        /** Merge planning objects; overlay (live table) wins same cell keys — keeps textarea/embed defaults when the table has no rows yet. */
        function mergePlanning(base, overlay) {
          if (!base && !overlay) return null;
          if (!overlay) return base;
          if (!base) return overlay;
          var out = {};
          var od = overlay.description != null ? String(overlay.description).trim() : '';
          out.description = od !== '' ? overlay.description : base.description;
          var cells = {};
          var k;
          if (base.cells && typeof base.cells === 'object') {
            for (k in base.cells) { if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(base.cells, k)) cells[k] = base.cells[k]; }
          }
          if (overlay.cells && typeof overlay.cells === 'object') {
            for (k in overlay.cells) { if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(overlay.cells, k)) cells[k] = overlay.cells[k]; }
          }
          out.cells = cells;
          return out;
        }

        var fromTable = null;
        if (typeof getSectionDataFromTable === 'function') {
          var json = getSectionDataFromTable('planning');
          if (json) {
            try { fromTable = JSON.parse(json); } catch (e0) { fromTable = null; }
          }
        }
        var fromTa = null;
        var ta = document.getElementById('gdu_planning');
        if (ta && ta.value && String(ta.value).trim()) {
          try { fromTa = JSON.parse(ta.value); } catch (e1) { fromTa = null; }
        }
        var fromState = null;
        if (typeof getState === 'function') {
          var st = getState();
          if (st && st.planning != null && st.planning !== '') {
            if (typeof st.planning === 'object') fromState = st.planning;
            else {
              var ps = String(st.planning).trim();
              if (ps) {
                try { fromState = JSON.parse(ps); } catch (e2) { fromState = null; }
              }
            }
          }
        }

        var merged = mergePlanning(fromTa || fromState, fromTable);
        if (merged && planningCellCount(merged) > 0) return merged;
        if (fromTable && planningCellCount(fromTable) > 0) return fromTable;
        if (fromTa && planningCellCount(fromTa) > 0) return fromTa;
        if (fromState && planningCellCount(fromState) > 0) return fromState;
        return merged || fromTable || fromTa || fromState || null;
      } catch (e) { console.warn('osrPeekM0Planning', e); }
      return null;
    };

    window.osrPeekM0PofMapping = function() {
      try {
        if (typeof getSectionDataFromTable === 'function') {
          const wrap = document.getElementById('gdu_pofMappingTable');
          if (wrap && wrap.querySelector('.data-table')) {
            const json = getSectionDataFromTable('pofMapping');
            if (json) {
              const arr = JSON.parse(json);
              return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : null;
            }
          }
        }
        const ta = document.getElementById('gdu_pofMapping');
        if (ta && ta.value && String(ta.value).trim()) {
          const arr = JSON.parse(ta.value);
          return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : null;
        }
      } catch (e) { console.warn('osrPeekM0PofMapping', e); }
      return null;
    };
